text_en: These are the names of the children of Israel , that went into Egypt with Jacob : they went in every man with his household :
text_la: Hæc sunt nomina filiorum Israël qui ingressi sunt in Ægyptum cum Jacob: singuli cum domibus suis introierunt:
text_pt: Estes pois são os nomes dos filhos de Israel, que entraram no Egito com Jacó; cada um entrou com sua casa:
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ τῶν εἰσπεπορευμένων εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἅμα Ιακωβ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτῶν ἕκαστος πανοικίᾳ αὐτῶν εἰσήλθοσαν

text_en: Ruben , Simeon , Levi , Juda ,
text_la: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Judas,
text_pt: Rúben, Simeão, Levi, e Judá;
text_el: Ρουβην Συμεων Λευι Ιουδας

text_en: Issachar , Zabulon , and Benjamin ,
text_la: Issachar, Zabulon et Benjamin,
text_pt: Issacar, Zebulom, e Benjamim;
text_el: Ισσαχαρ Ζαβουλων καὶ Βενιαμιν

text_en: Dan , and Nephthali , Gad and Aser .
text_la: Dan et Nephthali, Gad et Aser.
text_pt: Dã e Naftali, Gade e Aser.
text_el: Δαν καὶ Νεφθαλι Γαδ καὶ Ασηρ

text_en: And all the souls that came out of Jacob's thigh, were seventy: but Joseph was in Egypt .
text_la: Erant igitur omnes animæ eorum qui egressi sunt de femore Jacob, septuaginta : Joseph autem in Ægypto erat.
text_pt: Todas as almas, pois, que procederam dos lombos de Jacó, foram setenta almas; José, porém, estava no Egito.
text_el: Ιωσηφ δὲ ἦν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἦσαν δὲ πᾶσαι ψυχαὶ ἐξ Ιακωβ πέντε καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα

text_en: After he was dead, and all his brethren, and all that generation ,
text_la: Quo mortuo, et universis fratribus ejus, omnique cognatione illa,
text_pt: Faleceu José, e todos os seus irmãos, e toda aquela geração.
text_el: ἐτελεύτησεν δὲ Ιωσηφ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσα ἡ γενεὰ ἐκείνη

text_en: the children of Israel increased, and sprung up into multitudes, and growing exceedingly strong they filled the land.
text_la: filii Israël creverunt, et quasi germinantes multiplicati sunt : ac roborati nimis, impleverunt terram.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel frutificaram, aumentaram muito, e multiplicaram-se, e foram fortalecidos grandemente; de maneira que a terra se encheu deles.
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ηὐξήθησαν καὶ ἐπληθύνθησαν καὶ χυδαῖοι ἐγένοντο καὶ κατίσχυον σφόδρα σφόδρα ἐπλήθυνεν δὲ ἡ γῆ αὐτούς

text_en: In the mean time there arose a new king over Egypt , that knew not Joseph :
text_la: Surrexit interea rex novus super Ægyptum, qui ignorabat Joseph.
text_pt: E levantou-se um novo rei sobre o Egito, que não conhecera a José;
text_el: ἀνέστη δὲ βασιλεὺς ἕτερος ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον ὃς οὐκ ᾔδει τὸν Ιωσηφ

text_en: And he said to his people: Behold the people of the children of Israel are numerous and stronger than we.
text_la: Et ait ad populum suum : Ecce, populus filiorum Israël multus, et fortior nobis est.
text_pt: O qual disse ao seu povo: Eis que o povo dos filhos de Israel é muito, e mais poderoso do que nós.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ τῷ ἔθνει αὐτοῦ ἰδοὺ τὸ γένος τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ μέγα πλῆθος καὶ ἰσχύει ὑπὲρ ἡμᾶς

text_en: Come let us wisely oppress them, lest they multiply: and if any war shall rise against us, join with our enemies, and having overcome us, depart out of the land.
text_la: Venite, sapienter opprimamus eum, ne forte multiplicetur : et si ingruerit contra nos bellum, addatur inimicis nostris, expugnatisque nobis egrediatur de terra.
text_pt: Eia, usemos de sabedoria para com eles, para que não se multipliquem, e aconteça que, vindo guerra, eles também se ajuntem com os nossos inimigos, e pelejem contra nós, e subam da terra.
text_el: δεῦτε οὖν κατασοφισώμεθα αὐτούς μήποτε πληθυνθῇ καί ἡνίκα ἂν συμβῇ ἡμῖν πόλεμος προστεθήσονται καὶ οὗτοι πρὸς τοὺς ὑπεναντίους καὶ ἐκπολεμήσαντες ἡμᾶς ἐξελεύσονται ἐκ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Therefore he set over them masters of the works, to afflict them with burdens: and they built for Pharao cities of tabernacles, Phithom, and Ramesses.
text_la: Præposuit itaque eis magistros operum, ut affligerent eos oneribus : ædificaveruntque urbes tabernaculorum Pharaoni, Phithom et Ramesses.
text_pt: E puseram sobre eles maiorais de tributos, para os afligirem com suas cargas. Porque edificaram a Faraó cidades-armazéns, Pitom e Ramessés.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστησεν αὐτοῖς ἐπιστάτας τῶν ἔργων ἵνα κακώσωσιν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν πόλεις ὀχυρὰς τῷ Φαραω τήν τε Πιθωμ καὶ Ραμεσση καὶ Ων ἥ ἐστιν Ἡλίου πόλις

text_en: But the more they oppressed them, the more they were multiplied and increased.
text_la: Quantoque opprimebant eos, tanto magis multiplicabantur, et crescebant:
text_pt: Mas quanto mais os afligiam, tanto mais se multiplicavam, e tanto mais cresciam; de maneira que se enfadavam por causa dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καθότι δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐταπείνουν τοσούτῳ πλείους ἐγίνοντο καὶ ἴσχυον σφόδρα σφόδρα καὶ ἐβδελύσσοντο οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Egyptians hated the children of Israel , and afflicted them and mocked them:
text_la: oderantque filios Israël Ægyptii, et affligebant illudentes eis,
text_pt: E os egípcios faziam servir os filhos de Israel com dureza;
text_el: καὶ κατεδυνάστευον οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ βίᾳ

text_en: And they made their life bitter with hard works in clay and brick, and with all manner of service, wherewith they were overcharged in the works of the earth.
text_la: atque ad amaritudinem perducebant vitam eorum operibus duris luti et lateris, omnique famulatu, quo in terræ operibus premebantur.
text_pt: Assim que lhes fizeram amargar a vida com dura servidão, em barro e em tijolos, e com todo o trabalho no campo; com todo o seu serviço, em que os obrigavam com dureza.
text_el: καὶ κατωδύνων αὐτῶν τὴν ζωὴν ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς σκληροῖς τῷ πηλῷ καὶ τῇ πλινθείᾳ καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις κατὰ πάντα τὰ ἔργα ὧν κατεδουλοῦντο αὐτοὺς μετὰ βίας

text_en: And the king of Egypt spoke to the midwives of the Hebrews : of whom one was called Sephora, the other Phua,
text_la: Dixit autem rex Ægypti obstetricibus Hebræorum, quarum una vocabatur Sephora, altera Phua,
text_pt: E o rei do Egito falou às parteiras das hebréias (das quais o nome de uma era Sifrá, e o da outra Puá),
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ταῖς μαίαις τῶν Εβραίων τῇ μιᾷ αὐτῶν ᾗ ὄνομα Σεπφωρα καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς δευτέρας Φουα

text_en: commanding them: When you shall do the office of midwives to the Hebrew women , and the time of delivery has come: if it be a man child, kill it: if a woman , keep it alive.
text_la: præcipiens eis : Quando obstetricabitis Hebræas, et partus tempus advenerit : si masculus fuerit, interficite eum : si femina, reservate.
text_pt: E disse: Quando ajudardes a dar à luz às hebréias, e as virdes sobre os assentos, se for filho, matai-o; mas se for filha, então viva.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὅταν μαιοῦσθε τὰς Εβραίας καὶ ὦσιν πρὸς τῷ τίκτειν ἐὰν μὲν ἄρσεν ᾖ ἀποκτείνατε αὐτό ἐὰν δὲ θῆλυ περιποιεῖσθε αὐτό

text_en: But the midwives feared God , and did not do as the king of Egypt had commanded, but saved the men children.
text_la: Timuerunt autem obstetrices Deum, et non fecerunt juxta præceptum regis Ægypti, sed conservabant mares.
text_pt: As parteiras, porém, temeram a Deus e não fizeram como o rei do Egito lhes dissera, antes conservavam os meninos com vida.
text_el: ἐφοβήθησαν δὲ αἱ μαῖαι τὸν θεὸν καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησαν καθότι συνέταξεν αὐταῖς ὁ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐζωογόνουν τὰ ἄρσενα

text_en: And the king called for them and said: What is it that you meant to do, that you would save the men children?
text_la: Quibus ad se accersitis, rex ait : Quidnam est hoc quod facere voluistis, ut pueros servaretis?
text_pt: Então o rei do Egito chamou as parteiras e disse-lhes: Por que fizestes isto, deixando os meninos com vida?
text_el: ἐκάλεσεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου τὰς μαίας καὶ εἶπεν αὐταῖς τί ὅτι ἐποιήσατε τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο καὶ ἐζωογονεῖτε τὰ ἄρσενα

text_en: They answered: The Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women : for they themselves are skilful in the office of a midwife; and they are delivered before we come to them.
text_la: Quæ responderunt : Non sunt Hebreæ sicut ægyptiæ mulieres : ipsæ enim obstetricandi habent scientiam, et priusquam veniamus ad eas, pariunt.
text_pt: E as parteiras disseram a Faraó: É que as mulheres hebréias não são como as egípcias; porque são vivas, e já têm dado à luz antes que a parteira venha a elas.
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ αἱ μαῖαι τῷ Φαραω οὐχ ὡς γυναῖκες Αἰγύπτου αἱ Εβραῖαι τίκτουσιν γὰρ πρὶν ἢ εἰσελθεῖν πρὸς αὐτὰς τὰς μαίας καὶ ἔτικτον

text_en: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied and grew exceedingly strong.
text_la: Bene ergo fecit Deus obstetricibus : et crevit populus, confortatusque est nimis.
text_pt: Portanto Deus fez bem às parteiras. E o povo se aumentou, e se fortaleceu muito.
text_el: εὖ δὲ ἐποίει ὁ θεὸς ταῖς μαίαις καὶ ἐπλήθυνεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ἴσχυεν σφόδρα

text_en: And because the midwives feared God , he built them houses .
text_la: Et quia timuerunt obstetrices Deum, ædificavit eis domos.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, como as parteiras temeram a Deus, ele estabeleceu-lhes casas.
text_el: ἐπειδὴ ἐφοβοῦντο αἱ μαῖαι τὸν θεόν ἐποίησαν ἑαυταῖς οἰκίας

text_en: Pharao therefore charged all his people, saying: Whatsoever shall be born of the male sex, you shall cast into the river: whatsoever of the female, you shall save alive.
text_la: Præcepit ergo Pharao omni populo suo, dicens : Quidquid masculini sexus natum fuerit, in flumen projicite : quidquid feminini, reservate.
text_pt: Então ordenou Faraó a todo o seu povo, dizendo: A todos os filhos que nascerem lançareis no rio, mas a todas as filhas guardareis com vida.
text_el: συνέταξεν δὲ Φαραω παντὶ τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ λέγων πᾶν ἄρσεν ὃ ἐὰν τεχθῇ τοῖς Εβραίοις εἰς τὸν ποταμὸν ῥίψατε καὶ πᾶν θῆλυ ζωογονεῖτε αὐτό

text_en: After this there went a man of the house of Levi ; and took a wife of his own kindred .
text_la: Egressus est post hæc vir de domo Levi : et accepit uxorem stirpis suæ.
text_pt: E foi um homem da casa de Levi e casou com uma filha de Levi.
text_el: ἦν δέ τις ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Λευι ὃς ἔλαβεν τῶν θυγατέρων Λευι καὶ ἔσχεν αὐτήν

text_en: And she conceived, and bore a son : and seeing him a goodly child, hid him three months.
text_la: Quæ concepit, et peperit filium : et videns eum elegantem, abscondit tribus mensibus.
text_pt: E a mulher concebeu e deu à luz um filho; e, vendo que ele era formoso, escondeu-o três meses.
text_el: καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔλαβεν καὶ ἔτεκεν ἄρσεν ἰδόντες δὲ αὐτὸ ἀστεῖον ἐσκέπασαν αὐτὸ μῆνας τρεῖς

text_en: And when she could hide him no longer, she took a basket made of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and pitch: and put the little babe therein, and laid him in the sedges by the river's brink,
text_la: Cumque jam celare non posset, sumpsit fiscellam scirpeam, et linivit eam bitumine ac pice : posuitque intus infantulum, et exposuit eum in carecto ripæ fluminis,
text_pt: Não podendo, porém, mais escondê-lo, tomou uma arca de juncos, e a revestiu com barro e betume; e, pondo nela o menino, a pôs nos juncos à margem do rio.
text_el: ἐπεὶ δὲ οὐκ ἠδύναντο αὐτὸ ἔτι κρύπτειν ἔλαβεν αὐτῷ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ θῖβιν καὶ κατέχρισεν αὐτὴν ἀσφαλτοπίσσῃ καὶ ἐνέβαλεν τὸ παιδίον εἰς αὐτὴν καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὴν εἰς τὸ ἕλος παρὰ τὸν ποταμόν

text_en: his sister standing afar off, and taking notice what would be done.
text_la: stante procul sorore ejus, et considerante eventum rei.
text_pt: E sua irmã postou-se de longe, para saber o que lhe havia de acontecer.
text_el: καὶ κατεσκόπευεν ἡ ἀδελφὴ αὐτοῦ μακρόθεν μαθεῖν τί τὸ ἀποβησόμενον αὐτῷ

text_en: And behold the daughter of Pharao came down to wash herself in the river: and her maids walked by the river's brink. And when she saw the basket in the sedges she sent one of her maids for it: and when it was brought,
text_la: Ecce autem descendebat filia Pharaonis ut lavaretur in flumine : et puellæ ejus gradiebantur per crepidinem alvei. Quæ cum vidisset fiscellam in papyrione, misit unam e famulabus suis : et allatam
text_pt: E a filha de Faraó desceu a lavar-se no rio, e as suas donzelas passeavam, pela margem do rio; e ela viu a arca no meio dos juncos, e enviou a sua criada, que a tomou.
text_el: κατέβη δὲ ἡ θυγάτηρ Φαραω λούσασθαι ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμόν καὶ αἱ ἅβραι αὐτῆς παρεπορεύοντο παρὰ τὸν ποταμόν καὶ ἰδοῦσα τὴν θῖβιν ἐν τῷ ἕλει ἀποστείλασα τὴν ἅβραν ἀνείλατο αὐτήν

text_en: she opened it, and seeing within it an infant crying, having compassion on it, she said: This is one of the babes of the Hebrews .
text_la: aperiens, cernensque in ea parvulum vagientem, miserta ejus, ait : De infantibus Hebræorum est hic.
text_pt: E abrindo-a, viu ao menino e eis que o menino chorava; e moveu-se de compaixão dele, e disse: Dos meninos dos hebreus é este.
text_el: ἀνοίξασα δὲ ὁρᾷ παιδίον κλαῖον ἐν τῇ θίβει καὶ ἐφείσατο αὐτοῦ ἡ θυγάτηρ Φαραω καὶ ἔφη ἀπὸ τῶν παιδίων τῶν Εβραίων τοῦτο

text_en: And the child's sister said to her: Shall I go, and call to you a Hebrew woman , to nurse the babe?
text_la: Cui soror pueri : Vis, inquit, ut vadam, et vocem tibi mulierem hebræam, quæ nutrire possit infantulum?
text_pt: Então disse sua irmã à filha de Faraó: Irei chamar uma ama das hebréias, que crie este menino para ti?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ ἀδελφὴ αὐτοῦ τῇ θυγατρὶ Φαραω θέλεις καλέσω σοι γυναῖκα τροφεύουσαν ἐκ τῶν Εβραίων καὶ θηλάσει σοι τὸ παιδίον

text_en: She answered: Go. The maid went and called her mother.
text_la: Respondit : Vade. Perrexit puella et vocavit matrem suam.
text_pt: E a filha de Faraó disse-lhe: Vai. Foi, pois, a moça, e chamou a mãe do menino.
text_el: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ἡ θυγάτηρ Φαραω πορεύου ἐλθοῦσα δὲ ἡ νεᾶνις ἐκάλεσεν τὴν μητέρα τοῦ παιδίου

text_en: And Pharao's daughter said to her: Take this child, and nurse him for me: I will give you your wages. The woman took and nursed the child: and when he was grown up, she delivered him to Pharao's daughter.
text_la: Ad quam locuta filia Pharaonis : Accipe, ait, puerum istum, et nutri mihi : ego dabo tibi mercedem tuam. Suscepit mulier, et nutrivit puerum : adultumque tradidit filiæ Pharaonis.
text_pt: Então lhe disse a filha de Faraó: Leva este menino, e cria-mo; eu te darei teu salário. E a mulher tomou o menino, e criou-o.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν ἡ θυγάτηρ Φαραω διατήρησόν μοι τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο καὶ θήλασόν μοι αὐτό ἐγὼ δὲ δώσω σοι τὸν μισθόν ἔλαβεν δὲ ἡ γυνὴ τὸ παιδίον καὶ ἐθήλαζεν αὐτό

text_en: And she adopted him for a son, and called him Moses , saying: Because I took him out of the water.
text_la: Quem illa adoptavit in locum filii, vocavitque nomen ejus Moyses, dicens : Quia de aqua tuli eum.
text_pt: E, quando o menino já era grande, ela o trouxe à filha de Faraó, a qual o adotou; e chamou-lhe Moisés, e disse: Porque das águas o tenho tirado.
text_el: ἁδρυνθέντος δὲ τοῦ παιδίου εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὸ πρὸς τὴν θυγατέρα Φαραω καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτῇ εἰς υἱόν ἐπωνόμασεν δὲ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Μωυσῆν λέγουσα ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος αὐτὸν ἀνειλόμην

text_en: In those days, after Moses was grown up, he went out to his brethren: and saw their affliction, and an Egyptian striking one of the Hebrews , his brethren.
text_la: In diebus illis postquam creverat Moyses, egressus est ad fratres suos : viditque afflictionem eorum, et virum ægyptium percutientem quemdam de Hebræis fratribus suis.
text_pt: E aconteceu naqueles dias que, sendo Moisés já homem, saiu a seus irmãos, e atentou para as suas cargas; e viu que um egípcio feria a um hebreu, homem de seus irmãos.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταῖς πολλαῖς ἐκείναις μέγας γενόμενος Μωυσῆς ἐξήλθεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ κατανοήσας δὲ τὸν πόνον αὐτῶν ὁρᾷ ἄνθρωπον Αἰγύπτιον τύπτοντά τινα Εβραῖον τῶν ἑαυτοῦ ἀδελφῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And when he had looked about this way and that way, and saw no one there, he slew the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
text_la: Cumque circumspexisset huc atque illuc, et nullum adesse vidisset, percussum Ægyptium abscondit sabulo.
text_pt: E olhou a um e a outro lado e, vendo que não havia ninguém ali, matou ao egípcio, e escondeu-o na areia.
text_el: περιβλεψάμενος δὲ ὧδε καὶ ὧδε οὐχ ὁρᾷ οὐδένα καὶ πατάξας τὸν Αἰγύπτιον ἔκρυψεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἄμμῳ

text_en: And going out the next day, he saw two Hebrews quarrelling: and he said to him that did the wrong: Why do you strike your neighbour?
text_la: Et egressus die altero conspexit duos Hebræos rixantes : dixitque ei qui faciebat injuriam : Quare percutis proximum tuum?
text_pt: E tornou a sair no dia seguinte, e eis que dois homens hebreus contendiam; e disse ao injusto: Por que feres a teu próximo?
text_el: ἐξελθὼν δὲ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ δευτέρᾳ ὁρᾷ δύο ἄνδρας Εβραίους διαπληκτιζομένους καὶ λέγει τῷ ἀδικοῦντι διὰ τί σὺ τύπτεις τὸν πλησίον

text_en: But he answered: Who has appointed you prince and judge over us? Will you kill me, as you yesterday killed the Egyptian ? Moses feared , and said: How is this come to be known ?
text_la: Qui respondit : Quis te constituit principem et judicem super nos? num occidere me tu vis, sicut heri occidisti Ægyptium? Timuit Moyses, et ait : Quomodo palam factum est verbum istud?
text_pt: O qual disse: Quem te tem posto a ti por maioral e juiz sobre nós? Pensas matar-me, como mataste o egípcio? Então temeu Moisés, e disse: Certamente este negócio foi descoberto.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν τίς σε κατέστησεν ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστὴν ἐφ' ἡμῶν μὴ ἀνελεῖν με σὺ θέλεις ὃν τρόπον ἀνεῖλες ἐχθὲς τὸν Αἰγύπτιον ἐφοβήθη δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ εἶπεν εἰ οὕτως ἐμφανὲς γέγονεν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: And Pharao heard of this word, and sought to kill Moses : but he fled from his sight, and abode in the land of Madian , and he sat down by a well .
text_la: Audivitque Pharao sermonem hunc, et quærebat occidere Moysen : qui fugiens de conspectu ejus, moratus est in terra Madian, et sedit juxta puteum.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, Faraó este caso, procurou matar a Moisés; mas Moisés fugiu de diante da face de Faraó, e habitou na terra de Midiã, e assentou-se junto a um poço.
text_el: ἤκουσεν δὲ Φαραω τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο καὶ ἐζήτει ἀνελεῖν Μωυσῆν ἀνεχώρησεν δὲ Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ προσώπου Φαραω καὶ ᾤκησεν ἐν γῇ Μαδιαμ ἐλθὼν δὲ εἰς γῆν Μαδιαμ ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ τοῦ φρέατος

text_en: And the priest of Madian had seven daughters, who came to draw water: and when the troughs were filled, desired to water their father's flocks.
text_la: Erant autem sacerdoti Madian septem filiæ, quæ venerunt ad hauriendam aquam : et impletis canalibus adaquare cupiebant greges patris sui.
text_pt: E o sacerdote de Midiã tinha sete filhas, as quais vieram tirar água, e encheram os bebedouros, para dar de beber ao rebanho de seu pai.
text_el: τῷ δὲ ἱερεῖ Μαδιαμ ἦσαν ἑπτὰ θυγατέρες ποιμαίνουσαι τὰ πρόβατα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν Ιοθορ παραγενόμεναι δὲ ἤντλουν ἕως ἔπλησαν τὰς δεξαμενὰς ποτίσαι τὰ πρόβατα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν Ιοθορ

text_en: And the shepherds came and drove them away: and Moses arose, and defending the maids, watered their sheep.
text_la: Supervenere pastores, et ejecerunt eas : surrexitque Moyses, et defensis puellis, adaquavit oves earum.
text_pt: Então vieram os pastores, e expulsaram-nas dali; Moisés, porém, levantou-se e defendeu-as, e deu de beber ao rebanho.
text_el: παραγενόμενοι δὲ οἱ ποιμένες ἐξέβαλον αὐτάς ἀναστὰς δὲ Μωυσῆς ἐρρύσατο αὐτὰς καὶ ἤντλησεν αὐταῖς καὶ ἐπότισεν τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῶν

text_en: And when they returned to Raguel their father, he said to them: Why have you come sooner than usual?
text_la: Quæ cum revertissent ad Raguel patrem suum, dixit ad eas : Cur velocius venistis solito?
text_pt: E voltando elas a Reuel seu pai, ele disse: Por que hoje tornastes tão depressa?
text_el: παρεγένοντο δὲ πρὸς Ραγουηλ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐταῖς τί ὅτι ἐταχύνατε τοῦ παραγενέσθαι σήμερον

text_en: They answered: A man of Egypt delivered us from the hands of the shepherds: and he drew water also with us, and gave the sheep to drink.
text_la: Responderunt : Vir ægyptius liberavit nos de manu pastorum : insuper et hausit aquam nobiscum, potumque dedit ovibus.
text_pt: E elas disseram: Um homem egípcio nos livrou da mão dos pastores; e também nos tirou água em abundância, e deu de beber ao rebanho.
text_el: αἱ δὲ εἶπαν ἄνθρωπος Αἰγύπτιος ἐρρύσατο ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῶν ποιμένων καὶ ἤντλησεν ἡμῖν καὶ ἐπότισεν τὰ πρόβατα ἡμῶν

text_en: But he said: Where is he? Why have you let the man go? Call him that he may eat bread.
text_la: At ille : Ubi est? inquit : quare dimisistis hominem? vocate eum ut comedat panem.
text_pt: E disse a suas filhas: E onde está ele? Por que deixastes o homem? Chamai-o para que coma pão.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ταῖς θυγατράσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ποῦ ἐστι καὶ ἵνα τί οὕτως καταλελοίπατε τὸν ἄνθρωπον καλέσατε οὖν αὐτόν ὅπως φάγῃ ἄρτον

text_en: And Moses swore that he would dwell with him. And he took Sephora his daughter to wife:
text_la: Juravit ergo Moyses quod habitaret cum eo. Accepitque Sephoram filiam ejus uxorem:
text_pt: E Moisés consentiu em morar com aquele homem; e ele deu a Moisés sua filha Zípora,
text_el: κατῳκίσθη δὲ Μωυσῆς παρὰ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ καὶ ἐξέδοτο Σεπφωραν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ Μωυσῇ γυναῖκα

text_en: And she bore him a son, whom he called Gersam, saying: I have been a stranger in a foreign country. And she bore another, whom he called Eliezer, saying: For the God of my father, my helper, has delivered me out of the hand of Pharao .
text_la: quæ peperit ei filium, quem vocavit Gersam, dicens : Advena fui in terra aliena. Alterum vero peperit, quem vocavit Eliezer, dicens : Deus enim patris mei adjutor meus eripuit me de manu Pharaonis.
text_pt: A qual deu à luz um filho, a quem ele chamou Gérson, porque disse: Peregrino fui em terra estranha.
text_el: ἐν γαστρὶ δὲ λαβοῦσα ἡ γυνὴ ἔτεκεν υἱόν καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν Μωυσῆς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Γηρσαμ λέγων ὅτι πάροικός εἰμι ἐν γῇ ἀλλοτρίᾳ

text_en: Now after a long time the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel groaning, cried out because of the works: and their cry went up unto God from the works.
text_la: Post multum vero tempore mortuus est rex Ægypti : et ingemiscentes filii Israël, propter opera vociferati sunt : ascenditque clamor eorum ad Deum ab operibus.
text_pt: E aconteceu, depois de muitos dias, que morrendo o rei do Egito, os filhos de Israel suspiraram por causa da servidão, e clamaram; e o seu clamor subiu a Deus por causa de sua servidão.
text_el: μετὰ δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας τὰς πολλὰς ἐκείνας ἐτελεύτησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου καὶ κατεστέναξαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων καὶ ἀνεβόησαν καὶ ἀνέβη ἡ βοὴ αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων

text_en: And he heard their groaning, and remembered the covenant which he made with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
text_la: Et audivit gemitum eorum, ac recordatus est fœderis quod pepigit cum Abraham, Isaac et Jacob.
text_pt: E ouviu Deus o seu gemido, e lembrou-se Deus da sua aliança com Abraão, com Isaque, e com Jacó;
text_el: καὶ εἰσήκουσεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν στεναγμὸν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐμνήσθη ὁ θεὸς τῆς διαθήκης αὐτοῦ τῆς πρὸς Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ

text_en: And the Lord looked upon the children of Israel , and he knew them.
text_la: Et respexit Dominus filios Israël et cognovit eos.
text_pt: E viu Deus os filhos de Israel, e atentou Deus para a sua condição.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεῖδεν ὁ θεὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐγνώσθη αὐτοῖς

text_en: Now Moses fed the sheep of Jethro, his father in law, the priest of Madian : and he drove the flock to the inner parts of the desert , and came to the mountain of God , Horeb .
text_la: Moyses autem pascebat oves Jethro soceri sui sacerdotis Madian : cumque minasset gregem ad interiora deserti, venit ad montem Dei Horeb.
text_pt: E apascentava Moisés o rebanho de Jetro, seu sogro, sacerdote em Midiã; e levou o rebanho atrás do deserto, e chegou ao monte de Deus, a Horebe.
text_el: καὶ Μωυσῆς ἦν ποιμαίνων τὰ πρόβατα Ιοθορ τοῦ γαμβροῦ αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἱερέως Μαδιαμ καὶ ἤγαγεν τὰ πρόβατα ὑπὸ τὴν ἔρημον καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος Χωρηβ

text_en: And the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he saw that the bush was on fire, and was not burnt.
text_la: Apparuitque ei Dominus in flamma ignis de medio rubi : et videbat quod rubus arderet, et non combureretur.
text_pt: E apareceu-lhe o anjo do Senhor em uma chama de fogo do meio duma sarça; e olhou, e eis que a sarça ardia no fogo, e a sarça não se consumia.
text_el: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐν φλογὶ πυρὸς ἐκ τοῦ βάτου καὶ ὁρᾷ ὅτι ὁ βάτος καίεται πυρί ὁ δὲ βάτος οὐ κατεκαίετο

text_en: And Moses said: I will go, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
text_la: Dixit ergo Moyses : Vadam, et videbo visionem hanc magnam, quare non comburatur rubus.
text_pt: E Moisés disse: Agora me virarei para lá, e verei esta grande visão, porque a sarça não se queima.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς παρελθὼν ὄψομαι τὸ ὅραμα τὸ μέγα τοῦτο τί ὅτι οὐ κατακαίεται ὁ βάτος

text_en: And when the Lord saw that he went forward to see, he called to him out of the midst of the bush and said: Moses , Moses . And he answered: Here I am.
text_la: Cernens autem Dominus quod pergeret ad videndum, vocavit eum de medio rubi, et ait : Moyses, Moyses. Qui respondit : Adsum.
text_pt: E vendo o Senhor que se virava para ver, bradou Deus a ele do meio da sarça, e disse: Moisés, Moisés. Respondeu ele: Eis-me aqui.
text_el: ὡς δὲ εἶδεν κύριος ὅτι προσάγει ἰδεῖν ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν κύριος ἐκ τοῦ βάτου λέγων Μωυσῆ Μωυσῆ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν τί ἐστιν

text_en: And he said: Come not near hither, put off the shoes from your feet; for the place, whereon you stand, is holy ground.
text_la: At ille : Ne appropies, inquit, huc : solve calceamentum de pedibus tuis : locus enim, in quo stas, terra sancta est.
text_pt: E disse: Não te chegues para cá; tira os sapatos de teus pés; porque o lugar em que tu estás é terra santa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν μὴ ἐγγίσῃς ὧδε λῦσαι τὸ ὑπόδημα ἐκ τῶν ποδῶν σου ὁ γὰρ τόπος ἐν ᾧ σὺ ἕστηκας γῆ ἁγία ἐστίν

text_en: And he said: I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . Moses hid his face: for he dared not look at God .
text_la: Et ait : Ego sum Deus patris tui, Deus Abraham, Deus Isaac et Deus Jacob. Abscondit Moyses faciem suam : non enim audebat aspicere contra Deum.
text_pt: Disse mais: Eu sou o Deus de teu pai, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó. E Moisés encobriu o seu rosto, porque temeu olhar para Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεὸς τοῦ πατρός σου θεὸς Αβρααμ καὶ θεὸς Ισαακ καὶ θεὸς Ιακωβ ἀπέστρεψεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ εὐλαβεῖτο γὰρ κατεμβλέψαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said to him: I have seen the affliction of my people in Egypt , and I have heard their cry because of the rigour of them that are over the works;
text_la: Cui ait Dominus : Vidi afflictionem populi mei in Ægypto, et clamorem ejus audivi propter duritiam eorum qui præsunt operibus:
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Tenho visto atentamente a aflição do meu povo, que está no Egito, e tenho ouvido o seu clamor por causa dos seus exatores, porque conheci as suas dores.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἰδὼν εἶδον τὴν κάκωσιν τοῦ λαοῦ μου τοῦ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ τῆς κραυγῆς αὐτῶν ἀκήκοα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐργοδιωκτῶν οἶδα γὰρ τὴν ὀδύνην αὐτῶν

text_en: and knowing their sorrow, I have come down to deliver them out of the hands of the Egyptians , and to bring them out of that land into a good and spacious land, into a land that flows with milk and honey, to the places of the Chanaanite , and Hethite , and Amorrhite , and Pherezite, and Hevite, and Jebusite.
text_la: et sciens dolorem ejus, descendi ut liberem eum de manibus Ægyptiorum, et educam de terra illa in terram bonam, et spatiosam, in terram quæ fluit lacte et melle, ad loca Chananæi et Hethæi, et Amorrhæi, et Pherezæi, et Hevæi, et Jebusæi.
text_pt: Portanto desci para livrá-lo da mão dos egípcios, e para fazê-lo subir daquela terra, a uma terra boa e larga, a uma terra que mana leite e mel; ao lugar do cananeu, e do heteu, e do amorreu, e do perizeu, e do heveu, e do jebuseu.
text_el: καὶ κατέβην ἐξελέσθαι αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς Αἰγυπτίων καὶ ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐκείνης καὶ εἰσαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς γῆν ἀγαθὴν καὶ πολλήν εἰς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι εἰς τὸν τόπον τῶν Χαναναίων καὶ Χετταίων καὶ Αμορραίων καὶ Φερεζαίων καὶ Γεργεσαίων καὶ Ευαίων καὶ Ιεβουσαίων

text_en: For the cry of the children of Israel has come unto me: and I have seen their affliction, wherewith they are oppressed by the Egyptians .
text_la: Clamor ergo filiorum Israël venit ad me : vidique afflictionem eorum, qua ab Ægyptiis opprimuntur.
text_pt: E agora, eis que o clamor dos filhos de Israel é vindo a mim, e também tenho visto a opressão com que os egípcios os oprimem.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ κραυγὴ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἥκει πρός με κἀγὼ ἑώρακα τὸν θλιμμόν ὃν οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι θλίβουσιν αὐτούς

text_en: But come, and I will send you to Pharao , that you may bring forth my people, the children of Israel , out of Egypt .
text_la: Sed veni, et mittam te ad Pharaonem, ut educas populum meum, filios Israël, de Ægypto.
text_pt: Vem agora, pois, e eu te enviarei a Faraó para que tires o meu povo (os filhos de Israel) do Egito.
text_el: καὶ νῦν δεῦρο ἀποστείλω σε πρὸς Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐξάξεις τὸν λαόν μου τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And Moses said to God : Who am I that I should go to Pharao , and should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt ?
text_la: Dixitque Moyses ad Deum : Quis sum ego ut vadam ad Pharaonem, et educam filios Israël de Ægypto?
text_pt: Então Moisés disse a Deus: Quem sou eu, que vá a Faraó e tire do Egito os filhos de Israel?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν θεόν τίς εἰμι ὅτι πορεύσομαι πρὸς Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ὅτι ἐξάξω τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And he said to him: I will be with you; and this you shall have for a sign that I have sent you: When you shall have brought my people out of Egypt , you shall offer sacrifice to God upon this mountain .
text_la: Qui dixit ei : Ego ero tecum : et hoc habebis signum, quod miserim te : cum eduxeris populum meum de Ægypto, immolabis Deo super montem istum.
text_pt: E disse: Certamente eu serei contigo; e isto te será por sinal de que eu te enviei: Quando houveres tirado este povo do Egito, servireis a Deus neste monte.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς Μωυσεῖ λέγων ὅτι ἔσομαι μετὰ σοῦ καὶ τοῦτό σοι τὸ σημεῖον ὅτι ἐγώ σε ἐξαποστέλλω ἐν τῷ ἐξαγαγεῖν σε τὸν λαόν μου ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ λατρεύσετε τῷ θεῷ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ

text_en: Moses said to God : Lo, I shall go to the children of Israel , and say to them: The God of your fathers has sent me to you. If they shall say to me: What is his name ? What shall I say to them?
text_la: Ait Moyses ad Deum : Ecce ego vadam ad filios Israël, et dicam eis : Deus patrum vestrorum misit me ad vos. Si dixerint mihi : Quod est nomen ejus? quid dicam eis?
text_pt: Então disse Moisés a Deus: Eis que quando eu for aos filhos de Israel, e lhes disser: O Deus de vossos pais me enviou a vós; e eles me disserem: Qual é o seu nome? Que lhes direi?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν θεόν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐλεύσομαι πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρῶ πρὸς αὐτούς ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν ἀπέσταλκέν με πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐρωτήσουσίν με τί ὄνομα αὐτῷ τί ἐρῶ πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: God said to Moses : I AM WHO AM . He said: Thus shall you say to the children of Israel : HE WHO IS , has sent me to you.
text_la: Dixit Deus ad Moysen : Ego sum qui sum. Ait : Sic dices filiis Israël : Qui est, misit me ad vos.
text_pt: E disse Deus a Moisés: EU SOU O QUE SOU. Disse mais: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: EU SOU me enviou a vós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ὤν καὶ εἶπεν οὕτως ἐρεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ὁ ὢν ἀπέσταλκέν με πρὸς ὑμᾶς

text_en: And God said again to Moses : Thus shall you say to the children of Israel : The Lord God of your fathers the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob has sent me to you; this is my name for ever , and this is my memorial unto all generations .
text_la: Dixitque iterum Deus ad Moysen : Hæc dices filiis Israël : Dominus Deus patrum vestrorum, Deus Abraham, Deus Isaac et Deus Jacob, misit me ad vos : hoc nomen mihi est in æternum, et hoc memoriale meum in generationem et generationem.
text_pt: E Deus disse mais a Moisés: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: O Senhor Deus de vossos pais, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó, me enviou a vós; este é meu nome eternamente, e este é meu memorial de geração em geração.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς πάλιν πρὸς Μωυσῆν οὕτως ἐρεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν θεὸς Αβρααμ καὶ θεὸς Ισαακ καὶ θεὸς Ιακωβ ἀπέσταλκέν με πρὸς ὑμᾶς τοῦτό μού ἐστιν ὄνομα αἰώνιον καὶ μνημόσυνον γενεῶν γενεαῖς

text_en: Go and gather together the ancients of Israel , and you shall say to them: The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , has appeared to me, saying: Visiting I have visited you; and I have seen all that has befallen you in Egypt .
text_la: Vade, et congrega seniores Israël, et dices ad eos : Dominus Deus patrum vestrorum apparuit mihi, Deus Abraham, Deus Isaac et Deus Jacob, dicens : Visitans visitavi vos : et vidi omnia quæ acciderunt vobis in Ægypto.
text_pt: Vai, e ajunta os anciãos de Israel e dize-lhes: O Senhor Deus de vossos pais, o Deus de Abraão, de Isaque e de Jacó, me apareceu, dizendo: Certamente vos tenho visitado e visto o que vos é feito no Egito.
text_el: ἐλθὼν οὖν συνάγαγε τὴν γερουσίαν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν ὦπταί μοι θεὸς Αβρααμ καὶ θεὸς Ισαακ καὶ θεὸς Ιακωβ λέγων ἐπισκοπῇ ἐπέσκεμμαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ὅσα συμβέβηκεν ὑμῖν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: And I have said the word to bring you forth out of the affliction of Egypt , into the land of the Chanaanite , and Hethite , and Amorrhite , and Pherezite, and Hevite, and Jebusite, to a land that flows with milk and honey.
text_la: Et dixi ut educam vos de afflictione Ægypti in terram Chananæi, et Hethæi, et Amorrhæi, et Pherezæi, et Hevæi, et Jebusæi, ad terram fluentem lacte et melle.
text_pt: Portanto eu disse: Far-vos-ei subir da aflição do Egito à terra do cananeu, do heteu, do amorreu, do perizeu, do heveu e do jebuseu, a uma terra que mana leite e mel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον ἀναβιβάσω ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῆς κακώσεως τῶν Αἰγυπτίων εἰς τὴν γῆν τῶν Χαναναίων καὶ Χετταίων καὶ Αμορραίων καὶ Φερεζαίων καὶ Γεργεσαίων καὶ Ευαίων καὶ Ιεβουσαίων εἰς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι

text_en: And they shall hear your voice; and you shall go in, you and the ancients of Israel , to the king of Egypt , and you shall say to him: The Lord God of the Hebrews has called us; we will go three days' journey into the wilderness , to sacrifice unto the Lord our God .
text_la: Et audient vocem tuam : ingredierisque tu, et seniores Israël, ad regem Ægypti, et dices ad eum : Dominus Deus Hebræorum vocavit nos : ibimus viam trium dierum in solitudinem, ut immolemus Domino Deo nostro.
text_pt: E ouvirão a tua voz; e irás, tu com os anciãos de Israel, ao rei do Egito, e dir-lhe-eis: O Senhor Deus dos hebreus nos encontrou. Agora, pois, deixa-nos ir caminho de três dias para o deserto, para que sacrifiquemos ao Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἰσακούσονταί σου τῆς φωνῆς καὶ εἰσελεύσῃ σὺ καὶ ἡ γερουσία Ισραηλ πρὸς Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτόν ὁ θεὸς τῶν Εβραίων προσκέκληται ἡμᾶς πορευσώμεθα οὖν ὁδὸν τριῶν ἡμερῶν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ἵνα θύσωμεν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν

text_en: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go, but by a mighty hand.
text_la: Sed ego scio quod non dimittet vos rex Ægypti ut eatis nisi per manum validam.
text_pt: Eu sei, porém, que o rei do Egito não vos deixará ir, nem ainda por uma mão forte.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ οἶδα ὅτι οὐ προήσεται ὑμᾶς Φαραω βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου πορευθῆναι ἐὰν μὴ μετὰ χειρὸς κραταιᾶς

text_en: For I will stretch forth my hand, and will strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst of them: after these he will let you go.
text_la: Extendam enim manum meam, et percutiam Ægyptum in cunctis mirabilibus meis, quæ facturus sum in medio eorum : post hæc dimittet vos.
text_pt: Porque eu estenderei a minha mão, e ferirei ao Egito com todas as minhas maravilhas que farei no meio dele; depois vos deixará ir.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα πατάξω τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς θαυμασίοις μου οἷς ποιήσω ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξαποστελεῖ ὑμᾶς

text_en: And I will give favour to this people, in the sight of the Egyptians : and when you go forth, you shall not depart empty:
text_la: Daboque gratiam populo huic coram Ægyptiis : et cum egrediemini, non exibitis vacui:
text_pt: E eu darei graça a este povo aos olhos dos egípcios; e acontecerá que, quando sairdes, não saireis vazios,
text_el: καὶ δώσω χάριν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ἐναντίον τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ὅταν δὲ ἀποτρέχητε οὐκ ἀπελεύσεσθε κενοί

text_en: But every woman shall ask of her neighbour, and of her that is in her house, vessels of silver and of gold, and raiment: and you shall put them on your sons and daughters, and shall spoil Egypt .
text_la: sed postulabit mulier a vicina sua et ab hospita sua, vasa argentea et aurea, ac vestes : ponetisque eas super filios et filias vestras, et spoliabitis Ægyptum.
text_pt: Porque cada mulher pedirá à sua vizinha e à sua hóspeda jóias de prata, e jóias de ouro, e vestes, as quais poreis sobre vossos filhos e sobre vossas filhas; e despojareis os egípcios.
text_el: αἰτήσει γυνὴ παρὰ γείτονος καὶ συσκήνου αὐτῆς σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ καὶ χρυσᾶ καὶ ἱματισμόν καὶ ἐπιθήσετε ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν καὶ σκυλεύσετε τοὺς Αἰγυπτίους

text_en: Moses answered, and said: They will not believe me, nor hear my voice, but they will say: The Lord has not appeared to you.
text_la: Respondens Moyses ait : Non credent mihi, neque audient vocem meam, sed dicent : Non apparuit tibi Dominus.
text_pt: Então respondeu Moisés, e disse: Mas eis que não me crerão, nem ouvirão a minha voz, porque dirão: O SENHOR não te apareceu.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ εἶπεν ἐὰν οὖν μὴ πιστεύσωσίν μοι μηδὲ εἰσακούσωσιν τῆς φωνῆς μου ἐροῦσιν γὰρ ὅτι οὐκ ὦπταί σοι ὁ θεός τί ἐρῶ πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: Then he said to him: What is that you hold in your hand? He answered: A rod.
text_la: Dixit ergo ad eum : Quid est quod tenes in manu tua? Respondit : Virga.
text_pt: E o Senhor disse-lhe: Que é isso na tua mão? E ele disse: Uma vara.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ κύριος τί τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ῥάβδος

text_en: And the Lord said: Cast it down upon the ground. He cast it down, and it was turned into a serpent, so that Moses fled from it.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus : Projice eam in terram. Projecit, et versa est in colubrum, ita ut fugeret Moyses.
text_pt: E ele disse: Lança-a na terra. Ele a lançou na terra, e tornou-se em cobra; e Moisés fugia dela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ῥῖψον αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἔρριψεν αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐγένετο ὄφις καὶ ἔφυγεν Μωυσῆς ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said: Put out your hand, and take it by the tail. He put forth his hand, and took hold of it, and it was turned into a rod.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus : Extende manum tuam, et apprehende caudam ejus. Extendit, et tenuit, versaque est in virgam.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Estende a tua mão e pega-lhe pela cauda. E estendeu sua mão, e pegou-lhe pela cauda, e tornou-se em vara na sua mão;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρα καὶ ἐπιλαβοῦ τῆς κέρκου ἐκτείνας οὖν τὴν χεῖρα ἐπελάβετο τῆς κέρκου καὶ ἐγένετο ῥάβδος ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: That they may believe , says he, that the Lord God of their fathers, the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , has appeared to you.
text_la: Ut credant, inquit, quod apparuerit tibi Dominus Deus patrum suorum, Deus Abraham, Deus Isaac et Deus Jacob.
text_pt: Para que creiam que te apareceu o Senhor Deus de seus pais, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque e o Deus de Jacó.
text_el: ἵνα πιστεύσωσίν σοι ὅτι ὦπταί σοι κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν θεὸς Αβρααμ καὶ θεὸς Ισαακ καὶ θεὸς Ιακωβ

text_en: And the Lord said again: Put your hand into your bosom. And when he had put it into his bosom, he brought it forth leprous as snow.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus rursum : Mitte manum tuam in sinum tuum. Quam cum misisset in sinum, protulit leprosam instar nivis.
text_pt: E disse-lhe mais o Senhor: Põe agora a tua mão no teu seio. E, tirando-a, eis que a sua mão estava leprosa, branca como a neve.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ κύριος πάλιν εἰσένεγκε τὴν χεῖρά σου εἰς τὸν κόλπον σου καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ κόλπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγενήθη ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ χιών

text_en: And he said: Put back your hand into your bosom. He put it back, and brought it out again, and it was like the other flesh.
text_la: Retrahe, ait, manum tuam in sinum tuum. Retraxit, et protulit iterum, et erat similis carni reliquæ.
text_pt: E disse: Torna a por a tua mão no teu seio. E tornou a colocar sua mão no seu seio; depois tirou-a do seu seio, e eis que se tornara como a sua carne.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πάλιν εἰσένεγκε τὴν χεῖρά σου εἰς τὸν κόλπον σου καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν τὴν χεῖρα εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν αὐτὴν ἐκ τοῦ κόλπου αὐτοῦ καὶ πάλιν ἀπεκατέστη εἰς τὴν χρόαν τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: If they will not believe you, says he, nor hear the voice of the former sign , they will believe the word of the latter sign .
text_la: Si non crediderint, inquit, tibi, neque audierint sermonem signi prioris, credent verbo signi sequentis.
text_pt: E acontecerá que, se eles não te crerem, nem ouvirem a voz do primeiro sinal, crerão à voz do derradeiro sinal;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ πιστεύσωσίν σοι μηδὲ εἰσακούσωσιν τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ σημείου τοῦ πρώτου πιστεύσουσίν σοι τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ σημείου τοῦ ἐσχάτου

text_en: But if they will not even believe these two signs , nor hear your voice: take of the river water, and pour it out upon the dry land, and whatsoever you draw out of the river, shall be turned into blood.
text_la: Quod si nec duobus quidem his signis crediderint, neque audierint vocem tuam : sume aquam fluminis, et effunde eam super aridam, et quidquid hauseris de fluvio, vertetur in sanguinem.
text_pt: E se acontecer que ainda não creiam a estes dois sinais, nem ouvirem a tua voz, tomarás das águas do rio, e as derramarás na terra seca; e as águas, que tomarás do rio, tornar-se-ão em sangue sobre a terra seca.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν μὴ πιστεύσωσίν σοι τοῖς δυσὶ σημείοις τούτοις μηδὲ εἰσακούσωσιν τῆς φωνῆς σου λήμψῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ ἐκχεεῖς ἐπὶ τὸ ξηρόν καὶ ἔσται τὸ ὕδωρ ὃ ἐὰν λάβῃς ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ αἷμα ἐπὶ τοῦ ξηροῦ

text_en: Moses said: I beseech you, Lord , I am not eloquent from yesterday and the day before; and since you have spoken to your servant, I have more impediment and slowness of tongue.
text_la: Ait Moyses : Obsecro, Domine, non sum eloquens ab heri et nudiustertius : et ex quo locutus es ad servum tuum, impeditioris et tardioris linguæ sum.
text_pt: Então disse Moisés ao Senhor: Ah, meu Senhor! eu não sou homem eloqüente, nem de ontem nem de anteontem, nem ainda desde que tens falado ao teu servo; porque sou pesado de boca e pesado de língua.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον δέομαι κύριε οὐχ ἱκανός εἰμι πρὸ τῆς ἐχθὲς οὐδὲ πρὸ τῆς τρίτης ἡμέρας οὐδὲ ἀφ' οὗ ἤρξω λαλεῖν τῷ θεράποντί σου ἰσχνόφωνος καὶ βραδύγλωσσος ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: The Lord said to him: Who made man's mouth? Or who made the dumb and the deaf, the seeing and the blind? Did not I?
text_la: Dixit Dominus ad eum : Quis fecit os hominis? aut quis fabricatus est mutum et surdum, videntem et cæcum? nonne ego?
text_pt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Quem fez a boca do homem? ou quem fez o mudo, ou o surdo, ou o que vê, ou o cego? Não sou eu, o Senhor?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν τίς ἔδωκεν στόμα ἀνθρώπῳ καὶ τίς ἐποίησεν δύσκωφον καὶ κωφόν βλέποντα καὶ τυφλόν οὐκ ἐγὼ ὁ θεός

text_en: Go therefore, and I will be in your mouth; and I will teach you what you shall speak.
text_la: Perge, igitur, et ego ero in ore tuo : doceboque te quid loquaris.
text_pt: Vai, pois, agora, e eu serei com a tua boca e te ensinarei o que hás de falar.
text_el: καὶ νῦν πορεύου καὶ ἐγὼ ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα σου καὶ συμβιβάσω σε ὃ μέλλεις λαλῆσαι

text_en: But he said: I beseech you, Lord , send whom you will send.
text_la: At ille : Obsecro, inquit, Domine, mitte quem missurus es.
text_pt: Ele, porém, disse: Ah, meu Senhor! Envia pela mão daquele a quem tu hás de enviar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς δέομαι κύριε προχείρισαι δυνάμενον ἄλλον ὃν ἀποστελεῖς

text_en: The Lord being angry at Moses , said: Aaron the Levite is your brother, I know that he is eloquent: behold he comes forth to meet you, and seeing you, shall be glad at heart .
text_la: Iratus Dominus in Moysen, ait : Aaron frater tuus Levites, scio quod eloquens sit : ecce ipse egreditur in occursum tuum, vidensque te lætabitur corde.
text_pt: Então se acendeu a ira do Senhor contra Moisés, e disse: Não é Arão, o levita, teu irmão? Eu sei que ele falará muito bem; e eis que ele também sai ao teu encontro; e, vendo-te, se alegrará em seu coração.
text_el: καὶ θυμωθεὶς ὀργῇ κύριος ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν εἶπεν οὐκ ἰδοὺ Ααρων ὁ ἀδελφός σου ὁ Λευίτης ἐπίσταμαι ὅτι λαλῶν λαλήσει αὐτός σοι καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἐξελεύσεται εἰς συνάντησίν σοι καὶ ἰδών σε χαρήσεται ἐν ἑαυτῷ

text_en: Speak to him, and put my words in his mouth: and I will be in your mouth, and in his month, and will show you what you must do.
text_la: Loquere ad eum, et pone verba mea in ore ejus : et ego ero in ore tuo, et in ore illius, et ostendam vobis quid agere debeatis.
text_pt: E tu lhe falarás, e porás as palavras na sua boca; e eu serei com a tua boca, e com a dele, ensinando-vos o que haveis de fazer.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ δώσεις τὰ ῥήματά μου εἰς τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγὼ ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα σου καὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ συμβιβάσω ὑμᾶς ἃ ποιήσετε

text_en: He shall speak in your stead to the people , and shall be your mouth: but you shall be to him in those things that pertain to God .
text_la: Ipse loquetur pro te ad populum, et erit os tuum : tu autem eris ei in his quæ ad Deum pertinent.
text_pt: E ele falará por ti ao povo; e acontecerá que ele te será por boca, e tu lhe serás por Deus.
text_el: καὶ αὐτός σοι προσλαλήσει πρὸς τὸν λαόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται σου στόμα σὺ δὲ αὐτῷ ἔσῃ τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν

text_en: And take this rod in your hand wherewith you shall do the signs .
text_la: Virgam quoque hanc sume in manu tua, in qua facturus es signa.
text_pt: Toma, pois, esta vara na tua mão, com que farás os sinais.
text_el: καὶ τὴν ῥάβδον ταύτην τὴν στραφεῖσαν εἰς ὄφιν λήμψῃ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου ἐν ᾗ ποιήσεις ἐν αὐτῇ τὰ σημεῖα

text_en: Moses went his way, and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said to him; I will go and return to my brethren into Egypt , that I may see if they be yet alive. And Jethro said to him: Go in peace.
text_la: Abiit Moyses, et reversus est ad Jethro socerum suum, dixitque ei : Vadam et revertar ad fratres meos in Ægyptum, ut videam si adhuc vivant. Cui ait Jethro : Vade in pace.
text_pt: Então foi Moisés, e voltou para Jetro, seu sogro, e disse-lhe: Eu irei agora, e tornarei a meus irmãos, que estão no Egito, para ver se ainda vivem. Disse, pois, Jetro a Moisés: Vai em paz.
text_el: ἐπορεύθη δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν πρὸς Ιοθορ τὸν γαμβρὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει πορεύσομαι καὶ ἀποστρέψω πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφούς μου τοὺς ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ὄψομαι εἰ ἔτι ζῶσιν καὶ εἶπεν Ιοθορ Μωυσῇ βάδιζε ὑγιαίνων

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses , in Madian : Go, and return into Egypt ; for they are all dead that sought your life.
text_la: Dixit ergo Dominus ad Moysen in Madian : Vade, et revertere in Ægyptum, mortui sunt enim omnes qui quærebant animam tuam.
text_pt: Disse também o Senhor a Moisés em Midiã: Vai, volta para o Egito; porque todos os que buscavam a tua alma morreram.
text_el: μετὰ δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας τὰς πολλὰς ἐκείνας ἐτελεύτησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐν Μαδιαμ βάδιζε ἄπελθε εἰς Αἴγυπτον τεθνήκασιν γὰρ πάντες οἱ ζητοῦντές σου τὴν ψυχήν

text_en: Moses therefore took his wife, and his sons, and set them upon an ass; and returned into Egypt , carrying the rod of God in his hand.
text_la: Tulit ergo Moyses uxorem suam, et filios suos, et imposuit eos super asinum : reversusque est in Ægyptum, portans virgam Dei in manu sua.
text_pt: Tomou, pois, Moisés sua mulher e seus filhos, e os levou sobre um jumento, e tornou à terra do Egito; e Moisés tomou a vara de Deus na sua mão.
text_el: ἀναλαβὼν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ παιδία ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτὰ ἐπὶ τὰ ὑποζύγια καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἔλαβεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said to him as he was returning into Egypt : See that you do all the wonders before Pharao , which I have put in your hand: I shall harden his heart, and he will not let the people go.
text_la: Dixitque ei Dominus revertenti in Ægyptum : Vide ut omnia ostenta quæ posui in manu tua, facias coram Pharaone : ego indurabo cor ejus, et non dimittet populum.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Quando voltares ao Egito, atenta que faças diante de Faraó todas as maravilhas que tenho posto na tua mão; mas eu lhe endurecerei o coração, para que não deixe ir o povo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν πορευομένου σου καὶ ἀποστρέφοντος εἰς Αἴγυπτον ὅρα πάντα τὰ τέρατα ἃ ἔδωκα ἐν ταῖς χερσίν σου ποιήσεις αὐτὰ ἐναντίον Φαραω ἐγὼ δὲ σκληρυνῶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξαποστείλῃ τὸν λαόν

text_en: And you shall say to him: Thus says the Lord : Israel is my son, my firstborn .
text_la: Dicesque ad eum : Hæc dicit Dominus : Filius meus primogenitus Israël.
text_pt: Então dirás a Faraó: Assim diz o Senhor: Israel é meu filho, meu primogênito.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ἐρεῖς τῷ Φαραω τάδε λέγει κύριος υἱὸς πρωτότοκός μου Ισραηλ

text_en: I have said to you: Let my son go, that he may serve me, and you would not let him go: behold I will kill your son, your firstborn .
text_la: Dixi tibi : Dimitte filium meum ut serviat mihi; et noluisti dimittere eum : ecce ego interficiam filium tuum primogenitum.
text_pt: E eu te tenho dito: Deixa ir o meu filho, para que me sirva; mas tu recusaste deixá-lo ir; eis que eu matarei a teu filho, o teu primogênito.
text_el: εἶπα δέ σοι ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαόν μου ἵνα μοι λατρεύσῃ εἰ μὲν οὖν μὴ βούλει ἐξαποστεῖλαι αὐτούς ὅρα οὖν ἐγὼ ἀποκτενῶ τὸν υἱόν σου τὸν πρωτότοκον

text_en: And when he was in his journey, in the inn, the Lord met him, and would have killed him.
text_la: Cumque esset in itinere, in diversorio occurrit ei Dominus, et volebat occidere eum.
text_pt: E aconteceu no caminho, numa estalagem, que o Senhor o encontrou, e o quis matar.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐν τῷ καταλύματι συνήντησεν αὐτῷ ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ ἐζήτει αὐτὸν ἀποκτεῖναι

text_en: Immediately Sephora took a very sharp stone, and circumcised the foreskin of her son, and touched his feet, and said: A bloody spouse are you to me.
text_la: Tulit idcirco Sephora acutissimam petram, et circumcidit præputium filii sui, tetigitque pedes ejus, et ait : Sponsus sanguinum tu mihi es.
text_pt: Então Zípora tomou uma pedra aguda, e circuncidou o prepúcio de seu filho, e lançou-o a seus pés, e disse: Certamente me és um esposo sanguinário.
text_el: καὶ λαβοῦσα Σεπφωρα ψῆφον περιέτεμεν τὴν ἀκροβυστίαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς καὶ προσέπεσεν πρὸς τοὺς πόδας καὶ εἶπεν ἔστη τὸ αἷμα τῆς περιτομῆς τοῦ παιδίου μου

text_en: And he let him go after she had said: A bloody spouse are you to me, because of the circumcision .
text_la: Et dimisit eum postquam dixerat: Sponsus sanguinum ob circumcisionem.
text_pt: E desviou-se dele. Então ela disse: Esposo sanguinário, por causa da circuncisão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ διότι εἶπεν ἔστη τὸ αἷμα τῆς περιτομῆς τοῦ παιδίου μου

text_en: And the Lord said to Aaron : Go into the desert to meet Moses . And he went forth to meet him in the mountain of God , and kissed him.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Aaron : Vade in occursum Moysi in desertum. Qui perrexit obviam ei in montem Dei, et osculatus est eum.
text_pt: Disse o Senhor a Arão: Vai ao deserto, ao encontro de Moisés. E ele foi, e encontrou-o no monte de Deus, e beijou-o.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Ααρων πορεύθητι εἰς συνάντησιν Μωυσεῖ εἰς τὴν ἔρημον καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ συνήντησεν αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ κατεφίλησαν ἀλλήλους

text_en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord , by which he had sent him, and the signs that he had commanded.
text_la: Narravitque Moyses Aaron omnia verba Domini quibus miserat eum, et signa quæ mandaverat.
text_pt: E relatou Moisés a Arão todas as palavras do Senhor, com que o enviara, e todos os sinais que lhe mandara.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν Μωυσῆς τῷ Ααρων πάντας τοὺς λόγους κυρίου οὓς ἀπέστειλεν καὶ πάντα τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ

text_en: And they came together, and they assembled all the ancients of the children of Israel .
text_la: Veneruntque simul, et congregaverunt cunctos seniores filiorum Israël.
text_pt: Então foram Moisés e Arão, e ajuntaram todos os anciãos dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: ἐπορεύθη δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καὶ συνήγαγον τὴν γερουσίαν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And Aaron spoke all the words which the Lord had said to Moses : and he wrought the signs before the people.
text_la: Locutusque est Aaron omnia verba quæ dixerat Dominus ad Moysen : et fecit signa coram populo,
text_pt: E Arão falou todas as palavras que o Senhor falara a Moisés e fez os sinais perante os olhos do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Ααρων πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἃ ἐλάλησεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ ἐποίησεν τὰ σημεῖα ἐναντίον τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And the people believed . And they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel , and that he had looked upon their affliction: and falling down they adored .
text_la: et credidit populus. Audieruntque quod visitasset Dominus filios Israël, et respexisset afflictionem illorum : et proni adoraverunt.
text_pt: E o povo creu; e quando ouviram que o Senhor visitava aos filhos de Israel, e que via a sua aflição, inclinaram-se, e adoraram.
text_el: καὶ ἐπίστευσεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ἐχάρη ὅτι ἐπεσκέψατο ὁ θεὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ὅτι εἶδεν αὐτῶν τὴν θλῖψιν κύψας δὲ ὁ λαὸς προσεκύνησεν

text_en: After these things, Moses and Aaron went in, and said to Pharao : Thus says the Lord God of Israel : Let my people go, that they may sacrifice to me in the desert .
text_la: Post hæc ingressi sunt Moyses et Aaron, et dixerunt Pharaoni : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Dimitte populum meum ut sacrificet mihi in deserto.
text_pt: E depois foram Moisés e Arão e disseram a Faraó: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me celebre uma festa no deserto.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσῆλθεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων πρὸς Φαραω καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαόν μου ἵνα μοι ἑορτάσωσιν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: But he answered: Who is the Lord , that I should hear his voice, and let Israel go? I know not the Lord , neither will I let Israel go.
text_la: At ille respondit : Quis est Dominus, ut audiam vocem ejus, et dimittam Israël? nescio Dominum, et Israël non dimittam.
text_pt: Mas Faraó disse: Quem é o Senhor, cuja voz eu ouvirei, para deixar ir Israel? Não conheço o Senhor, nem tampouco deixarei ir Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Φαραω τίς ἐστιν οὗ εἰσακούσομαι τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ὥστε ἐξαποστεῖλαι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ οὐκ οἶδα τὸν κύριον καὶ τὸν Ισραηλ οὐκ ἐξαποστέλλω

text_en: And they said: The God of the Hebrews has called us, to go three days' journey into the wilderness , and to sacrifice to the Lord our God ; lest a pestilence or the sword fall upon us.
text_la: Dixeruntque : Deus Hebræorum vocavit nos, ut eamus viam trium dierum in solitudinem, et sacrificemus Domino Deo nostro : ne forte accidat nobis pestis aut gladius.
text_pt: E eles disseram: O Deus dos hebreus nos encontrou; portanto deixa-nos agora ir caminho de três dias ao deserto, para que ofereçamos sacrifícios ao SENHOR nosso Deus, e ele não venha sobre nós com pestilência ou com espada.
text_el: καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς τῶν Εβραίων προσκέκληται ἡμᾶς πορευσόμεθα οὖν ὁδὸν τριῶν ἡμερῶν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ὅπως θύσωμεν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν μήποτε συναντήσῃ ἡμῖν θάνατος ἢ φόνος

text_en: The king of Egypt said to them: Why do you Moses and Aaron draw off the people from their works? Get you gone to your burdens.
text_la: Ait ad eos rex Ægypti : Quare Moyses et Aaron sollicitatis populum ab operibus suis? ite ad onera vestra.
text_pt: Então disse-lhes o rei do Egito: Moisés e Arão, por que fazeis cessar o povo das suas obras? Ide às vossas cargas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου ἵνα τί Μωυσῆ καὶ Ααρων διαστρέφετε τὸν λαόν μου ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων ἀπέλθατε ἕκαστος ὑμῶν πρὸς τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Pharao said: The people of the land are numerous; you see that the multitude is increased; how much more if you give them rest from their works?
text_la: Dixitque Pharao : Multus est populus terræ : videtis quod turba succreverit : quanto magis si dederitis eis requiem ab operibus?
text_pt: E disse também Faraó: Eis que o povo da terra já é muito, e vós os fazeis abandonar as suas cargas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Φαραω ἰδοὺ νῦν πολυπληθεῖ ὁ λαός μὴ οὖν καταπαύσωμεν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων

text_en: Therefore he commanded the same day the overseers of the works, and the task-masters of the people, saying:
text_la: Præcepit ergo in die illo præfectis operum et exactoribus populi, dicens:
text_pt: Portanto deu ordem Faraó, naquele mesmo dia, aos exatores do povo, e aos seus oficiais, dizendo:
text_el: συνέταξεν δὲ Φαραω τοῖς ἐργοδιώκταις τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ τοῖς γραμματεῦσιν λέγων

text_en: You shall give straw no more to the people to make brick, as before; but let them go and gather straw.
text_la: Nequaquam ultra dabitis paleas populo ad conficiendos lateres, sicut prius : sed ipsi vadant, et colligant stipulas.
text_pt: Daqui em diante não torneis a dar palha ao povo, para fazer tijolos, como fizestes antes: vão eles mesmos, e colham palha para si.
text_el: οὐκέτι προστεθήσεται διδόναι ἄχυρον τῷ λαῷ εἰς τὴν πλινθουργίαν καθάπερ ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἡμέραν αὐτοὶ πορευέσθωσαν καὶ συναγαγέτωσαν ἑαυτοῖς ἄχυρα

text_en: And you shall lay upon them the task of bricks, which they did before; neither shall you diminish anything thereof, for they are idle, and therefore they cry, saying: Let us go and sacrifice to our God .
text_la: Et mensuram laterum, quam prius faciebant, imponetis super eos, nec minuetis quidquam : vacant enim, et idcirco vociferantur, dicentes : Eamus, et sacrificemus Deo nostro.
text_pt: E lhes imporeis a conta dos tijolos que fizeram antes; nada diminuireis dela, porque eles estão ociosos; por isso clamam, dizendo: Vamos, sacrifiquemos ao nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ τὴν σύνταξιν τῆς πλινθείας ἧς αὐτοὶ ποιοῦσιν καθ' ἑκάστην ἡμέραν ἐπιβαλεῖς αὐτοῖς οὐκ ἀφελεῖς οὐδέν σχολάζουσιν γάρ διὰ τοῦτο κεκράγασιν λέγοντες πορευθῶμεν καὶ θύσωμεν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν

text_en: Let them be oppressed with works, and let them fulfil them; that they may not regard lying words.
text_la: Opprimantur operibus, et expleant ea : ut non acquiescant verbis mendacibus.
text_pt: Agrave-se o serviço sobre estes homens, para que se ocupem nele e não confiem em palavras mentirosas.
text_el: βαρυνέσθω τὰ ἔργα τῶν ἀνθρώπων τούτων καὶ μεριμνάτωσαν ταῦτα καὶ μὴ μεριμνάτωσαν ἐν λόγοις κενοῖς

text_en: And the overseers of the works, and the taskmasters, went out and said to the people: Thus says Pharao : I allow you no straw;
text_la: Igitur egressi præfecti operum et exactores ad populum, dixerunt : Sic dicit Pharao : Non do vobis paleas:
text_pt: Então saíram os exatores do povo, e seus oficiais, e falaram ao povo, dizendo: Assim diz Faraó: Eu não vos darei palha;
text_el: κατέσπευδον δὲ αὐτοὺς οἱ ἐργοδιῶκται καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς τὸν λαὸν λέγοντες τάδε λέγει Φαραω οὐκέτι δίδωμι ὑμῖν ἄχυρα

text_en: go, and gather it where you can find it; neither shall anything of your work be diminished.
text_la: ite, et colligite sicubi invenire poteritis, nec minuetur quidquam de opere vestro.
text_pt: Ide vós mesmos, e tomai vós palha onde a achardes; porque nada se diminuirá de vosso serviço.
text_el: αὐτοὶ ὑμεῖς πορευόμενοι συλλέγετε ἑαυτοῖς ἄχυρα ὅθεν ἐὰν εὕρητε οὐ γὰρ ἀφαιρεῖται ἀπὸ τῆς συντάξεως ὑμῶν οὐθέν

text_en: And the people was scattered through all the land of Egypt to gather straw.
text_la: Dispersusque est populus per omnem terram Ægypti ad colligendas paleas.
text_pt: Então o povo se espalhou por toda a terra do Egito, a colher restolho em lugar de palha.
text_el: καὶ διεσπάρη ὁ λαὸς ἐν ὅλῃ Αἰγύπτῳ συναγαγεῖν καλάμην εἰς ἄχυρα

text_en: And the overseers of the works pressed them, saying: Fulfil your work every day, as before you were wont to do, when straw was given you.
text_la: Præfecti quoque operum instabant, dicentes : Complete opus vestrum quotidie, ut prius facere solebatis quando dabantur vobis paleæ.
text_pt: E os exatores os apertavam, dizendo: Acabai vossa obra, a tarefa de cada dia, como quando havia palha.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐργοδιῶκται κατέσπευδον αὐτοὺς λέγοντες συντελεῖτε τὰ ἔργα τὰ καθήκοντα καθ' ἡμέραν καθάπερ καὶ ὅτε τὸ ἄχυρον ἐδίδοτο ὑμῖν

text_en: And they that were over the works of the children of Israel , were scourged by Pharao's taskmasters, saying: Why have you not made up the task of bricks, both yesterday and to day, as before?
text_la: Flagellatique sunt qui præerant operibus filiorum Israël, ab exactoribus Pharaonis, dicentibus : Quare non impletis mensuram laterum sicut prius, nec heri, nec hodie?
text_pt: E foram açoitados os oficiais dos filhos de Israel, que os exatores de Faraó tinham posto sobre eles, dizendo estes: Por que não acabastes vossa tarefa, fazendo tijolos como antes, assim também ontem e hoje?
text_el: καὶ ἐμαστιγώθησαν οἱ γραμματεῖς τοῦ γένους τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ οἱ κατασταθέντες ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ὑπὸ τῶν ἐπιστατῶν τοῦ Φαραω λέγοντες διὰ τί οὐ συνετελέσατε τὰς συντάξεις ὑμῶν τῆς πλινθείας καθάπερ ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἡμέραν καὶ τὸ τῆς σήμερον

text_en: And the officers of the children of Israel came, and cried out to Pharao , saying: Why do you deal so with your servants?
text_la: Veneruntque præpositi filiorum Israël, et vociferati sunt ad Pharaonem dicentes : Cur ita agis contra servos tuos?
text_pt: Por isso, os oficiais dos filhos de Israel, foram e clamaram a Faraó, dizendo: Por que fazes assim a teus servos?
text_el: εἰσελθόντες δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ κατεβόησαν πρὸς Φαραω λέγοντες ἵνα τί οὕτως ποιεῖς τοῖς σοῖς οἰκέταις

text_en: Straw is not given us, and bricks are required of us as before; behold we, your servants, are beaten with whips, and your people is unjustly dealt withal.
text_la: paleæ non dantur nobis, et lateres similiter imperantur : en famuli tui flagellis cædimur, et injuste agitur contra populum tuum.
text_pt: Palha não se dá a teus servos, e nos dizem: Fazei tijolos; e eis que teus servos são açoitados; porém o teu povo tem a culpa.
text_el: ἄχυρον οὐ δίδοται τοῖς οἰκέταις σου καὶ τὴν πλίνθον ἡμῖν λέγουσιν ποιεῖν καὶ ἰδοὺ οἱ παῖδές σου μεμαστίγωνται ἀδικήσεις οὖν τὸν λαόν σου

text_en: And he said: You are idle, and therefore you say: Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord .
text_la: Qui ait : Vacatis otio, et idcirco dicitis : Eamus, et sacrificemus Domino.
text_pt: Mas ele disse: Vós sois ociosos; vós sois ociosos; por isso dizeis: Vamos, sacrifiquemos ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς σχολάζετε σχολασταί ἐστε διὰ τοῦτο λέγετε πορευθῶμεν θύσωμεν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν

text_en: Go therefore and work: straw shall not be given you, and you shall deliver the accustomed number of bricks.
text_la: Ite ergo, et operamini : paleæ non dabuntur vobis, et reddetis consuetum numerum laterum.
text_pt: Ide, pois, agora, trabalhai; palha porém não se vos dará; contudo, dareis a conta dos tijolos.
text_el: νῦν οὖν πορευθέντες ἐργάζεσθε τὸ γὰρ ἄχυρον οὐ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν καὶ τὴν σύνταξιν τῆς πλινθείας ἀποδώσετε

text_en: And the officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in evil case, because it was said to them: There shall not a whit be diminished of the bricks for every day.
text_la: Videbantque se præpositi filiorum Israël in malo, eo quod diceretur eis : Non minuetur quidquam de lateribus per singulos dies.
text_pt: Então os oficiais dos filhos de Israel viram-se em aflição, porquanto se dizia: Nada diminuireis de vossos tijolos, da tarefa do dia no seu dia.
text_el: ἑώρων δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἑαυτοὺς ἐν κακοῖς λέγοντες οὐκ ἀπολείψετε τῆς πλινθείας τὸ καθῆκον τῇ ἡμέρᾳ

text_en: And they met Moses and Aaron , who stood over against them as they came out from Pharao :
text_la: Occurreruntque Moysi et Aaron, qui stabant ex adverso, egredientibus a Pharaone:
text_pt: E encontraram a Moisés e a Arão, que estavam defronte deles, quando saíram de Faraó.
text_el: συνήντησαν δὲ Μωυσῇ καὶ Ααρων ἐρχομένοις εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῖς ἐκπορευομένων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Φαραω

text_en: And they said to them: The Lord see and judge, because you have, made our savour to stink before Pharao and his servants, and you have given him a sword, to kill us.
text_la: et dixerunt ad eos : Videat Dominus et judicet, quoniam fœtere fecistis odorem nostrum coram Pharaone et servis ejus, et præbuistis ei gladium, ut occideret nos.
text_pt: E disseram-lhes: O Senhor atente sobre vós, e julgue isso, porquanto fizestes o nosso caso repelente diante de Faraó, e diante de seus servos, dando-lhes a espada nas mãos, para nos matar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς ἴδοι ὁ θεὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ κρίναι ὅτι ἐβδελύξατε τὴν ὀσμὴν ἡμῶν ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ δοῦναι ῥομφαίαν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι ἡμᾶς

text_en: And Moses returned to the Lord , and said: Lord , why have you afflicted this people? Wherefore have you sent me?
text_la: Reversusque est Moyses ad Dominum, et ait : Domine, cur afflixisti populum istum? quare misisti me?
text_pt: Então, tornando-se Moisés ao Senhor, disse: Senhor! por que fizeste mal a este povo? por que me enviaste?
text_el: ἐπέστρεψεν δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον καὶ εἶπεν κύριε διὰ τί ἐκάκωσας τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ ἵνα τί ἀπέσταλκάς με

text_en: For since the time that I went in to Pharao to speak in your name , he has afflicted your people: and you have not delivered them.
text_la: ex eo enim quo ingressus sum ad Pharaonem ut loquerer in nomine tuo, afflixit populum tuum : et non liberasti eos.
text_pt: Porque desde que me apresentei a Faraó para falar em teu nome, ele maltratou a este povo; e de nenhuma sorte livraste o teu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀφ' οὗ πεπόρευμαι πρὸς Φαραω λαλῆσαι ἐπὶ τῷ σῷ ὀνόματι ἐκάκωσεν τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ οὐκ ἐρρύσω τὸν λαόν σου

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Now you shall see what I will do to Pharao : for by a mighty hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he cast them out of his land.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Nunc videbis quæ facturus sim Pharaoni : per manum enim fortem dimittet eos, et in manu robusta ejiciet illos de terra sua.
text_pt: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Agora verás o que hei de fazer a Faraó; porque por uma mão poderosa os deixará ir, sim, por uma mão poderosa os lançará de sua terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἤδη ὄψει ἃ ποιήσω τῷ Φαραω ἐν γὰρ χειρὶ κραταιᾷ ἐξαποστελεῖ αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ ἐκβαλεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying: I am the Lord
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen dicens: Ego Dominus
text_pt: Falou mais Deus a Moisés, e disse: Eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ἐλάλησεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: that appeared to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , by the name of God Almighty : and my name ADONAI I did not show them.
text_la: qui apparui Abraham, Isaac et Jacob in Deo omnipotente : et nomen meum Adonai non indicavi eis.
text_pt: E eu apareci a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó, como o Deus Todo-Poderoso; mas pelo meu nome, o Senhor, não lhes fui perfeitamente conhecido.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθην πρὸς Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ θεὸς ὢν αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου κύριος οὐκ ἐδήλωσα αὐτοῖς

text_en: And I made a covenant with them, to give them the land of Chanaan , the land of their pilgrimage wherein they were strangers.
text_la: Pepigique fœdus cum eis, ut darem eis terram Chanaan, terram peregrinationis eorum, in qua fuerunt advenæ.
text_pt: E também estabeleci a minha aliança com eles, para dar-lhes a terra de Canaã, a terra de suas peregrinações, na qual foram peregrinos.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησα τὴν διαθήκην μου πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὥστε δοῦναι αὐτοῖς τὴν γῆν τῶν Χαναναίων τὴν γῆν ἣν παρῳκήκασιν ἐν ᾗ καὶ παρῴκησαν ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel , wherewith the Egyptians have oppressed them: and I have remembered my covenant.
text_la: Ego audivi gemitum filiorum Israël, quo Ægyptii oppresserunt eos : et recordatus sum pacti mei.
text_pt: E também tenho ouvido o gemido dos filhos de Israel, aos quais os egípcios fazem servir, e lembrei-me da minha aliança.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ εἰσήκουσα τὸν στεναγμὸν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ὃν οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι καταδουλοῦνται αὐτούς καὶ ἐμνήσθην τῆς διαθήκης ὑμῶν

text_en: Therefore say to the children of Israel : I am the Lord who will bring you out from the work-prison of the Egyptians , and will deliver you from bondage : and redeem you with a high arm, and great judgments .
text_la: Ideo dic filiis Israël : Ego Dominus qui educam vos de ergastulo Ægyptiorum, et eruam de servitute, ac redimam in brachio excelso et judiciis magnis.
text_pt: Portanto dize aos filhos de Israel: Eu sou o Senhor, e vos tirarei de debaixo das cargas dos egípcios, e vos livrarei da servidão, e vos resgatarei com braço estendido e com grandes juízos.
text_el: βάδιζε εἰπὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγων ἐγὼ κύριος καὶ ἐξάξω ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς δυναστείας τῶν Αἰγυπτίων καὶ ῥύσομαι ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῆς δουλείας καὶ λυτρώσομαι ὑμᾶς ἐν βραχίονι ὑψηλῷ καὶ κρίσει μεγάλῃ

text_en: And I will take you to myself for my people, I will be your God : and you shall know that I am the Lord your God , who brought you out from the work-prison of the Egyptians :
text_la: Et assumam vos mihi in populum, et ero vester Deus : et scietis quod ego sum Dominus Deus vester qui eduxerim vos de ergastulo Ægyptiorum,
text_pt: E eu vos tomarei por meu povo, e serei vosso Deus; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus, que vos tiro de debaixo das cargas dos egípcios;
text_el: καὶ λήμψομαι ἐμαυτῷ ὑμᾶς λαὸν ἐμοὶ καὶ ἔσομαι ὑμῶν θεός καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν ὁ ἐξαγαγὼν ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῆς καταδυναστείας τῶν Αἰγυπτίων

text_en: And brought you into the land, concerning which I lifted up my hand to give it to Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob : and I will give it you to possess: I am the Lord .
text_la: et induxerim in terram, super quam levavi manum meam ut darem eam Abraham, Isaac et Jacob : daboque illam vobis possidendam. Ego Dominus.
text_pt: E eu vos levarei à terra, acerca da qual levantei minha mão, jurando que a daria a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó, e vo-la darei por herança, eu o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἰσάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν ἐξέτεινα τὴν χεῖρά μου δοῦναι αὐτὴν τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν αὐτὴν ἐν κλήρῳ ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And Moses told all this to the children of Israel : but they did not hearken to him, for anguish of spirit, and most painful work.
text_la: Narravit ergo Moyses omnia filiis Israël : qui non acquieverunt ei propter angustiam spiritus, et opus durissimum.
text_pt: Deste modo falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel, mas eles não ouviram a Moisés, por causa da angústia de espírito e da dura servidão.
text_el: ἐλάλησεν δὲ Μωυσῆς οὕτως τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσαν Μωυσῇ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀλιγοψυχίας καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων τῶν σκληρῶν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Go in, and speak to Pharao king of Egypt , that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
text_la: Ingredere, et loquere ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti, ut dimittat filios Israël de terra sua.
text_pt: Entra, e fala a Faraó rei do Egito, que deixe sair os filhos de Israel da sua terra.
text_el: εἴσελθε λάλησον Φαραω βασιλεῖ Αἰγύπτου ἵνα ἐξαποστείλῃ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Moses answered before the Lord : Behold the children of Israel do not hearken to me: and how will Pharao hear me, especially as I am of uncircumcised lips?
text_la: Respondit Moyses coram Domino : Ecce filii Israël non audiunt me : et quomodo audiet Pharao, præsertim cum incircumcisus sim labiis?
text_pt: Moisés, porém, falou perante o Senhor, dizendo: Eis que os filhos de Israel não me têm ouvido; como, pois, Faraó me ouvirá? Também eu sou incircunciso de lábios.
text_el: ἐλάλησεν δὲ Μωυσῆς ἔναντι κυρίου λέγων ἰδοὺ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ οὐκ εἰσήκουσάν μου καὶ πῶς εἰσακούσεταί μου Φαραω ἐγὼ δὲ ἄλογός εἰμι

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron , and he gave them a charge unto the children of Israel , and unto Pharao the king of Egypt , that they should bring forth the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, et dedit mandatum ad filios Israël, et ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti ut educerent filios Israël de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Todavia o Senhor falou a Moisés e a Arão, e deu-lhes mandamento para os filhos de Israel, e para Faraó rei do Egito, para que tirassem os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς πρὸς Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου ὥστε ἐξαποστεῖλαι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: These are the heads of their houses by their families . The sons of Ruben the firstborn of Israel : Henoch and Phallu, Hesron and Charmi.
text_la: Isti sunt principes domorum per familias suas. Filii Ruben primogeniti Israëlis : Henoch et Phallu, Hesron et Charmi:
text_pt: Estas são as cabeças das casas de seus pais: Os filhos de Rúben, o primogênito de Israel: Enoque e Palu, Hezrom e Carmi; estas são as famílias de Rúben.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι ἀρχηγοὶ οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν υἱοὶ Ρουβην πρωτοτόκου Ισραηλ Ενωχ καὶ Φαλλους Ασρων καὶ Χαρμι αὕτη ἡ συγγένεια Ρουβην

text_en: These are the kindreds of Ruben . The sons of Simeon , Jamuel and Jamin, and Ahod, and Jachin, and Soar, and Saul the son of a Chanaanitess : these are the families of Simeon .
text_la: hæ cognationes Ruben. Filii Simeon : Jamuel, et Jamin, et Ahod, et Jachin, et Soar, et Saul filius Chananitidis : hæ progenies Simeon.
text_pt: E os filhos de Simeão: Jemuel, Jamin, Oade, Jaquim, Zoar e Saul, filho de uma cananéia; estas são as famílias de Simeão.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Συμεων Ιεμουηλ καὶ Ιαμιν καὶ Αωδ καὶ Ιαχιν καὶ Σααρ καὶ Σαουλ ὁ ἐκ τῆς Φοινίσσης αὗται αἱ πατριαὶ τῶν υἱῶν Συμεων

text_en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi by their kindreds: Gerson, and Caath, and Merari. And the years of the life of Levi were a hundred and thirty-seven.
text_la: Et hæc nomina filiorum Levi per cognationes suas : Gerson, et Caath, et Merari. Anni autem vitæ Levi fuerunt centum triginta septem.
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Levi, segundo as suas gerações: Gérson, Coate e Merari; e os anos da vida de Levi foram cento e trinta e sete anos.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Λευι κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν Γεδσων Κααθ καὶ Μεραρι καὶ τὰ ἔτη τῆς ζωῆς Λευι ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἑπτά

text_en: The sons of Gerson: Lobni and Semei, by their kindreds.
text_la: Filii Gerson : Lobni et Semei, per cognationes suas.
text_pt: Os filhos de Gérson: Libni e Simei, segundo as suas famílias;
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Γεδσων Λοβενι καὶ Σεμεϊ οἶκοι πατριᾶς αὐτῶν

text_en: The sons of Caath: Amram, and Isaar, and Hebron and Oziel. And the years of Caath's life, were a hundred and thirty-three.
text_la: Filii Caath : Amram, et Isaar, et Hebron, et Oziel; anni quoque vitæ Caath, centum triginta tres.
text_pt: E os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel; e os anos da vida de Coate foram cento e trinta e três anos.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Κααθ Αμβραμ καὶ Ισσααρ Χεβρων καὶ Οζιηλ καὶ τὰ ἔτη τῆς ζωῆς Κααθ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἔτη

text_en: The sons of Merari: Moholi and Musi. These are the kindreds of Levi by their families .
text_la: Filii Merari : Moholi et Musi : hæ cognationes Levi per familias suas.
text_pt: E os filhos de Merari: Mali e Musi; estas são as famílias de Levi, segundo as suas gerações.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Μεραρι Μοολι καὶ Ομουσι οὗτοι οἶκοι πατριῶν Λευι κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν

text_en: And Amram took to wife Jochabed his aunt by the father's side: and she bore him Aaron and Moses . And the years of Amram's life, were a hundred and thirty-seven.
text_la: Accepit autem Amram uxorem Jochabed patruelem suam : quæ peperit ei Aaron et Moysen. Fueruntque anni vitæ Amram, centum triginta septem.
text_pt: E Anrão tomou por mulher a Joquebede, sua tia, e ela deu-lhe Arão e Moisés: e os anos da vida de Anrão foram cento e trinta e sete anos.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Αμβραμ τὴν Ιωχαβεδ θυγατέρα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἑαυτῷ εἰς γυναῖκα καὶ ἐγέννησεν αὐτῷ τόν τε Ααρων καὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Μαριαμ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν τὰ δὲ ἔτη τῆς ζωῆς Αμβραμ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα δύο ἔτη

text_en: The sons also of Isaar: Core, and Nepheg, and Zechri.
text_la: Filii quoque Isaar : Core, et Nepheg, et Zechri.
text_pt: E os filhos de Izar: Corá, Nefegue e Zicri.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ισσααρ Κορε καὶ Ναφεκ καὶ Ζεχρι

text_en: The sons also of Oziel: Mizael, and Elizaphan, and Sethri.
text_la: Filii quoque Oziel : Misaël, et Elisaphan, et Sethri.
text_pt: E os filhos de Uziel: Misael, Elzafã e Sitri.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Οζιηλ Ελισαφαν καὶ Σετρι

text_en: And Aaron took to wife Elizabeth the daughter of Aminadab, sister of Nahason, who bore him Nadab, and Abiu, and Eleazar , and Ithamar.
text_la: Accepit autem Aaron uxorem Elisabeth filiam Aminadab, sororem Nahason, quæ peperit ei Nadab, et Abiu, et Eleazar, et Ithamar.
text_pt: E Arão tomou por mulher a Eliseba, filha de Aminadabe, irmã de Naasson; e ela deu-lhe Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
text_el: ἔλαβεν δὲ Ααρων τὴν Ελισαβεθ θυγατέρα Αμιναδαβ ἀδελφὴν Ναασσων αὐτῷ γυναῖκα καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τόν τε Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ καὶ Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ

text_en: The sons also of Core: Aser , and Elcana, and Abiasaph. These are the kindreds of the Corites.
text_la: Filii quoque Core : Aser, et Elcana, et Abiasaph : hæ sunt cognationes Coritarum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Corá: Assir, Elcana e Abiasafe; estas são as famílias dos coraítas.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Κορε Ασιρ καὶ Ελκανα καὶ Αβιασαφ αὗται αἱ γενέσεις Κορε

text_en: But Eleazar the son of Aaron took a wife of the daughters of Phutiel: and she bore him Phinees. These are the heads of the Levitical families by their kindreds.
text_la: At vero Eleazar filius Aaron accepit uxorem de filiabus Phutiel : quæ peperit ei Phinees. Hi sunt principes familiarum Leviticarum per cognationes suas.
text_pt: E Eleazar, filho de Arão, tomou por mulher uma das filhas de Putiel, e ela deu-lhe a Finéias; estes são os cabeças dos pais dos levitas, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ Ελεαζαρ ὁ τοῦ Ααρων ἔλαβεν τῶν θυγατέρων Φουτιηλ αὐτῷ γυναῖκα καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Φινεες αὗται αἱ ἀρχαὶ πατριᾶς Λευιτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν

text_en: These are Aaron and Moses , whom the Lord commanded to bring forth the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their companies.
text_la: Iste est Aaron et Moyses, quibus præcepit Dominus ut educerent filios Israël de terra Ægypti per turmas suas.
text_pt: Estes são Arão e Moisés, aos quais o Senhor disse: Tirai os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, segundo os seus exércitos.
text_el: οὗτος Ααρων καὶ Μωυσῆς οἷς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ἐξαγαγεῖν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου σὺν δυνάμει αὐτῶν

text_en: These are they that speak to Pharao, king of Egypt , in order to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt : these are that Moses and Aaron ,
text_la: Hi sunt, qui loquuntur ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti, ut educant filios Israël de Ægypto : iste est Moyses et Aaron,
text_pt: Estes são os que falaram a Faraó, rei do Egito, para que tirasse do Egito os filhos de Israel; estes são Moisés e Arão.
text_el: οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ διαλεγόμενοι πρὸς Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐξήγαγον τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου αὐτὸς Ααρων καὶ Μωυσῆς

text_en: in the day when the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt .
text_la: in die qua locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, in terra Ægypti.
