text_pt: E aconteceu que naquele dia, quando o Senhor falou a Moisés na terra do Egito,
text_el: ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐλάλησεν κύριος Μωυσῇ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying: I am the Lord ; speak to Pharao, king of Egypt , all that I say to you.
text_la: Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens : Ego Dominus : loquere ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti, omnia quæ ego loquor tibi.
text_pt: Falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo: Eu sou o Senhor; fala a Faraó, rei do Egito, tudo quanto eu te digo.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων ἐγὼ κύριος λάλησον πρὸς Φαραω βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου ὅσα ἐγὼ λέγω πρὸς σέ

text_en: And Moses said before the Lord : Lo I am of uncircumcised lips, how will Pharao hear me?
text_la: Et ait Moyses coram Domino : En incircumcisus labiis sum, quomodo audiet me Pharao?
text_pt: Então disse Moisés perante o Senhor: Eis que eu sou incircunciso de lábios; como, pois, Faraó me ouvirá?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς ἐναντίον κυρίου ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἰσχνόφωνός εἰμι καὶ πῶς εἰσακούσεταί μου Φαραω

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Behold, I have appointed you the god of Pharao ; and Aaron , your brother, shall be your prophet .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Ecce constitui te Deum Pharaonis : et Aaron frater tuus erit propheta tuus.
text_pt: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Eis que te tenho posto por deus sobre Faraó, e Arão, teu irmão, será o teu profeta.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων ἰδοὺ δέδωκά σε θεὸν Φαραω καὶ Ααρων ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἔσται σου προφήτης

text_en: You shall speak to him all that I command you; and he shall speak to Pharao , that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
text_la: Tu loqueris ei omnia quæ mando tibi : et ille loquetur ad Pharaonem, ut dimittat filios Israël de terra sua.
text_pt: Tu falarás tudo o que eu te mandar; e Arão, teu irmão, falará a Faraó, que deixe ir os filhos de Israel da sua terra.
text_el: σὺ δὲ λαλήσεις αὐτῷ πάντα ὅσα σοι ἐντέλλομαι ὁ δὲ Ααρων ὁ ἀδελφός σου λαλήσει πρὸς Φαραω ὥστε ἐξαποστεῖλαι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: But I shall harden his heart, and shall multiply my signs and wonders in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Sed ego indurabo cor ejus, et multiplicabo signa et ostenta mea in terra Ægypti,
text_pt: Eu, porém, endurecerei o coração de Faraó, e multiplicarei na terra do Egito os meus sinais e as minhas maravilhas.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ σκληρυνῶ τὴν καρδίαν Φαραω καὶ πληθυνῶ τὰ σημεῖά μου καὶ τὰ τέρατα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: And he will not hear you: and I will lay my hand upon Egypt , and will bring forth my army and my people, the children of Israel , out of the land of Egypt , by very great judgments .
text_la: et non audiet vos : immittamque manum meam super Ægyptum, et educam exercitum et populum meum filios Israël de terra Ægypti per judicia maxima.
text_pt: Faraó, pois, não vos ouvirá; e eu porei minha mão sobre o Egito, e tirarei meus exércitos, meu povo, os filhos de Israel, da terra do Egito, com grandes juízos.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσεται ὑμῶν Φαραω καὶ ἐπιβαλῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐξάξω σὺν δυνάμει μου τὸν λαόν μου τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου σὺν ἐκδικήσει μεγάλῃ

text_en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord , who have stretched forth my hand upon Egypt , and have brought forth the children of Israel out of the midst of them.
text_la: Et scient Ægyptii quia ego sum Dominus qui extenderim manum meam super Ægyptum, et eduxerim filios Israël de medio eorum.
text_pt: Então os egípcios saberão que eu sou o Senhor, quando estender a minha mão sobre o Egito, e tirar os filhos de Israel do meio deles.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ἐκτείνων τὴν χεῖρα ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐξάξω τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν

text_en: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord had commanded; so did they.
text_la: Fecit itaque Moyses et Aaron sicut præceperat Dominus : ita egerunt.
text_pt: Assim fizeram Moisés e Arão; como o Senhor lhes ordenara, assim fizeram.
text_el: ἐποίησεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς κύριος οὕτως ἐποίησαν

text_en: And Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three, when they spoke to Pharao .
text_la: Erat autem Moyses octoginta annorum, et Aaron octoginta trium, quando locuti sunt ad Pharaonem.
text_pt: E Moisés era da idade de oitenta anos, e Arão da idade de oitenta e três anos quando falaram a Faraó.
text_el: Μωυσῆς δὲ ἦν ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα Ααρων δὲ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα τριῶν ἡνίκα ἐλάλησεν πρὸς Φαραω

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron :
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron:
text_pt: E o Senhor falou a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων

text_en: When Pharao shall say to you, Show signs ; you shall say to Aaron : Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharao , and it shall be turned into a serpent.
text_la: Cum dixerit vobis Pharao, Ostendite signa : dices ad Aaron : Tolle virgam tuam, et projice eam coram Pharaone, ac vertetur in colubrum.
text_pt: Quando Faraó vos falar, dizendo: Fazei vós um milagre, dirás a Arão: Toma a tua vara, e lança-a diante de Faraó; e se tornará em serpente.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν λαλήσῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς Φαραω λέγων δότε ἡμῖν σημεῖον ἢ τέρας καὶ ἐρεῖς Ααρων τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον καὶ ῥῖψον αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται δράκων

text_en: So Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharao , and did as the Lord had commanded. And Aaron took the rod before Pharao and his servants, and it was turned into a serpent.
text_la: Ingressi itaque Moyses et Aaron ad Pharaonem, fecerunt sicut præceperat Dominus : tulitque Aaron virgam coram Pharaone et servis ejus, quæ versa est in colubrum.
text_pt: Então Moisés e Arão foram a Faraó, e fizeram assim como o Senhor ordenara; e lançou Arão a sua vara diante de Faraó, e diante dos seus servos, e tornou-se em serpente.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς κύριος καὶ ἔρριψεν Ααρων τὴν ῥάβδον ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγένετο δράκων

text_en: And Pharao called the wise men and the magicians; and they also by Egyptian enchantments and certain secrets, did in like manner.
text_la: Vocavit autem Pharao sapientes et maleficos: et fecerunt etiam ipsi per incantationes ægyptiacas et arcana quædam similiter.
text_pt: E Faraó também chamou os sábios e encantadores; e os magos do Egito fizeram também o mesmo com os seus encantamentos.
text_el: συνεκάλεσεν δὲ Φαραω τοὺς σοφιστὰς Αἰγύπτου καὶ τοὺς φαρμακούς καὶ ἐποίησαν καὶ οἱ ἐπαοιδοὶ τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ταῖς φαρμακείαις αὐτῶν ὡσαύτως

text_en: And they every one cast down their rods, and they were turned into serpents: but Aaron's rod devoured their rods.
text_la: Projeceruntque singuli virgas suas, quæ versæ sunt in dracones : sed devoravit virga Aaron virgas eorum.
text_pt: Porque cada um lançou sua vara, e tornaram-se em serpentes; mas a vara de Arão tragou as varas deles.
text_el: καὶ ἔρριψαν ἕκαστος τὴν ῥάβδον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγένοντο δράκοντες καὶ κατέπιεν ἡ ῥάβδος ἡ Ααρων τὰς ἐκείνων ῥάβδους

text_en: And Pharao's heart was hardened, and he did not hearken to them, as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Induratumque est cor Pharaonis, et non audivit eos, sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: Porém o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não os ouviu, como o Senhor tinha falado.
text_el: καὶ κατίσχυσεν ἡ καρδία Φαραω καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς κύριος

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Pharao's heart is hardened, he will not let the people go.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen : Ingravatum est cor Pharaonis : non vult dimittere populum.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: O coração de Faraó está endurecido, recusa deixar ir o povo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν βεβάρηται ἡ καρδία Φαραω τοῦ μὴ ἐξαποστεῖλαι τὸν λαόν

text_en: Go to him in the morning, behold he will go out to the waters: and you shall stand to meet him on the bank of the river: and you shall take in your hand the rod that was turned into a serpent.
text_la: Vade ad eum mane, ecce egredietur ad aquas : et stabis in occursum ejus super ripam fluminis : et virgam quæ conversa est in draconem, tolles in manu tua.
text_pt: Vai pela manhã a Faraó; eis que ele sairá às águas; põe-te em frente dele na beira do rio, e tomarás em tua mão a vara que se tornou em cobra.
text_el: βάδισον πρὸς Φαραω τὸ πρωί ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἐκπορεύεται ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ στήσῃ συναντῶν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖλος τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν στραφεῖσαν εἰς ὄφιν λήμψῃ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου

text_en: And you shall say to him: The Lord God of the Hebrews sent me to you, saying: Let my people go to sacrifice to me in the desert : and hitherto you would not hear.
text_la: Dicesque ad eum : Dominus Deus Hebræorum misit me ad te, dicens : Dimitte populum meum ut sacrificet mihi in deserto : et usque ad præsens audire noluisti.
text_pt: E lhe dirás: O Senhor Deus dos hebreus me tem enviado a ti, dizendo: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me sirva no deserto; porém eis que até agora não tens ouvido.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτόν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν Εβραίων ἀπέσταλκέν με πρὸς σὲ λέγων ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαόν μου ἵνα μοι λατρεύσῃ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ εἰσήκουσας ἕως τούτου

text_en: Thus therefore says the Lord : In this you shall know that I am the Lord : behold I will strike with the rod, that is in my hand, the water of the river, and it shall be turned into blood.
text_la: Hæc igitur dicit Dominus : In hoc scies quod sim Dominus : ecce percutiam virga, quæ in manu mea est, aquam fluminis, et vertetur in sanguinem.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Nisto saberás que eu sou o Senhor: Eis que eu com esta vara, que tenho em minha mão, ferirei as águas que estão no rio, e tornar-se-ão em sangue.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐν τούτῳ γνώσῃ ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ τύπτω τῇ ῥάβδῳ τῇ ἐν τῇ χειρί μου ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ καὶ μεταβαλεῖ εἰς αἷμα

text_en: And the fishes that are in the river, shall die, and the waters shall be corrupted, and the Egyptians shall be afflicted when they drink the water of the river.
text_la: Pisces quoque, qui sunt in fluvio, morientur, et computrescent aquæ, et affligentur Ægyptii bibentes aquam fluminis.
text_pt: E os peixes, que estão no rio, morrerão, e o rio cheirará mal; e os egípcios terão nojo de beber da água do rio.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἰχθύες οἱ ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ τελευτήσουσιν καὶ ἐποζέσει ὁ ποταμός καὶ οὐ δυνήσονται οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι πιεῖν ὕδωρ ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ

text_en: The Lord also said to Moses : Say to Aaron , Take your rod; and stretch forth your hand upon the waters of Egypt , and upon their rivers, and streams and pools , and all the ponds of waters, that they may be turned into blood: and let blood be in all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood and of stone.
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen : Dic ad Aaron : Tolle virgam tuam, et extende manum tuam super aquas Ægypti, et super fluvios eorum, et rivos ac paludes, et omnes lacus aquarum, ut vertantur in sanguinem : et sit cruor in omni terra Ægypti, tam in ligneis vasis quam in saxeis.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Toma tua vara, e estende a tua mão sobre as águas do Egito, sobre as suas correntes, sobre os seus rios, e sobre os seus tanques, e sobre todo o ajuntamento das suas águas, para que se tornem em sangue; e haja sangue em toda a terra do Egito, assim nos vasos de madeira como nos de pedra.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν εἰπὸν Ααρων τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον σου καὶ ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ποταμοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς διώρυγας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἕλη αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶν συνεστηκὸς ὕδωρ αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσται αἷμα καὶ ἐγένετο αἷμα ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου ἔν τε τοῖς ξύλοις καὶ ἐν τοῖς λίθοις

text_en: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord had commanded: and lifting up the rod, he struck the water of the river before Pharao and his servants: and it was turned into blood.
text_la: Feceruntque Moyses et Aaron sicut præceperat Dominus : et elevans virgam percussit aquam fluminis coram Pharaone et servis ejus : quæ versa est in sanguinem.
text_pt: E Moisés e Arão fizeram assim como o Senhor tinha mandado; e Arão levantou a vara, e feriu as águas que estavam no rio, diante dos olhos de Faraó, e diante dos olhos de seus servos; e todas as águas do rio se tornaram em sangue,
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς κύριος καὶ ἐπάρας τῇ ῥάβδῳ αὐτοῦ ἐπάταξεν τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ καὶ μετέβαλεν πᾶν τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ εἰς αἷμα

text_en: And the fishes that were in the river died; and the river corrupted, and the Egyptians could not drink the water of the river, and there was blood in all the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et pisces, qui erant in flumine, mortui sunt : computruitque fluvius, et non poterant Ægyptii bibere aquam fluminis, et fuit sanguis in tota terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E os peixes, que estavam no rio, morreram, e o rio cheirou mal, e os egípcios não podiam beber a água do rio; e houve sangue por toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἰχθύες οἱ ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ ἐτελεύτησαν καὶ ἐπώζεσεν ὁ ποταμός καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι πιεῖν ὕδωρ ἐκ τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ ἦν τὸ αἷμα ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the magicians of the Egyptians with their enchantments did in like manner; and Pharao's heart was hardened, neither did he hear them, as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Feceruntque similiter malefici Ægyptiorum incantationibus suis : et induratum est cor Pharaonis, nec audivit eos, sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: Porém os magos do Egito também fizeram o mesmo com os seus encantamentos; de modo que o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não os ouviu, como o Senhor tinha dito.
text_el: ἐποίησαν δὲ ὡσαύτως καὶ οἱ ἐπαοιδοὶ τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ταῖς φαρμακείαις αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσκληρύνθη ἡ καρδία Φαραω καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν καθάπερ εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: And he turned himself away, and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to it this time also.
text_la: Avertitque se, et ingressus est domum suam, nec apposuit cor etiam hac vice.
text_pt: E virou-se Faraó, e foi para sua casa; nem ainda nisto pôs seu coração.
text_el: ἐπιστραφεὶς δὲ Φαραω εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐπέστησεν τὸν νοῦν αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τούτῳ

text_en: And all the Egyptians dug round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
text_la: Foderunt autem omnes Ægyptii per circuitum fluminis aquam ut biberent : non enim poterant bibere de aqua fluminis.
text_pt: E todos os egípcios cavaram poços junto ao rio, para beberem água; porquanto não podiam beber da água do rio.
text_el: ὤρυξαν δὲ πάντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι κύκλῳ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ὥστε πιεῖν ὕδωρ καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο πιεῖν ὕδωρ ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ

text_en: And seven days were fully ended, after that the Lord struck the river.
text_la: Impletique sunt septem dies, postquam percussit Dominus fluvium.
text_pt: Assim se cumpriram sete dias, depois que o Senhor ferira o rio.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεπληρώθησαν ἑπτὰ ἡμέραι μετὰ τὸ πατάξαι κύριον τὸν ποταμόν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Go in to Pharao , and you shall say to him: Thus says the Lord : Let my people go to sacrifice to me.
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen : Ingredere ad Pharaonem, et dices ad eum : Hæc dicit Dominus : Dimitte populum meum, ut sacrificet mihi:
text_pt: Depois disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Vai a Faraó e dize-lhe: Assim diz o SENHOR: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me sirva.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν εἴσελθε πρὸς Φαραω καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαόν μου ἵνα μοι λατρεύσωσιν

text_en: But if you will not let them go, behold I will strike all your coasts with frogs.
text_la: sin autem nolueris dimittere, ecce ego percutiam omnes terminos tuos ranis,
text_pt: E se recusares deixá-lo ir, eis que ferirei com rãs todos os teus termos.
text_el: εἰ δὲ μὴ βούλει σὺ ἐξαποστεῖλαι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ τύπτω πάντα τὰ ὅριά σου τοῖς βατράχοις

text_en: And the river shall bring forth an abundance of frogs; which shall come up and enter into your house, and your bedchamber, and upon your bed, and into the houses of your servants, and to your people, and into your ovens, and into the remains of your meats:
text_la: et ebulliet fluvius ranas : quæ ascendent, et ingredientur domum tuam, et cubiculum lectuli tui, et super stratum tuum, et in domos servorum tuorum, et in populum tuum, et in furnos tuos, et in reliquias ciborum tuorum:
text_pt: E o rio criará rãs, que subirão e virão à tua casa, e ao teu dormitório, e sobre a tua cama, e às casas dos teus servos, e sobre o teu povo, e aos teus fornos, e às tuas amassadeiras.
text_el: καὶ ἐξερεύξεται ὁ ποταμὸς βατράχους καὶ ἀναβάντες εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τοὺς οἴκους σου καὶ εἰς τὰ ταμίεια τῶν κοιτώνων σου καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν κλινῶν σου καὶ εἰς τοὺς οἴκους τῶν θεραπόντων σου καὶ τοῦ λαοῦ σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς φυράμασίν σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς κλιβάνοις σου

text_en: And the frogs shall come in to you, and to your people, and to all your servants.
text_la: et ad te, et ad populum tuum, et ad omnes servos tuos intrabunt ranæ.
text_pt: E as rãs subirão sobre ti, e sobre o teu povo, e sobre todos os teus servos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θεράποντάς σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου ἀναβήσονται οἱ βάτραχοι

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Say to Aaron : Stretch forth your hand upon the streams, and upon the rivers and the pools , and bring forth frogs upon the land of Egypt .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Dic ad Aaron : Extende manum tuam super fluvios ac super rivos et paludes, et educ ranas super terram Ægypti.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Estende a tua mão com tua vara sobre as correntes, e sobre os rios, e sobre os tanques, e faze subir rãs sobre a terra do Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν εἰπὸν Ααρων τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου ἔκτεινον τῇ χειρὶ τὴν ῥάβδον σου ἐπὶ τοὺς ποταμοὺς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς διώρυγας καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἕλη καὶ ἀνάγαγε τοὺς βατράχους

text_en: And Aaron stretched forth his hand upon the waters of Egypt , and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et extendit Aaron manum super aquas Ægypti, et ascenderunt ranæ, operueruntque terram Ægypti.
text_pt: E Arão estendeu a sua mão sobre as águas do Egito, e subiram rãs, e cobriram a terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Ααρων τὴν χεῖρα ἐπὶ τὰ ὕδατα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἀνήγαγεν τοὺς βατράχους καὶ ἀνεβιβάσθη ὁ βάτραχος καὶ ἐκάλυψεν τὴν γῆν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the magicians also, by their enchantments , did in like manner, and they brought forth frogs upon the land of Egypt .
text_la: Fecerunt autem et malefici per incantationes suas similiter, eduxeruntque ranas super terram Ægypti.
text_pt: Então os magos fizeram o mesmo com os seus encantamentos, e fizeram subir rãs sobre a terra do Egito.
text_el: ἐποίησαν δὲ ὡσαύτως καὶ οἱ ἐπαοιδοὶ τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ταῖς φαρμακείαις αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνήγαγον τοὺς βατράχους ἐπὶ γῆν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: But Pharao called Moses and Aaron , and said to them: Pray to the Lord to take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go to sacrifice to the Lord .
text_la: Vocavit autem Pharao Moysen et Aaron, et dixit eis : Orate Dominum ut auferat ranas a me et a populo meo, et dimittam populum ut sacrificet Domino.
text_pt: E Faraó chamou a Moisés e a Arão, e disse: Rogai ao Senhor que tire as rãs de mim e do meu povo; depois deixarei ir o povo, para que sacrifiquem ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Φαραω Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ εἶπεν εὔξασθε περὶ ἐμοῦ πρὸς κύριον καὶ περιελέτω τοὺς βατράχους ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ τὸν λαόν καὶ θύσωσιν κυρίῳ

text_en: And Moses said to Pharao : Set me a time when I shall pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs may be driven away from you and from your house, and from your servants, and from your people; and may remain only in the river.
text_la: Dixitque Moyses ad Pharaonem : Constitue mihi quando deprecer pro te, et pro servis tuis, et pro populo tuo, ut abigantur ranæ a te, et a domo tua, et a servis tuis, et a populo tuo : et tantum in flumine remaneant.
text_pt: E disse Moisés a Faraó: Digna-te dizer-me quando é que hei de rogar por ti, e pelos teus servos, e por teu povo, para tirar as rãs de ti, e das tuas casas, e fiquem somente no rio?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς Φαραω τάξαι πρός με πότε εὔξωμαι περὶ σοῦ καὶ περὶ τῶν θεραπόντων σου καὶ περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ σου ἀφανίσαι τοὺς βατράχους ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ σου καὶ ἐκ τῶν οἰκιῶν ὑμῶν πλὴν ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ ὑπολειφθήσονται

text_en: And he answered: Tomorrow. But he said: I will do according to your word; that you may know that there is none like to the Lord our God .
text_la: Qui respondit : Cras. At ille : Juxta, inquit, verbum tuum faciam : ut scias quoniam non est sicut Dominus Deus noster.
text_pt: E ele disse: Amanhã. E Moisés disse: Seja conforme à tua palavra, para que saibas que ninguém há como o Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν εἰς αὔριον εἶπεν οὖν ὡς εἴρηκας ἵνα εἰδῇς ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλος πλὴν κυρίου

text_en: And the frogs shall depart from you, and from your house, and from your servants, and from your people; and shall remain only in the river.
text_la: Et recedent ranæ a te, et a domo tua, et a servis tuis, et a populo tuo : et tantum in flumine remanebunt.
text_pt: E as rãs apartar-se-ão de ti, das tuas casas, dos teus servos, e do teu povo; somente ficarão no rio.
text_el: καὶ περιαιρεθήσονται οἱ βάτραχοι ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἐκ τῶν οἰκιῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐπαύλεων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν θεραπόντων σου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ σου πλὴν ἐν τῷ ποταμῷ ὑπολειφθήσονται

text_en: And Moses and Aaron went forth from Pharao : and Moses cried to the Lord for the promise , which he had made to Pharao concerning the frogs.
text_la: Egressique sunt Moyses et Aaron a Pharaone: et clamavit Moyses ad Dominum pro sponsione ranarum quam condixerat Pharaoni.
text_pt: Então saíram Moisés e Arão da presença de Faraó; e Moisés clamou ao Senhor por causa das rãs que tinha posto sobre Faraó.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων ἀπὸ Φαραω καὶ ἐβόησεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον περὶ τοῦ ὁρισμοῦ τῶν βατράχων ὡς ἐτάξατο Φαραω

text_en: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses : and the frogs died out of the houses, and out of the villages , and out of the fields:
text_la: Fecitque Dominus juxta verbum Moysi : et mortuæ sunt ranæ de domibus, et de villis, et de agris.
text_pt: E o Senhor fez conforme a palavra de Moisés; e as rãs morreram nas casas, nos pátios, e nos campos.
text_el: ἐποίησεν δὲ κύριος καθάπερ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐτελεύτησαν οἱ βάτραχοι ἐκ τῶν οἰκιῶν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐπαύλεων καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν

text_en: And they gathered them together into immense heaps, and the land was corrupted.
text_la: Congregaveruntque eas in immensos aggeres, et computruit terra.
text_pt: E ajuntaram-se em montões, e a terra cheirou mal.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγον αὐτοὺς θιμωνιὰς θιμωνιάς καὶ ὤζεσεν ἡ γῆ

text_en: And Pharao seeing that rest was given, hardened his own heart, and did not hear them, as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Videns autem Pharao quod data esset requies, ingravavit cor suum, et non audivit eos, sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, Faraó que havia descanso, endureceu o seu coração, e não os ouviu, como o Senhor tinha dito.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ Φαραω ὅτι γέγονεν ἀνάψυξις ἐβαρύνθη ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν κύριος

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Say to Aaron : Stretch forth your rod, and strike the dust of the earth; and may there be sciniphs in all the land of Egypt .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Loquere ad Aaron : Extende virgam tuam, et percute pulverem terræ : et sint sciniphes in universa terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Estende a tua vara, e fere o pó da terra, para que se torne em piolhos por toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν εἰπὸν Ααρων ἔκτεινον τῇ χειρὶ τὴν ῥάβδον σου καὶ πάταξον τὸ χῶμα τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔσονται σκνῖφες ἔν τε τοῖς ἀνθρώποις καὶ ἐν τοῖς τετράποσιν καὶ ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And they did so. And Aaron stretched forth his hand, holding the rod; and he struck the dust of the earth, and there came sciniphs on men and on beasts: all the dust of the earth was turned into sciniphs through all the land of Egypt .
text_la: Feceruntque ita. Et extendit Aaron manum, virgam tenens : percussitque pulverem terræ, et facti sunt sciniphes in hominibus, et in jumentis : omnis pulvis terræ versus est in sciniphes per totam terram Ægypti.
text_pt: E fizeram assim; e Arão estendeu a sua mão com a sua vara, e feriu o pó da terra, e havia muitos piolhos nos homens e no gado; todo o pó da terra se tornou em piolhos em toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: ἐξέτεινεν οὖν Ααρων τῇ χειρὶ τὴν ῥάβδον καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸ χῶμα τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ σκνῖφες ἔν τε τοῖς ἀνθρώποις καὶ ἐν τοῖς τετράποσιν καὶ ἐν παντὶ χώματι τῆς γῆς ἐγένοντο οἱ σκνῖφες ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the magicians with their enchantments practised in like manner, to bring forth sciniphs, and they could not: and there were sciniphs as well on men as on beasts.
text_la: Feceruntque similiter malefici incantationibus suis, ut educerent sciniphes, et non potuerunt : erantque sciniphes tam in hominibus quam in jumentis.
text_pt: E os magos fizeram também assim com os seus encantamentos para produzir piolhos, mas não puderam; e havia piolhos nos homens e no gado.
text_el: ἐποιήσαν δὲ ὡσαύτως καὶ οἱ ἐπαοιδοὶ ταῖς φαρμακείαις αὐτῶν ἐξαγαγεῖν τὸν σκνῖφα καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ σκνῖφες ἐν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις καὶ ἐν τοῖς τετράποσιν

text_en: And the magicians said to Pharao : This is the finger of God . And Pharao's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them, as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Et dixerunt malefici ad Pharaonem : Digitus Dei est hic; induratumque est cor Pharaonis, et non audivit eos sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: Então disseram os magos a Faraó: Isto é o dedo de Deus. Porém o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não os ouvia, como o Senhor tinha dito.
text_el: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ ἐπαοιδοὶ τῷ Φαραω δάκτυλος θεοῦ ἐστιν τοῦτο καὶ ἐσκληρύνθη ἡ καρδία Φαραω καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν κύριος

text_en: The Lord also said to Moses : Arise early, and stand before Pharao ; for he will go forth to the waters: and you shall say to him: Thus says the Lord : Let my people go to sacrifice to me.
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen : Consurge diluculo, et sta coram Pharaone : egredietur enim ad aquas : et dices ad eum : Hæc dicit Dominus : Dimitte populum meum ut sacrificet mihi.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Levanta-te pela manhã cedo e põe-te diante de Faraó; eis que ele sairá às águas; e dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me sirva.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ὄρθρισον τὸ πρωὶ καὶ στῆθι ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἐξελεύσεται ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαόν μου ἵνα μοι λατρεύσωσιν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: But if you will not let them go, behold I will send in upon you, and upon your servants, and upon your houses, all kind of flies: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be filled with flies of divers kinds, and the whole land wherein they shall be.
text_la: Quod si non dimiseris eum, ecce ego immittam in te, et in servos tuos, et in populum tuum, et in domos tuas, omne genus muscarum : et implebuntur domus Ægyptiorum muscis diversi generis, et universa terra in qua fuerint.
text_pt: Porque se não deixares ir o meu povo, eis que enviarei enxames de moscas sobre ti, e sobre os teus servos, e sobre o teu povo, e às tuas casas; e as casas dos egípcios se encherão destes enxames, e também a terra em que eles estiverem.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ βούλῃ ἐξαποστεῖλαι τὸν λαόν μου ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπαποστέλλω ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θεράποντάς σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς οἴκους ὑμῶν κυνόμυιαν καὶ πλησθήσονται αἱ οἰκίαι τῶν Αἰγυπτίων τῆς κυνομυίης καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐφ' ἧς εἰσιν ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will make the land of Gessen wonderful in that day, so that flies shall not be there: and you shall know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.
text_la: Faciamque mirabilem in die illa terram Gessen, in qua populus meus est, ut non sint ibi muscæ : et scias quoniam ego Dominus in medio terræ.
text_pt: E naquele dia eu separarei a terra de Gósen, em que meu povo habita, que nela não haja enxames de moscas para que saibas que eu sou o Senhor no meio desta terra.
text_el: καὶ παραδοξάσω ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ τὴν γῆν Γεσεμ ἐφ' ἧς ὁ λαός μου ἔπεστιν ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἐφ' ἧς οὐκ ἔσται ἐκεῖ ἡ κυνόμυια ἵνα εἰδῇς ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ κύριος πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: And I will put a division between my people and your people: tomorrow shall this sign be.
text_la: Ponamque divisionem inter populum meum et populum tuum : cras erit signum istud.
text_pt: E porei separação entre o meu povo e o teu povo; amanhã se fará este sinal.
text_el: καὶ δώσω διαστολὴν ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σοῦ λαοῦ ἐν δὲ τῇ αὔριον ἔσται τὸ σημεῖον τοῦτο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the Lord did so. And there came a very grievous swarm of flies into the houses of Pharao and of his servants, and into all the land of Egypt : and the land was corrupted by this kind of flies.
text_la: Fecitque Dominus ita. Et venit musca gravissima in domos Pharaonis et servorum ejus, et in omnem terram Ægypti : corruptaque est terra ab hujuscemodi muscis.
text_pt: E o Senhor fez assim; e vieram grandes enxames de moscas à casa de Faraó e às casas dos seus servos, e sobre toda a terra do Egito; a terra foi corrompida destes enxames.
text_el: ἐποίησεν δὲ κύριος οὕτως καὶ παρεγένετο ἡ κυνόμυια πλῆθος εἰς τοὺς οἴκους Φαραω καὶ εἰς τοὺς οἴκους τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐξωλεθρεύθη ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ τῆς κυνομυίης

text_en: And Pharao called Moses and Aaron , and said to them: Go and sacrifice to your God in this land.
text_la: Vocavitque Pharao Moysen et Aaron, et ait eis : Ite et sacrificate Deo vestro in terra hac.
text_pt: Então chamou Faraó a Moisés e a Arão, e disse: Ide, e sacrificai ao vosso Deus nesta terra.
text_el: ἐκάλεσεν δὲ Φαραω Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων ἐλθόντες θύσατε τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: And Moses said: It cannot be so: for we shall sacrifice the abominations of the Egyptians to the Lord our God : now if we kill those things which the Egyptians worship , in their presence, they will stone us.
text_la: Et ait Moyses : Non potest ita fieri : abominationes enim Ægyptiorum immolabimus Domino Deo nostro : quod si mactaverimus ea quæ colunt Ægyptii coram eis, lapidibus nos obruent.
text_pt: E Moisés disse: Não convém que façamos assim, porque sacrificaríamos ao Senhor nosso Deus a abominação dos egípcios; eis que se sacrificássemos a abominação dos egípcios perante os seus olhos, não nos apedrejariam eles?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς οὐ δυνατὸν γενέσθαι οὕτως τὰ γὰρ βδελύγματα τῶν Αἰγυπτίων θύσομεν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἐὰν γὰρ θύσωμεν τὰ βδελύγματα τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ἐναντίον αὐτῶν λιθοβοληθησόμεθα

text_en: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness ; and we will sacrifice to the Lord our God , as he has commanded us.
text_la: Viam trium dierum pergemus in solitudinem : et sacrificabimus Domino Deo nostro, sicut præcepit nobis.
text_pt: Deixa-nos ir caminho de três dias ao deserto, para que sacrifiquemos ao Senhor nosso Deus, como ele nos disser.
text_el: ὁδὸν τριῶν ἡμερῶν πορευσόμεθα εἰς τὴν ἔρημον καὶ θύσομεν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν καθάπερ εἶπεν ἡμῖν

text_en: And Pharao said: I will let you go to sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness , but go no farther: pray for me.
text_la: Dixitque Pharao : Ego dimittam vos ut sacrificetis Domino Deo vestro in deserto : verumtamen longius ne abeatis, rogate pro me.
text_pt: Então disse Faraó: Deixar-vos-ei ir, para que sacrifiqueis ao Senhor vosso Deus no deserto; somente que, indo, não vades longe; orai também por mim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Φαραω ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω ὑμᾶς καὶ θύσατε κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἀλλ' οὐ μακρὰν ἀποτενεῖτε πορευθῆναι εὔξασθε οὖν περὶ ἐμοῦ πρὸς κύριον

text_en: And Moses said: I will go out from you, and will pray to the Lord : and the flies shall depart from Pharao , and from his servants, and from his people tomorrow: but do not deceive any more, in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the Lord .
text_la: At ait Moyses : Egressus a te, orabo Dominum : et recedet musca a Pharaone, et a servis suis, et a populo ejus cras : verumtamen noli ultra fallere, ut non dimittas populum sacrificare Domino.
text_pt: E Moisés disse: Eis que saio de ti, e orarei ao Senhor, que estes enxames de moscas se retirem amanhã de Faraó, dos seus servos, e do seu povo; somente que Faraó não mais me engane, não deixando ir a este povo para sacrificar ao Senhor.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς ὅδε ἐγὼ ἐξελεύσομαι ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ εὔξομαι πρὸς τὸν θεόν καὶ ἀπελεύσεται ἡ κυνόμυια ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν θεραπόντων σου καὶ τοῦ λαοῦ σου αὔριον μὴ προσθῇς ἔτι Φαραω ἐξαπατῆσαι τοῦ μὴ ἐξαποστεῖλαι τὸν λαὸν θῦσαι κυρίῳ

text_en: So Moses went out from Pharao , and prayed to the Lord .
text_la: Egressusque Moyses a Pharaone, oravit Dominum.
text_pt: Então saiu Moisés da presença de Faraó, e orou ao Senhor.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ Φαραω καὶ ηὔξατο πρὸς τὸν θεόν

text_en: And he did according to his word: and he took away the flies from Pharao , and from his servants, and from his people: there was not left so much as one.
text_la: Qui fecit juxta verbum illius, et abstulit muscas a Pharaone, et a servis suis, et a populo ejus : non superfuit ne una quidem.
text_pt: E fez o Senhor conforme a palavra de Moisés, e os enxames de moscas se retiraram de Faraó, dos seus servos, e do seu povo; não ficou uma só.
text_el: ἐποίησεν δὲ κύριος καθάπερ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς καὶ περιεῖλεν τὴν κυνόμυιαν ἀπὸ Φαραω καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη οὐδεμία

text_en: And Pharao's heart was hardened, so that neither this time would he let the people go.
text_la: Et ingravatum est cor Pharaonis, ita ut nec hac quidem vice dimitteret populum.
text_pt: Mas endureceu Faraó ainda esta vez seu coração, e não deixou ir o povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐβάρυνεν Φαραω τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ καιροῦ τούτου καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν ἐξαποστεῖλαι τὸν λαόν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Go in to Pharao , and speak to him: Thus says the Lord God of the Hebrews : Let my people go to sacrifice to me.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen : Ingredere ad Pharaonem, et loquere ad eum : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Hebræorum : Dimitte populum meum ut sacrificet mihi.
text_pt: Depois o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Vai a Faraó, e dize-lhe: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus dos hebreus: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me sirva.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν εἴσελθε πρὸς Φαραω καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν Εβραίων ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαόν μου ἵνα μοι λατρεύσωσιν

text_en: But if you refuse, and withhold them still:
text_la: Quod si adhuc renuis, et retines eos,
text_pt: Porque se recusares deixá-los ir, e ainda por força os detiveres,
text_el: εἰ μὲν οὖν μὴ βούλει ἐξαποστεῖλαι τὸν λαόν μου ἀλλ' ἔτι ἐγκρατεῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Behold my hand shall be upon your fields; and a very grievous murrain upon your horses, and asses, and camels, and oxen, and sheep.
text_la: ecce manus mea erit super agros tuos, et super equos, et asinos, et camelos, et boves, et oves, pestis valde gravis.
text_pt: Eis que a mão do Senhor será sobre teu gado, que está no campo, sobre os cavalos, sobre os jumentos, sobre os camelos, sobre os bois, e sobre as ovelhas, com pestilência gravíssima.
text_el: ἰδοὺ χεὶρ κυρίου ἐπέσται ἐν τοῖς κτήνεσίν σου τοῖς ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις ἔν τε τοῖς ἵπποις καὶ ἐν τοῖς ὑποζυγίοις καὶ ταῖς καμήλοις καὶ βουσὶν καὶ προβάτοις θάνατος μέγας σφόδρα

text_en: And the Lord will make a wonderful difference between the possessions of Israel and the possessions of the Egyptians , that nothing at all shall die of those things that belong to the children of Israel .
text_la: Et faciet Dominus mirabile inter possessiones Israël et possessiones Ægyptiorum, ut nihil omnino pereat ex eis quæ pertinent ad filios Israël.
text_pt: E o Senhor fará separação entre o gado dos israelitas e o gado dos egípcios, para que nada morra de tudo o que for dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ παραδοξάσω ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν Αἰγυπτίων καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὐ τελευτήσει ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν τοῦ Ισραηλ υἱῶν ῥητόν

text_en: And the Lord appointed a time, saying: Tomorrow will the Lord do this thing in the land.
text_la: Constituitque Dominus tempus, dicens : Cras faciet Dominus verbum istud in terra.
text_pt: E o Senhor assinalou certo tempo, dizendo: Amanhã fará o Senhor esta coisa na terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς ὅρον λέγων ἐν τῇ αὔριον ποιήσει κύριος τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: The Lord therefore did this thing the next day: and all the beasts of the Egyptians died, but of the beasts of the children of Israel there died not one.
text_la: Fecit ergo Dominus verbum hoc altera die : mortuaque sunt omnia animantia Ægyptiorum; de animalibus vero filiorum Israël, nihil omnino periit.
text_pt: E o Senhor fez isso no dia seguinte, e todo o gado dos egípcios morreu; porém do gado dos filhos de Israel não morreu nenhum.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν κύριος τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τῇ ἐπαύριον καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν πάντα τὰ κτήνη τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὐκ ἐτελεύτησεν οὐδέν

text_en: And Pharao sent to see; and there was not anything dead of that which Israel possessed. And Pharao's heart was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
text_la: Et misit Pharao ad videndum : nec erat quidquam mortuum de his quæ possidebat Israël. Ingravatumque est cor Pharaonis, et non dimisit populum.
text_pt: E Faraó enviou a ver, e eis que do gado de Israel não morrera nenhum; porém o coração de Faraó se agravou, e não deixou ir o povo.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ Φαραω ὅτι οὐκ ἐτελεύτησεν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ οὐδέν ἐβαρύνθη ἡ καρδία Φαραω καὶ οὐκ ἐξαπέστειλεν τὸν λαόν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron : Take to you handfuls of ashes out of the chimney, and let Moses sprinkle it in the air in the presence of Pharao .
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron : Tollite plenas manus cineris de camino, et spargat illum Moyses in cælum coram Pharaone.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão: Tomai vossas mãos cheias de cinza do forno, e Moisés a espalhe para o céu diante dos olhos de Faraó;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων λάβετε ὑμεῖς πλήρεις τὰς χεῖρας αἰθάλης καμιναίας καὶ πασάτω Μωυσῆς εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And be there dust upon all the land of Egypt : for there shall be boils and swelling blains both in men and beasts, in the whole land of Egypt .
text_la: Sitque pulvis super omnem terram Ægypti : erunt enim in hominibus et jumentis ulcera, et vesicæ turgentes in universa terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E tornar-se-á em pó miúdo sobre toda a terra do Egito, e se tornará em sarna, que arrebente em úlceras, nos homens e no gado, por toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ γενηθήτω κονιορτὸς ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἔσται ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ τετράποδα ἕλκη φλυκτίδες ἀναζέουσαι ἔν τε τοῖς ἀνθρώποις καὶ ἐν τοῖς τετράποσιν καὶ ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And they took ashes out of the chimney, and stood before Pharao , and Moses sprinkled it in the air; and there came boils with swelling blains in men and beasts.
text_la: Tuleruntque cinerem de camino, et steterunt coram Pharaone, et sparsit illum Moyses in cælum : factaque sunt ulcera vesicarum turgentium in hominibus et jumentis:
text_pt: E eles tomaram a cinza do forno, e puseram-se diante de Faraó, e Moisés a espalhou para o céu; e tornou-se em sarna, que arrebentava em úlceras nos homens e no gado;
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν αἰθάλην τῆς καμιναίας ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἔπασεν αὐτὴν Μωυσῆς εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ ἐγένετο ἕλκη φλυκτίδες ἀναζέουσαι ἐν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις καὶ ἐν τοῖς τετράποσιν

text_en: Neither could the magicians stand before Moses , for the boils that were upon them, and in all the land of Egypt .
text_la: nec poterant malefici stare coram Moyse propter ulcera quæ in illis erant, et in omni terra Ægypti.
text_pt: De maneira que os magos não podiam parar diante de Moisés, por causa da sarna; porque havia sarna nos magos, e em todos os egípcios.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο οἱ φαρμακοὶ στῆναι ἐναντίον Μωυσῆ διὰ τὰ ἕλκη ἐγένετο γὰρ τὰ ἕλκη ἐν τοῖς φαρμακοῖς καὶ ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the Lord hardened Pharao's heart, and he hearkened not unto them, as the Lord had spoken to Moses .
text_la: Induravitque Dominus cor Pharaonis, et non audivit eos, sicut locutus est Dominus ad Moysen.
text_pt: Porém o Senhor endureceu o coração de Faraó, e não os ouviu, como o Senhor tinha dito a Moisés.
text_el: ἐσκλήρυνεν δὲ κύριος τὴν καρδίαν Φαραω καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Arise in the morning, and stand before Pharao , and you shall say to him: Thus says the Lord , the God of the Hebrews : Let my people go to sacrifice to me.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Mane consurge, et sta coram Pharaone, et dices ad eum : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Hebræorum : Dimitte populum meum ut sacrificet mihi.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Levanta-te pela manhã cedo, e põe-te diante de Faraó, e dize-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor Deus dos hebreus: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me sirva;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ὄρθρισον τὸ πρωὶ καὶ στῆθι ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν Εβραίων ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαόν μου ἵνα λατρεύσωσίν μοι

text_en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon your heart, and upon your servants, and upon your people; that you may know that there is none like me in all the earth.
text_la: Quia in hac vice mittam omnes plagas meas super cor tuum, et super servos tuos, et super populum tuum : ut scias quod non sit similis mei in omni terra.
text_pt: Porque esta vez enviarei todas as minhas pragas sobre o teu coração, e sobre os teus servos, e sobre o teu povo, para que saibas que não há outro como eu em toda a terra.
text_el: ἐν τῷ γὰρ νῦν καιρῷ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω πάντα τὰ συναντήματά μου εἰς τὴν καρδίαν σου καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων σου καὶ τοῦ λαοῦ σου ἵν' εἰδῇς ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς ἐγὼ ἄλλος ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: For now I will stretch out my hand to strike you, and your people, with pestilence, and you shall perish from the earth.
text_la: Nunc enim extendens manum percutiam te, et populum tuum peste, peribisque de terra.
text_pt: Porque agora tenho estendido minha mão, para te ferir a ti e ao teu povo com pestilência, e para que sejas destruído da terra;
text_el: νῦν γὰρ ἀποστείλας τὴν χεῖρα πατάξω σε καὶ τὸν λαόν σου θανάτῳ καὶ ἐκτριβήσῃ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And therefore have I raised you, that I may show my power in you, and my name may be spoken of throughout all the earth.
text_la: Idcirco autem posui te, ut ostendam in te fortitudinem meam, et narretur nomen meum in omni terra.
text_pt: Mas, deveras, para isto te mantive, para mostrar meu poder em ti, e para que o meu nome seja anunciado em toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἕνεκεν τούτου διετηρήθης ἵνα ἐνδείξωμαι ἐν σοὶ τὴν ἰσχύν μου καὶ ὅπως διαγγελῇ τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: Do you yet hold back my people; and will you not let them go?
text_la: Adhuc retines populum meum, et non vis dimittere eum?
text_pt: Tu ainda te exaltas contra o meu povo, para não o deixar ir?
text_el: ἔτι οὖν σὺ ἐμποιῇ τοῦ λαοῦ μου τοῦ μὴ ἐξαποστεῖλαι αὐτούς

text_en: Behold I will cause it to rain tomorrow at this same hour, an exceeding great hail; such as has not been in Egypt from the day that it was founded, until this present time.
text_la: En pluam cras hac ipsa hora grandinem multam nimis, qualis non fuit in Ægypto a die qua fundata est, usque in præsens tempus.
text_pt: Eis que amanhã por este tempo farei chover saraiva mui grave, qual nunca houve no Egito, desde o dia em que foi fundado até agora.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ὕω ταύτην τὴν ὥραν αὔριον χάλαζαν πολλὴν σφόδρα ἥτις τοιαύτη οὐ γέγονεν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἔκτισται ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: Send therefore now presently, and gather together your cattle, and all that you have in the field; for men and beasts, and all things that shall be found abroad, and not gathered together out of the fields which the hail shall fall upon, shall die.
text_la: Mitte ergo jam nunc, et congrega jumenta tua, et omnia quæ habes in agro : homines enim, et jumenta, et universa quæ inventa fuerint foris, nec congregata de agris, cecideritque super ea grando, morientur.
text_pt: Agora, pois, envia, recolhe o teu gado, e tudo o que tens no campo; todo o homem e animal, que for achado no campo, e não for recolhido à casa, a saraiva cairá sobre eles, e morrerão.
text_el: νῦν οὖν κατάσπευσον συναγαγεῖν τὰ κτήνη σου καὶ ὅσα σοί ἐστιν ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ πάντες γὰρ οἱ ἄνθρωποι καὶ τὰ κτήνη ὅσα ἂν εὑρεθῇ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ καὶ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς οἰκίαν πέσῃ δὲ ἐπ' αὐτὰ ἡ χάλαζα τελευτήσει

text_en: He that feared the word of the Lord among Pharao's servants, made his servants and his cattle flee into houses:
text_la: Qui timuit verbum Domini de servis Pharaonis, facit confugere servos suos et jumenta in domos:
text_pt: Quem dos servos de Faraó temia a palavra do Senhor, fez fugir os seus servos e o seu gado para as casas;
text_el: ὁ φοβούμενος τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου τῶν θεραπόντων Φαραω συνήγαγεν τὰ κτήνη αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς οἴκους

text_en: But he that regarded not the word of the Lord , left his servants, and his cattle in the fields.
text_la: qui autem neglexit sermonem Domini, dimisit servos suos et jumenta in agris.
text_pt: Mas aquele que não tinha considerado a palavra do Senhor deixou os seus servos e o seu gado no campo.
text_el: ὃς δὲ μὴ προσέσχεν τῇ διανοίᾳ εἰς τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ἀφῆκεν τὰ κτήνη ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Stretch forth your hand towards heaven , that there may be hail in the whole land of Egypt upon men , and upon beasts, and upon every herb of the field in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Moysen : Extende manum tuam in cælum, ut fiat grando in universa terra Ægypti super homines, et super jumenta, et super omnem herbam agri in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Estende a tua mão para o céu, e haverá saraiva em toda a terra do Egito, sobre os homens e sobre o gado, e sobre toda a erva do campo, na terra do Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρά σου εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ ἔσται χάλαζα ἐπὶ πᾶσαν γῆν Αἰγύπτου ἐπί τε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ τὰ κτήνη καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν βοτάνην τὴν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And Moses stretched forth his rod towards heaven , and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and lightnings running along the ground: and the Lord rained hail upon the land of Egypt .
text_la: Extenditque Moyses virgam in cælum, et Dominus dedit tonitrua, et grandinem, ac discurrentia fulgura super terram : pluitque Dominus grandinem super terram Ægypti.
text_pt: E Moisés estendeu a sua vara para o céu, e o Senhor deu trovões e saraiva, e fogo corria pela terra; e o Senhor fez chover saraiva sobre a terra do Egito.
text_el: ἐξέτεινεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὴν χεῖρα εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ κύριος ἔδωκεν φωνὰς καὶ χάλαζαν καὶ διέτρεχεν τὸ πῦρ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔβρεξεν κύριος χάλαζαν ἐπὶ πᾶσαν γῆν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the hail and fire mixt with it drove on together: and it was of so great bigness, as never before was seen in the whole land of Egypt since that nation was founded.
text_la: Et grando et ignis mista pariter ferebantur : tantæque fuit magnitudinis, quanta ante numquam apparuit in universa terra Ægypti ex quo gens illa condita est.
text_pt: E havia saraiva, e fogo misturado entre a saraiva, tão grave, qual nunca houve em toda a terra do Egito desde que veio a ser uma nação.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἡ χάλαζα καὶ τὸ πῦρ φλογίζον ἐν τῇ χαλάζῃ ἡ δὲ χάλαζα πολλὴ σφόδρα σφόδρα ἥτις τοιαύτη οὐ γέγονεν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἀφ' οὗ γεγένηται ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἔθνος

text_en: And the hail destroyed through all the land of Egypt all things that were in the fields, both man and beast: and the hail smote every herb of the field, and it broke every tree of the country.
text_la: Et percussit grando in omni terra Ægypti cuncta quæ fuerunt in agris, ab homine usque ad jumentum : cunctamque herbam agri percussit grando, et omne lignum regionis confregit.
text_pt: E a saraiva feriu, em toda a terra do Egito, tudo quanto havia no campo, desde os homens até aos animais; também a saraiva feriu toda a erva do campo, e quebrou todas as árvores do campo.
text_el: ἐπάταξεν δὲ ἡ χάλαζα ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους καὶ πᾶσαν βοτάνην τὴν ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ ἐπάταξεν ἡ χάλαζα καὶ πάντα τὰ ξύλα τὰ ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις συνέτριψεν ἡ χάλαζα

text_en: Only in the land of Gessen, where the children of Israel were, the hail fell not.
text_la: Tantum in terra Gessen, ubi erant filii Israël, grando non cecidit.
text_pt: Somente na terra de Gósen, onde estavam os filhos de Israel, não havia saraiva.
text_el: πλὴν ἐν γῇ Γεσεμ οὗ ἦσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ οὐκ ἐγένετο ἡ χάλαζα

text_en: And Pharao sent and called Moses and Aaron , saying to them: I have sinned this time also, the Lord is just : I and my people, are wicked .
text_la: Misitque Pharao, et vocavit Moysen et Aaron, dicens ad eos : Peccavi etiam nunc : Dominus justus; ego et populus meus, impii.
text_pt: Então Faraó mandou chamar a Moisés e a Arão, e disse-lhes: Esta vez pequei; o Senhor é justo, mas eu e o meu povo ímpios.
text_el: ἀποστείλας δὲ Φαραω ἐκάλεσεν Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἡμάρτηκα τὸ νῦν ὁ κύριος δίκαιος ἐγὼ δὲ καὶ ὁ λαός μου ἀσεβεῖς

text_en: Pray to the Lord that the thunderings of God and the hail may cease: that I may let you go, and that you may stay here no longer.
text_la: Orate Dominum ut desinant tonitrua Dei, et grando : ut dimittam vos, et nequaquam hic ultra maneatis.
text_pt: Orai ao Senhor (pois que basta) para que não haja mais trovões de Deus nem saraiva; e eu vos deixarei ir, e não ficareis mais aqui.
text_el: εὔξασθε οὖν περὶ ἐμοῦ πρὸς κύριον καὶ παυσάσθω τοῦ γενηθῆναι φωνὰς θεοῦ καὶ χάλαζαν καὶ πῦρ καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ ὑμᾶς καὶ οὐκέτι προσθήσεσθε μένειν

text_en: Moses said: As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will stretch forth my hands to the Lord , and the thunders shall cease, and the hail shall be no more: that you may know that the earth is the Lord's :
text_la: Ait Moyses : Cum egressus fuero de urbe, extendam palmas meas ad Dominum, et cessabunt tonitrua, et grando non erit, ut scias quia Domini est terra:
text_pt: Então lhe disse Moisés: Em saindo da cidade estenderei minhas mãos ao Senhor; os trovões cessarão, e não haverá mais saraiva; para que saibas que a terra é do Senhor.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Μωυσῆς ὡς ἂν ἐξέλθω τὴν πόλιν ἐκπετάσω τὰς χεῖράς μου πρὸς κύριον καὶ αἱ φωναὶ παύσονται καὶ ἡ χάλαζα καὶ ὁ ὑετὸς οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι ἵνα γνῷς ὅτι τοῦ κυρίου ἡ γῆ

text_en: But I know that neither you, nor your servants do yet fear the Lord God .
text_la: novi autem quod et tu et servi tui necdum timeatis Dominum Deum.
text_pt: Todavia, quanto a ti e aos teus servos, eu sei que ainda não temereis diante do Senhor Deus.
text_el: καὶ σὺ καὶ οἱ θεράποντές σου ἐπίσταμαι ὅτι οὐδέπω πεφόβησθε τὸν κύριον

text_en: The flax therefore, and the barley were hurt, because the barley was green, and the flax was now bolled;
text_la: Linum ergo et hordeum læsum est, eo quod hordeum esset virens, et linum jam folliculos germinaret:
text_pt: E o linho e a cevada foram feridos, porque a cevada já estava na espiga, e o linho na haste.
text_el: τὸ δὲ λίνον καὶ ἡ κριθὴ ἐπλήγη ἡ γὰρ κριθὴ παρεστηκυῖα τὸ δὲ λίνον σπερματίζον

text_en: but the wheat, and other winter corn were not hurt, because they were lateward.
text_la: triticum autem et far non sunt læsa, quia serotina erant.
text_pt: Mas o trigo e o centeio não foram feridos, porque estavam cobertos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ πυρὸς καὶ ἡ ὀλύρα οὐκ ἐπλήγη ὄψιμα γὰρ ἦν

text_en: And when Moses had gone from Pharao out of the city, he stretched forth his hands to the Lord : and the thunders and the hail ceased, neither did there drop any more rain upon the earth.
text_la: Egressusque Moyses a Pharaone ex urbe, tetendit manus ad Dominum : et cessaverunt tonitrua et grando, nec ultra stillavit pluvia super terram.
text_pt: Saiu, pois, Moisés da presença de Faraó, da cidade, e estendeu as suas mãos ao Senhor; e cessaram os trovões e a saraiva, e a chuva não caiu mais sobre a terra.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ Φαραω ἐκτὸς τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐξεπέτασεν τὰς χεῖρας πρὸς κύριον καὶ αἱ φωναὶ ἐπαύσαντο καὶ ἡ χάλαζα καὶ ὁ ὑετὸς οὐκ ἔσταξεν ἔτι ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And Pharao seeing that the rain, and the hail, and the thunders were ceased, increased his sin :
text_la: Videns autem Pharao quod cessasset pluvia, et grando, et tonitrua, auxit peccatum:
text_pt: Vendo Faraó que cessou a chuva, e a saraiva, e os trovões, pecou ainda mais; e endureceu o seu coração, ele e os seus servos.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ Φαραω ὅτι πέπαυται ὁ ὑετὸς καὶ ἡ χάλαζα καὶ αἱ φωναί προσέθετο τοῦ ἁμαρτάνειν καὶ ἐβάρυνεν αὐτοῦ τὴν καρδίαν καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And his heart was hardened, and the heart of his servants, and it was made exceeding hard: neither did he let the children of Israel go, as the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses .
text_la: et ingravatum est cor ejus, et servorum illius, et induratum nimis : nec dimisit filios Israël, sicut præceperat Dominus per manum Moysi.
text_pt: Assim o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não deixou ir os filhos de Israel, como o Senhor tinha dito por Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐσκληρύνθη ἡ καρδία Φαραω καὶ οὐκ ἐξαπέστειλεν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Go in to Pharao ; for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants: that I may work these my signs in him,
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Moysen : Ingredere ad Pharaonem : ego enim induravi cor ejus, et servorum illius, ut faciam signa mea hæc in eo:
text_pt: Depois disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Vai a Faraó, porque tenho endurecido o seu coração, e o coração de seus servos, para fazer estes meus sinais no meio deles,
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων εἴσελθε πρὸς Φαραω ἐγὼ γὰρ ἐσκλήρυνα αὐτοῦ τὴν καρδίαν καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ ἵνα ἑξῆς ἐπέλθῃ τὰ σημεῖα ταῦτα ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: and you may tell in the ears of your sons, and of your grandsons, how often I have plagued the Egyptians , and wrought my signs amongst them: and you may know that I am the Lord .
text_la: et narres in auribus filii tui, et nepotum tuorum, quoties contriverim Ægyptios, et signa mea fecerim in eis : et sciatis quia ego Dominus.
text_pt: E para que contes aos ouvidos de teus filhos, e dos filhos de teus filhos, as coisas que fiz no Egito, e os meus sinais, que tenho feito entre eles; para que saibais que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: ὅπως διηγήσησθε εἰς τὰ ὦτα τῶν τέκνων ὑμῶν καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις τῶν τέκνων ὑμῶν ὅσα ἐμπέπαιχα τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις καὶ τὰ σημεῖά μου ἃ ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: Therefore Moses and Aaron went in to Pharao , and said to him: Thus says the Lord God of the Hebrews : How long will you refuse to submit to me? Let my people go, to sacrifice to me.
text_la: Introierunt ergo Moyses et Aaron ad Pharaonem, et dixerunt ei : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Hebræorum : Usquequo non vis subjici mihi? dimitte populum meum, ut sacrificet mihi.
text_pt: Assim foram Moisés e Arão a Faraó, e disseram-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor Deus dos hebreus: Até quando recusarás humilhar-te diante de mim? Deixa ir o meu povo para que me sirva;
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν Εβραίων ἕως τίνος οὐ βούλει ἐντραπῆναί με ἐξαπόστειλον τὸν λαόν μου ἵνα λατρεύσωσίν μοι

text_en: But if you resist, and will not let them go, behold I will bring in tomorrow the locusts into your coasts;
text_la: Sin autem resistis, et non vis dimittere eum : ecce ego inducam cras locustam in fines tuos:
text_pt: Porque se ainda recusares deixar ir o meu povo, eis que trarei amanhã gafanhotos aos teus termos.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ θέλῃς σὺ ἐξαποστεῖλαι τὸν λαόν μου ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ταύτην τὴν ὥραν αὔριον ἀκρίδα πολλὴν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ὅριά σου

text_en: to cover the face of the earth, that nothing thereof may appear, but that which the hail has left may be eaten: for they shall feed upon all the trees that spring in the fields.
text_la: quæ operiat superficiem terræ, ne quidquam ejus appareat, sed comedatur quod residuum fuerit grandini : corrodet enim omnia ligna quæ germinant in agris.
text_pt: E cobrirão a face da terra, de modo que não se poderá ver a terra; e eles comerão o restante que escapou, o que vos ficou da saraiva; também comerão toda a árvore que vos cresce no campo;
text_el: καὶ καλύψει τὴν ὄψιν τῆς γῆς καὶ οὐ δυνήσῃ κατιδεῖν τὴν γῆν καὶ κατέδεται πᾶν τὸ περισσὸν τῆς γῆς τὸ καταλειφθέν ὃ κατέλιπεν ὑμῖν ἡ χάλαζα καὶ κατέδεται πᾶν ξύλον τὸ φυόμενον ὑμῖν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And they shall fill your houses, and the houses of your servants, and of all the Egyptians : such a number as your fathers have not seen, nor your grandfathers, from the time they were first upon the earth, until this present day. And he turned himself away, and went forth from Pharao .
text_la: Et implebunt domos tuas, et servorum tuorum, et omnium Ægyptiorum, quantam non viderunt patres tui, et avi, ex quo orti sunt super terram, usque in præsentem diem. Avertitque se, et egressus est a Pharaone.
text_pt: E encherão as tuas casas, e as casas de todos os teus servos e as casas de todos os egípcios, quais nunca viram teus pais, nem os pais de teus pais, desde o dia em que se acharam na terra até o dia de hoje. E virou-se, e saiu da presença de Faraó.
text_el: καὶ πλησθήσονταί σου αἱ οἰκίαι καὶ αἱ οἰκίαι τῶν θεραπόντων σου καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ οἰκίαι ἐν πάσῃ γῇ τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ἃ οὐδέποτε ἑωράκασιν οἱ πατέρες σου οὐδὲ οἱ πρόπαπποι αὐτῶν ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας γεγόνασιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης καὶ ἐκκλίνας Μωυσῆς ἐξῆλθεν ἀπὸ Φαραω

text_en: And Pharao's servants said to him: How long shall we endure this scandal ? Let the men go to sacrifice to the Lord their God . Do you not see that Egypt is undone?
text_la: Dixerunt autem servi Pharaonis ad eum : Usquequo patiemur hoc scandalum? dimitte homines, ut sacrificent Domino Deo suo; nonne vides quod perierit Ægyptus?
text_pt: E os servos de Faraó disseram-lhe: Até quando este homem nos há de ser por laço? Deixa ir os homens, para que sirvam ao Senhor seu Deus; ainda não sabes que o Egito está destruído?
text_el: καὶ λέγουσιν οἱ θεράποντες Φαραω πρὸς αὐτόν ἕως τίνος ἔσται τοῦτο ἡμῖν σκῶλον ἐξαπόστειλον τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ὅπως λατρεύσωσιν τῷ θεῷ αὐτῶν ἢ εἰδέναι βούλει ὅτι ἀπόλωλεν Αἴγυπτος

text_en: And they called back Moses , and Aaron , to Pharao ; and he said to them: Go, sacrifice to the Lord your God : who are they that shall go?
text_la: Revocaveruntque Moysen et Aaron ad Pharaonem : qui dixit eis : Ite, sacrificate Domino Deo vestro : quinam sunt qui ituri sunt?
text_pt: Então Moisés e Arão foram levados outra vez a Faraó, e ele disse-lhes: Ide, servi ao Senhor vosso Deus. Quais são os que hão de ir?
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν τόν τε Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων πρὸς Φαραω καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς πορεύεσθε καὶ λατρεύσατε τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν τίνες δὲ καὶ τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ πορευόμενοι

text_en: Moses said: We will go with our young and old, with our sons and daughters, with our sheep and herds: for it is the solemnity of the Lord our God .
text_la: Ait Moyses : Cum parvulis nostris, et senioribus pergemus, cum filiis et filiabus, cum ovibus et armentis : est enim solemnitas Domini Dei nostri.
text_pt: E Moisés disse: Havemos de ir com os nossos jovens, e com os nossos velhos; com os nossos filhos, e com as nossas filhas, com as nossas ovelhas, e com os nossos bois havemos de ir; porque temos de celebrar uma festa ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ λέγει Μωυσῆς σὺν τοῖς νεανίσκοις καὶ πρεσβυτέροις πορευσόμεθα σὺν τοῖς υἱοῖς καὶ θυγατράσιν καὶ προβάτοις καὶ βουσὶν ἡμῶν ἔστιν γὰρ ἑορτὴ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: And Pharao answered: So be the Lord with you, as I shall let you and your children go: who can doubt but that you intend some great evil ?
text_la: Et respondit Pharao : Sic Dominus sit vobiscum, quomodo ego dimittam vos, et parvulos vestros, cui dubium est quod pessime cogitetis?
text_pt: Então ele lhes disse: Seja o Senhor assim convosco, como eu vos deixarei ir a vós e a vossos filhos; olhai que há mal diante da vossa face.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἔστω οὕτως κύριος μεθ' ὑμῶν καθότι ἀποστέλλω ὑμᾶς μὴ καὶ τὴν ἀποσκευὴν ὑμῶν ἴδετε ὅτι πονηρία πρόκειται ὑμῖν

text_en: It shall not be so, but go, you men only, and sacrifice to the Lord : for this yourselves also desired. And immediately they were cast out from Pharao's presence.
text_la: non fiet ita, sed ite tantum viri, et sacrificate Domino : hoc enim et ipsi petistis. Statimque ejecti sunt de conspectu Pharaonis.
text_pt: Não será assim; agora ide vós, homens, e servi ao Senhor; pois isso é o que pedistes. E os expulsaram da presença de Faraó.
text_el: μὴ οὕτως πορευέσθωσαν δὲ οἱ ἄνδρες καὶ λατρεύσατε τῷ θεῷ τοῦτο γὰρ αὐτοὶ ζητεῖτε ἐξέβαλον δὲ αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου Φαραω

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Stretch forth your hand upon the land of Egypt unto the locust, that it come upon it, and devour every herb that is left after the hail.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen : Extende manum tuam super terram Ægypti ad locustam, ut ascendat super eam, et devoret omnem herbam quæ residua fuerit grandini.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Estende a tua mão sobre a terra do Egito para que os gafanhotos venham sobre a terra do Egito, e comam toda a erva da terra, tudo o que deixou a saraiva.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρα ἐπὶ γῆν Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἀναβήτω ἀκρὶς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ κατέδεται πᾶσαν βοτάνην τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντα τὸν καρπὸν τῶν ξύλων ὃν ὑπελίπετο ἡ χάλαζα

text_en: And Moses stretched forth his rod upon the land of Egypt : and the Lord brought a burning wind all that day, and night; and when it was morning, the burning wind raised the locusts.
text_la: Et extendit Moyses virgam super terram Ægypti : et Dominus induxit ventum urentem tota die illa et nocte : et mane facto, ventus urens levavit locustas.
text_pt: Então estendeu Moisés sua vara sobre a terra do Egito, e o Senhor trouxe sobre a terra um vento oriental todo aquele dia e toda aquela noite; e aconteceu que pela manhã o vento oriental trouxe os gafanhotos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπῆρεν Μωυσῆς τὴν ῥάβδον εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ κύριος ἐπήγαγεν ἄνεμον νότον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐκείνην καὶ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα τὸ πρωὶ ἐγενήθη καὶ ὁ ἄνεμος ὁ νότος ἀνέλαβεν τὴν ἀκρίδα

text_en: And they came up over the whole land of Egypt ; and rested in all the coasts of the Egyptians , innumerable, the like as had not been before that time, nor shall be hereafter.
text_la: Quæ ascenderunt super universam terram Ægypti : et sederunt in cunctis finibus Ægyptiorum innumerabiles, quales ante illud tempus non fuerant, nec postea futuræ sunt.
text_pt: E vieram os gafanhotos sobre toda a terra do Egito, e assentaram-se sobre todos os termos do Egito; tão numerosos foram que, antes destes nunca houve tantos, nem depois deles haverá.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγαγεν αὐτὴν ἐπὶ πᾶσαν γῆν Αἰγύπτου καὶ κατέπαυσεν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ὅρια Αἰγύπτου πολλὴ σφόδρα προτέρα αὐτῆς οὐ γέγονεν τοιαύτη ἀκρὶς καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα οὐκ ἔσται οὕτως

text_en: And they covered the whole face of the earth, wasting all things. And the grass of the earth was devoured, and what fruits soever were on the trees, which the hail had left; and there remained not anything that was green on the trees, or in the herbs of the earth, in all Egypt .
text_la: Operueruntque universam superficiem terræ, vastantes omnia. Devorata est igitur herba terræ, et quidquid pomorum in arboribus fuit, quæ grando dimiserat : nihilque omnino virens relictum est in lignis et in herbis terræ, in cuncta Ægypto.
text_pt: Porque cobriram a face de toda a terra, de modo que a terra se escureceu; e comeram toda a erva da terra, e todo o fruto das árvores, que deixara a saraiva; e não ficou verde algum nas árvores, nem na erva do campo, em toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλυψεν τὴν ὄψιν τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐφθάρη ἡ γῆ καὶ κατέφαγεν πᾶσαν βοτάνην τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντα τὸν καρπὸν τῶν ξύλων ὃς ὑπελείφθη ἀπὸ τῆς χαλάζης οὐχ ὑπελείφθη χλωρὸν οὐδὲν ἐν τοῖς ξύλοις καὶ ἐν πάσῃ βοτάνῃ τοῦ πεδίου ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: Wherefore Pharao in haste called Moses and Aaron , and said to them: I have sinned against the Lord your God , and against you.
text_la: Quam ob rem festinus Pharao vocavit Moysen et Aaron, et dixit eis : Peccavi in Dominum Deum vestrum, et in vos.
text_pt: Então Faraó se apressou a chamar a Moisés e a Arão, e disse: Pequei contra o Senhor vosso Deus, e contra vós.
text_el: κατέσπευδεν δὲ Φαραω καλέσαι Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων ἡμάρτηκα ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν καὶ εἰς ὑμᾶς

text_en: But now forgive me my sin this time also, and pray to the Lord your God , that he take away from me this death.
text_la: Sed nunc dimittite peccatum mihi etiam hac vice, et rogate Dominum Deum vestrum, ut auferat a me mortem istam.
text_pt: Agora, pois, peço-vos que perdoeis o meu pecado somente desta vez, e que oreis ao Senhor vosso Deus que tire de mim somente esta morte.
text_el: προσδέξασθε οὖν μου τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἔτι νῦν καὶ προσεύξασθε πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν καὶ περιελέτω ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τὸν θάνατον τοῦτον

text_en: And Moses going forth from the presence of Pharao , prayed to the Lord :
text_la: Egressusque Moyses de conspectu Pharaonis, oravit Dominum.
text_pt: E saiu da presença de Faraó, e orou ao Senhor.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ Φαραω καὶ ηὔξατο πρὸς τὸν θεόν

text_en: And he made a very strong wind to blow from the west, and it took the locusts and cast them into the Red Sea : there remained not so much as one in all the coasts of Egypt .
text_la: Qui flare fecit ventum ab occidente vehementissimum, et arreptam locustam projecit in mare Rubrum : non remansit ne una quidem in cunctis finibus Ægypti.
text_pt: Então o Senhor trouxe um vento ocidental fortíssimo, o qual levantou os gafanhotos e os lançou no Mar Vermelho; não ficou um só gafanhoto em todos os termos do Egito.
text_el: καὶ μετέβαλεν κύριος ἄνεμον ἀπὸ θαλάσσης σφοδρόν καὶ ἀνέλαβεν τὴν ἀκρίδα καὶ ἐνέβαλεν αὐτὴν εἰς τὴν ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν καὶ οὐχ ὑπελείφθη ἀκρὶς μία ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the Lord hardened Pharao's heart, neither did he let the children of Israel go.
text_la: Et induravit Dominus cor Pharaonis, nec dimisit filios Israël.
text_pt: O Senhor, porém, endureceu o coração de Faraó, e este não deixou ir os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐσκλήρυνεν κύριος τὴν καρδίαν Φαραω καὶ οὐκ ἐξαπέστειλεν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Stretch out your hand towards heaven : and may there be darkness upon the land of Egypt so thick that it may be felt.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen : Extende manum tuam in cælum : et sint tenebræ super terram Ægypti tam densæ, ut palpari queant.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Estende a tua mão para o céu, e virão trevas sobre a terra do Egito, trevas que se apalpem.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρά σου εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ γενηθήτω σκότος ἐπὶ γῆν Αἰγύπτου ψηλαφητὸν σκότος

text_en: And Moses stretched forth his hand towards heaven : and there came horrible darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.
text_la: Extenditque Moyses manum in cælum : et factæ sunt tenebræ horribiles in universa terra Ægypti tribus diebus.
text_pt: E Moisés estendeu a sua mão para o céu, e houve trevas espessas em toda a terra do Egito por três dias.
text_el: ἐξέτεινεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὴν χεῖρα εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ ἐγένετο σκότος γνόφος θύελλα ἐπὶ πᾶσαν γῆν Αἰγύπτου τρεῖς ἡμέρας

text_en: No man saw his brother, nor moved himself out of the place where he was: but wheresoever the children of Israel dwelt, there was light.
text_la: Nemo vidit fratrem suum, nec movit se de loco in quo erat : ubicumque autem habitabant filii Israël, lux erat.
text_pt: Não viu um ao outro, e ninguém se levantou do seu lugar por três dias; mas todos os filhos de Israel tinham luz em suas habitações.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ εἶδεν οὐδεὶς τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ οὐκ ἐξανέστη οὐδεὶς ἐκ τῆς κοίτης αὐτοῦ τρεῖς ἡμέρας πᾶσι δὲ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἦν φῶς ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς κατεγίνοντο

text_en: And Pharao called Moses and Aaron , and said to them: Go, sacrifice to the Lord : let your sheep only, and herds remain, let your children go with you.
text_la: Vocavitque Pharao Moysen et Aaron, et dixit eis : Ite, sacrificate Domino : oves tantum vestræ et armenta remaneant, parvuli vestri eant vobiscum.
text_pt: Então Faraó chamou a Moisés, e disse: Ide, servi ao Senhor; somente fiquem vossas ovelhas e vossas vacas; vão também convosco as vossas crianças.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Φαραω Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων βαδίζετε λατρεύσατε κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν πλὴν τῶν προβάτων καὶ τῶν βοῶν ὑπολίπεσθε καὶ ἡ ἀποσκευὴ ὑμῶν ἀποτρεχέτω μεθ' ὑμῶν

text_en: Moses said: You shall give us also sacrifices and burnt-offerings , to the Lord our God .
text_la: Ait Moyses : Hostias quoque et holocausta dabis nobis, quæ offeramus Domino Deo nostro.
text_pt: Moisés, porém, disse: Tu também darás em nossas mãos sacrifícios e holocaustos, que ofereçamos ao Senhor nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς ἀλλὰ καὶ σὺ δώσεις ἡμῖν ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ θυσίας ἃ ποιήσομεν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν

text_en: All the flocks shall go with us; there shall not a hoof remain of them: for they are necessary for the service of the Lord our God : especially as we know not what must be offered, till we come to the very place.
text_la: Cuncti greges pergent nobiscum; non remanebit ex eis ungula : quæ necessaria sunt in cultum Domini Dei nostri : præsertim cum ignoremus quid debeat immolari, donec ad ipsum locum perveniamus.
text_pt: E também o nosso gado há de ir conosco, nem uma unha ficará; porque daquele havemos de tomar, para servir ao Senhor nosso Deus; porque não sabemos com que havemos de servir ao Senhor, até que cheguemos lá.
text_el: καὶ τὰ κτήνη ἡμῶν πορεύσεται μεθ' ἡμῶν καὶ οὐχ ὑπολειψόμεθα ὁπλήν ἀπ' αὐτῶν γὰρ λημψόμεθα λατρεῦσαι κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί λατρεύσωμεν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν ἡμᾶς ἐκεῖ

text_en: And the Lord hardened Pharao's heart, and he would not let them go.
text_la: Induravit autem Dominus cor Pharaonis, et noluit dimittere eos.
text_pt: O Senhor, porém, endureceu o coração de Faraó, e este não os quis deixar ir.
text_el: ἐσκλήρυνεν δὲ κύριος τὴν καρδίαν Φαραω καὶ οὐκ ἐβουλήθη ἐξαποστεῖλαι αὐτούς

text_en: And Pharao said to Moses : Get you from me, and beware that you see not my face any more: in what day soever you shall come in my sight, you shall die.
text_la: Dixitque Pharao ad Moysen : Recede a me, et cave ne ultra videas faciem meam : quocumque die apparueris mihi, morieris.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Faraó: Vai-te de mim, guarda-te que não mais vejas o meu rosto; porque no dia em que vires o meu rosto, morrerás.
text_el: καὶ λέγει Φαραω ἄπελθε ἀπ' ἐμοῦ πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ ἔτι προσθεῖναι ἰδεῖν μου τὸ πρόσωπον ᾗ δ' ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ὀφθῇς μοι ἀποθανῇ

text_en: Moses answered: So shall it be as you have spoken, I will not see your face anymore.
text_la: Respondit Moyses : Ita fiet ut locutus es : non videbo ultra faciem tuam.
text_pt: E disse Moisés: Bem disseste; eu nunca mais verei o teu rosto.
text_el: λέγει δὲ Μωυσῆς εἴρηκας οὐκέτι ὀφθήσομαί σοι εἰς πρόσωπον

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Yet one plague more will I bring upon Pharao and Egypt , and after that he shall let you go, and thrust you out.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus ad Moysen : Adhuc una plaga tangam Pharaonem et Ægyptum, et post hæc dimittet vos, et exire compellet.
text_pt: E o Senhor disse a Moisés: Ainda uma praga trarei sobre Faraó, e sobre o Egito; depois vos deixará ir daqui; e, quando vos deixar ir totalmente, a toda a pressa vos lançará daqui.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἔτι μίαν πληγὴν ἐπάξω ἐπὶ Φαραω καὶ ἐπ' Αἴγυπτον καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξαποστελεῖ ὑμᾶς ἐντεῦθεν ὅταν δὲ ἐξαποστέλλῃ ὑμᾶς σὺν παντὶ ἐκβαλεῖ ὑμᾶς ἐκβολῇ

text_en: Therefore you shall tell all the people, that every man ask of his friend, and every woman of her neighbour, vessels of silver and of gold.
text_la: Dices ergo omni plebi ut postulet vir ab amico suo, et mulier a vicina sua, vasa argentea et aurea.
text_pt: Fala agora aos ouvidos do povo, que cada homem peça ao seu vizinho, e cada mulher à sua vizinha, jóias de prata e jóias de ouro.
text_el: λάλησον οὖν κρυφῇ εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ αἰτησάτω ἕκαστος παρὰ τοῦ πλησίον καὶ γυνὴ παρὰ τῆς πλησίον σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ καὶ χρυσᾶ καὶ ἱματισμόν

text_en: And the Lord will give favour to his people in the sight of the Egyptians . And Moses was a very great man in the land of Egypt , in the sight of Pharao's servants, and of all the people.
text_la: Dabit autem Dominus gratiam populo suo coram Ægyptiis. Fuitque Moyses vir magnus valde in terra Ægypti coram servis Pharaonis et omni populo.
text_pt: E o Senhor deu ao povo graça aos olhos dos egípcios; também o homem Moisés era mui grande na terra do Egito, aos olhos dos servos de Faraó e aos olhos do povo.
text_el: κύριος δὲ ἔδωκεν τὴν χάριν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ ἐναντίον τῶν Αἰγυπτίων καὶ ἔχρησαν αὐτοῖς καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος Μωυσῆς μέγας ἐγενήθη σφόδρα ἐναντίον τῶν Αἰγυπτίων καὶ ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said: Thus says the Lord : At midnight I will enter into Egypt :
text_la: Et ait : Hæc dicit Dominus : Media nocte egrediar in Ægyptum:
text_pt: Disse mais Moisés: Assim o Senhor tem dito: À meia-noite eu sairei pelo meio do Egito;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς τάδε λέγει κύριος περὶ μέσας νύκτας ἐγὼ εἰσπορεύομαι εἰς μέσον Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And every firstborn in the land of the Egyptians shall die, from the firstborn of Pharao who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the handmaid that is at the mill, and all the firstborn of beasts.
text_la: et morietur omne primogenitum in terra Ægyptiorum, a primogenito Pharaonis, qui sedet in solio ejus, usque ad primogenitum ancillæ quæ est ad molam, et omnia primogenita jumentorum.
text_pt: E todo o primogênito na terra do Egito morrerá, desde o primogênito de Faraó, que haveria de assentar-se sobre o seu trono, até ao primogênito da serva que está detrás da mó, e todo o primogênito dos animais.
text_el: καὶ τελευτήσει πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἀπὸ πρωτοτόκου Φαραω ὃς κάθηται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἕως πρωτοτόκου τῆς θεραπαίνης τῆς παρὰ τὸν μύλον καὶ ἕως πρωτοτόκου παντὸς κτήνους

text_en: And there shall be a great cry in all the land of Egypt , such as neither has been before, nor shall be hereafter.
text_la: Eritque clamor magnus in universa terra Ægypti, qualis nec ante fuit, nec postea futurus est.
text_pt: E haverá grande clamor em toda a terra do Egito, como nunca houve semelhante e nunca haverá;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται κραυγὴ μεγάλη κατὰ πᾶσαν γῆν Αἰγύπτου ἥτις τοιαύτη οὐ γέγονεν καὶ τοιαύτη οὐκέτι προστεθήσεται

text_en: But with all the children of Israel there shall not a dog make the least noise, from man even to beast; that you may know how wonderful a difference the Lord makes between the Egyptians and Israel .
text_la: Apud omnes autem filios Israël non mutiet canis ab homine usque ad pecus: ut sciatis quanto miraculo dividat Dominus Ægyptios et Israël.
text_pt: Mas entre todos os filhos de Israel nem mesmo um cão moverá a sua língua, desde os homens até aos animais, para que saibais que o Senhor fez diferença entre os egípcios e os israelitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ οὐ γρύξει κύων τῇ γλώσσῃ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους ὅπως εἰδῇς ὅσα παραδοξάσει κύριος ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν Αἰγυπτίων καὶ τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And all these your servants shall come down to me, and shall worship me, saying: Go forth; you, and all the people that is under you: after that we will go out.
text_la: Descendentque omnes servi tui isti ad me, et adorabunt me, dicentes : Egredere tu, et omnis populus qui subjectus est tibi : post hæc egrediemur.
text_pt: Então todos estes teus servos descerão a mim, e se inclinarão diante de mim, dizendo: Sai tu, e todo o povo que te segue as pisadas; e depois eu sairei. E saiu da presença de Faraó ardendo em ira.
text_el: καὶ καταβήσονται πάντες οἱ παῖδές σου οὗτοι πρός με καὶ προκυνήσουσίν με λέγοντες ἔξελθε σὺ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαός σου οὗ σὺ ἀφηγῇ καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξελεύσομαι ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς ἀπὸ Φαραω μετὰ θυμοῦ

text_en: And he went out from Pharao exceeding angry . But the Lord said to Moses : Pharao will not hear you, that many signs may be done in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et exivit a Pharaone iratus nimis. Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen : Non audiet vos Pharao ut multa signa fiant in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: O Senhor dissera a Moisés: Faraó não vos ouvirá, para que as minhas maravilhas se multipliquem na terra do Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν οὐκ εἰσακούσεται ὑμῶν Φαραω ἵνα πληθύνων πληθύνω μου τὰ σημεῖα καὶ τὰ τέρατα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: And Moses and Aaron did all the wonders that are written, before Pharao . And the Lord hardened Pharao's heart, neither did he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
text_la: Moyses autem et Aaron fecerunt omnia ostenta, quæ scripta sunt, coram Pharaone. Et induravit Dominus cor Pharaonis, nec dimisit filios Israël de terra sua.
text_pt: E Moisés e Arão fizeram todas estas maravilhas diante de Faraó; mas o Senhor endureceu o coração de Faraó, que não deixou ir os filhos de Israel da sua terra.
text_el: Μωυσῆς δὲ καὶ Ααρων ἐποίησαν πάντα τὰ σημεῖα καὶ τὰ τέρατα ταῦτα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἐναντίον Φαραω ἐσκλήρυνεν δὲ κύριος τὴν καρδίαν Φαραω καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν ἐξαποστεῖλαι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt :
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron in terra Ægypti:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão na terra do Egito, dizendo:
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου λέγων

text_en: This month shall be to you the beginning of months; it shall be the first in the months of the year.
text_la: Mensis iste, vobis principium mensium : primus erit in mensibus anni.
text_pt: Este mesmo mês vos será o princípio dos meses; este vos será o primeiro dos meses do ano.
text_el: ὁ μὴν οὗτος ὑμῖν ἀρχὴ μηνῶν πρῶτός ἐστιν ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς μησὶν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ

text_en: Speak to the whole assembly of the children of Israel , and say to them: On the tenth day of this month let every man take a lamb by their families and houses.
text_la: Loquimini ad universum cœtum filiorum Israël, et dicite eis : Decima die mensis hujus tollat unusquisque agnum per familias et domos suas.
text_pt: Falai a toda a congregação de Israel, dizendo: Aos dez deste mês tome cada um para si um cordeiro, segundo as casas dos pais, um cordeiro para cada família.
text_el: λάλησον πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ λέγων τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου λαβέτωσαν ἕκαστος πρόβατον κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν ἕκαστος πρόβατον κατ' οἰκίαν

text_en: But if the number be less than may suffice to eat the lamb , he shall take unto him his neighbour that joins to his house, according to the number of souls which may be enough to eat the lamb .
text_la: Sin autem minor est numerus ut sufficere possit ad vescendum agnum, assumet vicinum suum qui junctus est domui suæ, juxta numerum animarum quæ sufficere possunt ad esum agni.
text_pt: Mas se a família for pequena para um cordeiro, então tome um só com seu vizinho perto de sua casa, conforme o número das almas; cada um conforme ao seu comer, fareis a conta conforme ao cordeiro.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ὀλιγοστοὶ ὦσιν οἱ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ὥστε μὴ ἱκανοὺς εἶναι εἰς πρόβατον συλλήμψεται μεθ' ἑαυτοῦ τὸν γείτονα τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ψυχῶν ἕκαστος τὸ ἀρκοῦν αὐτῷ συναριθμήσεται εἰς πρόβατον
