text_en: I have heard the murmuring of the children of Israel , say to them: In the evening you shall eat flesh, and in the morning you shall have your fill of bread; and you shall know that I am the Lord your God .
text_la: Audivi murmurationes filiorum Israël. Loquere ad eos : Vespere comedetis carnes, et mane saturabimini panibus : scietisque quod ego sum Dominus Deus vester.
text_pt: Tenho ouvido as murmurações dos filhos de Israel. Fala-lhes, dizendo: Entre as duas tardes comereis carne, e pela manhã vos fartareis de pão; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: εἰσακήκοα τὸν γογγυσμὸν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ λάλησον πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων τὸ πρὸς ἑσπέραν ἔδεσθε κρέα καὶ τὸ πρωὶ πλησθήσεσθε ἄρτων καὶ γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: So it came to pass in the evening, that quails coming up, covered the camp: and in the morning a dew lay round about the camp.
text_la: Factum est ergo vespere, et ascendens coturnix, cooperuit castra : mane quoque ros jacuit per circuitum castrorum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que à tarde subiram codornizes, e cobriram o arraial; e pela manhã jazia o orvalho ao redor do arraial.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἑσπέρα καὶ ἀνέβη ὀρτυγομήτρα καὶ ἐκάλυψεν τὴν παρεμβολήν τὸ πρωὶ ἐγένετο καταπαυομένης τῆς δρόσου κύκλῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: And when it had covered the face of the earth, it appeared in the wilderness small, and as it were beaten with a pestle, like unto the hoar frost on the ground.
text_la: Cumque operuisset superficiem terræ, apparuit in solitudine minutum, et quasi pilo tusum in similitudinem pruinæ super terram.
text_pt: E quando o orvalho se levantou, eis que sobre a face do deserto estava uma coisa miúda, redonda, miúda como a geada sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τῆς ἐρήμου λεπτὸν ὡσεὶ κόριον λευκὸν ὡσεὶ πάγος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another: Manhu! which signifies: What is this! for they knew not what it was. And Moses said to them: This is the bread which the Lord has given you to eat.
text_la: Quod cum vidissent filii Israël, dixerunt ad invicem : Manhu? quod significat : Quid est hoc? ignorabant enim quid esset. Quibus ait Moyses : Iste est panis quem Dominus dedit vobis ad vescendum.
text_pt: E, vendo-a os filhos de Israel, disseram uns aos outros: Que é isto? Porque não sabiam o que era. Disse-lhes pois Moisés: Este é o pão que o Senhor vos deu para comer.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ αὐτὸ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ εἶπαν ἕτερος τῷ ἑτέρῳ τί ἐστιν τοῦτο οὐ γὰρ ᾔδεισαν τί ἦν εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς αὐτούς οὗτος ὁ ἄρτος ὃν ἔδωκεν κύριος ὑμῖν φαγεῖν

text_en: This is the word that the Lord has commanded: Let every one gather of it as much as is enough to eat; a gomor for every man , according to the number of your souls that dwell in a tent, so shall you take of it.
text_la: Hic est sermo, quem præcepit Dominus : Colligat unusquisque ex eo quantum sufficit ad vescendum : gomor per singula capita, juxta numerum animarum vestrarum quæ habitant in tabernaculo sic tolletis.
text_pt: Esta é a palavra que o Senhor tem mandado: Colhei dele cada um conforme ao que pode comer, um ômer por cabeça, segundo o número das vossas almas; cada um tomará para os que se acharem na sua tenda.
text_el: τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ συνέταξεν κύριος συναγάγετε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἕκαστος εἰς τοὺς καθήκοντας γομορ κατὰ κεφαλὴν κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ἕκαστος σὺν τοῖς συσκηνίοις ὑμῶν συλλέξατε

text_en: And the children of Israel did so: and they gathered, one more, another less.
text_la: Feceruntque ita filii Israël : et collegerunt, alius plus, alius minus.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel fizeram assim; e colheram, uns mais e outros menos.
text_el: ἐποίησαν δὲ οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ συνέλεξαν ὁ τὸ πολὺ καὶ ὁ τὸ ἔλαττον

text_en: And they measured by the measure of a gomor: neither had he more that had gathered more; nor did he find less that had provided less: but every one had gathered, according to what they were able to eat.
text_la: Et mensi sunt ad mensuram gomor : nec qui plus collegerat, habuit amplius : nec qui minus paraverat, reperit minus : sed singuli juxta id quod edere poterant, congregaverunt.
text_pt: Porém, medindo-o com o ômer, não sobejava ao que colhera muito, nem faltava ao que colhera pouco; cada um colheu tanto quanto podia comer.
text_el: καὶ μετρήσαντες τῷ γομορ οὐκ ἐπλεόνασεν ὁ τὸ πολύ καὶ ὁ τὸ ἔλαττον οὐκ ἠλαττόνησεν ἕκαστος εἰς τοὺς καθήκοντας παρ' ἑαυτῷ συνέλεξαν

text_en: And Moses said to them: Let no man leave thereof till the morning.
text_la: Dixitque Moyses ad eos : Nullus relinquat ex eo in mane.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Moisés: Ninguém deixe dele para amanhã.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς αὐτούς μηδεὶς καταλιπέτω ἀπ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πρωί

text_en: And they hearkened not to him, but some of them left until the morning, and it began to be full of worms, and it putrefied, and Moses was angry with them.
text_la: Qui non audierunt eum, sed dimiserunt quidam ex eis usque mane, et scatere cœpit vermibus, atque computruit : et iratus est contra eos Moyses.
text_pt: Eles, porém, não deram ouvidos a Moisés, antes alguns deles deixaram dele para o dia seguinte; e criou bichos, e cheirava mal; por isso indignou-se Moisés contra eles.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσαν Μωυσῆ ἀλλὰ κατέλιπόν τινες ἀπ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πρωί καὶ ἐξέζεσεν σκώληκας καὶ ἐπώζεσεν καὶ ἐπικράνθη ἐπ' αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς

text_en: Now every one of them gathered in the morning, as much as might suffice to eat: and after the sun grew hot, it melted.
text_la: Colligebant autem mane singuli, quantum sufficere poterat ad vescendum : cumque incaluisset sol, liquefiebat.
text_pt: Eles, pois, o colhiam cada manhã, cada um conforme ao que podia comer; porque, aquecendo o sol, derretia-se.
text_el: καὶ συνέλεξαν αὐτὸ πρωὶ πρωί ἕκαστος τὸ καθῆκον αὐτῷ ἡνίκα δὲ διεθέρμαινεν ὁ ἥλιος ἐτήκετο

text_en: But on the sixth day they gathered twice as much, that is, two gomors every man : and all the rulers of the multitude came, and told Moses .
text_la: In die autem sexta collegerunt cibos duplices, id est, duo gomor per singulos homines : venerunt autem omnes principes multitudinis, et narraverunt Moysi.
text_pt: E aconteceu que ao sexto dia colheram pão em dobro, dois ômeres para cada um; e todos os príncipes da congregação vieram, e contaram-no a Moisés.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἕκτῃ συνέλεξαν τὰ δέοντα διπλᾶ δύο Γομορ τῷ ἑνί εἰσήλθοσαν δὲ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς συναγωγῆς καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν Μωυσεῖ

text_en: And he said to them: This is what the Lord has spoken: Tomorrow is the rest of the sabbath sanctified to the Lord . Whatsoever work is to be done, do it; and the meats that are to be dressed, dress them; and whatsoever shall remain, lay it up until the morning.
text_la: Qui ait eis : Hoc est quod locutus est Dominus : Requies sabbati sanctificata est Domino cras : quodcumque operandum est, facite, et quæ coquenda sunt coquite : quidquid autem reliquum fuerit, reponite usque in mane.
text_pt: E ele disse-lhes: Isto é o que o Senhor tem dito: Amanhã é repouso, o santo sábado do Senhor; o que quiserdes cozer no forno, cozei-o, e o que quiserdes cozer em água, cozei-o em água; e tudo o que sobejar, guardai para vós até amanhã.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς αὐτούς τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμά ἐστιν ὃ ἐλάλησεν κύριος σάββατα ἀνάπαυσις ἁγία τῷ κυρίῳ αὔριον ὅσα ἐὰν πέσσητε πέσσετε καὶ ὅσα ἐὰν ἕψητε ἕψετε καὶ πᾶν τὸ πλεονάζον καταλίπετε αὐτὸ εἰς ἀποθήκην εἰς τὸ πρωί

text_en: And they did so as Moses had commanded, and it did not putrefy, neither was there worm found in it.
text_la: Feceruntque ita ut præceperat Moyses, et non computruit, neque vermis inventus est in eo.
text_pt: E guardaram-no até o dia seguinte, como Moisés tinha ordenado; e não cheirou mal nem nele houve algum bicho.
text_el: καὶ κατελίποσαν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πρωί καθάπερ συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς καὶ οὐκ ἐπώζεσεν οὐδὲ σκώληξ ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: And Moses said: Eat it to day, because it is the sabbath of the Lord : to day it shall not be found in the field.
text_la: Dixitque Moyses : Comedite illud hodie, quia sabbatum est Domini : non invenietur hodie in agro.
text_pt: Então disse Moisés: Comei-o hoje, porquanto hoje é o sábado do Senhor; hoje não o achareis no campo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς φάγετε σήμερον ἔστιν γὰρ σάββατα σήμερον τῷ κυρίῳ οὐχ εὑρεθήσεται ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ

text_en: Gather it six days; but on the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord , therefore it shall not be found.
text_la: Sex diebus colligite : in die autem septimo sabbatum est Domini, idcirco non invenietur.
text_pt: Seis dias o colhereis, mas o sétimo dia é o sábado; nele não haverá.
text_el: ἓξ ἡμέρας συλλέξετε τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ σάββατα ὅτι οὐκ ἔσται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And the seventh day came; and some of the people going forth to gather, found none.
text_la: Venitque septima dies : et egressi de populo ut colligerent, non invenerunt.
text_pt: E aconteceu ao sétimo dia, que alguns do povo saíram para colher, mas não o acharam.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἐξήλθοσάν τινες ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ συλλέξαι καὶ οὐχ εὗρον

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : How long will you refuse to keep my commandments , and my law ?
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen: Usquequo non vultis custodire mandata mea et legem meam?
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Até quando recusareis guardar os meus mandamentos e as minhas leis?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἕως τίνος οὐ βούλεσθε εἰσακούειν τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τὸν νόμον μου

text_en: See that the Lord has given you the sabbath , and for this reason on the sixth day he gives you a double provision: let each man stay at home, and let none go forth out of his place the seventh day.
text_la: videte quod Dominus dederit vobis sabbatum, et propter hoc die sexta tribuit vobis cibos duplices : maneat unusquisque apud semetipsum; nullus egrediatur de loco suo die septimo.
text_pt: Vede, porquanto o Senhor vos deu o sábado, portanto ele no sexto dia vos dá pão para dois dias; cada um fique no seu lugar, ninguém saia do seu lugar no sétimo dia.
text_el: ἴδετε ὁ γὰρ κύριος ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν τὴν ἡμέραν ταύτην τὰ σάββατα διὰ τοῦτο αὐτὸς ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἕκτῃ ἄρτους δύο ἡμερῶν καθήσεσθε ἕκαστος εἰς τοὺς οἴκους ὑμῶν μηδεὶς ἐκπορευέσθω ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ

text_en: And the people kept the sabbath on the seventh day.
text_la: Et sabbatizavit populus die septimo.
text_pt: Assim repousou o povo no sétimo dia.
text_el: καὶ ἐσαββάτισεν ὁ λαὸς τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ

text_en: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna : and it was like coriander seed, white, and the taste thereof like to flour with honey.
text_la: Appellavitque domus Israël nomen ejus Man : quod erat quasi semen coriandri album, gustusque ejus quasi similæ cum melle.
text_pt: E chamou a casa de Israel o seu nome maná; e era como semente de coentro branco, e o seu sabor como bolos de mel.
text_el: καὶ ἐπωνόμασαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Μαν ἦν δὲ ὡς σπέρμα κορίου λευκόν τὸ δὲ γεῦμα αὐτοῦ ὡς ἐγκρὶς ἐν μέλιτι

text_en: And Moses said: This is the word which the Lord has commanded: Fill a gomor of it, and let it be kept unto generations to come hereafter; that they may know the bread, wherewith I fed you in the wilderness when you were brought forth out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Dixit autem Moyses : Iste est sermo, quem præcepit Dominus : Imple gomor ex eo, et custodiatur in futuras retro generationes : ut noverint panem, quo alui vos in solitudine, quando educti estis de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E disse Moisés: Esta é a palavra que o Senhor tem mandado: Encherás um ômer dele e guardá-lo-ás para as vossas gerações, para que vejam o pão que vos tenho dado a comer neste deserto, quando eu vos tirei da terra do Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ συνέταξεν κύριος πλήσατε τὸ γομορ τοῦ μαν εἰς ἀποθήκην εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἵνα ἴδωσιν τὸν ἄρτον ὃν ἐφάγετε ὑμεῖς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὡς ἐξήγαγεν ὑμᾶς κύριος ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And Moses said to Aaron : Take a vessel, and put manna into it, as much as a gomor can hold; and lay it up before the Lord , to keep unto your generations ,
text_la: Dixitque Moyses ad Aaron : Sume vas unum, et mitte ibi man, quantum potest capere gomor, et repone coram Domino ad servandum in generationes vestras,
text_pt: Disse também Moisés a Arão: Toma um vaso, e põe nele um ômer cheio de maná, e coloca-o diante do Senhor, para guardá-lo para as vossas gerações.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς Ααρων λαβὲ στάμνον χρυσοῦν ἕνα καὶ ἔμβαλε εἰς αὐτὸν πλῆρες τὸ γομορ τοῦ μαν καὶ ἀποθήσεις αὐτὸ ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς διατήρησιν εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν

text_en: as the Lord commanded Moses . And Aaron put it in the tabernacle to be kept.
text_la: sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi. Posuitque illud Aaron in tabernaculo reservandum.
text_pt: Como o Senhor tinha ordenado a Moisés, assim Arão o pôs diante do Testemunho, para ser guardado.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ καὶ ἀπέθετο Ααρων ἐναντίον τοῦ μαρτυρίου εἰς διατήρησιν

text_en: And the children of Israel ate manna forty years, till they came to a habitable land: with this meat were they fed, until they reached the borders of the land of Chanaan .
text_la: Filii autem Israël comederunt man quadraginta annis, donec venirent in terram habitabilem : hoc cibo aliti sunt, usquequo tangerent fines terræ Chanaan.
text_pt: E comeram os filhos de Israel maná quarenta anos, até que entraram em terra habitada; comeram maná até que chegaram aos termos da terra de Canaã.
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἔφαγον τὸ μαν ἔτη τεσσαράκοντα ἕως ἦλθον εἰς γῆν οἰκουμένην τὸ μαν ἐφάγοσαν ἕως παρεγένοντο εἰς μέρος τῆς Φοινίκης

text_en: Now a gomor is the tenth part of an ephi.
text_la: Gomor autem decima pars est ephi.
text_pt: E um ômer é a décima parte do efa.
text_el: τὸ δὲ γομορ τὸ δέκατον τῶν τριῶν μέτρων ἦν

text_en: Then all the multitude of the children of Israel setting forward from the desert of Sin, by their mansions, according to the word of the Lord , encamped in Raphidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
text_la: Igitur profecta omnis multitudo filiorum Israël de deserto Sin per mansiones suas, juxta sermonem Domini, castrametati sunt in Raphidim, ubi non erat aqua ad bibendum populo.
text_pt: Depois toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel partiu do deserto de Sim pelas suas jornadas, segundo o mandamento do Senhor, e acampou em Refidim; não havia ali água para o povo beber.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν πᾶσα συναγωγὴ υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου Σιν κατὰ παρεμβολὰς αὐτῶν διὰ ῥήματος κυρίου καὶ παρενεβάλοσαν ἐν Ραφιδιν οὐκ ἦν δὲ ὕδωρ τῷ λαῷ πιεῖν

text_en: And they chode with Moses , and said: Give us water, that we may drink. And Moses answered them: Why chide you with me? Wherefore do you tempt the Lord ?
text_la: Qui jurgatus contra Moysen, ait : Da nobis aquam, ut bibamus. Quibus respondit Moyses : Quid jurgamini contra me? cur tentatis Dominum?
text_pt: Então contendeu o povo com Moisés, e disse: Dá-nos água para beber. E Moisés lhes disse: Por que contendeis comigo? Por que tentais ao Senhor?
text_el: καὶ ἐλοιδορεῖτο ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγοντες δὸς ἡμῖν ὕδωρ ἵνα πίωμεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς τί λοιδορεῖσθέ μοι καὶ τί πειράζετε κύριον

text_en: So the people were thirsty there for want of water, and murmured against Moses , saying: Why did you make us go forth out of Egypt , to kill us and our children, and our beasts with thirst?
text_la: Sitivit ergo ibi populus præ aquæ penuria, et murmuravit contra Moysen, dicens : Cur fecisti nos exire de Ægypto, ut occideres nos, et liberos nostros, ac jumenta siti?
text_pt: Tendo pois ali o povo sede de água, o povo murmurou contra Moisés, e disse: Por que nos fizeste subir do Egito, para nos matares de sede, a nós e aos nossos filhos, e ao nosso gado?
text_el: ἐδίψησεν δὲ ἐκεῖ ὁ λαὸς ὕδατι καὶ ἐγόγγυζεν ἐκεῖ ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγοντες ἵνα τί τοῦτο ἀνεβίβασας ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἀποκτεῖναι ἡμᾶς καὶ τὰ τέκνα ἡμῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη τῷ δίψει

text_en: And Moses cried to the Lord , saying: What shall I do to this people? Yet a little more and they will stone me.
text_la: Clamavit autem Moyses ad Dominum, dicens : Quid faciam populo huic? adhuc paululum, et lapidabit me.
text_pt: E clamou Moisés ao Senhor, dizendo: Que farei a este povo? Daqui a pouco me apedrejará.
text_el: ἐβόησεν δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον λέγων τί ποιήσω τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ καταλιθοβολήσουσίν με

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Go before the people, and take with you of the ancients of Israel : and take in your hand the rod wherewith you struck the river, and go.
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad Moysen : Antecede populum, et sume tecum de senioribus Israël : et virgam qua percussisti fluvium, tolle in manu tua, et vade.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Passa diante do povo, e toma contigo alguns dos anciãos de Israel; e toma na tua mão a tua vara, com que feriste o rio, e vai.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν προπορεύου τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου λαβὲ δὲ μετὰ σεαυτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ τὴν ῥάβδον ἐν ᾗ ἐπάταξας τὸν ποταμόν λαβὲ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου καὶ πορεύσῃ

text_en: Behold I will stand there before you, upon the rock Horeb , and you shall strike the rock, and water shall come out of it that the people may drink. Moses did so before the ancients of Israel :
text_la: En ego stabo ibi coram te, supra petram Horeb : percutiesque petram, et exibit ex ea aqua, ut bibat populus. Fecit Moyses ita coram senioribus Israël:
text_pt: Eis que eu estarei ali diante de ti sobre a rocha, em Horebe, e tu ferirás a rocha, e dela sairão águas e o povo beberá. E Moisés assim o fez, diante dos olhos dos anciãos de Israel.
text_el: ὅδε ἐγὼ ἕστηκα πρὸ τοῦ σὲ ἐκεῖ ἐπὶ τῆς πέτρας ἐν Χωρηβ καὶ πατάξεις τὴν πέτραν καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ἐξ αὐτῆς ὕδωρ καὶ πίεται ὁ λαός μου ἐποίησεν δὲ Μωυσῆς οὕτως ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And he called the name of that place Temptation , because of the chiding of the children of Israel , and for that they tempted the Lord , saying: Is the Lord amongst us or not?
text_la: et vocavit nomen loci illius, Tentatio, propter jurgium filiorum Israël, et quia tentaverunt Dominum, dicentes : Estne Dominus in nobis, an non?
text_pt: E chamou aquele lugar Massá e Meribá, por causa da contenda dos filhos de Israel, e porque tentaram ao Senhor, dizendo: Está o Senhor no meio de nós, ou não?
text_el: καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου πειρασμὸς καὶ λοιδόρησις διὰ τὴν λοιδορίαν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ διὰ τὸ πειράζειν κύριον λέγοντας εἰ ἔστιν κύριος ἐν ἡμῖν ἢ οὔ

text_en: And Amalec came, and fought against Israel in Raphidim.
text_la: Venit autem Amalec, et pugnabat contra Israël in Raphidim.
text_pt: Então veio Amaleque, e pelejou contra Israel em Refidim.
text_el: ἦλθεν δὲ Αμαληκ καὶ ἐπολέμει Ισραηλ ἐν Ραφιδιν

text_en: And Moses said to Joshua : Choose out men ; and go out and fight against Amalec : tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill, having the rod of God in my hand.
text_la: Dixitque Moyses ad Josue : Elige viros : et egressus, pugna contra Amalec : cras ego stabo in vertice collis, habens virgam Dei in manu mea.
text_pt: Por isso disse Moisés a Josué: Escolhe-nos homens, e sai, peleja contra Amaleque; amanhã eu estarei sobre o cume do outeiro, e a vara de Deus estará na minha mão.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπίλεξον σεαυτῷ ἄνδρας δυνατοὺς καὶ ἐξελθὼν παράταξαι τῷ Αμαληκ αὔριον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἕστηκα ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ βουνοῦ καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν τῇ χειρί μου

text_en: Joshua did as Moses had spoken, and he fought against Amalec ; but Moses , and Aaron , and Hur, went up upon the top of the hill.
text_la: Fecit Josue ut locutus erat Moyses, et pugnavit contra Amalec : Moyses autem et Aaron et Hur ascenderunt super verticem collis.
text_pt: E fez Josué como Moisés lhe dissera, pelejando contra Amaleque; mas Moisés, Arão, e Hur subiram ao cume do outeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς καθάπερ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐξελθὼν παρετάξατο τῷ Αμαληκ καὶ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καὶ Ωρ ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ βουνοῦ

text_en: And when Moses lifted up his hands, Israel overcame; but if he let them down a little, Amalec overcame.
text_la: Cumque levaret Moyses manus, vincebat Israël : sin autem paululum remisisset, superabat Amalec.
text_pt: E acontecia que, quando Moisés levantava a sua mão, Israel prevalecia; mas quando ele abaixava a sua mão, Amaleque prevalecia.
text_el: καὶ ἐγίνετο ὅταν ἐπῆρεν Μωυσῆς τὰς χεῖρας κατίσχυεν Ισραηλ ὅταν δὲ καθῆκεν τὰς χεῖρας κατίσχυεν Αμαληκ

text_en: And Moses' hands were heavy: so they took a stone, and put under him, and he sat on it: and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands on both sides. And it came to pass, that his hands were not weary until sunset.
text_la: Manus autem Moysi erant graves : sumentes igitur lapidem, posuerunt subter eum, in quo sedit : Aaron autem et Hur sustentabant manus ejus ex utraque parte. Et factum est ut manus illius non lassarentur usque ad occasum solis.
text_pt: Porém as mãos de Moisés eram pesadas, por isso tomaram uma pedra, e a puseram debaixo dele, para assentar-se sobre ela; e Arão e Hur sustentaram as suas mãos, um de um lado e o outro do outro; assim ficaram as suas mãos firmes até que o sol se pôs.
text_el: αἱ δὲ χεῖρες Μωυσῆ βαρεῖαι καὶ λαβόντες λίθον ὑπέθηκαν ὑπ' αὐτόν καὶ ἐκάθητο ἐπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ Ααρων καὶ Ωρ ἐστήριζον τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἐντεῦθεν εἷς καὶ ἐντεῦθεν εἷς καὶ ἐγένοντο αἱ χεῖρες Μωυσῆ ἐστηριγμέναι ἕως δυσμῶν ἡλίου

text_en: And Joshua put Amalec and his people to flight, by the edge of the sword.
text_la: Fugavitque Josue Amalec, et populum ejus in ore gladii.
text_pt: E assim Josué desfez a Amaleque e a seu povo, ao fio da espada.
text_el: καὶ ἐτρέψατο Ἰησοῦς τὸν Αμαληκ καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν φόνῳ μαχαίρας

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Write this for a memorial in a book, and deliver it to the ears of Joshua ; for I will destroy the memory of Amalec from under heaven .
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen : Scribe hoc ob monimentum in libro, et trade auribus Josue : delebo enim memoriam Amalec sub cælo.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Escreve isto para memória num livro, e relata-o aos ouvidos de Josué; que eu totalmente hei de riscar a memória de Amaleque de debaixo dos céus.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν κατάγραψον τοῦτο εἰς μνημόσυνον ἐν βιβλίῳ καὶ δὸς εἰς τὰ ὦτα Ἰησοῖ ὅτι ἀλοιφῇ ἐξαλείψω τὸ μνημόσυνον Αμαληκ ἐκ τῆς ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν

text_en: And Moses built an altar ; and called the name thereof, The Lord , my exaltation , saying:
text_la: Ædificavitque Moyses altare : et vocavit nomen ejus, Dominus exaltatio mea, dicens:
text_pt: E Moisés edificou um altar, ao qual chamou: O SENHOR É MINHA BANDEIRA.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Μωυσῆς θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ κύριός μου καταφυγή

text_en: Because the hand of the throne of the Lord , and the war of the Lord shall be against Amalec , from generation to generation .
text_la: Quia manus solii Domini, et bellum Domini erit contra Amalec, a generatione in generationem.
text_pt: E disse: Porquanto jurou o Senhor, haverá guerra do Senhor contra Amaleque de geração em geração.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν χειρὶ κρυφαίᾳ πολεμεῖ κύριος ἐπὶ Αμαληκ ἀπὸ γενεῶν εἰς γενεάς

text_en: And when Jethro the priest of Madian , the kinsman of Moses , had heard all the things that God had done to Moses , and to Israel his people, and that the Lord had brought forth Israel out of Egypt :
text_la: Cumque audisset Jethro, sacerdos Madian, cognatus Moysi, omnia quæ fecerat Deus Moysi, et Israëli populo suo, et quod eduxisset Dominus Israël de Ægypto,
text_pt: Ora Jetro, sacerdote de Midiã, sogro de Moisés, ouviu todas as coisas que Deus tinha feito a Moisés e a Israel seu povo, como o SENHOR tinha tirado a Israel do Egito.
text_el: ἤκουσεν δὲ Ιοθορ ὁ ἱερεὺς Μαδιαμ ὁ γαμβρὸς Μωυσῆ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος Ισραηλ τῷ ἑαυτοῦ λαῷ ἐξήγαγεν γὰρ κύριος τὸν Ισραηλ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: He took Sephora, the wife of Moses , whom he had sent back:
text_la: tulit Sephoram uxorem Moysi quam remiserat,
text_pt: E Jetro, sogro de Moisés, tomou a Zípora, a mulher de Moisés, depois que ele lha enviara,
text_el: ἔλαβεν δὲ Ιοθορ ὁ γαμβρὸς Μωυσῆ Σεπφωραν τὴν γυναῖκα Μωυσῆ μετὰ τὴν ἄφεσιν αὐτῆς

text_en: And her two sons, of whom one was called Gersam: his father saying, I have been a stranger in a foreign country.
text_la: et duos filios ejus : quorum unus vocabatur Gersam, dicente patre : Advena fui in terra aliena;
text_pt: Com seus dois filhos, dos quais um se chamava Gérson; porque disse: Eu fui peregrino em terra estranha;
text_el: καὶ τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ὄνομα τῷ ἑνὶ αὐτῶν Γηρσαμ λέγων πάροικος ἤμην ἐν γῇ ἀλλοτρίᾳ

text_en: And the other Eliezer: For the God of my father, said he, is my helper, and has delivered me from the sword of Pharao .
text_la: alter vero Eliezer : Deus enim, ait, patris mei adjutor meus, et eruit me de gladio Pharaonis.
text_pt: E o outro se chamava Eliézer; porque disse: O Deus de meu pai foi por minha ajuda, e me livrou da espada de Faraó.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ δευτέρου Ελιεζερ λέγων ὁ γὰρ θεὸς τοῦ πατρός μου βοηθός μου καὶ ἐξείλατό με ἐκ χειρὸς Φαραω

text_en: And Jethro, the kinsman of Moses , came with his sons, and his wife to Moses into the desert , where he was camped by the mountain of God .
text_la: Venit ergo Jethro cognatus Moysi, et filii ejus, et uxor ejus ad Moysen in desertum, ubi erat castrametatus juxta montem Dei.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, Jetro, o sogro de Moisés, com seus filhos e com sua mulher, a Moisés no deserto, ao monte de Deus, onde se tinha acampado,
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιοθορ ὁ γαμβρὸς Μωυσῆ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ πρὸς Μωυσῆν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον οὗ παρενέβαλεν ἐπ' ὄρους τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And he sent word to Moses , saying: I Jethro, your kinsman, come to you, and your wife, and your two sons with her.
text_la: Et mandavit Moysi, dicens : Ego Jethro cognatus tuus venio ad te, et uxor tua, et duo filii cum ea.
text_pt: Disse a Moisés: Eu, teu sogro Jetro, venho a ti, com tua mulher e seus dois filhos com ela.
text_el: ἀνηγγέλη δὲ Μωυσεῖ λέγοντες ἰδοὺ ὁ γαμβρός σου Ιοθορ παραγίνεται πρὸς σέ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ καὶ οἱ δύο υἱοί σου μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he went out to meet his kinsman, and worshipped and kissed him: and they saluted one another with words of peace. And when he had come into the tent,
text_la: Qui egressus in occursum cognati sui, adoravit, et osculatus est eum : salutaveruntque se mutuo verbis pacificis. Cumque intrasset tabernaculum,
text_pt: Então saiu Moisés ao encontro de seu sogro, e inclinou-se, e beijou-o, e perguntaram um ao outro como estavam, e entraram na tenda.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς εἰς συνάντησιν τῷ γαμβρῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐφίλησεν αὐτόν καὶ ἠσπάσαντο ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν σκηνήν

text_en: Moses told his kinsman all that the Lord had done to Pharao , and the Egyptians in favour of Israel : and all the labour which had befallen them in the journey, and that the Lord had delivered them.
text_la: narravit Moyses cognato suo cuncta quæ fecerat Dominus Pharaoni et Ægyptiis propter Israël : universumque laborem, qui accidisset eis in itinere, et quod liberaverat eos Dominus.
text_pt: E Moisés contou a seu sogro todas as coisas que o Senhor tinha feito a Faraó e aos egípcios por amor de Israel, e todo o trabalho que passaram no caminho, e como o Senhor os livrara.
text_el: καὶ διηγήσατο Μωυσῆς τῷ γαμβρῷ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος τῷ Φαραω καὶ τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις ἕνεκεν τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ πάντα τὸν μόχθον τὸν γενόμενον αὐτοῖς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ὅτι ἐξείλατο αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐκ χειρὸς Φαραω καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν Αἰγυπτίων

text_en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the good things that the Lord had done to Israel , because he had delivered them out of the hands of the Egyptians .
text_la: Lætatusque est Jethro super omnibus bonis, quæ fecerat Dominus Israëli, eo quod eruisset eum de manu Ægyptiorum.
text_pt: E alegrou-se Jetro de todo o bem que o Senhor tinha feito a Israel, livrando-o da mão dos egípcios.
text_el: ἐξέστη δὲ Ιοθορ ἐπὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς οἷς ἐποίησεν αὐτοῖς κύριος ὅτι ἐξείλατο αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς Αἰγυπτίων καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς Φαραω

text_en: And he said: Blessed is the Lord , who has delivered his people out of the hand of Egypt .
text_la: Et ait : Benedictus Dominus, qui liberavit vos de manu Ægyptiorum, et de manu Pharaonis; qui eruit populum suum de manu Ægypti.
text_pt: E Jetro disse: Bendito seja o Senhor, que vos livrou das mãos dos egípcios e da mão de Faraó; que livrou a este povo de debaixo da mão dos egípcios.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιοθορ εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὅτι ἐξείλατο τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς Αἰγυπτίων καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς Φαραω

text_en: Now I know, that the Lord is great above all gods; because they dealt proudly against them.
text_la: Nunc cognovi, quia magnus Dominus super omnes deos : eo quod superbe egerint contra illos.
text_pt: Agora sei que o Senhor é maior que todos os deuses; porque na coisa em que se ensoberbeceram, os sobrepujou.
text_el: νῦν ἔγνων ὅτι μέγας κύριος παρὰ πάντας τοὺς θεούς ἕνεκεν τούτου ὅτι ἐπέθεντο αὐτοῖς

text_en: So Jethro, the kinsman of Moses , offered holocausts and sacrifices to God : and Aaron and all the ancients of Israel came, to eat bread with him before God .
text_la: Obtulit ergo Jethro cognatus Moysi holocausta et hostias Deo : veneruntque Aaron et omnes seniores Israël, ut comederent panem cum eo coram Deo.
text_pt: Então Jetro, o sogro de Moisés, tomou holocausto e sacrifícios para Deus; e veio Arão, e todos os anciãos de Israel, para comerem pão com o sogro de Moisés diante de deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ιοθορ ὁ γαμβρὸς Μωυσῆ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ θυσίας τῷ θεῷ παρεγένετο δὲ Ααρων καὶ πάντες οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ισραηλ συμφαγεῖν ἄρτον μετὰ τοῦ γαμβροῦ Μωυσῆ ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And the next day Moses sat to judge the people, who stood by Moses from morning until night.
text_la: Altera autem die sedit Moyses ut judicaret populum, qui assistebat Moysi a mane usque ad vesperam.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, no outro dia, Moisés assentou-se para julgar o povo; e o povo estava em pé diante de Moisés desde a manhã até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὴν ἐπαύριον συνεκάθισεν Μωυσῆς κρίνειν τὸν λαόν παρειστήκει δὲ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς Μωυσεῖ ἀπὸ πρωίθεν ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: And when his kinsman had seen all things that he did among the people, he said: What is it that you do among the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people wait from morning till night?
text_la: Quod cum vidisset cognatus ejus, omnia scilicet quæ agebat in populo, ait : Quid est hoc quod facis in plebe? cur solus sedes, et omnis populus præstolatur de mane usque ad vesperam?
text_pt: Vendo, pois, o sogro de Moisés tudo o que ele fazia ao povo, disse: Que é isto, que tu fazes ao povo? Por que te assentas só, e todo o povo está em pé diante de ti, desde a manhã até à tarde?
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν Ιοθορ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίει τῷ λαῷ λέγει τί τοῦτο ὃ σὺ ποιεῖς τῷ λαῷ διὰ τί σὺ κάθησαι μόνος πᾶς δὲ ὁ λαὸς παρέστηκέν σοι ἀπὸ πρωίθεν ἕως δείλης

text_en: And Moses answered him: The people come to me to seek the judgment of God ?
text_la: Cui respondit Moyses : Venit ad me populus quærens sententiam Dei:
text_pt: Então disse Moisés a seu sogro: É porque este povo vem a mim, para consultar a Deus;
text_el: καὶ λέγει Μωυσῆς τῷ γαμβρῷ ὅτι παραγίνεται πρός με ὁ λαὸς ἐκζητῆσαι κρίσιν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And when any controversy falls out among them, they come to me to judge between them, and to show the precepts of God , and his laws.
text_la: cumque acciderit eis aliqua disceptatio, veniunt ad me ut judicem inter eos, et ostendam præcepta Dei, et leges ejus.
text_pt: Quando tem algum negócio vem a mim, para que eu julgue entre um e outro e lhes declare os estatutos de Deus e as suas leis.
text_el: ὅταν γὰρ γένηται αὐτοῖς ἀντιλογία καὶ ἔλθωσι πρός με διακρίνω ἕκαστον καὶ συμβιβάζω αὐτοὺς τὰ προστάγματα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὸν νόμον αὐτοῦ

text_en: But he said: The thing you do is not good .
text_la: At ille : Non bonam, inquit, rem facis.
text_pt: O sogro de Moisés, porém, lhe disse: Não é bom o que fazes.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ γαμβρὸς Μωυσῆ πρὸς αὐτόν οὐκ ὀρθῶς σὺ ποιεῖς τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: You are spent with foolish labour, both you, and this people that is with you; the business is above your strength, you alone can not bear it.
text_la: Stulto labore consumeris et tu, et populus iste qui tecum est : ultra vires tuas est negotium; solus illud non poteris sustinere.
text_pt: Totalmente desfalecerás, assim tu como este povo que está contigo; porque este negócio é mui difícil para ti; tu só não o podes fazer.
text_el: φθορᾷ καταφθαρήσῃ ἀνυπομονήτῳ καὶ σὺ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς οὗτος ὅς ἐστιν μετὰ σοῦ βαρύ σοι τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο οὐ δυνήσῃ ποιεῖν μόνος

text_en: But hear my words and counsels, and God shall be with you. Be thou to the people in those things that pertain to God , to bring their words to him:
text_la: Sed audi verba mea atque consilia, et erit Deus tecum. Esto tu populo in his quæ ad Deum pertinent, ut referas quæ dicuntur ad eum:
text_pt: Ouve agora minha voz, eu te aconselharei, e Deus será contigo. Sê tu pelo povo diante de Deus, e leva tu as causas a Deus;
text_el: νῦν οὖν ἄκουσόν μου καὶ συμβουλεύσω σοι καὶ ἔσται ὁ θεὸς μετὰ σοῦ γίνου σὺ τῷ λαῷ τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν καὶ ἀνοίσεις τοὺς λόγους αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸν θεὸν

text_en: And to show the people the ceremonies , and the manner of worshipping ; and the way wherein they ought to walk, and the work that they ought to do.
text_la: ostendasque populo cæremonias et ritum colendi, viamque per quam ingredi debeant, et opus quod facere debeant.
text_pt: E declara-lhes os estatutos e as leis, e faze-lhes saber o caminho em que devem andar, e a obra que devem fazer.
text_el: καὶ διαμαρτυρῇ αὐτοῖς τὰ προστάγματα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὸν νόμον αὐτοῦ καὶ σημανεῖς αὐτοῖς τὰς ὁδούς ἐν αἷς πορεύσονται ἐν αὐταῖς καὶ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιήσουσιν

text_en: And provide out of all the people able men , such as fear God , in whom there is truth , and that hate avarice , and appoint of them rulers of thousands, and of hundreds , and of fifties, and of tens,
text_la: Provide autem de omni plebe viros potentes, et timentes Deum, in quibus sit veritas, et qui oderint avaritiam, et constitue ex eis tribunos, et centuriones, et quinquagenarios, et decanos,
text_pt: E tu dentre todo o povo procura homens capazes, tementes a Deus, homens de verdade, que odeiem a avareza; e põe-nos sobre eles por maiorais de mil, maiorais de cem, maiorais de cinqüenta, e maiorais de dez;
text_el: καὶ σὺ σεαυτῷ σκέψαι ἀπὸ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ ἄνδρας δυνατοὺς θεοσεβεῖς ἄνδρας δικαίους μισοῦντας ὑπερηφανίαν καὶ καταστήσεις αὐτοὺς ἐπ' αὐτῶν χιλιάρχους καὶ ἑκατοντάρχους καὶ πεντηκοντάρχους καὶ δεκαδάρχους

text_en: who may judge the people at all times: and when any great matter soever shall fall out, let them refer it to you, and let them judge the lesser matters only: that so it may be lighter for you, the burden being shared out unto others.
text_la: qui judicent populum omni tempore : quidquid autem majus fuerit, referant ad te, et ipsi minora tantummodo judicent : leviusque sit tibi, partito in alios onere.
text_pt: Para que julguem este povo em todo o tempo; e seja que todo o negócio grave tragam a ti, mas todo o negócio pequeno eles o julguem; assim a ti mesmo te aliviarás da carga, e eles a levarão contigo.
text_el: καὶ κρινοῦσιν τὸν λαὸν πᾶσαν ὥραν τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα τὸ ὑπέρογκον ἀνοίσουσιν ἐπὶ σέ τὰ δὲ βραχέα τῶν κριμάτων κρινοῦσιν αὐτοὶ καὶ κουφιοῦσιν ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ συναντιλήμψονταί σοι

text_en: If you do this, you shall fulfil the commandment of God , and shall be able to bear his precepts : and all this people shall return to their places with peace.
text_la: Si hoc feceris, implebis imperium Dei, et præcepta ejus poteris sustentare : et omnis hic populus revertetur ad loca sua cum pace.
text_pt: Se isto fizeres, e Deus to mandar, poderás então subsistir; assim também todo este povo em paz irá ao seu lugar.
text_el: ἐὰν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ποιήσῃς κατισχύσει σε ὁ θεός καὶ δυνήσῃ παραστῆναι καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς οὗτος εἰς τὸν ἑαυτοῦ τόπον μετ' εἰρήνης ἥξει

text_en: And when Moses heard this, he did all things that he had suggested unto him.
text_la: Quibus auditis, Moyses fecit omnia quæ ille suggesserat.
text_pt: E Moisés deu ouvidos à voz de seu sogro, e fez tudo quanto tinha dito;
text_el: ἤκουσεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ γαμβροῦ καὶ ἐποίησεν ὅσα αὐτῷ εἶπεν

text_en: And choosing able men out of all Israel , he appointed them rulers of the people, rulers over thousands, and over hundreds , and over fifties, and over tens.
text_la: Et electis viris strenuis de cuncto Israël, constituit eos principes populi, tribunos, et centuriones, et quinquagenarios, et decanos.
text_pt: E escolheu Moisés homens capazes, de todo o Israel, e os pôs por cabeças sobre o povo; maiorais de mil, maiorais de cem, maiorais de cinqüenta e maiorais de dez.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέλεξεν Μωυσῆς ἄνδρας δυνατοὺς ἀπὸ παντὸς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτοὺς ἐπ' αὐτῶν χιλιάρχους καὶ ἑκατοντάρχους καὶ πεντηκοντάρχους καὶ δεκαδάρχους

text_en: And they judged the people at all times: and whatsoever was of greater difficulty they referred to him, and they judged the easier cases only.
text_la: Qui judicabant plebem omni tempore : quidquid autem gravius erat, referebant ad eum, faciliora tantummodo judicantes.
text_pt: E eles julgaram o povo em todo o tempo; o negócio árduo trouxeram a Moisés, e todo o negócio pequeno julgaram eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐκρίνοσαν τὸν λαὸν πᾶσαν ὥραν πᾶν δὲ ῥῆμα ὑπέρογκον ἀνεφέροσαν ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν πᾶν δὲ ῥῆμα ἐλαφρὸν ἐκρίνοσαν αὐτοί

text_en: And he let his kinsman depart: and he returned and went into his own country.
text_la: Dimisitque cognatum suum : qui reversus abiit in terram suam.
text_pt: Então despediu Moisés o seu sogro, o qual se foi à sua terra.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὸν ἑαυτοῦ γαμβρόν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ

text_en: In the third month of the departure of Israel out of the land of Egypt , on this day they came into the wilderness of Sinai :
text_la: Mense tertio egressionis Israël de terra Ægypti, in die hac venerunt in solitudinem Sinai.
text_pt: Ao terceiro mês da saída dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, no mesmo dia chegaram ao deserto de Sinai,
text_el: τοῦ δὲ μηνὸς τοῦ τρίτου τῆς ἐξόδου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τοῦ Σινα

text_en: For departing out of Raphidim, and coming to the desert of Sinai , they camped in the same place, and there Israel pitched their tents over against the mountain .
text_la: Nam profecti de Raphidim, et pervenientes usque in desertum Sinai, castrametati sunt in eodem loco, ibique Israël fixit tentoria e regione montis.
text_pt: Porque partiram de Refidim e entraram no deserto de Sinai, onde se acamparam. Israel, pois, ali se acampou em frente ao monte.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆραν ἐκ Ραφιδιν καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον τοῦ Σινα καὶ παρενέβαλεν ἐκεῖ Ισραηλ κατέναντι τοῦ ὄρους

text_en: And Moses went up to God ; and the Lord called unto him from the mountain , and said: Thus shall you say to the house of Jacob , and tell the children of Israel :
text_la: Moyses autem ascendit ad Deum : vocavitque eum Dominus de monte, et ait : Hæc dices domui Jacob, et annuntiabis filiis Israël:
text_pt: E subiu Moisés a Deus, e o Senhor o chamou do monte, dizendo: Assim falarás à casa de Jacó, e anunciarás aos filhos de Israel:
text_el: καὶ Μωυσῆς ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους λέγων τάδε ἐρεῖς τῷ οἴκῳ Ιακωβ καὶ ἀναγγελεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: You have seen what I have done to the Egyptians , how I have carried you upon the wings of eagles, and have taken you to myself.
text_la: Vos ipsi vidistis quæ fecerim Ægyptiis, quomodo portaverim vos super alas aquilarum, et assumpserim mihi.
text_pt: Vós tendes visto o que fiz aos egípcios, como vos levei sobre asas de águias, e vos trouxe a mim;
text_el: αὐτοὶ ἑωράκατε ὅσα πεποίηκα τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις καὶ ἀνέλαβον ὑμᾶς ὡσεὶ ἐπὶ πτερύγων ἀετῶν καὶ προσηγαγόμην ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν

text_en: If therefore you will hear my voice, and keep my covenant, you shall be my peculiar possession above all people: for all the earth is mine.
text_la: Si ergo audieritis vocem meam, et custodieritis pactum meum, eritis mihi in peculium de cunctis populis : mea est enim omnis terra:
text_pt: Agora, pois, se diligentemente ouvirdes a minha voz e guardardes a minha aliança, então sereis a minha propriedade peculiar dentre todos os povos, porque toda a terra é minha.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσητε τῆς ἐμῆς φωνῆς καὶ φυλάξητε τὴν διαθήκην μου ἔσεσθέ μοι λαὸς περιούσιος ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐμὴ γάρ ἐστιν πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: And you shall be to me a priestly kingdom, and a holy nation. These are the words you shall speak to the children of Israel .
text_la: et vos eritis mihi in regnum sacerdotale, et gens sancta. Hæc sunt verba quæ loqueris ad filios Israël.
text_pt: E vós me sereis um reino sacerdotal e o povo santo. Estas são as palavras que falarás aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ ἔσεσθέ μοι βασίλειον ἱεράτευμα καὶ ἔθνος ἅγιον ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐρεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: Moses came; and calling together the elders of the people, he declared all the words which the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Venit Moyses : et convocatis majoribus natu populi, exposuit omnes sermones quos mandaverat Dominus.
text_pt: E veio Moisés, e chamou os anciãos do povo, e expôs diante deles todas estas palavras, que o Senhor lhe tinha ordenado.
text_el: ἦλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους οὓς συνέταξεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός

text_en: And all the people answered together: All that the Lord has spoken , we will do. And when Moses had related the people's words to the Lord ,
text_la: Responditque omnis populus simul : Cuncta quæ locutus est Dominus, faciemus. Cumque retulisset Moyses verba populi ad Dominum,
text_pt: Então todo o povo respondeu a uma voz, e disse: Tudo o que o Senhor tem falado, faremos. E relatou Moisés ao Senhor as palavras do povo.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁμοθυμαδὸν καὶ εἶπαν πάντα ὅσα εἶπεν ὁ θεός ποιήσομεν καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα ἀνήνεγκεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τοὺς λόγους τοῦ λαοῦ πρὸς τὸν θεόν

text_en: the Lord said to him: Lo, now will I come to you in the darkness of a cloud, that the people may hear me speaking to you, and may believe you for ever. And Moses told the words of the people to the Lord .
text_la: ait ei Dominus : Jam nunc veniam ad te in caligine nubis, ut audiat me populus loquentem ad te, et credat tibi in perpetuum. Nuntiavit ergo Moyses verba populi ad Dominum.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Eis que eu virei a ti numa nuvem espessa, para que o povo ouça, falando eu contigo, e para que também te creiam eternamente. Porque Moisés tinha anunciado as palavras do seu povo ao Senhor.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραγίνομαι πρὸς σὲ ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης ἵνα ἀκούσῃ ὁ λαὸς λαλοῦντός μου πρὸς σὲ καὶ σοὶ πιστεύσωσιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἀνήγγειλεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ λαοῦ πρὸς κύριον

text_en: And he said to him: Go to the people, and sanctify them today, and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments.
text_la: Qui dixit ei : Vade ad populum, et sanctifica illos hodie, et cras, laventque vestimenta sua.
text_pt: Disse também o Senhor a Moisés: Vai ao povo, e santifica-os hoje e amanhã, e lavem eles as suas roupas,
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καταβὰς διαμάρτυραι τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἅγνισον αὐτοὺς σήμερον καὶ αὔριον καὶ πλυνάτωσαν τὰ ἱμάτια

text_en: And let them be ready against the third day; for on the third day the Lord will come down in the sight of all the people, upon Mount Sinai .
text_la: Et sint parati in diem tertium: in die enim tertia descendet Dominus coram omni plebe super montem Sinai.
text_pt: E estejam prontos para o terceiro dia; porquanto no terceiro dia o Senhor descerá diante dos olhos de todo o povo sobre o monte Sinai.
text_el: καὶ ἔστωσαν ἕτοιμοι εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν τρίτην τῇ γὰρ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καταβήσεται κύριος ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινα ἐναντίον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And you shall appoint certain limits to the people round about, and you shall say to them: Take heed that you not go up into the mount , and that you touch not the borders thereof: every one that touches the mount , dying he shall die.
text_la: Constituesque terminos populo per circuitum, et dices ad eos : Cavete ne ascendatis in montem, nec tangatis fines illius : omnis qui tetigerit montem, morte morietur.
text_pt: E marcarás limites ao povo em redor, dizendo: Guardai-vos, não subais ao monte, nem toqueis o seu termo; todo aquele que tocar o monte, certamente morrerá.
text_el: καὶ ἀφοριεῖς τὸν λαὸν κύκλῳ λέγων προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς τοῦ ἀναβῆναι εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ θιγεῖν τι αὐτοῦ πᾶς ὁ ἁψάμενος τοῦ ὄρους θανάτῳ τελευτήσει

text_en: No hands shall touch him, but he shall be stoned to death , or he shall be shot through with arrows: whether it be beast, or man , he shall not live. When the trumpet shall begin to sound, then let them go up into the mount .
text_la: Manus non tanget eum, sed lapidibus opprimetur, aut confodietur jaculis : sive jumentum fuerit, sive homo, non vivet : cum cœperit clangere buccina, tunc ascendant in montem.
text_pt: Nenhuma mão tocará nele; porque certamente será apedrejado ou asseteado; quer seja animal, quer seja homem, não viverá; soando a buzina longamente, então subirão ao monte.
text_el: οὐχ ἅψεται αὐτοῦ χείρ ἐν γὰρ λίθοις λιθοβοληθήσεται ἢ βολίδι κατατοξευθήσεται ἐάν τε κτῆνος ἐάν τε ἄνθρωπος οὐ ζήσεται ὅταν αἱ φωναὶ καὶ αἱ σάλπιγγες καὶ ἡ νεφέλη ἀπέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους ἐκεῖνοι ἀναβήσονται ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος

text_en: And Moses came down from the mount to the people, and sanctified them. And when they had washed their garments,
text_la: Descenditque Moyses de monte ad populum, et sanctificavit eum. Cumque lavissent vestimenta sua,
text_pt: Então Moisés desceu do monte ao povo, e santificou o povo; e lavaram as suas roupas.
text_el: κατέβη δὲ Μωυσῆς ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους πρὸς τὸν λαὸν καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτούς καὶ ἔπλυναν τὰ ἱμάτια

text_en: he said to them: Be ready against the third day, and come not near your wives.
text_la: ait ad eos : Estote parati in diem tertium, et ne appropinquetis uxoribus vestris.
text_pt: E disse ao povo: Estai prontos ao terceiro dia; e não vos chegueis a mulher.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ λαῷ γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι τρεῖς ἡμέρας μὴ προσέλθητε γυναικί

text_en: And now the third day had come, and the morning appeared: and behold thunders began to be heard, and lightning to flash, and a very thick cloud to cover the mount , and the noise of the trumpet sounded exceeding loud; and the people that was in the camp, feared.
text_la: Jamque advenerat tertius dies, et mane inclaruerat : et ecce cœperunt audiri tonitrua, ac micare fulgura, et nubes densissima operire montem, clangorque buccinæ vehementius perstrepebat : et timuit populus qui erat in castris.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ao terceiro dia, ao amanhecer, houve trovões e relâmpagos sobre o monte, e uma espessa nuvem, e um sonido de buzina mui forte, de maneira que estremeceu todo o povo que estava no arraial.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ γενηθέντος πρὸς ὄρθρον καὶ ἐγίνοντο φωναὶ καὶ ἀστραπαὶ καὶ νεφέλη γνοφώδης ἐπ' ὄρους Σινα φωνὴ τῆς σάλπιγγος ἤχει μέγα καὶ ἐπτοήθη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ

text_en: And when Moses had brought them forth to meet God , from the place of the camp, they stood at the bottom of the mount .
text_la: Cumque eduxisset eos Moyses in occursum Dei de loco castrorum, steterunt ad radices montis.
text_pt: E Moisés levou o povo fora do arraial ao encontro de Deus; e puseram-se ao pé do monte.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν Μωυσῆς τὸν λαὸν εἰς συνάντησιν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ παρέστησαν ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος

text_en: And all Mount Sinai was on a smoke: because the Lord had come down upon it in fire, and the smoke arose from it as out of a furnace: and all the mount was terrible.
text_la: Totus autem mons Sinai fumabat, eo quod descendisset Dominus super eum in igne : et ascenderet fumus ex eo quasi de fornace, eratque omnis mons terribilis.
text_pt: E todo o monte Sinai fumegava, porque o Senhor descera sobre ele em fogo; e a sua fumaça subiu como fumaça de uma fornalha, e todo o monte tremia grandemente.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ὄρος τὸ Σινα ἐκαπνίζετο ὅλον διὰ τὸ καταβεβηκέναι ἐπ' αὐτὸ τὸν θεὸν ἐν πυρί καὶ ἀνέβαινεν ὁ καπνὸς ὡς καπνὸς καμίνου καὶ ἐξέστη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς σφόδρα

text_en: And the sound of the trumpet grew by degrees louder and louder, and was drawn out to a greater length: Moses spoke, and God answered him.
text_la: Et sonitus buccinæ paulatim crescebat in majus, et prolixius tendebatur : Moyses loquebatur, et Deus respondebat ei.
text_pt: E o sonido da buzina ia crescendo cada vez mais; Moisés falava, e Deus lhe respondia em voz alta.
text_el: ἐγίνοντο δὲ αἱ φωναὶ τῆς σάλπιγγος προβαίνουσαι ἰσχυρότεραι σφόδρα Μωυσῆς ἐλάλει ὁ δὲ θεὸς ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτῷ φωνῇ

text_en: And the Lord came down upon Mount Sinai , in the very top of the mount , and he called Moses unto the top thereof. And when he had gone up thither,
text_la: Descenditque Dominus super montem Sinai in ipso montis vertice, et vocavit Moysen in cacumen ejus. Quo cum ascendisset,
text_pt: E, descendo o Senhor sobre o monte Sinai, sobre o cume do monte, chamou o Senhor a Moisés ao cume do monte; e Moisés subiu.
text_el: κατέβη δὲ κύριος ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινα ἐπὶ τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ ὄρους καὶ ἐκάλεσεν κύριος Μωυσῆν ἐπὶ τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ ὄρους καὶ ἀνέβη Μωυσῆς

text_en: he said unto him: Go down, and charge the people; lest they should have a mind to pass the limits to see the Lord , and a very great multitude of them should perish.
text_la: dixit ad eum : Descende, et contestare populum : ne forte velit transcendere terminos ad videndum Dominum, et pereat ex eis plurima multitudo.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Moisés: Desce, adverte ao povo que não traspasse o termo para ver o Senhor, para que muitos deles não pereçam.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων καταβὰς διαμάρτυραι τῷ λαῷ μήποτε ἐγγίσωσιν πρὸς τὸν θεὸν κατανοῆσαι καὶ πέσωσιν ἐξ αὐτῶν πλῆθος

text_en: The priests also that come to the Lord , let them be sanctified , lest he strike them.
text_la: Sacerdotes quoque qui accedunt ad Dominum, sanctificentur, ne percutiat eos.
text_pt: E também os sacerdotes, que se chegam ao Senhor, se hão de santificar, para que o Senhor não se lance sobre eles.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ ἐγγίζοντες κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἁγιασθήτωσαν μήποτε ἀπαλλάξῃ ἀπ' αὐτῶν κύριος

text_en: And Moses said to the Lord : The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai : for you charged, and commanded, saying: Set limits about the mount , and sanctify it.
text_la: Dixitque Moyses ad Dominum : Non poterit vulgus ascendere in montem Sinai : tu enim testificatus es, et jussisti, dicens : Pone terminos circa montem, et sanctifica illum.
text_pt: Então disse Moisés ao Senhor: O povo não poderá subir ao monte Sinai, porque tu nos tens advertido, dizendo: Marca termos ao redor do monte, e santifica-o.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν θεόν οὐ δυνήσεται ὁ λαὸς προσαναβῆναι πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινα σὺ γὰρ διαμεμαρτύρησαι ἡμῖν λέγων ἀφόρισαι τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἁγίασαι αὐτό

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Go, get you down; and you shall come up, you and Aaron with you: but let not the priests and the people pass the limits, nor come up to the Lord , lest he kill them.
text_la: Cui ait Dominus : Vade, descende : ascendesque tu, et Aaron tecum : sacerdotes autem et populus ne transeant terminos, nec ascendant ad Dominum, ne forte interficiat illos.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Vai, desce; depois subirás tu, e Arão contigo; os sacerdotes, porém, e o povo não traspassem o termo para subir ao Senhor, para que não se lance sobre eles.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ κύριος βάδιζε κατάβηθι καὶ ἀνάβηθι σὺ καὶ Ααρων μετὰ σοῦ οἱ δὲ ἱερεῖς καὶ ὁ λαὸς μὴ βιαζέσθωσαν ἀναβῆναι πρὸς τὸν θεόν μήποτε ἀπολέσῃ ἀπ' αὐτῶν κύριος

text_en: And Moses went down to the people and told them all.
text_la: Descenditque Moyses ad populum, et omnia narravit eis.
text_pt: Então Moisés desceu ao povo, e disse-lhe isto.
text_el: κατέβη δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν λαὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And the Lord spoke all these words :
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus cunctos sermones hos:
text_pt: Então falou Deus todas estas palavras, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους λέγων

text_en: I am the Lord your God , who brought you out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .
text_la: Ego sum Dominus Deus tuus, qui eduxi te de terra Ægypti, de domo servitutis.
text_pt: Eu sou o Senhor teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεός σου ὅστις ἐξήγαγόν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας

text_en: You shall not have strange gods before me.
text_la: Non habebis deos alienos coram me.
text_pt: Não terás outros deuses diante de mim.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσονταί σοι θεοὶ ἕτεροι πλὴν ἐμοῦ

text_en: You shall not make to yourself a graven thing , nor the likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or in the earth beneath, nor of those things that are in the waters under the earth.
text_la: Non facies tibi sculptile, neque omnem similitudinem quæ est in cælo desuper, et quæ in terra deorsum, nec eorum quæ sunt in aquis sub terra.
text_pt: Não farás para ti imagem de escultura, nem alguma semelhança do que há em cima nos céus, nem em baixo na terra, nem nas águas debaixo da terra.
text_el: οὐ ποιήσεις σεαυτῷ εἴδωλον οὐδὲ παντὸς ὁμοίωμα ὅσα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ ὅσα ἐν τῇ γῇ κάτω καὶ ὅσα ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς

text_en: You shall not adore them, nor serve them: I am the Lord your God , mighty, jealous, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me:
text_la: Non adorabis ea, neque coles : ego sum Dominus Deus tuus fortis, zelotes, visitans iniquitatem patrum in filios, in tertiam et quartam generationem eorum qui oderunt me:
text_pt: Não te encurvarás a elas nem as servirás; porque eu, o Senhor teu Deus, sou Deus zeloso, que visito a iniqüidade dos pais nos filhos, até a terceira e quarta geração daqueles que me odeiam.
text_el: οὐ προσκυνήσεις αὐτοῖς οὐδὲ μὴ λατρεύσῃς αὐτοῖς ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεός σου θεὸς ζηλωτὴς ἀποδιδοὺς ἁμαρτίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα ἕως τρίτης καὶ τετάρτης γενεᾶς τοῖς μισοῦσίν με

text_en: And showing mercy unto thousands to them that love me, and keep my commandments.
text_la: et faciens misericordiam in millia his qui diligunt me, et custodiunt præcepta mea.
text_pt: E faço misericórdia a milhares dos que me amam e aos que guardam os meus mandamentos.
text_el: καὶ ποιῶν ἔλεος εἰς χιλιάδας τοῖς ἀγαπῶσίν με καὶ τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὰ προστάγματά μου

text_en: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that shall take the name of the Lord his God in vain.
text_la: Non assumes nomen Domini Dei tui in vanum : nec enim habebit insontem Dominus eum qui assumpserit nomen Domini Dei sui frustra.
text_pt: Não tomarás o nome do Senhor teu Deus em vão; porque o Senhor não terá por inocente o que tomar o seu nome em vão.
text_el: οὐ λήμψῃ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἐπὶ ματαίῳ οὐ γὰρ μὴ καθαρίσῃ κύριος τὸν λαμβάνοντα τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ ματαίῳ

text_en: Remember that you keep holy the sabbath day .
text_la: Memento ut diem sabbati sanctifices.
text_pt: Lembra-te do dia do sábado, para o santificar.
text_el: μνήσθητι τὴν ἡμέραν τῶν σαββάτων ἁγιάζειν αὐτήν

text_en: Six days shall you labour, and shall do all your works.
text_la: Sex diebus operaberis, et facies omnia opera tua.
text_pt: Seis dias trabalharás, e farás toda a tua obra.
text_el: ἓξ ἡμέρας ἐργᾷ καὶ ποιήσεις πάντα τὰ ἔργα σου

text_en: But on the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord your God : you shall do no work on it, neither you nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your beast, nor the stranger that is within your gates.
text_la: Septimo autem die sabbatum Domini Dei tui est : non facies omne opus in eo, tu, et filius tuus et filia tua, servus tuus et ancilla tua, jumentum tuum, et advena qui est intra portas tuas.
text_pt: Mas o sétimo dia é o sábado do Senhor teu Deus; não farás nenhuma obra, nem tu, nem teu filho, nem tua filha, nem o teu servo, nem a tua serva, nem o teu animal, nem o teu estrangeiro, que está dentro das tuas portas.
text_el: τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ σάββατα κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου οὐ ποιήσεις ἐν αὐτῇ πᾶν ἔργον σὺ καὶ ὁ υἱός σου καὶ ἡ θυγάτηρ σου ὁ παῖς σου καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη σου ὁ βοῦς σου καὶ τὸ ὑποζύγιόν σου καὶ πᾶν κτῆνός σου καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ὁ παροικῶν ἐν σοί

text_en: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and the sea, and all things that are in them, and rested on the seventh day: therefore the Lord blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it.
text_la: Sex enim diebus fecit Dominus cælum et terram, et mare, et omnia quæ in eis sunt, et requievit in die septimo : idcirco benedixit Dominus diei sabbati, et sanctificavit eum.
text_pt: Porque em seis dias fez o Senhor os céus e a terra, o mar e tudo que neles há, e ao sétimo dia descansou; portanto abençoou o Senhor o dia do sábado, e o santificou.
text_el: ἐν γὰρ ἓξ ἡμέραις ἐποίησεν κύριος τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ κατέπαυσεν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ διὰ τοῦτο εὐλόγησεν κύριος τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἑβδόμην καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτήν

text_en: Honour your father and your mother , that you may be longlived upon the land which the Lord your God will give you.
text_la: Honora patrem tuum et matrem tuam, ut sis longævus super terram, quam Dominus Deus tuus dabit tibi.
text_pt: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, para que se prolonguem os teus dias na terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dá.
text_el: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἵνα μακροχρόνιος γένῃ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τῆς ἀγαθῆς ἧς κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι

text_en: You shall not kill .
text_la: Non occides.
text_pt: Não matarás.
text_el: οὐ μοιχεύσεις

text_en: You shall not commit adultery .
text_la: Non mœchaberis.
text_pt: Não adulterarás.
text_el: οὐ κλέψεις

text_en: You shall not steal .
text_la: Non furtum facies.
text_pt: Não furtarás.
text_el: οὐ φονεύσεις

text_en: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbour.
text_la: Non loqueris contra proximum tuum falsum testimonium.
text_pt: Não dirás falso testemunho contra o teu próximo.
text_el: οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις κατὰ τοῦ πλησίον σου μαρτυρίαν ψευδῆ

text_en: You shall not covet your neighbour's house; neither shall you desire his wife, nor his servant, nor his handmaid, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is his.
text_la: Non concupisces domum proximi tui, nec desiderabis uxorem ejus, non servum, non ancillam, non bovem, non asinum, nec omnia quæ illius sunt.
text_pt: Não cobiçarás a casa do teu próximo, não cobiçarás a mulher do teu próximo, nem o seu servo, nem a sua serva, nem o seu boi, nem o seu jumento, nem coisa alguma do teu próximo.
text_el: οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον σου οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ πλησίον σου οὔτε τὸν ἀγρὸν αὐτοῦ οὔτε τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ οὔτε τὴν παιδίσκην αὐτοῦ οὔτε τοῦ βοὸς αὐτοῦ οὔτε τοῦ ὑποζυγίου αὐτοῦ οὔτε παντὸς κτήνους αὐτοῦ οὔτε ὅσα τῷ πλησίον σού ἐστιν

text_en: And all the people saw the voices and the flames, and the sound of the trumpet, and the mount smoking; and being terrified and struck with fear , they stood afar off,
text_la: Cunctus autem populus videbat voces et lampades, et sonitum buccinæ, montemque fumantem : et perterriti ac pavore concussi, steterunt procul,
text_pt: E todo o povo viu os trovões e os relâmpagos, e o sonido da buzina, e o monte fumegando; e o povo, vendo isso retirou-se e pôs-se de longe.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἑώρα τὴν φωνὴν καὶ τὰς λαμπάδας καὶ τὴν φωνὴν τῆς σάλπιγγος καὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ καπνίζον φοβηθέντες δὲ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἔστησαν μακρόθεν

text_en: saying to Moses : Speak to us, and we will hear: let not the Lord speak to us, lest we die.
text_la: dicentes Moysi : Loquere tu nobis, et audiemus : non loquatur nobis Dominus, ne forte moriamur.
text_pt: E disseram a Moisés: Fala tu conosco, e ouviremos: e não fale Deus conosco, para que não morramos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Μωυσῆν λάλησον σὺ ἡμῖν καὶ μὴ λαλείτω πρὸς ἡμᾶς ὁ θεός μήποτε ἀποθάνωμεν

text_en: And Moses said to the people: Fear not; for God has come to prove you, and that the dread of him might be in you, and you should not sin .
text_la: Et ait Moyses ad populum : Nolite timere : ut enim probaret vos venit Deus, et ut terror illius esset in vobis, et non peccaretis.
text_pt: E disse Moisés ao povo: Não temais, Deus veio para vos provar, e para que o seu temor esteja diante de vós, a fim de que não pequeis.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς θαρσεῖτε ἕνεκεν γὰρ τοῦ πειράσαι ὑμᾶς παρεγενήθη ὁ θεὸς πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὅπως ἂν γένηται ὁ φόβος αὐτοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμαρτάνητε

text_en: And the people stood afar off. But Moses went to the dark cloud wherein God was.
text_la: Stetitque populus de longe. Moyses autem accessit ad caliginem in qua erat Deus.
text_pt: E o povo estava em pé de longe. Moisés, porém, se chegou à escuridão, onde Deus estava.
text_el: εἱστήκει δὲ ὁ λαὸς μακρόθεν Μωυσῆς δὲ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν γνόφον οὗ ἦν ὁ θεός

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Thus shall you say to the children of Israel : You have seen that I have spoken to you from heaven .
text_la: Dixit præterea Dominus ad Moysen : Hæc dices filiis Israël : Vos vidistis quod de cælo locutus sim vobis.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: Vós tendes visto que, dos céus, eu falei convosco.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν τάδε ἐρεῖς τῷ οἴκῳ Ιακωβ καὶ ἀναγγελεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ὑμεῖς ἑωράκατε ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ λελάληκα πρὸς ὑμᾶς

text_en: You shall not make gods of silver, nor shall you make to yourselves gods of gold.
text_la: Non facietis deos argenteos, nec deos aureos facietis vobis.
text_pt: Não fareis outros deuses comigo; deuses de prata ou deuses de ouro não fareis para vós.
text_el: οὐ ποιήσετε ἑαυτοῖς θεοὺς ἀργυροῦς καὶ θεοὺς χρυσοῦς οὐ ποιήσετε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς

text_en: You shall make an altar of earth unto me, and you shall offer upon it your holocausts and peace offerings , your sheep and oxen, in every place where the memory of my name shall be: I will come to you, and will bless you.
text_la: Altare de terra facietis mihi, et offeretis super eo holocausta et pacifica vestra, oves vestras et boves in omni loco in quo memoria fuerit nominis mei : veniam ad te, et benedicam tibi.
text_pt: Um altar de terra me farás, e sobre ele sacrificarás os teus holocaustos, e as tuas ofertas pacíficas, as tuas ovelhas, e as tuas vacas; em todo o lugar, onde eu fizer celebrar a memória do meu nome, virei a ti e te abençoarei.
text_el: θυσιαστήριον ἐκ γῆς ποιήσετέ μοι καὶ θύσετε ἐπ' αὐτοῦ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ τὰ σωτήρια ὑμῶν τὰ πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς μόσχους ὑμῶν ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ οὗ ἐὰν ἐπονομάσω τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐκεῖ καὶ ἥξω πρὸς σὲ καὶ εὐλογήσω σε

text_en: And if you make an altar of stone unto me, you shall not build it of hewn stones; for if you lift up a tool upon it, it shall be defiled.
text_la: Quod si altare lapideum feceris mihi, non ædificabis illud de sectis lapidibus : si enim levaveris cultrum super eo, polluetur.
text_pt: E se me fizeres um altar de pedras, não o farás de pedras lavradas; se sobre ele levantares o teu buril, profaná-lo-ás.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ θυσιαστήριον ἐκ λίθων ποιῇς μοι οὐκ οἰκοδομήσεις αὐτοὺς τμητούς τὸ γὰρ ἐγχειρίδιόν σου ἐπιβέβληκας ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ μεμίανται

text_en: You shall not go up by steps unto my altar , lest your nakedness be discovered.
text_la: Non ascendes per gradus ad altare meum, ne reveletur turpitudo tua.
text_pt: Também não subirás ao meu altar por degraus, para que a tua nudez não seja descoberta diante deles.
text_el: οὐκ ἀναβήσῃ ἐν ἀναβαθμίσιν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριόν μου ὅπως ἂν μὴ ἀποκαλύψῃς τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην σου ἐπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: These are the judgments which you shall set before them.
text_la: Hæc sunt judicia quæ propones eis.
text_pt: Estes são os estatutos que lhes proporás.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ δικαιώματα ἃ παραθήσεις ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: If you buy a Hebrew servant , six years shall he serve you; in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
text_la: Si emeris servum hebræum, sex annis serviet tibi : in septimo egredietur liber gratis.
text_pt: Se comprares um servo hebreu, seis anos servirá; mas ao sétimo sairá livre, de graça.
text_el: ἐὰν κτήσῃ παῖδα Εβραῖον ἓξ ἔτη δουλεύσει σοι τῷ δὲ ἑβδόμῳ ἔτει ἀπελεύσεται ἐλεύθερος δωρεάν

text_en: With what raiment he came in, with the like let him go out: if having a wife, his wife also shall go out with him.
text_la: Cum quali veste intraverit, cum tali exeat : si habens uxorem, et uxor egredietur simul.
text_pt: Se entrou só com o seu corpo, só com o seu corpo sairá; se ele era homem casado, sua mulher sairá com ele.
text_el: ἐὰν αὐτὸς μόνος εἰσέλθῃ καὶ μόνος ἐξελεύσεται ἐὰν δὲ γυνὴ συνεισέλθῃ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ ἡ γυνὴ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: But if his master gave him a wife, and she has borne sons and daughters; the woman and her children shall be her master's: but he himself shall go out with his raiment.
text_la: Sin autem dominus dederit illi uxorem, et pepererit filios et filias : mulier et liberi ejus erunt domini sui, ipse vero exibit cum vestitu suo.
text_pt: Se seu senhor lhe houver dado uma mulher e ela lhe houver dado filhos ou filhas, a mulher e seus filhos serão de seu senhor, e ele sairá sozinho.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ὁ κύριος δῷ αὐτῷ γυναῖκα καὶ τέκῃ αὐτῷ υἱοὺς ἢ θυγατέρας ἡ γυνὴ καὶ τὰ παιδία ἔσται τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς δὲ μόνος ἐξελεύσεται

text_en: And if the servant shall say: I love my master and my wife and children, I will not go out free:
text_la: Quod si dixerit servus : Diligo dominum meum et uxorem ac liberos; non egrediar liber:
text_pt: Mas se aquele servo expressamente disser: Eu amo a meu senhor, e a minha mulher, e a meus filhos; não quero sair livre,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἴπῃ ὁ παῖς ἠγάπηκα τὸν κύριόν μου καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ παιδία οὐκ ἀποτρέχω ἐλεύθερος

text_en: His master shall bring him to the gods, and he shall be set to the door and the posts, and he shall bore his ear through with an awl: and he shall be his servant for ever.
text_la: offeret eum dominus diis, et applicabitur ad ostium et postes, perforabitque aurem ejus subula : et erit ei servus in sæculum.
text_pt: Então seu senhor o levará aos juízes, e o fará chegar à porta, ou ao umbral da porta, e seu senhor lhe furará a orelha com uma sovela; e ele o servirá para sempre.
text_el: προσάξει αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸ κριτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τότε προσάξει αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν ἐπὶ τὸν σταθμόν καὶ τρυπήσει αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος τὸ οὖς τῷ ὀπητίῳ καὶ δουλεύσει αὐτῷ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: If any man sell his daughter to be a servant , she shall not go out as bondwomen are wont to go out.
text_la: Si quis vendiderit filiam suam in famulam, non egredietur sicut ancillæ exire consueverunt.
text_pt: E se um homem vender sua filha para ser serva, ela não sairá como saem os servos.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις ἀποδῶται τὴν ἑαυτοῦ θυγατέρα οἰκέτιν οὐκ ἀπελεύσεται ὥσπερ ἀποτρέχουσιν αἱ δοῦλαι

text_en: If she displease the eyes of her master to whom she was delivered, he shall let her go: but he shall have no power to sell her to a foreign nation , if he despise her.
text_la: Si displicuerit oculis domini sui cui tradita fuerat, dimittet eam : populo autem alieno vendendi non habebit potestatem, si spreverit eam.
text_pt: Se ela não agradar ao seu senhor, e ele não se desposar com ela, fará que se resgate; não poderá vendê-la a um povo estranho, agindo deslealmente com ela.
text_el: ἐὰν μὴ εὐαρεστήσῃ τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτῆς ἣν αὑτῷ καθωμολογήσατο ἀπολυτρώσει αὐτήν ἔθνει δὲ ἀλλοτρίῳ οὐ κύριός ἐστιν πωλεῖν αὐτήν ὅτι ἠθέτησεν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: But if he have betrothed her to his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
text_la: Sin autem filio suo desponderit eam, juxta morem filiarum faciet illi.
text_pt: Mas se a desposar com seu filho, fará com ela conforme ao direito das filhas.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ τῷ υἱῷ καθομολογήσηται αὐτήν κατὰ τὸ δικαίωμα τῶν θυγατέρων ποιήσει αὐτῇ

text_en: And if he take another wife for him, he shall provide her a marriage , and raiment, neither shall he refuse the price of her chastity .
text_la: Quod si alteram ei acceperit, providebit puellæ nuptias, et vestimenta, et pretium pudicitiæ non negabit.
text_pt: Se lhe tomar outra, não diminuirá o mantimento desta, nem o seu vestido, nem a sua obrigação marital.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἄλλην λάβῃ ἑαυτῷ τὰ δέοντα καὶ τὸν ἱματισμὸν καὶ τὴν ὁμιλίαν αὐτῆς οὐκ ἀποστερήσει

text_en: If he do not these three things, she shall go out free without money.
text_la: Si tria ista non fecerit, egredietur gratis absque pecunia.
text_pt: E se lhe não fizer estas três coisas, sairá de graça, sem dar dinheiro.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ τὰ τρία ταῦτα μὴ ποιήσῃ αὐτῇ ἐξελεύσεται δωρεὰν ἄνευ ἀργυρίου

text_en: He that strikes a man with a will to kill him, shall be put to death .
text_la: Qui percusserit hominem volens occidere, morte moriatur.
text_pt: Quem ferir alguém, de modo que este morra, certamente será morto.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ πατάξῃ τίς τινα καὶ ἀποθάνῃ θανάτῳ θανατούσθω

text_en: But he that did not lie in wait for him, but God delivered him into his hands: I will appoint you a place to which he must flee.
text_la: Qui autem non est insidiatus, sed Deus illum tradidit in manus ejus, constituam tibi locum in quem fugere debeat.
text_pt: Porém se lhe não armou cilada, mas Deus lho entregou nas mãos, ordenar-te-ei um lugar para onde fugirá.
text_el: ὁ δὲ οὐχ ἑκών ἀλλὰ ὁ θεὸς παρέδωκεν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ δώσω σοι τόπον οὗ φεύξεται ἐκεῖ ὁ φονεύσας

text_en: If a man kill his neighbour on set purpose, and by lying in wait for him: you shall take him away from my altar that he may die .
text_la: Si quis per industriam occiderit proximum suum, et per insidias : ab altari meo evelles eum, ut moriatur.
text_pt: Mas se alguém agir premeditadamente contra o seu próximo, matando-o à traição, tirá-lo-ás do meu altar, para que morra.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις ἐπιθῆται τῷ πλησίον ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτὸν δόλῳ καὶ καταφύγῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου μου λήμψῃ αὐτὸν θανατῶσαι

text_en: He that strikes his father or mother , shall be put to death .
text_la: Qui percusserit patrem suum aut matrem, morte moriatur.
text_pt: O que ferir a seu pai, ou a sua mãe, certamente será morto.
text_el: ὃς τύπτει πατέρα αὐτοῦ ἢ μητέρα αὐτοῦ θανάτῳ θανατούσθω

text_en: He that shall steal a man , and sell him, being convicted of the guilt, shall be put to death .
text_la: Qui furatus fuerit hominem, et vendiderit eum, convictus noxæ, morte moriatur.
text_pt: E quem raptar um homem, e o vender, ou for achado na sua mão, certamente será morto.
text_el: ὁ κακολογῶν πατέρα αὐτοῦ ἢ μητέρα αὐτοῦ τελευτήσει θανάτῳ

text_en: He that curses his father or mother , shall die the death .
text_la: Qui maledixerit patri suo, vel matri, morte moriatur.
text_pt: E quem amaldiçoar a seu pai ou a sua mãe, certamente será morto.
text_el: ὃς ἐὰν κλέψῃ τίς τινα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ καταδυναστεύσας αὐτὸν ἀποδῶται καὶ εὑρεθῇ ἐν αὐτῷ θανάτῳ τελευτάτω

text_en: If men quarrel, and the one strike his neighbour with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keeps his bed:
text_la: Si rixati fuerint viri, et percusserit alter proximum suum lapide vel pugno, et ille mortuus non fuerit, sed jacuerit in lectulo:
text_pt: E se dois homens pelejarem, ferindo-se um ao outro com pedra ou com o punho, e este não morrer, mas cair na cama,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ λοιδορῶνται δύο ἄνδρες καὶ πατάξῃ τις τὸν πλησίον λίθῳ ἢ πυγμῇ καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ κατακλιθῇ δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν κοίτην

text_en: If he rise again and walk abroad upon his staff, he that struck him shall be quit, yet so that he make restitution for his work, and for his expenses upon the physicians.
text_la: si surrexerit, et ambulaverit foris super baculum suum, innocens erit qui percusserit, ita tamen ut operas ejus et impensas in medicos restituat.
text_pt: Se ele tornar a levantar-se e andar fora, sobre o seu bordão, então aquele que o feriu será absolvido; somente lhe pagará o tempo que perdera e o fará curar totalmente.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐξαναστὰς ὁ ἄνθρωπος περιπατήσῃ ἔξω ἐπὶ ῥάβδου ἀθῷος ἔσται ὁ πατάξας πλὴν τῆς ἀργίας αὐτοῦ ἀποτείσει καὶ τὰ ἰατρεῖα

text_en: He that strikes his bondman , or bondwoman , with a rod, and they die under his hands, shall be guilty of the crime.
text_la: Qui percusserit servum suum, vel ancillam virga, et mortui fuerint in manibus ejus, criminis reus erit.
text_pt: Se alguém ferir a seu servo, ou a sua serva, com pau, e morrer debaixo da sua mão, certamente será castigado;
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις πατάξῃ τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ ἢ τὴν παιδίσκην αὐτοῦ ἐν ῥάβδῳ καὶ ἀποθάνῃ ὑπὸ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ δίκῃ ἐκδικηθήτω

text_en: But if the party remain alive a day or two, he shall not be subject to the punishment , because it is his money.
text_la: Sin autem uno die vel duobus supervixerit, non subjacebit pœnæ, quia pecunia illius est.
text_pt: Porém se sobreviver por um ou dois dias, não será castigado, porque é dinheiro seu.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ διαβιώσῃ ἡμέραν μίαν ἢ δύο οὐκ ἐκδικηθήσεται τὸ γὰρ ἀργύριον αὐτοῦ ἐστιν

text_en: If men quarrel, and one strike a woman with child and she miscarry indeed, but live herself: he shall be answerable for so much damage as the woman's husband shall require, and as arbiters shall award.
text_la: Si rixati fuerint viri, et percusserit quis mulierem prægnantem, et abortivum quidem fecerit, sed ipsa vixerit : subjacebit damno quantum maritus mulieris expetierit, et arbitri judicaverint.
text_pt: Se alguns homens pelejarem, e um ferir uma mulher grávida, e for causa de que aborte, porém não havendo outro dano, certamente será multado, conforme o que lhe impuser o marido da mulher, e julgarem os juízes.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μάχωνται δύο ἄνδρες καὶ πατάξωσιν γυναῖκα ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσαν καὶ ἐξέλθῃ τὸ παιδίον αὐτῆς μὴ ἐξεικονισμένον ἐπιζήμιον ζημιωθήσεται καθότι ἂν ἐπιβάλῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ τῆς γυναικός δώσει μετὰ ἀξιώματος

text_en: But if her death ensue thereupon, he shall render life for life ,
text_la: Sin autem mors ejus fuerit subsecuta, reddet animam pro anima,
text_pt: Mas se houver morte, então darás vida por vida,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξεικονισμένον ἦν δώσει ψυχὴν ἀντὶ ψυχῆς

text_en: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
text_la: oculum pro oculo, dentem pro dente, manum pro manu, pedem pro pede,
text_pt: Olho por olho, dente por dente, mão por mão, pé por pé,
text_el: ὀφθαλμὸν ἀντὶ ὀφθαλμοῦ ὀδόντα ἀντὶ ὀδόντος χεῖρα ἀντὶ χειρός πόδα ἀντὶ ποδός

text_en: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
text_la: adustionem pro adustione, vulnus pro vulnere, livorem pro livore.
text_pt: Queimadura por queimadura, ferida por ferida, golpe por golpe.
text_el: κατάκαυμα ἀντὶ κατακαύματος τραῦμα ἀντὶ τραύματος μώλωπα ἀντὶ μώλωπος

text_en: If any man strike the eye of his manservant or maidservant , and leave them but one eye, he shall let them go free for the eye which he put out.
text_la: Si percusserit quispiam oculum servi sui aut ancillæ, et luscos eos fecerit, dimittet eos liberos pro oculo quem eruit.
text_pt: E quando alguém ferir o olho do seu servo, ou o olho da sua serva, e o danificar, o deixará ir livre pelo seu olho.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις πατάξῃ τὸν ὀφθαλμὸν τοῦ οἰκέτου αὐτοῦ ἢ τὸν ὀφθαλμὸν τῆς θεραπαίνης αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκτυφλώσῃ ἐλευθέρους ἐξαποστελεῖ αὐτοὺς ἀντὶ τοῦ ὀφθαλμοῦ αὐτῶν

text_en: Also if he strike out a tooth of his manservant or maidservant , he shall in like manner make them free.
text_la: Dentem quoque si excusserit servo vel ancillæ suæ, similiter dimittet eos liberos.
text_pt: E se tirar o dente do seu servo, ou o dente da sua serva, o deixará ir livre pelo seu dente.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ τὸν ὀδόντα τοῦ οἰκέτου ἢ τὸν ὀδόντα τῆς θεραπαίνης αὐτοῦ ἐκκόψῃ ἐλευθέρους ἐξαποστελεῖ αὐτοὺς ἀντὶ τοῦ ὀδόντος αὐτῶν

text_en: If an ox gore a man or a woman , and they die, he shall be stoned : and his flesh shall not be eaten, but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
text_la: Si bos cornu percusserit virum aut mulierem, et mortui fuerint, lapidibus obruetur : et non comedentur carnes ejus, dominus quoque bovis innocens erit.
text_pt: E se algum boi escornear homem ou mulher, que morra, o boi será apedrejado certamente, e a sua carne não se comerá; mas o dono do boi será absolvido.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ κερατίσῃ ταῦρος ἄνδρα ἢ γυναῖκα καὶ ἀποθάνῃ λίθοις λιθοβοληθήσεται ὁ ταῦρος καὶ οὐ βρωθήσεται τὰ κρέα αὐτοῦ ὁ δὲ κύριος τοῦ ταύρου ἀθῷος ἔσται

text_en: But if the ox was wont to push with his horn yesterday, and the day before, and they warned his master, and he did not shut him up, and he shall kill a man or a woman : then the ox shall be stoned , and his owner also shall be put to death .
text_la: Quod si bos cornupeta fuerit ab heri et nudiustertius, et contestati sunt dominum ejus, nec recluserit eum, occideritque virum aut mulierem : et bos lapidibus obruetur, et dominum ejus occident.
text_pt: Mas se o boi dantes era escorneador, e o seu dono foi conhecedor disso, e não o guardou, matando homem ou mulher, o boi será apedrejado, e também o seu dono morrerá.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ὁ ταῦρος κερατιστὴς ᾖ πρὸ τῆς ἐχθὲς καὶ πρὸ τῆς τρίτης καὶ διαμαρτύρωνται τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἀφανίσῃ αὐτόν ἀνέλῃ δὲ ἄνδρα ἢ γυναῖκα ὁ ταῦρος λιθοβοληθήσεται καὶ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ προσαποθανεῖται

text_en: And if they set a price upon him, he shall give for his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
text_la: Quod si pretium fuerit ei impositum, dabit pro anima sua quidquid fuerit postulatus.
text_pt: Se lhe for imposto resgate, então dará por resgate da sua vida tudo quanto lhe for imposto,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ λύτρα ἐπιβληθῇ αὐτῷ δώσει λύτρα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐὰν ἐπιβάλωσιν αὐτῷ

text_en: If he have gored a son, or a daughter, he shall fall under the like sentence.
text_la: Filium quoque et filiam si cornu percusserit, simili sententiæ subjacebit.
text_pt: Quer tenha escorneado um filho, quer tenha escorneado uma filha; conforme a este estatuto lhe será feito.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ υἱὸν ἢ θυγατέρα κερατίσῃ κατὰ τὸ δικαίωμα τοῦτο ποιήσουσιν αὐτῷ

text_en: If he assault a bondman or bondwoman , he shall give thirty sicles of silver to their master, and the ox shall be stoned .
text_la: Si servum ancillamque invaserit, triginta siclos argenti domino dabit, bos vero lapidibus opprimetur.
text_pt: Se o boi escornear um servo, ou uma serva, dar-se-á trinta siclos de prata ao seu senhor, e o boi será apedrejado.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ παῖδα κερατίσῃ ὁ ταῦρος ἢ παιδίσκην ἀργυρίου τριάκοντα δίδραχμα δώσει τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ ταῦρος λιθοβοληθήσεται

text_en: If a man open a pit, and dig one, and cover it not, and an ox or an ass fall into it,
text_la: Si quis aperuerit cisternam, et foderit, et non operuerit eam, cecideritque bos aut asinus in eam,
text_pt: Se alguém abrir uma cova, ou se alguém cavar uma cova, e não a cobrir, e nela cair um boi ou um jumento,
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις ἀνοίξῃ λάκκον ἢ λατομήσῃ λάκκον καὶ μὴ καλύψῃ αὐτόν καὶ ἐμπέσῃ ἐκεῖ μόσχος ἢ ὄνος

text_en: the owner of the pit shall pay the price of the beasts: and that which is dead shall be his own.
text_la: reddet dominus cisternæ pretium jumentorum : quod autem mortuum est, ipsius erit.
text_pt: O dono da cova o pagará; pagará em dinheiro ao seu dono, mas o animal morto será seu.
text_el: ὁ κύριος τοῦ λάκκου ἀποτείσει ἀργύριον δώσει τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτῶν τὸ δὲ τετελευτηκὸς αὐτῷ ἔσται

text_en: If one man's ox gore another man's ox, and he die: they shall sell the live ox, and shall divide the price, and the carcass of that which died they shall part between them:
text_la: Si bos alienus bovem alterius vulneraverit, et ille mortuus fuerit : vendent bovem vivum, et divident pretium, cadaver autem mortui inter se dispertient.
text_pt: Se o boi de alguém ferir o boi do seu próximo, e morrer, então se venderá o boi vivo, e o dinheiro dele se repartirá igualmente, e também repartirão entre si o boi morto.
