text_el: ἐὰν δὲ κερατίσῃ τινὸς ταῦρος τὸν ταῦρον τοῦ πλησίον καὶ τελευτήσῃ ἀποδώσονται τὸν ταῦρον τὸν ζῶντα καὶ διελοῦνται τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν ταῦρον τὸν τεθνηκότα διελοῦνται

text_en: But if he knew that his ox was wont to push yesterday, and the day before, and his master did not keep him in; he shall pay ox for ox, and shall take the whole carcass.
text_la: Sin autem sciebat quod bos cornupeta esset ab heri et nudiustertius, et non custodivit eum dominus suus : reddet bovem pro bove, et cadaver integrum accipiet.
text_pt: Mas se foi notório que aquele boi antes era escorneador, e seu dono não o guardou, certamente pagará boi por boi; porém o morto será seu.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ γνωρίζηται ὁ ταῦρος ὅτι κερατιστής ἐστιν πρὸ τῆς ἐχθὲς καὶ πρὸ τῆς τρίτης ἡμέρας καὶ διαμεμαρτυρημένοι ὦσιν τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἀφανίσῃ αὐτόν ἀποτείσει ταῦρον ἀντὶ ταύρου ὁ δὲ τετελευτηκὼς αὐτῷ ἔσται

text_en: If any man steal an ox or a sheep, and kill or sell it: he shall restore five oxen for one ox, and four sheep for one sheep.
text_la: Si quis furatus fuerit bovem aut ovem, et occiderit vel vendiderit : quinque boves pro uno bove restituet, et quatuor oves pro una ove.
text_pt: Se alguém furtar boi ou ovelha, e o degolar ou vender, por um boi pagará cinco bois, e pela ovelha quatro ovelhas.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις κλέψῃ μόσχον ἢ πρόβατον καὶ σφάξῃ αὐτὸ ἢ ἀποδῶται πέντε μόσχους ἀποτείσει ἀντὶ τοῦ μόσχου καὶ τέσσαρα πρόβατα ἀντὶ τοῦ προβάτου

text_en: If a thief be found breaking open a house or undermining it, and be wounded so as to die: he that slew him shall not be guilty of blood.
text_la: Si effringens fur domum sive suffodiens fuerit inventus, et accepto vulnere mortuus fuerit, percussor non erit reus sanguinis.
text_pt: Se o ladrão for achado roubando, e for ferido, e morrer, o que o feriu não será culpado do sangue.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν τῷ διορύγματι εὑρεθῇ ὁ κλέπτης καὶ πληγεὶς ἀποθάνῃ οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῷ φόνος

text_en: But if he did this when the sun is risen, he has committed murder , and he shall die . If he have not wherewith to make restitution for the theft , he shall be sold.
text_la: Quod si orto sole hoc fecerit, homicidium perpetravit, et ipse morietur. Si non habuerit quod pro furto reddat, ipse venundabitur.
text_pt: Se o sol houver saído sobre ele, o agressor será culpado do sangue; o ladrão fará restituição total; e se não tiver com que pagar, será vendido por seu furto.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀνατείλῃ ὁ ἥλιος ἐπ' αὐτῷ ἔνοχός ἐστιν ἀνταποθανεῖται ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ὑπάρχῃ αὐτῷ πραθήτω ἀντὶ τοῦ κλέμματος

text_en: If that which he stole be found with him, alive, either ox, or ass, or sheep: he shall restore double.
text_la: Si inventum fuerit apud eum quod furatus est, vivens : sive bos, sive asinus, sive ovis, duplum restituet.
text_pt: Se o furto for achado vivo na sua mão, seja boi, ou jumento, ou ovelha, pagará o dobro.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ καταλημφθῇ καὶ εὑρεθῇ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ κλέμμα ἀπό τε ὄνου ἕως προβάτου ζῶντα διπλᾶ αὐτὰ ἀποτείσει

text_en: If any man hurt a field or a vineyard, and put in his beast to feed upon that which is other men's : he shall restore the best of whatsoever he has in his own field, or in his vineyard, according to the estimation of the damage.
text_la: Si læserit quispiam agrum vel vineam, et dimiserit jumentum suum ut depascatur aliena : quidquid optimum habuerit in agro suo, vel in vinea, pro damni æstimatione restituet.
text_pt: Se alguém fizer pastar o seu animal num campo ou numa vinha, e largá-lo para comer no campo de outro, o melhor do seu próprio campo e o melhor da sua própria vinha restituirá.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ καταβοσκήσῃ τις ἀγρὸν ἢ ἀμπελῶνα καὶ ἀφῇ τὸ κτῆνος αὐτοῦ καταβοσκῆσαι ἀγρὸν ἕτερον ἀποτείσει ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὸ γένημα αὐτοῦ ἐὰν δὲ πάντα τὸν ἀγρὸν καταβοσκήσῃ τὰ βέλτιστα τοῦ ἀγροῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ βέλτιστα τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος αὐτοῦ ἀποτείσει

text_en: If a fire breaking out light upon thorns, and catch stacks of corn, or corn standing in the fields, he that kindled the fire shall make good the loss.
text_la: Si egressus ignis invenerit spinas, et comprehenderit acervos frugum, sive stantes segetes in agris, reddet damnum qui ignem succenderit.
text_pt: Se irromper um fogo, e pegar nos espinhos, e queimar a meda de trigo, ou a seara, ou o campo, aquele que acendeu o fogo totalmente pagará o queimado.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐξελθὸν πῦρ εὕρῃ ἀκάνθας καὶ προσεμπρήσῃ ἅλωνα ἢ στάχυς ἢ πεδίον ἀποτείσει ὁ τὸ πῦρ ἐκκαύσας

text_en: If a man deliver money, or any vessel unto his friend to keep, and they be stolen away from him that received them: if the thief be found, he shall restore double:
text_la: Si quis commendaverit amico pecuniam aut vas in custodiam, et ab eo, qui susceperat, furto ablata fuerint : si invenitur fur, duplum reddet:
text_pt: Se alguém der ao seu próximo dinheiro, ou bens, a guardar, e isso for furtado da casa daquele homem, o ladrão, se for achado, pagará o dobro.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις δῷ τῷ πλησίον ἀργύριον ἢ σκεύη φυλάξαι καὶ κλαπῇ ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐὰν εὑρεθῇ ὁ κλέψας ἀποτείσει διπλοῦν

text_en: If the thief be not known , the master of the house shall be brought to the gods, and shall swear that he did not lay his hand upon his neighbour's goods ,
text_la: si latet fur, dominus domus applicabitur ad deos, et jurabit quod non extenderit manum in rem proximi sui,
text_pt: Se o ladrão não for achado, então o dono da casa será levado diante dos juízes, a ver se não pôs a sua mão nos bens do seu próximo.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ εὑρεθῇ ὁ κλέψας προσελεύσεται ὁ κύριος τῆς οἰκίας ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ὀμεῖται ἦ μὴν μὴ αὐτὸς πεπονηρεῦσθαι ἐφ' ὅλης τῆς παρακαταθήκης τοῦ πλησίον

text_en: to do any fraud , either in ox, or in ass, or sheep, or raiment, or anything that may bring damage: the cause of both parties shall come to the gods: and if they give judgment, he shall restore double to his neighbour.
text_la: ad perpetrandam fraudem, tam in bove quam in asino, et ove ac vestimento, et quidquid damnum inferre potest : ad deos utriusque causa perveniet, et si illi judicaverit, duplum restituet proximo suo.
text_pt: Sobre todo o negócio fraudulento, sobre boi, sobre jumento, sobre gado miúdo, sobre roupa, sobre toda a coisa perdida, de que alguém disser que é sua, a causa de ambos será levada perante os juízes; aquele a quem condenarem os juízes pagará em dobro ao seu próximo.
text_el: κατὰ πᾶν ῥητὸν ἀδίκημα περί τε μόσχου καὶ ὑποζυγίου καὶ προβάτου καὶ ἱματίου καὶ πάσης ἀπωλείας τῆς ἐγκαλουμένης ὅ τι οὖν ἂν ᾖ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐλεύσεται ἡ κρίσις ἀμφοτέρων καὶ ὁ ἁλοὺς διὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀποτείσει διπλοῦν τῷ πλησίον

text_en: If a man deliver ass, ox, sheep, or any beast, to his neighbour's custody, and it die, or be hurt, or be taken by enemies, and no man saw it:
text_la: Si quis commendaverit proximo suo asinum, bovem, ovem, et omne jumentum ad custodiam, et mortuum fuerit, aut debilitatum, vel captum ab hostibus, nullusque hoc viderit:
text_pt: Se alguém der a seu próximo a guardar um jumento, ou boi, ou ovelha, ou outro animal, e este morrer, ou for dilacerado, ou arrebatado, ninguém o vendo,
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις δῷ τῷ πλησίον ὑποζύγιον ἢ μόσχον ἢ πρόβατον ἢ πᾶν κτῆνος φυλάξαι καὶ συντριβῇ ἢ τελευτήσῃ ἢ αἰχμάλωτον γένηται καὶ μηδεὶς γνῷ

text_en: There shall be an oath between them, that he did not put forth his hand to his neighbour's goods : and the owner shall accept of the oath , and he shall not be compelled to make restitution .
text_la: jusjurandum erit in medio, quod non extenderit manum ad rem proximi sui : suscipietque dominus juramentum, et ille reddere non cogetur.
text_pt: Então haverá juramento do Senhor entre ambos, de que não pôs a sua mão nos bens do seu próximo; e seu dono o aceitará, e o outro não o restituirá.
text_el: ὅρκος ἔσται τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνὰ μέσον ἀμφοτέρων ἦ μὴν μὴ αὐτὸν πεπονηρεῦσθαι καθ' ὅλης τῆς παρακαταθήκης τοῦ πλησίον καὶ οὕτως προσδέξεται ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀποτείσει

text_en: But if it were taken away by stealth, he shall make the loss good to the owner.
text_la: Quod si furto ablatum fuerit, restituet damnum domino;
text_pt: Mas, se de fato lhe tiver sido furtado, pagá-lo-á ao seu dono.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ κλαπῇ παρ' αὐτοῦ ἀποτείσει τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: If it were eaten by a beast, let him bring to him that which was slain, and he shall not make restitution .
text_la: si comestum a bestia, deferat ad eum quod occisum est, et non restituet.
text_pt: Porém se lhe for dilacerado, trá-lo-á em testemunho disso, e não pagará o dilacerado.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ θηριάλωτον γένηται ἄξει αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν θήραν καὶ οὐκ ἀποτείσει

text_en: If a man borrow of his neighbour any of these things , and it be hurt or die, the owner not being present, he shall be obliged to make restitution .
text_la: Qui a proximo suo quidquam horum mutuo postulaverit, et debilitatum aut mortuum fuerit domino non præsente, reddere compelletur.
text_pt: E se alguém pedir emprestado a seu próximo algum animal, e for danificado ou morto, não estando presente o seu dono, certamente o pagará.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ αἰτήσῃ τις παρὰ τοῦ πλησίον καὶ συντριβῇ ἢ ἀποθάνῃ ἢ αἰχμάλωτον γένηται ὁ δὲ κύριος μὴ ᾖ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἀποτείσει

text_en: But if the owner be present, he shall not make restitution , especially if it were hired, and came for the hire of his work.
text_la: Quod si impræsentiarum dominus fuerit, non restituet, maxime si conductum venerat pro mercede operis sui.
text_pt: Se o seu dono estava presente, não o pagará; se foi alugado, será pelo seu aluguel.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ὁ κύριος ᾖ μετ' αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀποτείσει ἐὰν δὲ μισθωτὸς ᾖ ἔσται αὐτῷ ἀντὶ τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: If a man seduce a virgin not yet espoused , and lie with her: he shall endow her, and have her to wife.
text_la: Si seduxerit quis virginem necdum desponsatam, dormieritque cum ea : dotabit eam, et habebit eam uxorem.
text_pt: Se alguém enganar alguma virgem, que não for desposada, e se deitar com ela, certamente a dotará e tomará por sua mulher.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀπατήσῃ τις παρθένον ἀμνήστευτον καὶ κοιμηθῇ μετ' αὐτῆς φερνῇ φερνιεῖ αὐτὴν αὐτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: If the maid's father will not give her to him, he shall give money according to the dowry, which virgins are wont to receive.
text_la: Si pater virginis dare noluerit, reddet pecuniam juxta modum dotis, quam virgines accipere consueverunt.
text_pt: Se seu pai inteiramente recusar dar-lha, pagará ele em dinheiro conforme ao dote das virgens.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀνανεύων ἀνανεύσῃ καὶ μὴ βούληται ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῆς δοῦναι αὐτὴν αὐτῷ γυναῖκα ἀργύριον ἀποτείσει τῷ πατρὶ καθ' ὅσον ἐστὶν ἡ φερνὴ τῶν παρθένων

text_en: Wizards you shall not allow to live.
text_la: Maleficos non patieris vivere.
text_pt: A feiticeira não deixarás viver.
text_el: φαρμακοὺς οὐ περιποιήσετε

text_en: Whosoever copulates with a beast; shall be put to death .
text_la: Qui coierit cum jumento, morte moriatur.
text_pt: Todo aquele que se deitar com animal, certamente morrerá.
text_el: πᾶν κοιμώμενον μετὰ κτήνους θανάτῳ ἀποκτενεῖτε αὐτούς

text_en: He that sacrifices to gods, shall be put to death , save only to the Lord .
text_la: Qui immolat diis, occidetur, præterquam Domino soli.
text_pt: O que sacrificar aos deuses, e não só ao Senhor, será morto.
text_el: ὁ θυσιάζων θεοῖς θανάτῳ ὀλεθρευθήσεται πλὴν κυρίῳ μόνῳ

text_en: You shall not molest a stranger, nor afflict him: for yourselves also were strangers in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Advenam non contristabis, neque affliges eum : advenæ enim et ipsi fuistis in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: O estrangeiro não afligirás, nem o oprimirás; pois estrangeiros fostes na terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ προσήλυτον οὐ κακώσετε οὐδὲ μὴ θλίψητε αὐτόν ἦτε γὰρ προσήλυτοι ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: You shall not hurt a widow or an orphan .
text_la: Viduæ et pupillo non nocebitis.
text_pt: A nenhuma viúva nem órfão afligireis.
text_el: πᾶσαν χήραν καὶ ὀρφανὸν οὐ κακώσετε

text_en: If you hurt them, they will cry out to me, and I will hear their cry:
text_la: Si læseritis eos, vociferabuntur ad me, et ego audiam clamorem eorum:
text_pt: Se de algum modo os afligires, e eles clamarem a mim, eu certamente ouvirei o seu clamor.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ κακίᾳ κακώσητε αὐτοὺς καὶ κεκράξαντες καταβοήσωσι πρός με ἀκοῇ εἰσακούσομαι τῆς φωνῆς αὐτῶν

text_en: And my rage shall be enkindled, and I will strike you with the sword, and your wives shall be widows , and your children fatherless .
text_la: et indignabitur furor meus, percutiamque vos gladio, et erunt uxores vestræ viduæ, et filii vestri pupilli.
text_pt: E a minha ira se acenderá, e vos matarei à espada; e vossas mulheres ficarão viúvas, e vossos filhos órfãos.
text_el: καὶ ὀργισθήσομαι θυμῷ καὶ ἀποκτενῶ ὑμᾶς μαχαίρᾳ καὶ ἔσονται αἱ γυναῖκες ὑμῶν χῆραι καὶ τὰ παιδία ὑμῶν ὀρφανά

text_en: If you lend money to any of my people that is poor , that dwells with you, you shall not be hard upon them as an extortioner, nor oppress them with usuries .
text_la: Si pecuniam mutuam dederis populo meo pauperi qui habitat tecum, non urgebis eum quasi exactor, nec usuris opprimes.
text_pt: Se emprestares dinheiro ao meu povo, ao pobre que está contigo, não te haverás com ele como um usurário; não lhe imporeis usura.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἀργύριον ἐκδανείσῃς τῷ ἀδελφῷ τῷ πενιχρῷ παρὰ σοί οὐκ ἔσῃ αὐτὸν κατεπείγων οὐκ ἐπιθήσεις αὐτῷ τόκον

text_en: If you take of your neighbour a garment in pledge, you shall give it him again before sunset.
text_la: Si pignus a proximo tuo acceperis vestimentum, ante solis occasum reddes ei.
text_pt: Se tomares em penhor a roupa do teu próximo, lho restituirás antes do pôr do sol,
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐνεχύρασμα ἐνεχυράσῃς τὸ ἱμάτιον τοῦ πλησίον πρὸ δυσμῶν ἡλίου ἀποδώσεις αὐτῷ

text_en: For that same is the only thing, wherewith he is covered, the clothing of his body, neither has he any other to sleep in: if he cry to me, I will hear him, because I am compassionate.
text_la: Ipsum enim est solum, quo operitur, indumentum carnis ejus, nec habet aliud in quo dormiat : si clamaverit ad me, exaudiam eum, quia misericors sum.
text_pt: Porque aquela é a sua cobertura, e o vestido da sua pele; em que se deitaria? Será pois que, quando clamar a mim, eu o ouvirei, porque sou misericordioso.
text_el: ἔστιν γὰρ τοῦτο περιβόλαιον αὐτοῦ μόνον τοῦτο τὸ ἱμάτιον ἀσχημοσύνης αὐτοῦ ἐν τίνι κοιμηθήσεται ἐὰν οὖν καταβοήσῃ πρός με εἰσακούσομαι αὐτοῦ ἐλεήμων γάρ εἰμι

text_en: You shall not speak ill of the gods, and the prince of your people you shall not curse .
text_la: Diis non detrahes, et principi populi tui non maledices.
text_pt: A Deus não amaldiçoarás, e o príncipe dentre o teu povo não maldirás.
text_el: θεοὺς οὐ κακολογήσεις καὶ ἄρχοντας τοῦ λαοῦ σου οὐ κακῶς ἐρεῖς

text_en: You shall not delay to pay your tithes and your firstfruits : you shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.
text_la: Decimas tuas et primitias tuas non tardabis reddere : primogenitum filiorum tuorum dabis mihi.
text_pt: As tuas primícias, e os teus licores não retardarás; o primogênito de teus filhos me darás.
text_el: ἀπαρχὰς ἅλωνος καὶ ληνοῦ σου οὐ καθυστερήσεις τὰ πρωτότοκα τῶν υἱῶν σου δώσεις ἐμοί

text_en: You shall do the same with the firstborn of your oxen also and sheep: seven days let it be with its dam: the eighth day you shall give it to me.
text_la: De bobus quoque, et ovibus similiter facies : septem diebus sit cum matre sua, die octava reddes illum mihi.
text_pt: Assim farás dos teus bois e das tuas ovelhas: sete dias estarão com sua mãe, e ao oitavo dia mos darás.
text_el: οὕτως ποιήσεις τὸν μόσχον σου καὶ τὸ πρόβατόν σου καὶ τὸ ὑποζύγιόν σου ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἔσται ὑπὸ τὴν μητέρα τῇ δὲ ὀγδόῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἀποδώσεις μοι αὐτό

text_en: You shall be holy men to me: the flesh that beasts have tasted of before, you shall not eat, but shall cast it to the dogs.
text_la: Viri sancti eritis mihi : carnem, quæ a bestiis fuerit prægustata, non comedetis, sed projicietis canibus.
text_pt: E ser-me-eis homens santos; portanto não comereis carne despedaçada no campo; aos cães a lançareis.
text_el: καὶ ἄνδρες ἅγιοι ἔσεσθέ μοι καὶ κρέας θηριάλωτον οὐκ ἔδεσθε τῷ κυνὶ ἀπορρίψατε αὐτό

text_en: You shall not receive the voice of a lie: neither shall you join your hand to bear false witness for a wicked person.
text_la: Non suscipies vocem mendacii, nec junges manum tuam ut pro impio dicas falsum testimonium.
text_pt: Não admitirás falso boato, e não porás a tua mão com o ímpio, para seres testemunha falsa.
text_el: οὐ παραδέξῃ ἀκοὴν ματαίαν οὐ συγκαταθήσῃ μετὰ τοῦ ἀδίκου γενέσθαι μάρτυς ἄδικος

text_en: You shall not follow the multitude to do evil : neither shall you yield in judgment, to the opinion of the most part, to stray from the truth .
text_la: Non sequeris turbam ad faciendum malum : nec in judicio, plurimorum acquiesces sententiæ, ut a vero devies.
text_pt: Não seguirás a multidão para fazeres o mal; nem numa demanda falarás, tomando parte com a maioria para torcer o direito.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσῃ μετὰ πλειόνων ἐπὶ κακίᾳ οὐ προστεθήσῃ μετὰ πλήθους ἐκκλῖναι μετὰ πλειόνων ὥστε ἐκκλῖναι κρίσιν

text_en: Neither shall you favour a poor man in judgment.
text_la: Pauperis quoque non misereberis in judicio.
text_pt: Nem ao pobre favorecerás na sua demanda.
text_el: καὶ πένητα οὐκ ἐλεήσεις ἐν κρίσει

text_en: If you meet your enemy's ox or ass going astray, bring it back to him.
text_la: Si occurreris bovi inimici tui, aut asino erranti, reduc ad eum.
text_pt: Se encontrares o boi do teu inimigo, ou o seu jumento, desgarrado, sem falta lho reconduzirás.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ συναντήσῃς τῷ βοὶ τοῦ ἐχθροῦ σου ἢ τῷ ὑποζυγίῳ αὐτοῦ πλανωμένοις ἀποστρέψας ἀποδώσεις αὐτῷ

text_en: If you see the ass of him that hates you lie underneath his burden, you shall not pass by, but shall lift him up with him.
text_la: Si videris asinum odientis te jacere sub onere, non pertransibis, sed sublevabis cum eo.
text_pt: Se vires o jumento, daquele que te odeia, caído debaixo da sua carga, deixarás pois de ajudá-lo? Certamente o ajudarás a levantá-lo.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἴδῃς τὸ ὑποζύγιον τοῦ ἐχθροῦ σου πεπτωκὸς ὑπὸ τὸν γόμον αὐτοῦ οὐ παρελεύσῃ αὐτό ἀλλὰ συνεγερεῖς αὐτὸ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: You shall not go aside in the poor man's judgment.
text_la: Non declinabis in judicium pauperis.
text_pt: Não perverterás o direito do teu pobre na sua demanda.
text_el: οὐ διαστρέψεις κρίμα πένητος ἐν κρίσει αὐτοῦ

text_en: You shall fly lying . The innocent and just person you shall not put to death : because I abhor the wicked.
text_la: Mendacium fugies. Insontem et justum non occides : quia aversor impium.
text_pt: De palavras de falsidade te afastarás, e não matarás o inocente e o justo; porque não justificarei o ímpio.
text_el: ἀπὸ παντὸς ῥήματος ἀδίκου ἀποστήσῃ ἀθῷον καὶ δίκαιον οὐκ ἀποκτενεῖς καὶ οὐ δικαιώσεις τὸν ἀσεβῆ ἕνεκεν δώρων

text_en: Neither shall you take bribes , which even blind the wise, and pervert the words of the just .
text_la: Nec accipies munera, quæ etiam excæcant prudentes, et subvertunt verba justorum.
text_pt: Também suborno não tomarás; porque o suborno cega os que têm vista, e perverte as palavras dos justos.
text_el: καὶ δῶρα οὐ λήμψῃ τὰ γὰρ δῶρα ἐκτυφλοῖ ὀφθαλμοὺς βλεπόντων καὶ λυμαίνεται ῥήματα δίκαια

text_en: You shall not molest a stranger, for you know the hearts of strangers: for you also were strangers in the land of Egypt .
text_la: Peregrino molestus non eris. Scitis enim advenarum animas : quia et ipsi peregrini fuistis in terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Também não oprimirás o estrangeiro; pois vós conheceis o coração do estrangeiro, pois fostes estrangeiros na terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ προσήλυτον οὐ θλίψετε ὑμεῖς γὰρ οἴδατε τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ προσηλύτου αὐτοὶ γὰρ προσήλυτοι ἦτε ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: Six years you shall sow your ground, and shall gather the corn thereof.
text_la: Sex annis seminabis terram tuam, et congregabis fruges ejus:
text_pt: Também seis anos semearás tua terra, e recolherás os seus frutos;
text_el: ἓξ ἔτη σπερεῖς τὴν γῆν σου καὶ συνάξεις τὰ γενήματα αὐτῆς

text_en: But the seventh year you shall let it alone, and allow it to rest, that the poor of your people may eat, and whatsoever shall be left, let the beasts of the field eat it: so shall you do with your vineyard and your oliveyard.
text_la: anno autem septimo dimittes eam, et requiescere facies, ut comedant pauperes populi tui : et quidquid reliquum fuerit, edant bestiæ agri : ita facies in vinea et in oliveto tuo.
text_pt: Mas ao sétimo a dispensarás e deixarás descansar, para que possam comer os pobres do teu povo, e da sobra comam os animais do campo. Assim farás com a tua vinha e com o teu olival.
text_el: τῷ δὲ ἑβδόμῳ ἄφεσιν ποιήσεις καὶ ἀνήσεις αὐτήν καὶ ἔδονται οἱ πτωχοὶ τοῦ ἔθνους σου τὰ δὲ ὑπολειπόμενα ἔδεται τὰ ἄγρια θηρία οὕτως ποιήσεις τὸν ἀμπελῶνά σου καὶ τὸν ἐλαιῶνά σου

text_en: Six days you shall work: the seventh day you shall cease, that your ox and your ass may rest: and the son of your handmaid and the stranger may be refreshed.
text_la: Sex diebus operaberis : septimo die cessabis, ut requiescat bos et asinus tuus, et refrigeretur filius ancillæ tuæ, et advena.
text_pt: Seis dias farás os teus trabalhos, mas ao sétimo dia descansarás; para que descanse o teu boi, e o teu jumento; e para que tome alento o filho da tua escrava, e o estrangeiro.
text_el: ἓξ ἡμέρας ποιήσεις τὰ ἔργα σου τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἀνάπαυσις ἵνα ἀναπαύσηται ὁ βοῦς σου καὶ τὸ ὑποζύγιόν σου καὶ ἵνα ἀναψύξῃ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς παιδίσκης σου καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος

text_en: Keep all things that I have said to you. And by the name of strange gods you shall not swear , neither shall it be heard out of your mouth.
text_la: Omnia quæ dixi vobis, custodite. Et per nomen externorum deorum non jurabitis, neque audietur ex ore vestro.
text_pt: E em tudo o que vos tenho dito, guardai-vos; e do nome de outros deuses nem vos lembreis, nem se ouça da vossa boca.
text_el: πάντα ὅσα εἴρηκα πρὸς ὑμᾶς φυλάξασθε καὶ ὄνομα θεῶν ἑτέρων οὐκ ἀναμνησθήσεσθε οὐδὲ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν

text_en: Three times every year you shall celebrate feasts to me.
text_la: Tribus vicibus per singulos annos mihi festa celebrabitis.
text_pt: Três vezes no ano me celebrareis festa.
text_el: τρεῖς καιροὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἑορτάσατέ μοι

text_en: You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread . Seven days shall you eat unleavened bread , as I commanded you, in the time of the month of new corn, when you came forth out of Egypt : you shall not appear empty before me.
text_la: Solemnitatem azymorum custodies. Septem diebus comedes azyma, sicut præcepi tibi, tempore mensis novorum, quando egressus es de Ægypto : non apparebis in conspectu meo vacuus.
text_pt: A festa dos pães ázimos guardarás; sete dias comerás pães ázimos, como te tenho ordenado, ao tempo apontado no mês de Abibe; porque nele saíste do Egito; e ninguém apareça vazio perante mim;
text_el: τὴν ἑορτὴν τῶν ἀζύμων φυλάξασθε ποιεῖν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἔδεσθε ἄζυμα καθάπερ ἐνετειλάμην σοι κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν τοῦ μηνὸς τῶν νέων ἐν γὰρ αὐτῷ ἐξῆλθες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου οὐκ ὀφθήσῃ ἐνώπιόν μου κενός

text_en: And the feast of the harvest of the firstfruits of your work, whatsoever you have sown in the field. The feast also in the end of the year , when you have gathered in all your corn out of the field.
text_la: Et solemnitatem messis primitivorum operis tui, quæcumque seminaveris in agro : solemnitatem quoque in exitu anni, quando congregaveris omnes fruges tuas de agro.
text_pt: E a festa da sega dos primeiros frutos do teu trabalho, que houveres semeado no campo, e a festa da colheita, à saída do ano, quando tiveres colhido do campo o teu trabalho.
text_el: καὶ ἑορτὴν θερισμοῦ πρωτογενημάτων ποιήσεις τῶν ἔργων σου ὧν ἐὰν σπείρῃς ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ σου καὶ ἑορτὴν συντελείας ἐπ' ἐξόδου τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ τῶν ἔργων σου τῶν ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ σου

text_en: Thrice a year shall all your males appear before the Lord your God .
text_la: Ter in anno apparebit omne masculinum tuum coram Domino Deo tuo.
text_pt: Três vezes no ano todos os teus homens aparecerão diante do Senhor DEUS.
text_el: τρεῖς καιροὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ὀφθήσεται πᾶν ἀρσενικόν σου ἐνώπιον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: You shall not sacrifice the blood of my victim upon leaven, neither shall the fat of my solemnity remain until the morning.
text_la: Non immolabis super fermento sanguinem victimæ meæ, nec remanebit adeps solemnitatis meæ usque mane.
text_pt: Não oferecerás o sangue do meu sacrifício com pão levedado; nem ficará a gordura da minha festa de noite até pela manhã.
text_el: ὅταν γὰρ ἐκβάλω ἔθνη ἀπὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἐμπλατύνω τὰ ὅριά σου οὐ θύσεις ἐπὶ ζύμῃ αἷμα θυσιάσματός μου οὐδὲ μὴ κοιμηθῇ στέαρ τῆς ἑορτῆς μου ἕως πρωί

text_en: You shall carry the first-fruits of the corn of your ground to the house of the Lord your God . You shall not boil a kid in the milk of his dam.
text_la: Primitias frugum terræ tuæ deferes in domum Domini Dei tui. Non coques hædum in lacte matris suæ.
text_pt: As primícias dos primeiros frutos da tua terra trarás à casa do Senhor teu Deus; não cozerás o cabrito no leite de sua mãe.
text_el: τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τῶν πρωτογενημάτων τῆς γῆς σου εἰσοίσεις εἰς τὸν οἶκον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου οὐχ ἑψήσεις ἄρνα ἐν γάλακτι μητρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Behold I will send my angel , who shall go before you, and keep you in your journey, and bring you into the place that I have prepared.
text_la: Ecce ego mittam angelum meum, qui præcedat te, et custodiat in via, et introducat in locum quem paravi.
text_pt: Eis que eu envio um anjo diante de ti, para que te guarde pelo caminho, e te leve ao lugar que te tenho preparado.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου ἵνα φυλάξῃ σε ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ὅπως εἰσαγάγῃ σε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἡτοίμασά σοι

text_en: Take notice of him, and hear his voice, and do not think him one to be contemned: for he will not forgive when you have sinned , and my name is in him.
text_la: Observa eum, et audi vocem ejus, nec contemnendum putes : quia non dimittet cum peccaveris, et est nomen meum in illo.
text_pt: Guarda-te diante dele, e ouve a sua voz, e não o provoques à ira; porque não perdoará a vossa rebeldia; porque o meu nome está nele.
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ καὶ εἰσάκουε αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἀπείθει αὐτῷ οὐ γὰρ μὴ ὑποστείληταί σε τὸ γὰρ ὄνομά μού ἐστιν ἐπ' αὐτῷ

text_en: But if you will hear his voice, and do all that I speak, I will be an enemy to your enemies, and will afflict them that afflict you.
text_la: Quod si audieris vocem ejus, et feceris omnia quæ loquor, inimicus ero inimicis tuis, et affligam affligentes te.
text_pt: Mas se diligentemente ouvires a sua voz, e fizeres tudo o que eu disser, então serei inimigo dos teus inimigos, e adversário dos teus adversários.
text_el: ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσητε τῆς ἐμῆς φωνῆς καὶ ποιήσῃς πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐντείλωμαί σοι καὶ φυλάξητε τὴν διαθήκην μου ἔσεσθέ μοι λαὸς περιούσιος ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐμὴ γάρ ἐστιν πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ὑμεῖς δὲ ἔσεσθέ μοι βασίλειον ἱεράτευμα καὶ ἔθνος ἅγιον ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐρεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσητε τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ ποιήσῃς πάντα ὅσα ἂν εἴπω σοι ἐχθρεύσω τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου καὶ ἀντικείσομαι τοῖς ἀντικειμένοις σοι

text_en: And my angel shall go before you, and shall bring you in unto the Amorrhite , and the Hethite , and the Pherexite, and the Chanaanite , and the Hevite, and the Jebuzite, whom I will destroy.
text_la: Præcedetque te angelus meus, et introducet te ad Amorrhæum, et Hethæum, et Pherezæum, Chananæumque, et Hevæum, et Jebusæum, quos ego conteram.
text_pt: Porque o meu anjo irá adiante de ti, e te levará aos amorreus, e aos heteus, e aos perizeus, e aos cananeus, heveus e jebuseus; e eu os destruirei.
text_el: πορεύσεται γὰρ ὁ ἄγγελός μου ἡγούμενός σου καὶ εἰσάξει σε πρὸς τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ Χετταῖον καὶ Φερεζαῖον καὶ Χαναναῖον καὶ Γεργεσαῖον καὶ Ευαῖον καὶ Ιεβουσαῖον καὶ ἐκτρίψω αὐτούς

text_en: You shall not adore their gods , nor serve them. You shall not do their works, but shall destroy them, and break their statues .
text_la: Non adorabis deos eorum, nec coles eos : non facies opera eorum, sed destrues eos, et confringes statuas eorum.
text_pt: Não te inclinarás diante dos seus deuses, nem os servirás, nem farás conforme às suas obras; antes os destruirás totalmente, e quebrarás de todo as suas estátuas.
text_el: οὐ προσκυνήσεις τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν οὐδὲ μὴ λατρεύσῃς αὐτοῖς οὐ ποιήσεις κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν ἀλλὰ καθαιρέσει καθελεῖς καὶ συντρίβων συντρίψεις τὰς στήλας αὐτῶν

text_en: And you shall serve the Lord your God , that I may bless your bread and your waters, and may take away sickness from the midst of you.
text_la: Servietisque Domino Deo vestro, ut benedicam panibus tuis et aquis, et auferam infirmitatem de medio tui.
text_pt: E servireis ao Senhor vosso Deus, e ele abençoará o vosso pão e a vossa água; e eu tirarei do meio de vós as enfermidades.
text_el: καὶ λατρεύσεις κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου καὶ εὐλογήσω τὸν ἄρτον σου καὶ τὸν οἶνόν σου καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ σου καὶ ἀποστρέψω μαλακίαν ἀφ' ὑμῶν

text_en: There shall not be one fruitless nor barren in your land: I will fill the number of your days.
text_la: Non erit infœcunda, nec sterilis in terra tua : numerum dierum tuorum implebo.
text_pt: Não haverá mulher que aborte, nem estéril na tua terra; o número dos teus dias cumprirei.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσται ἄγονος οὐδὲ στεῖρα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς σου τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἡμερῶν σου ἀναπληρώσω

text_en: I will send my fear before you, and will destroy all the people to whom you shall come: and will turn the backs of all your enemies before you:
text_la: Terrorem meum mittam in præcursum tuum, et occidam omnem populum, ad quem ingredieris : cunctorumque inimicorum tuorum coram te terga vertam:
text_pt: Enviarei o meu terror adiante de ti, destruindo a todo o povo aonde entrares, e farei que todos os teus inimigos te voltem as costas.
text_el: καὶ τὸν φόβον ἀποστελῶ ἡγούμενόν σου καὶ ἐκστήσω πάντα τὰ ἔθνη εἰς οὓς σὺ εἰσπορεύῃ εἰς αὐτούς καὶ δώσω πάντας τοὺς ὑπεναντίους σου φυγάδας

text_en: Sending out hornets before, that shall drive away the Hevite, and the Chanaanite , and the Hethite , before you come in.
text_la: emittens crabrones prius, qui fugabunt Hevæum, et Chananæum, et Hethæum, antequam introëas.
text_pt: Também enviarei vespões adiante de ti, que lancem fora os heveus, os cananeus, e os heteus de diante de ti.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστελῶ τὰς σφηκίας προτέρας σου καὶ ἐκβαλεῖ τοὺς Αμορραίους καὶ τοὺς Ευαίους καὶ τοὺς Χαναναίους καὶ τοὺς Χετταίους ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: I will not cast them out from your face in one year; lest the land be brought into a wilderness , and the beasts multiply against you.
text_la: Non ejiciam eos a facie tua anno uno : ne terra in solitudinem redigatur, et crescant contra te bestiæ.
text_pt: Não os lançarei fora de diante de ti num só ano, para que a terra não se torne em deserto, e as feras do campo não se multipliquem contra ti.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκβαλῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐνιαυτῷ ἑνί ἵνα μὴ γένηται ἡ γῆ ἔρημος καὶ πολλὰ γένηται ἐπὶ σὲ τὰ θηρία τῆς γῆς

text_en: By little and little I will drive them out from before you, till you be increased, and possess the land.
text_la: Paulatim expellam eos de conspectu tuo, donec augearis, et possideas terram.
text_pt: Pouco a pouco os lançarei de diante de ti, até que sejas multiplicado, e possuas a terra por herança.
text_el: κατὰ μικρὸν μικρὸν ἐκβαλῶ αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ σοῦ ἕως ἂν αὐξηθῇς καὶ κληρονομήσῃς τὴν γῆν

text_en: And I will set your bounds from the Red Sea to the sea of the Palestines , and from the desert to the river: I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hands, and will drive them out from before you.
text_la: Ponam autem terminos tuos a mari Rubro usque ad mare Palæstinorum, et a deserto usque ad fluvium : tradam in manibus vestris habitatores terræ, et ejiciam eos de conspectu vestro.
text_pt: E porei os teus termos desde o Mar Vermelho até ao mar dos filisteus, e desde o deserto até ao rio; porque darei nas tuas mãos os moradores da terra, para que os lances fora de diante de ti.
text_el: καὶ θήσω τὰ ὅριά σου ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρυθρᾶς θαλάσσης ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Φυλιστιιμ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου ἕως τοῦ μεγάλου ποταμοῦ Εὐφράτου καὶ παραδώσω εἰς τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν τοὺς ἐγκαθημένους ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ ἐκβαλῶ αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: You shall not enter into league with them, nor with their gods.
text_la: Non inibis cum eis fœdus, nec cum diis eorum.
text_pt: Não farás aliança alguma com eles, ou com os seus deuses.
text_el: οὐ συγκαταθήσῃ αὐτοῖς καὶ τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν διαθήκην

text_en: Let them not dwell in your land, lest perhaps they make you sin against me, if you serve their gods ; which, undoubtedly, will be a scandal to you.
text_la: Non habitent in terra tua, ne forte peccare te faciant in me, si servieris diis eorum : quod tibi certe erit in scandalum.
text_pt: Na tua terra não habitarão, para que não te façam pecar contra mim; se servires aos seus deuses, certamente isso será um laço para ti.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαθήσονται ἐν τῇ γῇ σου ἵνα μὴ ἁμαρτεῖν σε ποιήσωσιν πρός με ἐὰν γὰρ δουλεύσῃς τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν οὗτοι ἔσονταί σοι πρόσκομμα

text_en: And he said to Moses : Come up to the Lord , you, and Aaron , Nadab and Abiu, and seventy of the ancients of Israel , and you shall adore afar off.
text_la: Moysi quoque dixit : Ascende ad Dominum tu, et Aaron, Nadab et Abiu, et septuaginta senes ex Israël, et adorabitis procul.
text_pt: Depois disse a Moisés: Sobe ao SENHOR, tu e Arão, Nadabe e Abiú, e setenta dos anciãos de Israel; e adorai de longe.
text_el: καὶ Μωυσῇ εἶπεν ἀνάβηθι πρὸς κύριον σὺ καὶ Ααρων καὶ Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα τῶν πρεσβυτέρων Ισραηλ καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν μακρόθεν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And Moses alone shall come up to the Lord , but they shall not come near; neither shall the people come up with him.
text_la: Solusque Moyses ascendet ad Dominum, et illi non appropinquabunt : nec populus ascendet cum eo.
text_pt: E só Moisés se chegará ao Senhor; mas eles não se cheguem, nem o povo suba com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐγγιεῖ Μωυσῆς μόνος πρὸς τὸν θεόν αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἐγγιοῦσιν ὁ δὲ λαὸς οὐ συναναβήσεται μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: So Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord , and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice: We will do all the words of the Lord , which he has spoken.
text_la: Venit ergo Moyses et narravit plebi omnia verba Domini, atque judicia : responditque omnis populus una voce : Omnia verba Domini, quæ locutus est, faciemus.
text_pt: Veio, pois, Moisés, e contou ao povo todas as palavras do Senhor, e todos os estatutos; então o povo respondeu a uma voz, e disse: Todas as palavras, que o Senhor tem falado, faremos.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ διηγήσατο τῷ λαῷ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα ἀπεκρίθη δὲ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς φωνῇ μιᾷ λέγοντες πάντας τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐλάλησεν κύριος ποιήσομεν καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα

text_en: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord : and rising in the morning, he built an altar at the foot of the mount , and twelve titles according to the twelve tribes of Israel .
text_la: Scripsit autem Moyses universos sermones Domini : et mane consurgens, ædificavit altare ad radices montis, et duodecim titulos per duodecim tribus Israël.
text_pt: Moisés escreveu todas as palavras do Senhor, e levantou-se pela manhã de madrugada, e edificou um altar ao pé do monte, e doze monumentos, segundo as doze tribos de Israel;
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν Μωυσῆς πάντα τὰ ῥήματα κυρίου ὀρθρίσας δὲ Μωυσῆς τὸ πρωὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν θυσιαστήριον ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος καὶ δώδεκα λίθους εἰς τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel , and they offered holocausts , and sacrificed pacific victims of calves to the Lord .
text_la: Misitque juvenes de filiis Israël, et obtulerunt holocausta, immolaveruntque victimas pacificas Domino, vitulos.
text_pt: E enviou alguns jovens dos filhos de Israel, os quais ofereceram holocaustos e sacrificaram ao Senhor sacrifícios pacíficos de bezerros.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν τοὺς νεανίσκους τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ἀνήνεγκαν ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ ἔθυσαν θυσίαν σωτηρίου τῷ θεῷ μοσχάρια

text_en: Then Moses took half of the blood, and put it into bowls; and the rest he poured upon the altar .
text_la: Tulit itaque Moyses dimidiam partem sanguinis, et misit in crateras : partem autem residuam fudit super altare.
text_pt: E Moisés tomou a metade do sangue, e a pôs em bacias; e a outra metade do sangue espargiu sobre o altar.
text_el: λαβὼν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ αἵματος ἐνέχεεν εἰς κρατῆρας τὸ δὲ ἥμισυ τοῦ αἵματος προσέχεεν πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον

text_en: And taking the book of the covenant, he read it in the hearing of the people: and they said: All things that the Lord has spoken, we will do, we will be obedient .
text_la: Assumensque volumen fœderis, legit audiente populo : qui dixerunt : Omnia quæ locutus est Dominus, faciemus, et erimus obedientes.
text_pt: E tomou o livro da aliança e o leu aos ouvidos do povo, e eles disseram: Tudo o que o Senhor tem falado faremos, e obedeceremos.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν τὸ βιβλίον τῆς διαθήκης ἀνέγνω εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ εἶπαν πάντα ὅσα ἐλάλησεν κύριος ποιήσομεν καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα

text_en: And he took the blood and sprinkled it upon the people, and he said: This is the blood of the covenant, which the Lord has made with you concerning all these words.
text_la: Ille vero sumptum sanguinem respersit in populum, et ait : Hic est sanguis fœderis quod pepigit Dominus vobiscum super cunctis sermonibus his.
text_pt: Então tomou Moisés aquele sangue, e espargiu-o sobre o povo, e disse: Eis aqui o sangue da aliança que o Senhor tem feito convosco sobre todas estas palavras.
text_el: λαβὼν δὲ Μωυσῆς τὸ αἷμα κατεσκέδασεν τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης ἧς διέθετο κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων τῶν λόγων τούτων

text_en: Then Moses and Aaron , Nadab and Abiu, and seventy of the ancients of Israel went up:
text_la: Ascenderuntque Moyses et Aaron, Nadab et Abiu, et septuaginta de senioribus Israël:
text_pt: E subiram Moisés e Arão, Nadabe e Abiú, e setenta dos anciãos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καὶ Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ καὶ ἑβδομήκοντα τῆς γερουσίας Ισραηλ

text_en: And they saw the God of Israel : and under his feet as it were a work of sapphire stone, and as the heaven , when clear.
text_la: et viderunt Deum Israël : et sub pedibus ejus quasi opus lapidis sapphirini, et quasi cælum, cum serenum est.
text_pt: E viram o Deus de Israel, e debaixo de seus pés havia como que uma pavimentação de pedra de safira, que se parecia com o céu na sua claridade.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον τὸν τόπον οὗ εἱστήκει ἐκεῖ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ τὰ ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ ἔργον πλίνθου σαπφείρου καὶ ὥσπερ εἶδος στερεώματος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῇ καθαριότητι

text_en: Neither did he lay his hand upon those of the children of Israel , that retired afar off, and they saw God , and they ate and drank.
text_la: Nec super eos qui procul recesserant de filiis Israël, misit manum suam, videruntque Deum, et comederunt, ac biberunt.
text_pt: Porém não estendeu a sua mão sobre os escolhidos dos filhos de Israel, mas viram a Deus, e comeram e beberam.
text_el: καὶ τῶν ἐπιλέκτων τοῦ Ισραηλ οὐ διεφώνησεν οὐδὲ εἷς καὶ ὤφθησαν ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἔπιον

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Come up to me into the mount , and be there; and I will give you tables of stone, and the law , and the commandments which I have written; that you may teach them.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen : Ascende ad me in montem, et esto ibi : daboque tibi tabulas lapideas, et legem, ac mandata quæ scripsi : ut doceas eos.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Sobe a mim ao monte, e fica lá; e dar-te-ei as tábuas de pedra e a lei, e os mandamentos que tenho escrito, para os ensinar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἀνάβηθι πρός με εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἴσθι ἐκεῖ καὶ δώσω σοι τὰ πυξία τὰ λίθινα τὸν νόμον καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς ἃς ἔγραψα νομοθετῆσαι αὐτοῖς

text_en: Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua : and Moses going up into the mount of God ,
text_la: Surrexerunt Moyses et Josue minister ejus: ascendensque Moyses in montem Dei,
text_pt: E levantou-se Moisés com Josué seu servidor; e subiu Moisés ao monte de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ παρεστηκὼς αὐτῷ ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: said to the ancients: Wait here till we return to you. You have Aaron and Hur with you: if any question shall arise, you shall refer it to them.
text_la: senioribus ait : Expectate hic donec revertamur ad vos. Habetis Aaron et Hur vobiscum : si quid natum fuerit quæstionis, referetis ad eos.
text_pt: E disse aos anciãos: Esperai-nos aqui, até que tornemos a vós; e eis que Arão e Hur ficam convosco; quem tiver algum negócio, se chegará a eles.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις εἶπαν ἡσυχάζετε αὐτοῦ ἕως ἀναστρέψωμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἰδοὺ Ααρων καὶ Ωρ μεθ' ὑμῶν ἐάν τινι συμβῇ κρίσις προσπορευέσθωσαν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And when Moses had gone up, a cloud covered the mount .
text_la: Cumque ascendisset Moyses, operuit nubes montem,
text_pt: E, subindo Moisés ao monte, a nuvem cobriu o monte.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἐκάλυψεν ἡ νεφέλη τὸ ὄρος

text_en: And the glory of the Lord dwelt upon Sinai , covering it with a cloud six days: and the seventh day he called him out of the midst of the cloud.
text_la: et habitavit gloria Domini super Sinai, tegens illum nube sex diebus : septimo autem die vocavit eum de medio caliginis.
text_pt: E a glória do Senhor repousou sobre o monte Sinai, e a nuvem o cobriu por seis dias; e ao sétimo dia chamou a Moisés do meio da nuvem.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη ἡ δόξα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινα καὶ ἐκάλυψεν αὐτὸ ἡ νεφέλη ἓξ ἡμέρας καὶ ἐκάλεσεν κύριος τὸν Μωυσῆν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἐκ μέσου τῆς νεφέλης

text_en: And the sight of the glory of the Lord , was like a burning fire upon the top of the mount , in the eyes of the children of Israel .
text_la: Erat autem species gloriæ Domini quasi ignis ardens super verticem montis in conspectu filiorum Israël.
text_pt: E o parecer da glória do Senhor era como um fogo consumidor no cume do monte, aos olhos dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: τὸ δὲ εἶδος τῆς δόξης κυρίου ὡσεὶ πῦρ φλέγον ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And Moses entering into the midst of the cloud, went up into the mountain : And he was there forty days and forty nights.
text_la: Ingressusque Moyses medium nebulæ, ascendit in montem : et fuit ibi quadraginta diebus, et quadraginta noctibus.
text_pt: E Moisés entrou no meio da nuvem, depois que subiu ao monte; e Moisés esteve no monte quarenta dias e quarenta noites.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Μωυσῆς εἰς τὸ μέσον τῆς νεφέλης καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Então falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , that they bring firstfruits to me: of every man that offers of his own accord, you shall take them.
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, ut tollant mihi primitias : ab omni homine qui offeret ultroneus, accipietis eas.
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, que me tragam uma oferta alçada; de todo o homem cujo coração se mover voluntariamente, dele tomareis a minha oferta alçada.
text_el: εἰπὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ λάβετέ μοι ἀπαρχὰς παρὰ πάντων οἷς ἂν δόξῃ τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ λήμψεσθε τὰς ἀπαρχάς μου

text_en: And these are the things you must take: Gold, and silver, and brass,
text_la: Hæc sunt autem quæ accipere debeatis : aurum, et argentum, et æs,
text_pt: E esta é a oferta alçada que recebereis deles: ouro, e prata, e cobre,
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀπαρχή ἣν λήμψεσθε παρ' αὐτῶν χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον καὶ χαλκὸν

text_en: violet and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
text_la: hyacinthum et purpuram, coccumque bis tinctum, et byssum, pilos caprarum,
text_pt: E azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho fino, e pêlos de cabras,
text_el: καὶ ὑάκινθον καὶ πορφύραν καὶ κόκκινον διπλοῦν καὶ βύσσον κεκλωσμένην καὶ τρίχας αἰγείας

text_en: and rams' skins dyed red, and violet skins, and setim wood :
text_la: et pelles arietum rubricatas, pellesque janthinas, et ligna setim:
text_pt: E peles de carneiros tintas de vermelho, e peles de texugos, e madeira de acácia,
text_el: καὶ δέρματα κριῶν ἠρυθροδανωμένα καὶ δέρματα ὑακίνθινα καὶ ξύλα ἄσηπτα

text_en: Oil to make lights: spices for ointment , and for sweetsmelling incense :
text_la: oleum ad luminaria concinnanda : aromata in unguentum, et thymiamata boni odoris:
text_pt: Azeite para a luz, especiarias para o óleo da unção, e especiarias para o incenso,

text_en: Onyx stones, and precious stones to adorn the ephod and the rational .
text_la: lapides onychinos, et gemmas ad ornandum ephod, ac rationale.
text_pt: Pedras de ônix, e pedras de engaste para o éfode e para o peitoral.
text_el: καὶ λίθους σαρδίου καὶ λίθους εἰς τὴν γλυφὴν εἰς τὴν ἐπωμίδα καὶ τὸν ποδήρη

text_en: And they shall make me a sanctuary , and I will dwell in the midst of them:
text_la: Facientque mihi sanctuarium, et habitabo in medio eorum:
text_pt: E me farão um santuário, e habitarei no meio deles.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις μοι ἁγίασμα καὶ ὀφθήσομαι ἐν ὑμῖν

text_en: According to all the likeness of the tabernacle which I will show you, and of all the vessels for the service thereof: and thus you shall make it:
text_la: juxta omnem similitudinem tabernaculi quod ostendam tibi, et omnium vasorum in cultum ejus. Sicque facietis illud:
text_pt: Conforme a tudo o que eu te mostrar para modelo do tabernáculo, e para modelo de todos os seus pertences, assim mesmo o fareis.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις μοι κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐγώ σοι δεικνύω ἐν τῷ ὄρει τὸ παράδειγμα τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τὸ παράδειγμα πάντων τῶν σκευῶν αὐτῆς οὕτω ποιήσεις

text_en: Frame an ark of setim wood , the length whereof shall be of two cubits and a half; the breadth, a cubit and a half; the height, likewise, a cubit and a half.
text_la: arcam de lignis setim compingite, cujus longitudo habeat duos et semis cubitos : latitudo, cubitum et dimidium : altitudo, cubitum similiter ac semissem.
text_pt: Também farão uma arca de madeira de acácia; o seu comprimento será de dois côvados e meio, e a sua largura de um côvado e meio, e de um côvado e meio a sua altura.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις κιβωτὸν μαρτυρίου ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων δύο πήχεων καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ μῆκος καὶ πήχεος καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ πλάτος καὶ πήχεος καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ ὕψος

text_en: And you shall overlay it with the purest gold, within and without; and over it you shall make a golden crown round about:
text_la: Et deaurabis eam auro mundissimo intus et foris : faciesque supra, coronam auream per circuitum:
text_pt: E cobri-la-á de ouro puro; por dentro e por fora a cobrirás; e farás sobre ela uma coroa de ouro ao redor;
text_el: καὶ καταχρυσώσεις αὐτὴν χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ ἔξωθεν καὶ ἔσωθεν χρυσώσεις αὐτήν καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῇ κυμάτια στρεπτὰ χρυσᾶ κύκλῳ

text_en: And four golden rings, which you shall put at the four corners of the ark : let two rings be on the one side, and two on the other.
text_la: et quatuor circulos aureos, quos pones per quatuor arcæ angulos : duo circuli sint in latere uno, et duo in altero.
text_pt: E fundirás para ela quatro argolas de ouro, e as porás nos quatro cantos dela, duas argolas num lado dela, e duas argolas noutro lado.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάσεις αὐτῇ τέσσαρας δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἐπὶ τὰ τέσσαρα κλίτη δύο δακτυλίους ἐπὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ ἓν καὶ δύο δακτυλίους ἐπὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ δεύτερον

text_en: You shall make bars also of setim wood , and shall overlay them with gold.
text_la: Facies quoque vectes de lignis setim, et operies eos auro.
text_pt: E farás varas de madeira de acácia, e as cobrirás com ouro.
text_el: ποιήσεις δὲ ἀναφορεῖς ξύλα ἄσηπτα καὶ καταχρυσώσεις αὐτὰ χρυσίῳ

text_en: And you shall put them in through the rings that are in the sides of the ark , that it may be carried on them:
text_la: Inducesque per circulos qui sunt in arcæ lateribus, ut portetur in eis:
text_pt: E colocarás as varas nas argolas, aos lados da arca, para se levar com elas a arca.
text_el: καὶ εἰσάξεις τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς εἰς τοὺς δακτυλίους τοὺς ἐν τοῖς κλίτεσι τῆς κιβωτοῦ αἴρειν τὴν κιβωτὸν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they shall be always in the rings, neither shall they at any time be drawn out of them.
text_la: qui semper erunt in circulis, nec umquam extrahentur ab eis.
text_pt: As varas estarão nas argolas da arca, não se tirarão dela.
text_el: ἐν τοῖς δακτυλίοις τῆς κιβωτοῦ ἔσονται οἱ ἀναφορεῖς ἀκίνητοι

text_en: And you shall put in the ark the testimony which I will give you.
text_la: Ponesque in arca testificationem quam dabo tibi.
text_pt: Depois porás na arca o testemunho, que eu te darei.
text_el: καὶ ἐμβαλεῖς εἰς τὴν κιβωτὸν τὰ μαρτύρια ἃ ἂν δῶ σοι

text_en: You shall make also a propitiatory of the purest gold: the length thereof shall be two cubits and a half, and the breadth a cubit and a half.
text_la: Facies et propitiatorium de auro mundissimo : duos cubitos et dimidium tenebit longitudo ejus, et cubitum ac semissem latitudo.
text_pt: Também farás um propiciatório de ouro puro; o seu comprimento será de dois côvados e meio, e a sua largura de um côvado e meio.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις ἱλαστήριον ἐπίθεμα χρυσίου καθαροῦ δύο πήχεων καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ μῆκος καὶ πήχεος καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ πλάτος

text_en: You shall make also two cherubims of beaten gold, on the two sides of the oracle.
text_la: Duos quoque cherubim aureos et productiles facies, ex utraque parte oraculi.
text_pt: Farás também dois querubins de ouro; de ouro batido os farás, nas duas extremidades do propiciatório.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις δύο χερουβιμ χρυσᾶ τορευτὰ καὶ ἐπιθήσεις αὐτὰ ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν κλιτῶν τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου

text_en: Let one cherub be on the one side, and the other on the other.
text_la: Cherub unus sit in latere uno, et alter in altero.
text_pt: Farás um querubim na extremidade de uma parte, e o outro querubim na extremidade da outra parte; de uma só peça com o propiciatório, fareis os querubins nas duas extremidades dele.
text_el: ποιηθήσονται χερουβ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους τούτου καὶ χερουβ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους τοῦ δευτέρου τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου καὶ ποιήσεις τοὺς δύο χερουβιμ ἐπὶ τὰ δύο κλίτη

text_en: Let them cover both sides of the propitiatory, spreading their wings, and covering the oracle, and let them look one towards the other, their faces being turned towards the propitiatory wherewith the ark is to be covered.
text_la: Utrumque latus propitiatorii tegant expandentes alas, et operientes oraculum, respiciantque se mutuo versis vultibus in propitiatorium quo operienda est arca,
text_pt: Os querubins estenderão as suas asas por cima, cobrindo com elas o propiciatório; as faces deles uma defronte da outra; as faces dos querubins estarão voltadas para o propiciatório.
text_el: ἔσονται οἱ χερουβιμ ἐκτείνοντες τὰς πτέρυγας ἐπάνωθεν συσκιάζοντες ταῖς πτέρυξιν αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου καὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν εἰς ἄλληλα εἰς τὸ ἱλαστήριον ἔσονται τὰ πρόσωπα τῶν χερουβιμ

text_en: In which you shall put the testimony that I will give you.
text_la: in qua pones testimonium quod dabo tibi.
text_pt: E porás o propiciatório em cima da arca, depois que houveres posto na arca o testemunho que eu te darei.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τὸ ἱλαστήριον ἐπὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν ἄνωθεν καὶ εἰς τὴν κιβωτὸν ἐμβαλεῖς τὰ μαρτύρια ἃ ἂν δῶ σοι

text_en: Thence will I give orders, and will speak to you over the propitiatory, and from the midst of the two cherubims , which shall be upon the ark of the testimony , all things which I will command the children of Israel by you.
text_la: Inde præcipiam, et loquar ad te supra propitiatorium, ac de medio duorum cherubim, qui erunt super arcam testimonii, cuncta quæ mandabo per te filiis Israël.
text_pt: E ali virei a ti, e falarei contigo de cima do propiciatório, do meio dos dois querubins (que estão sobre a arca do testemunho), tudo o que eu te ordenar para os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ γνωσθήσομαί σοι ἐκεῖθεν καὶ λαλήσω σοι ἄνωθεν τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν δύο χερουβιμ τῶν ὄντων ἐπὶ τῆς κιβωτοῦ τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐντείλωμαί σοι πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: You shall make a table also of setim wood , of two cubits in length, and a cubit in breadth, and a cubit and a half in height.
text_la: Facies et mensam de lignis setim, habentem duos cubitos longitudinis, et in latitudine cubitum, et in altitudine cubitum et semissem.
text_pt: Também farás uma mesa de madeira de acácia; o seu comprimento será de dois côvados, e a sua largura de um côvado, e a sua altura de um côvado e meio.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τράπεζαν χρυσίου καθαροῦ δύο πήχεων τὸ μῆκος καὶ πήχεος τὸ εὖρος καὶ πήχεος καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ ὕψος

text_en: And you shall overlay it with the purest gold: and you shall make to it a golden ledge round about.
text_la: Et inaurabis eam auro purissimo : faciesque illi labium aureum per circuitum,
text_pt: E cobri-la-ás com ouro puro; também lhe farás uma coroa de ouro ao redor.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῇ στρεπτὰ κυμάτια χρυσᾶ κύκλῳ

text_en: And to the ledge itself a polished crown, four inches high; and over the same another little golden crown.
text_la: et ipsi labio coronam interrasilem altam quatuor digitis : et super illam, alteram coronam aureolam.
text_pt: Também lhe farás uma moldura ao redor, da largura de quatro dedos, e lhe farás uma coroa de ouro ao redor da moldura.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῇ στεφάνην παλαιστοῦ κύκλῳ καὶ ποιήσεις στρεπτὸν κυμάτιον τῇ στεφάνῃ κύκλῳ

text_en: You shall prepare also four golden rings, and shall put them in the four corners of the same table, over each foot.
text_la: Quatuor quoque circulos aureos præparabis, et pones eis in quatuor angulis ejusdem mensæ per singulos pedes.
text_pt: Também lhe farás quatro argolas de ouro; e porás as argolas aos quatro cantos, que estão nos seus quatro pés.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τέσσαρας δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τοὺς δακτυλίους ἐπὶ τὰ τέσσαρα μέρη τῶν ποδῶν αὐτῆς

text_en: Under the crown shall the golden rings be, that the bars may be put through them, and the table may be carried.
text_la: Subter coronam erunt circuli aurei, ut mittantur vectes per eos, et possit mensa portari.
text_pt: Defronte da moldura estarão as argolas, como lugares para os varais, para se levar a mesa.
text_el: ὑπὸ τὴν στεφάνην καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δακτύλιοι εἰς θήκας τοῖς ἀναφορεῦσιν ὥστε αἴρειν ἐν αὐτοῖς τὴν τράπεζαν

text_en: The bars also themselves you shall make of setim wood , and shall overlay them with gold, to bear up the table.
text_la: Ipsos quoque vectes facies de lignis setim, et circumdabis auro ad subvehendam mensam.
text_pt: Farás, pois, estes varais de madeira de acácia, e cobri-los-ás com ouro; e levar-se-á com eles a mesa.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων καὶ καταχρυσώσεις αὐτοὺς χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ καὶ ἀρθήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς ἡ τράπεζα

text_en: You shall prepare also dishes, and bowls, censers , and cups, wherein the libations are to be offered , of the purest gold.
text_la: Parabis et acetabula, ac phialas, thuribula, et cyathos, in quibus offerenda sunt libamina, ex auro purissimo.
text_pt: Também farás os seus pratos, e as suas colheres, e as suas cobertas, e as suas tigelas com que se hão de oferecer libações; de ouro puro os farás.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τὰ τρυβλία αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς θυίσκας καὶ τὰ σπονδεῖα καὶ τοὺς κυάθους ἐν οἷς σπείσεις ἐν αὐτοῖς χρυσίου καθαροῦ ποιήσεις αὐτά

text_en: And you shall set upon the table loaves of proposition in my sight always.
text_la: Et pones super mensam panes propositionis in conspectu meo semper.
text_pt: E sobre a mesa porás o pão da proposição perante a minha face perpetuamente.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἐπὶ τὴν τράπεζαν ἄρτους ἐνωπίους ἐναντίον μου διὰ παντός

text_en: You shall make also a candlestick of beaten work, of the finest gold, the shaft thereof, and the branches, the cups, and the bowls, and the lilies going forth from it.
text_la: Facies et candelabrum ductile de auro mundissimo, hastile ejus, et calamos, scyphos, et sphærulas, ac lilia ex ipso procedentia.
text_pt: Também farás um candelabro de ouro puro; de ouro batido se fará este candelabro; o seu pé, as suas hastes, os seus copos, os seus botões, e as suas flores serão do mesmo.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις λυχνίαν ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ τορευτὴν ποιήσεις τὴν λυχνίαν ὁ καυλὸς αὐτῆς καὶ οἱ καλαμίσκοι καὶ οἱ κρατῆρες καὶ οἱ σφαιρωτῆρες καὶ τὰ κρίνα ἐξ αὐτῆς ἔσται

text_en: Six branches shall come out of the sides, three out of one side, and three out of the other.
text_la: Sex calami egredientur de lateribus, tres ex uno latere, et tres ex altero.
text_pt: E dos seus lados sairão seis hastes; três hastes do candelabro de um lado dele, e três hastes do outro lado dele.
text_el: ἓξ δὲ καλαμίσκοι ἐκπορευόμενοι ἐκ πλαγίων τρεῖς καλαμίσκοι τῆς λυχνίας ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους αὐτῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς καὶ τρεῖς καλαμίσκοι τῆς λυχνίας ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους τοῦ δευτέρου

text_en: Three cups as it were nuts to every branch, and a bowl withal, and a lily: and three cups likewise of the fashion of nuts in the other branch, and a bowl withal, and a lily. Such shall be the work of the six branches, that are to come out from the shaft:
text_la: Tres scyphi quasi in nucis modum per calamos singulos, sphærulaque simul, et lilium : et tres similiter scyphi instar nucis in calamo altero, sphærulaque simul et lilium. Hoc erit opus sex calamorum, qui producendi sunt de hastili:
text_pt: Numa haste haverá três copos a modo de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor; e três copos a modo de amêndoas na outra haste, um botão e uma flor; assim serão as seis hastes que saem do candelabro.
text_el: καὶ τρεῖς κρατῆρες ἐκτετυπωμένοι καρυίσκους ἐν τῷ ἑνὶ καλαμίσκῳ σφαιρωτὴρ καὶ κρίνον οὕτως τοῖς ἓξ καλαμίσκοις τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ἐκ τῆς λυχνίας

text_en: And in the candlestick itself shall be four cups in the manner of a nut, and at every one bowls and lilies.
text_la: in ipso autem candelabro erunt quatuor scyphi in nucis modum, sphærulæque per singulos, et lilia.
text_pt: Mas no candelabro mesmo haverá quatro copos a modo de amêndoas, com seus botões e com suas flores;
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῇ λυχνίᾳ τέσσαρες κρατῆρες ἐκτετυπωμένοι καρυίσκους ἐν τῷ ἑνὶ καλαμίσκῳ οἱ σφαιρωτῆρες καὶ τὰ κρίνα αὐτῆς

text_en: Bowls under two branches in three places, which together make six, coming forth out of one shaft.
text_la: Sphærulæ sub duobus calamis per tria loca, qui simul sex fiunt procedentes de hastili uno.
text_pt: E um botão debaixo de duas hastes que saem dele; e ainda um botão debaixo de duas outras hastes que saem dele; e ainda um botão debaixo de duas outras hastes que saem dele; assim se fará com as seis hastes que saem do candelabro.
text_el: ὁ σφαιρωτὴρ ὑπὸ τοὺς δύο καλαμίσκους ἐξ αὐτῆς καὶ σφαιρωτὴρ ὑπὸ τοὺς τέσσαρας καλαμίσκους ἐξ αὐτῆς οὕτως τοῖς ἓξ καλαμίσκοις τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ἐκ τῆς λυχνίας

text_en: And both the bowls and the branches shall be of the same beaten work of the purest gold.
text_la: Et sphærulæ igitur et calami ex ipso erunt, universa ductilia de auro purissimo.
text_pt: Os seus botões e as suas hastes serão do mesmo; tudo será de uma só peça, obra batida de ouro puro.
text_el: οἱ σφαιρωτῆρες καὶ οἱ καλαμίσκοι ἐξ αὐτῆς ἔστωσαν ὅλη τορευτὴ ἐξ ἑνὸς χρυσίου καθαροῦ

text_en: You shall make also seven lamps, and shall set them upon the candlestick , to give light over against.
text_la: Facies et lucernas septem, et pones eas super candelabrum, ut luceant ex adverso.
text_pt: Também lhe farás sete lâmpadas, as quais se acenderão para iluminar defronte dele.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τοὺς λύχνους αὐτῆς ἑπτά καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τοὺς λύχνους καὶ φανοῦσιν ἐκ τοῦ ἑνὸς προσώπου

text_en: The snuffers also, and where the snuffings shall be put out, shall be made of the purest gold.
text_la: Emunctoria quoque, et ubi quæ emuncta sunt extinguantur, fiant de auro purissimo.
text_pt: Os seus espevitadores e os seus apagadores serão de ouro puro.
text_el: καὶ τὸν ἐπαρυστῆρα αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ ὑποθέματα αὐτῆς ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ ποιήσεις

text_en: The whole weight of the candlestick , with all the furniture thereof, shall be a talent of the purest gold.
text_la: Omne pondus candelabri cum universis vasis suis habebit talentum auri purissimi.
text_pt: De um talento de ouro puro os farás, com todos estes vasos.
text_el: πάντα τὰ σκεύη ταῦτα τάλαντον χρυσίου καθαροῦ

text_en: Look, and make it according to the pattern that was shown you in the mount .
text_la: Inspice, et fac secundum exemplar quod tibi in monte monstratum est.
text_pt: Atenta, pois, que o faças conforme ao seu modelo, que te foi mostrado no monte.
text_el: ὅρα ποιήσεις κατὰ τὸν τύπον τὸν δεδειγμένον σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει

text_en: And you shall make the tabernacle in this manner: You shall make ten curtains of fine twisted linen, and violet and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, diversified with embroidery .
text_la: Tabernaculum vero ita facies : decem cortinas de bysso retorta, et hyacintho, ac purpura, coccoque bis tincto, variatas opere plumario facies.
text_pt: E o tabernáculo farás de dez cortinas de linho fino torcido, e azul, púrpura, e carmesim; com querubins as farás de obra esmerada.
text_el: καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν ποιήσεις δέκα αὐλαίας ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης καὶ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου κεκλωσμένου χερουβιμ ἐργασίᾳ ὑφάντου ποιήσεις αὐτάς

text_en: The length of one curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits; the breadth shall be four cubits. All the curtains shall be of one measure.
text_la: Longitudo cortinæ unius habebit viginti octo cubitos : latitudo, quatuor cubitorum erit. Unius mensuræ fient universa tentoria.
text_pt: O comprimento de uma cortina será de vinte e oito côvados, e a largura de uma cortina de quatro côvados; todas estas cortinas serão de uma medida.
text_el: μῆκος τῆς αὐλαίας τῆς μιᾶς ὀκτὼ καὶ εἴκοσι πήχεων καὶ εὖρος τεσσάρων πήχεων ἡ αὐλαία ἡ μία ἔσται μέτρον τὸ αὐτὸ ἔσται πάσαις ταῖς αὐλαίαις

text_en: Five curtains shall be joined one to another, and the other five shall be coupled together in like manner.
text_la: Quinque cortinæ sibi jungentur mutuo, et aliæ quinque nexu simili cohærebunt.
text_pt: Cinco cortinas se enlaçarão uma à outra; e as outras cinco cortinas se enlaçarão uma com a outra.
text_el: πέντε δὲ αὐλαῖαι ἔσονται ἐξ ἀλλήλων ἐχόμεναι ἡ ἑτέρα ἐκ τῆς ἑτέρας καὶ πέντε αὐλαῖαι ἔσονται συνεχόμεναι ἑτέρα τῇ ἑτέρᾳ

text_en: You shall make loops of violet in the sides and tops of the curtains, that they may be joined one to another.
text_la: Ansulas hyacinthinas in lateribus ac summitatibus facies cortinarum, ut possint invicem copulari.
text_pt: E farás laçadas de azul na orla de uma cortina, na extremidade, e na juntura; assim também farás na orla da extremidade da outra cortina, na segunda juntura.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις αὐταῖς ἀγκύλας ὑακινθίνας ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους τῆς αὐλαίας τῆς μιᾶς ἐκ τοῦ ἑνὸς μέρους εἰς τὴν συμβολὴν καὶ οὕτως ποιήσεις ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους τῆς αὐλαίας τῆς ἐξωτέρας πρὸς τῇ συμβολῇ τῇ δευτέρᾳ

text_en: Every curtain shall have fifty loops on both sides, so set on, that one loop may be against another loop, and one may be fitted to the other.
text_la: Quinquagenas ansulas cortina habebit in utraque parte, ita insertas ut ansa contra ansam veniat, et altera alteri possit aptari.
text_pt: Cinqüenta laçadas farás numa cortina, e outras cinqüenta laçadas farás na extremidade da cortina que está na segunda juntura; as laçadas estarão presas uma com a outra.
text_el: πεντήκοντα ἀγκύλας ποιήσεις τῇ αὐλαίᾳ τῇ μιᾷ καὶ πεντήκοντα ἀγκύλας ποιήσεις ἐκ τοῦ μέρους τῆς αὐλαίας κατὰ τὴν συμβολὴν τῆς δευτέρας ἀντιπρόσωποι ἀντιπίπτουσαι ἀλλήλαις εἰς ἑκάστην

text_en: You shall make also fifty rings of gold, wherewith the veils of the curtains are to be joined, that it may be made one tabernacle .
text_la: Facies et quinquaginta circulos aureos quibus cortinarum vela jungenda sunt, ut unum tabernaculum fiat.
text_pt: Farás também cinqüenta colchetes de ouro, e ajuntarás com estes colchetes as cortinas, uma com a outra, e será um tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις κρίκους πεντήκοντα χρυσοῦς καὶ συνάψεις τὰς αὐλαίας ἑτέραν τῇ ἑτέρᾳ τοῖς κρίκοις καὶ ἔσται ἡ σκηνὴ μία

text_en: You shall make also eleven curtains of goats' hair, to cover the top of the tabernacle .
text_la: Facies et saga cilicina undecim, ad operiendum tectum tabernaculi.
text_pt: Farás também cortinas de pêlos de cabras para servirem de tenda sobre o tabernáculo; onze cortinas farás.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις δέρρεις τριχίνας σκέπην ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς ἕνδεκα δέρρεις ποιήσεις αὐτάς

text_en: The length of one hair-curtain shall be thirty cubits; and the breadth, four: the measure of all the curtains shall be equal.
text_la: Longitudo sagi unius habebit triginta cubitos, et latitudo, quatuor : æqua erit mensura sagorum omnium.
text_pt: O comprimento de uma cortina será de trinta côvados, e a largura da mesma cortina de quatro côvados; estas onze cortinas serão da mesma medida.
text_el: τὸ μῆκος τῆς δέρρεως τῆς μιᾶς ἔσται τριάκοντα πήχεων καὶ τεσσάρων πήχεων τὸ εὖρος τῆς δέρρεως τῆς μιᾶς μέτρον τὸ αὐτὸ ἔσται ταῖς ἕνδεκα δέρρεσι

text_en: Five of which you shall couple by themselves, and the six others you shall couple one to another, so as to double the sixth curtain in the front of the roof.
text_la: E quibus quinque junges seorsum, et sex sibi mutuo copulabis, ita ut sextum sagum in fronte tecti duplices.
text_pt: E juntarás cinco destas cortinas à parte, e as outras seis cortinas também à parte; e dobrarás a sexta cortina à frente da tenda.
text_el: καὶ συνάψεις τὰς πέντε δέρρεις ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ τὰς ἓξ δέρρεις ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό καὶ ἐπιδιπλώσεις τὴν δέρριν τὴν ἕκτην κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: You shall make also fifty loops in the edge of one curtain, that it may be joined with the other: and fifty loops in the edge of the other curtain, that it may be coupled with its fellow.
text_la: Facies et quinquaginta ansas in ora sagi unius, ut conjungi cum altero queat, et quinquaginta ansas in ora sagi alterius, ut cum altero copuletur.
text_pt: E farás cinqüenta laçadas na borda de uma cortina, na extremidade, na juntura, e outras cinqüenta laçadas na borda da outra cortina, na segunda juntura.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις ἀγκύλας πεντήκοντα ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους τῆς δέρρεως τῆς μιᾶς τῆς ἀνὰ μέσον κατὰ συμβολὴν καὶ πεντήκοντα ἀγκύλας ποιήσεις ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους τῆς δέρρεως τῆς συναπτούσης τῆς δευτέρας

text_en: You shall make also fifty buckles of brass, wherewith the loops may be joined, that of all there may be made one covering.
text_la: Facies et quinquaginta fibulas æneas quibus jungantur ansæ, ut unum ex omnibus operimentum fiat.
text_pt: Farás também cinqüenta colchetes de cobre, e colocarás os colchetes nas laçadas, e assim ajuntarás a tenda, para que seja uma.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις κρίκους χαλκοῦς πεντήκοντα καὶ συνάψεις τοὺς κρίκους ἐκ τῶν ἀγκυλῶν καὶ συνάψεις τὰς δέρρεις καὶ ἔσται ἕν

text_en: And that which shall remain of the curtains, that are prepared for the roof, to wit, one curtain that is over and above, with the half thereof you shall cover the back parts of the tabernacle .
text_la: Quod autem superfuerit in sagis quæ parantur tecto, id est unum sagum quod amplius est, ex medietate ejus operies posteriora tabernaculi.
text_pt: E a parte que sobejar das cortinas da tenda, a saber, a metade da cortina que sobejar, penderá de sobra às costas do tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ ὑποθήσεις τὸ πλεονάζον ἐν ταῖς δέρρεσιν τῆς σκηνῆς τὸ ἥμισυ τῆς δέρρεως τὸ ὑπολελειμμένον ὑποκαλύψεις τὸ πλεονάζον τῶν δέρρεων τῆς σκηνῆς ὑποκαλύψεις ὀπίσω τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: And there shall hang down a cubit on the one side, and another on the other side, which is over and above in the length of the curtains, fencing both sides of the tabernacle .
text_la: Et cubitus ex una parte pendebit, et alter ex altera qui plus est in sagorum longitudine, utrumque latus tabernaculi protegens.
text_pt: E um côvado de um lado, e outro côvado do outro, que sobejará no comprimento das cortinas da tenda, penderá de sobra aos lados do tabernáculo de um e de outro lado, para cobri-lo.
text_el: πῆχυν ἐκ τούτου καὶ πῆχυν ἐκ τούτου ἐκ τοῦ ὑπερέχοντος τῶν δέρρεων ἐκ τοῦ μήκους τῶν δέρρεων τῆς σκηνῆς ἔσται συγκαλύπτον ἐπὶ τὰ πλάγια τῆς σκηνῆς ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν ἵνα καλύπτῃ

text_en: You shall make also another cover to the roof of rams' skins dyed red: and over that again another cover of violet coloured skins.
text_la: Facies et operimentum aliud tecto de pellibus arietum rubricatis : et super hoc rursum aliud operimentum de janthinis pellibus.
text_pt: Farás também à tenda uma coberta de peles de carneiro, tintas de vermelho, e outra coberta de peles de texugo em cima.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις κατακάλυμμα τῇ σκηνῇ δέρματα κριῶν ἠρυθροδανωμένα καὶ ἐπικαλύμματα δέρματα ὑακίνθινα ἐπάνωθεν

text_en: You shall make also the boards of the tabernacle standing upright of setim wood .
text_la: Facies et tabulas stantes tabernaculi de lignis setim,
text_pt: Farás também as tábuas para o tabernáculo de madeira de acácia, que serão postas verticalmente.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις στύλους τῇ σκηνῇ ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων

text_en: Let every one of them be ten cubits in length, and in breadth one cubit and a half.
text_la: quæ singulæ denos cubitos in longitudine habeant, et in latitudine singulos ac semissem.
text_pt: O comprimento de uma tábua será de dez côvados, e a largura de cada tábua será de um côvado e meio.
text_el: δέκα πήχεων ποιήσεις τὸν στῦλον τὸν ἕνα καὶ πήχεος ἑνὸς καὶ ἡμίσους τὸ πλάτος τοῦ στύλου τοῦ ἑνός

text_en: In the sides of the boards shall be made two mortises, whereby one board may be joined to another board: and after this manner shall all the boards be prepared.
text_la: In lateribus tabulæ, duæ incastraturæ fient, quibus tabula alteri tabulæ connectatur : atque in hunc modum cunctæ tabulæ parabuntur.
text_pt: Dois encaixes terá cada tábua, travados um com o outro; assim farás com todas as tábuas do tabernáculo.
text_el: δύο ἀγκωνίσκους τῷ στύλῳ τῷ ἑνὶ ἀντιπίπτοντας ἕτερον τῷ ἑτέρῳ οὕτως ποιήσεις πᾶσι τοῖς στύλοις τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: Of which twenty shall be in the south side southward.
text_la: Quarum viginti erunt in latere meridiano quod vergit ad austrum.
text_pt: E farás as tábuas para o tabernáculo assim: vinte tábuas para o lado meridional.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις στύλους τῇ σκηνῇ εἴκοσι στύλους ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους τοῦ πρὸς βορρᾶν

text_en: For which you shall cast forty sockets of silver, that under every board may be put two sockets at the two corners.
text_la: Quibus quadraginta bases argenteas fundes, ut binæ bases singulis tabulis per duos angulos subjiciantur.
text_pt: Farás também quarenta bases de prata debaixo das vinte tábuas; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua para os seus dois encaixes e duas bases debaixo de outra tábua para os seus dois encaixes.
text_el: καὶ τεσσαράκοντα βάσεις ἀργυρᾶς ποιήσεις τοῖς εἴκοσι στύλοις δύο βάσεις τῷ στύλῳ τῷ ἑνὶ εἰς ἀμφότερα τὰ μέρη αὐτοῦ καὶ δύο βάσεις τῷ στύλῳ τῷ ἑνὶ εἰς ἀμφότερα τὰ μέρη αὐτοῦ

text_en: In the second side also of the tabernacle that looks to the north, there shall be twenty boards,
text_la: In latere quoque secundo tabernaculi quod vergit ad aquilonem, viginti tabulæ erunt,
text_pt: Também haverá vinte tábuas ao outro lado do tabernáculo, para o lado norte,
text_el: καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ δεύτερον τὸ πρὸς νότον εἴκοσι στύλους

text_en: having forty sockets of silver, two sockets shall be put under each board.
text_la: quadraginta habentes bases argenteas, binæ bases singulis tabulis supponentur.
text_pt: Com as suas quarenta bases de prata; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo de outra tábua,
text_el: καὶ τεσσαράκοντα βάσεις αὐτῶν ἀργυρᾶς δύο βάσεις τῷ στύλῳ τῷ ἑνὶ εἰς ἀμφότερα τὰ μέρη αὐτοῦ καὶ δύο βάσεις τῷ στύλῳ τῷ ἑνὶ εἰς ἀμφότερα τὰ μέρη αὐτοῦ

text_en: But on the west side of the tabernacle you shall make six boards.
text_la: Ad occidentalem vero plagam tabernaculi facies sex tabulas,
text_pt: E ao lado do tabernáculo para o ocidente farás seis tábuas.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὀπίσω τῆς σκηνῆς κατὰ τὸ μέρος τὸ πρὸς θάλασσαν ποιήσεις ἓξ στύλους

text_en: And again other two which shall be erected in the corners at the back of the tabernacle .
text_la: et rursum alias duas quæ in angulis erigantur post tergum tabernaculi.
text_pt: Farás também duas tábuas para os cantos do tabernáculo, de ambos os lados.
text_el: καὶ δύο στύλους ποιήσεις ἐπὶ τῶν γωνιῶν τῆς σκηνῆς ἐκ τῶν ὀπισθίων

text_en: And they shall be joined together from beneath unto the top, and one joint shall hold them all. The like joining shall be observed for the two boards also that are to be put in the corners.
text_la: Eruntque conjunctæ a deorsum usque sursum, et una omnes compago retinebit. Duabus quoque tabulis quæ in angulis ponendæ sunt, similis junctura servabitur.
text_pt: E por baixo se ajuntarão, e também em cima dele se ajuntarão numa argola. Assim se fará com as duas tábuas; ambas serão por tábuas para os dois cantos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐξ ἴσου κάτωθεν κατὰ τὸ αὐτὸ ἔσονται ἴσοι ἐκ τῶν κεφαλίδων εἰς σύμβλησιν μίαν οὕτως ποιήσεις ἀμφοτέραις ταῖς δυσὶν γωνίαις ἔστωσαν

text_en: And they shall be in all eight boards, and their silver sockets sixteen, reckoning two sockets for each board.
text_la: Et erunt simul tabulæ octo, bases earum argenteæ sedecim, duabus basibus per unam tabulam supputatis.
text_pt: Assim serão as oito tábuas com as suas bases de prata, dezesseis bases; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo da outra tábua.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονται ὀκτὼ στῦλοι καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν ἀργυραῖ δέκα ἕξ δύο βάσεις τῷ στύλῳ τῷ ἑνὶ εἰς ἀμφότερα τὰ μέρη αὐτοῦ καὶ δύο βάσεις τῷ στύλῳ τῷ ἑνί

text_en: You shall make also five bars of setim wood , to hold together the boards on one side of the tabernacle .
text_la: Facies et vectes de lignis setim quinque ad continendas tabulas in uno latere tabernaculi,
text_pt: Farás também cinco travessas de madeira de acácia, para as tábuas de um lado do tabernáculo,
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις μοχλοὺς ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων πέντε τῷ ἑνὶ στύλῳ ἐκ τοῦ ἑνὸς μέρους τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: And five others on the other side, and as many at the west side:
text_la: et quinque alios in altero, et ejusdem numeri ad occidentalem plagam:
text_pt: E cinco travessas para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo; como também cinco travessas para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo, de ambos os lados, para o ocidente.
text_el: καὶ πέντε μοχλοὺς τῷ στύλῳ τῷ κλίτει τῆς σκηνῆς τῷ δευτέρῳ καὶ πέντε μοχλοὺς τῷ στύλῳ τῷ ὀπισθίῳ τῷ κλίτει τῆς σκηνῆς τῷ πρὸς θάλασσαν

text_en: And they shall be put along by the midst of the boards, from one end to the other.
text_la: qui mittentur per medias tabulas a summo usque ad summum.
text_pt: E a travessa central estará no meio das tábuas, passando de uma extremidade até à outra.
text_el: καὶ ὁ μοχλὸς ὁ μέσος ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν στύλων διικνείσθω ἀπὸ τοῦ ἑνὸς κλίτους εἰς τὸ ἕτερον κλίτος

text_en: The boards also themselves you shall overlay with gold, and shall cast rings of gold to be set upon them, for places for the bars to hold together the boardwork: which bars you shall cover with plates of gold.
text_la: Ipsas quoque tabulas deaurabis, et fundes in eis annulos aureos per quos vectes tabulata contineant : quos operies laminis aureis.
text_pt: E cobrirás de ouro as tábuas, e farás de ouro as suas argolas, para passar por elas as travessas; também as travessas as cobrirás de ouro.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς στύλους καταχρυσώσεις χρυσίῳ καὶ τοὺς δακτυλίους ποιήσεις χρυσοῦς εἰς οὓς εἰσάξεις τοὺς μοχλούς καὶ καταχρυσώσεις τοὺς μοχλοὺς χρυσίῳ

text_en: And you shall rear up the tabernacle according to the pattern that was shown you in the mount .
text_la: Et eriges tabernaculum juxta exemplar quod tibi in monte monstratum est.
text_pt: Então levantarás o tabernáculo conforme ao modelo que te foi mostrado no monte.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστήσεις τὴν σκηνὴν κατὰ τὸ εἶδος τὸ δεδειγμένον σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει

text_en: You shall make also a veil of violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine twisted linen, wrought with embroidered work and goodly variety:
text_la: Facies et velum de hyacintho, et purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso retorta, opere plumario et pulchra varietate contextum:
text_pt: Depois farás um véu de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e de linho fino torcido; com querubins de obra prima se fará.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις καταπέτασμα ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου κεκλωσμένου καὶ βύσσου νενησμένης ἔργον ὑφαντὸν ποιήσεις αὐτὸ χερουβιμ

text_en: And you shall hang it up before four pillars of setim wood , which themselves also shall be overlaid with gold, and shall have heads of gold, but sockets of silver.
text_la: quod appendes ante quatuor columnas de lignis setim, quæ ipsæ quidem deauratæ erunt, et habebunt capita aurea, sed bases argenteas.
text_pt: E colocá-lo-ás sobre quatro colunas de madeira de acácia, cobertas de ouro; seus colchetes serão de ouro, sobre quatro bases de prata.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσεις αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τεσσάρων στύλων ἀσήπτων κεχρυσωμένων χρυσίῳ καὶ αἱ κεφαλίδες αὐτῶν χρυσαῖ καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τέσσαρες ἀργυραῖ

text_en: And the veil shall be hanged on with rings, and within it you shall put the ark of the testimony , and the sanctuary and the holy of the holies shall be divided with it.
text_la: Inseretur autem velum per circulos, intra quod pones arcam testimonii, quo et sanctuarium, et sanctuarii sanctuaria dividentur.
text_pt: Pendurarás o véu debaixo dos colchetes, e porás a arca do testemunho ali dentro do véu; e este véu vos fará separação entre o santuário e o lugar santíssimo,
text_el: καὶ θήσεις τὸ καταπέτασμα ἐπὶ τοὺς στύλους καὶ εἰσοίσεις ἐκεῖ ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ διοριεῖ τὸ καταπέτασμα ὑμῖν ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ἁγίου τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: And you shall set the propitiatory upon the ark of the testimony , in the holy of holies.
text_la: Pones et propitiatorium super arcam testimonii in Sancto sanctorum,
text_pt: E porás a coberta do propiciatório sobre a arca do testemunho no lugar santíssimo,
text_el: καὶ κατακαλύψεις τῷ καταπετάσματι τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: And the table without the veil, and over against the table the candlestick in the south side of the tabernacle : for the table shall stand in the north side.
text_la: mensamque extra velum, et contra mensam candelabrum in latere tabernaculi meridiano : mensa enim stabit in parte aquilonis.
text_pt: E a mesa porás fora do véu, e o candelabro defronte da mesa, ao lado do tabernáculo, para o sul; mas a mesa porás ao lado do norte.
text_el: καὶ θήσεις τὴν τράπεζαν ἔξωθεν τοῦ καταπετάσματος καὶ τὴν λυχνίαν ἀπέναντι τῆς τραπέζης ἐπὶ μέρους τῆς σκηνῆς τὸ πρὸς νότον καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν θήσεις ἐπὶ μέρους τῆς σκηνῆς τὸ πρὸς βορρᾶν

text_en: You shall make also a hanging in the entrance of the tabernacle of violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine twisted linen with embroidered work .
text_la: Facies et tentorium in introitu tabernaculi de hyacintho, et purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso retorta, opere plumarii.
text_pt: Farás também para a porta da tenda, uma cortina de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e de linho fino torcido, de obra de bordador.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις ἐπίσπαστρον ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου κεκλωσμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης ἔργον ποικιλτοῦ

text_en: And you shall overlay with gold five pillars of setim wood , before which the hanging shall be drawn: their heads shall be of gold, and the sockets of brass.
text_la: Et quinque columnas deaurabis lignorum setim, ante quas ducetur tentorium : quarum erunt capita aurea, et bases æneæ.
text_pt: E farás para esta cortina cinco colunas de madeira de acácia, e as cobrirás de ouro; seus colchetes serão de ouro, e far-lhe-ás de fundição cinco bases de cobre.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τῷ καταπετάσματι πέντε στύλους καὶ χρυσώσεις αὐτοὺς χρυσίῳ καὶ αἱ κεφαλίδες αὐτῶν χρυσαῖ καὶ χωνεύσεις αὐτοῖς πέντε βάσεις χαλκᾶς

text_en: You shall make also an altar of setim wood , which shall be five cubits long, and as many broad, that is four square, and three cubits high.
text_la: Facies et altare de lignis setim, quod habebit quinque cubitus in longitudine, et totidem in latitudine, id est, quadrum, et tres cubitos in altitudine.
