text_pt: Farás também o altar de madeira de acácia; cinco côvados será o comprimento, e cinco côvados a largura (será quadrado o altar), e três côvados a sua altura.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις θυσιαστήριον ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων πέντε πήχεων τὸ μῆκος καὶ πέντε πήχεων τὸ εὖρος τετράγωνον ἔσται τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ τριῶν πήχεων τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And there shall be horns at the four corners of the same: and you shall cover it with brass.
text_la: Cornua autem per quatuor angulos ex ipso erunt : et operies illud ære.
text_pt: E farás as suas pontas nos seus quatro cantos; as suas pontas serão do mesmo, e o cobrirás de cobre.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τὰ κέρατα ἐπὶ τῶν τεσσάρων γωνιῶν ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔσται τὰ κέρατα καὶ καλύψεις αὐτὰ χαλκῷ

text_en: And you shall make for the uses thereof pans to receive the ashes, and tongs and fleshhooks, and firepans: all its vessels you shall make of brass.
text_la: Faciesque in usus ejus lebetes ad suscipiendos cineres, et forcipes atque fuscinulas, et ignium receptacula; omnia vasa ex ære fabricabis.
text_pt: Far-lhe-ás também os seus recipientes, para recolher a sua cinza, e as suas pás, e as suas bacias, e os seus garfos e os seus braseiros; todos os seus utensílios farás de cobre.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις στεφάνην τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ καὶ τὸν καλυπτῆρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς φιάλας αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς κρεάγρας αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ πυρεῖον αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ποιήσεις χαλκᾶ

text_en: And a grate of brass in manner of a net; at the four corners of which, shall be four rings of brass,
text_la: Craticulamque in modum retis æneam: per cujus quatuor angulos erunt quatuor annuli ænei.
text_pt: Far-lhe-ás também um crivo de cobre em forma de rede, e farás a esta rede quatro argolas de metal nos seus quatro cantos.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῷ ἐσχάραν ἔργῳ δικτυωτῷ χαλκῆν καὶ ποιήσεις τῇ ἐσχάρᾳ τέσσαρας δακτυλίους χαλκοῦς ἐπὶ τὰ τέσσαρα κλίτη

text_en: which you shall put under the hearth of the altar : and the grate shall be even to the midst of the altar .
text_la: Quos pones subter arulam altaris : eritque craticula usque ad altaris medium.
text_pt: E as porás dentro da borda do altar para baixo, de maneira que a rede chegue até ao meio do altar.
text_el: καὶ ὑποθήσεις αὐτοὺς ὑπὸ τὴν ἐσχάραν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου κάτωθεν ἔσται δὲ ἡ ἐσχάρα ἕως τοῦ ἡμίσους τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου

text_en: You shall make also two bars for the altar , of setim wood , which you shall cover with plates of brass:
text_la: Facies et vectes altaris de lignis setim duos, quos operies laminis æneis:
text_pt: Farás também varais para o altar, varais de madeira de acácia, e os cobrirás de cobre.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ φορεῖς ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων καὶ περιχαλκώσεις αὐτοὺς χαλκῷ

text_en: And you shall draw them through rings, and they shall be on both sides of the altar to carry it.
text_la: et induces per circulos, eruntque ex utroque latere altaris ad portandum.
text_pt: E os varais serão postos nas argolas, de maneira que os varais estejam de ambos os lados do altar, quando for levado.
text_el: καὶ εἰσάξεις τοὺς φορεῖς εἰς τοὺς δακτυλίους καὶ ἔστωσαν οἱ φορεῖς κατὰ τὰ πλευρὰ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ἐν τῷ αἴρειν αὐτό

text_en: You shall not make it solid, but empty and hollow in the inside, as it was shown you in the mount .
text_la: Non solidum, sed inane et cavum intrinsecus facies illud, sicut tibi in monte monstratum est.
text_pt: Oco e de tábuas o farás; como se te mostrou no monte, assim o farão.
text_el: κοῖλον σανιδωτὸν ποιήσεις αὐτό κατὰ τὸ παραδειχθέν σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει οὕτως ποιήσεις αὐτό

text_en: You shall make also the court of the tabernacle , in the south side whereof southward there shall be hangings of fine twisted linen of a hundred cubits long for one side.
text_la: Facies et atrium tabernaculi, in cujus australi plaga contra meridiem erunt tentoria de bysso retorta : centum cubitos unum latus tenebit in longitudine.
text_pt: Farás também o pátio do tabernáculo, ao lado meridional que dá para o sul; o pátio terá cortinas de linho fino torcido; o comprimento de cada lado será de cem côvados.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις αὐλὴν τῇ σκηνῇ εἰς τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς λίβα ἱστία τῆς αὐλῆς ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης μῆκος ἑκατὸν πηχῶν τῷ ἑνὶ κλίτει

text_en: And twenty pillars with as many sockets of brass, the heads of which, with their engraving, shall be of silver.
text_la: Et columnas viginti cum basibus totidem æneis, quæ capita cum cælaturis suis habebunt argentea.
text_pt: Também as suas vinte colunas e as suas vinte bases serão de cobre; os colchetes das colunas e as suas faixas serão de prata.
text_el: καὶ οἱ στῦλοι αὐτῶν εἴκοσι καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν εἴκοσι χαλκαῖ καὶ οἱ κρίκοι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ ψαλίδες αὐτῶν ἀργυραῖ

text_en: In like manner also on the north side there shall be hangings of a hundred cubits long, twenty pillars, and as many sockets of brass, and their heads with their engraving of silver.
text_la: Similiter et in latere aquilonis per longum erunt tentoria centum cubitorum, columnæ viginti, et bases æneæ ejusdem numeri, et capita earum cum cælaturis suis argentea.
text_pt: Assim também para o lado norte as cortinas, no comprimento, serão de cem côvados; e as suas vinte colunas e as suas vinte bases serão de cobre; os colchetes das colunas e as suas faixas serão de prata,
text_el: οὕτως τῷ κλίτει τῷ πρὸς ἀπηλιώτην ἱστία ἑκατὸν πηχῶν μῆκος καὶ οἱ στῦλοι αὐτῶν εἴκοσι καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν εἴκοσι χαλκαῖ καὶ οἱ κρίκοι καὶ αἱ ψαλίδες τῶν στύλων καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν περιηργυρωμέναι ἀργύρῳ

text_en: But in the breadth of the court , that looks to the west, there shall be hangings of fifty cubits, and ten pillars, and as many sockets.
text_la: In latitudine vero atrii, quod respicit ad occidentem, erunt tentoria per quinquaginta cubitos, et columnæ decem, basesque totidem.
text_pt: E na largura do pátio para o lado do ocidente haverá cortinas de cinqüenta côvados; as suas colunas dez, e as suas bases dez.
text_el: τὸ δὲ εὖρος τῆς αὐλῆς τὸ κατὰ θάλασσαν ἱστία πεντήκοντα πηχῶν στῦλοι αὐτῶν δέκα καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν δέκα

text_en: In that breadth also of the court , which looks to the east, there shall be fifty cubits.
text_la: In ea quoque atrii latitudine, quæ respicit ad orientem, quinquaginta cubiti erunt.
text_pt: Semelhantemente a largura do pátio do lado oriental para o levante será de cinqüenta côvados.
text_el: καὶ εὖρος τῆς αὐλῆς τὸ πρὸς νότον ἱστία πεντήκοντα πήχεων στῦλοι αὐτῶν δέκα καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν δέκα

text_en: In which there shall be for one side, hangings of fifteen cubits, and three pillars, and as many sockets.
text_la: In quibus quindecim cubitorum tentoria lateri uno deputabuntur, columnæque tres et bases totidem:
text_pt: De maneira que haja quinze côvados de cortinas de um lado; suas colunas três, e as suas bases três.
text_el: καὶ πεντεκαίδεκα πήχεων τὸ ὕψος τῶν ἱστίων τῷ κλίτει τῷ ἑνί στῦλοι αὐτῶν τρεῖς καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τρεῖς

text_en: And in the other side, there shall be hangings of fifteen cubits, with three pillars, and as many sockets.
text_la: et in latere altero erunt tentoria cubitos obtinentia quindecim, columnæ tres, et bases totidem.
text_pt: E quinze côvados das cortinas do outro lado; as suas colunas três, e as suas bases três.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ δεύτερον δέκα πέντε πηχῶν τῶν ἱστίων τὸ ὕψος στῦλοι αὐτῶν τρεῖς καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τρεῖς

text_en: And in the entrance of the court there shall be made a hanging of twenty cubits of violet and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine twisted linen, with embroidered work : it shall have four pillars, with as many sockets.
text_la: In introitu vero atrii fiet tentorium cubitorum viginti ex hyacintho et purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso retorta, opere plumarii : columnas habebit quatuor, cum basibus totidem.
text_pt: E à porta do pátio haverá uma cortina de vinte côvados, de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e de linho fino torcido, de obra de bordador; as suas colunas quatro, e as suas bases quatro.
text_el: καὶ τῇ πύλῃ τῆς αὐλῆς κάλυμμα εἴκοσι πηχῶν τὸ ὕψος ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου κεκλωσμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης τῇ ποικιλίᾳ τοῦ ῥαφιδευτοῦ στῦλοι αὐτῶν τέσσαρες καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τέσσαρες

text_en: All the pillars of the court round about shall be garnished with plates of silver, silver heads, and sockets of brass.
text_la: Omnes columnæ atrii per circuitum vestitæ erunt argenteis laminis, capitibus argenteis, et basibus æneis.
text_pt: Todas as colunas do pátio ao redor serão cingidas de faixas de prata; os seus colchetes serão de prata, mas as suas bases de cobre.
text_el: πάντες οἱ στῦλοι τῆς αὐλῆς κύκλῳ κατηργυρωμένοι ἀργυρίῳ καὶ αἱ κεφαλίδες αὐτῶν ἀργυραῖ καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν χαλκαῖ

text_en: In length the court shall take up a hundred cubits, in breadth fifty, the height shall be of five cubits, and it shall be made of fine twisted linen, and shall have sockets of brass.
text_la: In longitudine occupabit atrium cubitos centum, in latitudine quinquaginta, altitudo quinque cubitorum erit : fietque de bysso retorta, et habebit bases æneas.
text_pt: O comprimento do pátio será de cem côvados, e a largura de cada lado de cinqüenta, e a altura de cinco côvados, as cortinas serão de linho fino torcido; mas as suas bases serão de cobre.
text_el: τὸ δὲ μῆκος τῆς αὐλῆς ἑκατὸν ἐφ' ἑκατόν καὶ εὖρος πεντήκοντα ἐπὶ πεντήκοντα καὶ ὕψος πέντε πηχῶν ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν χαλκαῖ

text_en: All the vessels of the tabernacle for all uses and ceremonies , and the pins both of it and of the court , you shall make of brass.
text_la: Cuncta vasa tabernaculi in omnes usus et cæremonias, tam paxillos ejus quam atrii, ex ære facies.
text_pt: No tocante a todos os vasos do tabernáculo em todo o seu serviço, até todos os seus pregos, e todos os pregos do pátio, serão de cobre.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα ἡ κατασκευὴ καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐργαλεῖα καὶ οἱ πάσσαλοι τῆς αὐλῆς χαλκοῖ

text_en: Command the children of Israel that they bring you the purest oil of the olives, and beaten with a pestle: that a lamp may burn always,
text_la: Præcipe filiis Israël ut afferant tibi oleum de arboribus olivarum purissimum, piloque contusum, ut ardeat lucerna semper
text_pt: Tu pois ordenarás aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite puro de oliveiras, batido, para o candeeiro, para fazer arder as lâmpadas continuamente.
text_el: καὶ σὺ σύνταξον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ λαβέτωσάν σοι ἔλαιον ἐξ ἐλαίων ἄτρυγον καθαρὸν κεκομμένον εἰς φῶς καῦσαι ἵνα κάηται λύχνος διὰ παντός

text_en: in the tabernacle of the testimony , without the veil that hangs before the testimony. And Aaron and his sons shall order it, that it may give light before the Lord until the morning. It shall be a perpetual observance throughout their successions among the children of Israel .
text_la: in tabernaculo testimonii, extra velum quod oppansum est testimonio. Et collocabunt eam Aaron et filii ejus, ut usque mane luceat coram Domino. Perpetuus erit cultus per successiones eorum a filiis Israël.
text_pt: Na tenda da congregação, fora do véu que está diante do testemunho, Arão e seus filhos as porão em ordem, desde a tarde até a manhã, perante o Senhor; isto será um estatuto perpétuo para os filhos de Israel, pelas suas gerações.
text_el: ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἔξωθεν τοῦ καταπετάσματος τοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς διαθήκης καύσει αὐτὸ Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἀφ' ἑσπέρας ἕως πρωὶ ἐναντίον κυρίου νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: Take unto you also Aaron your brother with his sons, from among the children of Israel , that they may minister to me in the priest's office: Aaron , Nadab, and Abiu, Eleazar , and Ithamar.
text_la: Applica quoque ad te Aaron fratrem tuum cum filiis suis de medio filiorum Israël, ut sacerdotio fungantur mihi : Aaron, Nadab, et Abiu, Eleazar, et Ithamar.
text_pt: Depois tu farás chegar a ti teu irmão Arão, e seus filhos com ele, do meio dos filhos de Israel, para me administrarem o ofício sacerdotal; a saber: Arão, Nadabe, e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar, os filhos de Arão.
text_el: καὶ σὺ προσαγάγου πρὸς σεαυτὸν τόν τε Ααρων τὸν ἀδελφόν σου καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἱερατεύειν μοι Ααρων καὶ Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ καὶ Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ υἱοὺς Ααρων

text_en: And you shall make a holy vesture for Aaron , your brother, for glory and for beauty.
text_la: Faciesque vestem sanctam Aaron fratri tuo in gloriam et decorem.
text_pt: E farás vestes sagradas a Arão teu irmão, para glória e ornamento.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις στολὴν ἁγίαν Ααρων τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου εἰς τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν

text_en: And you shall speak to all the wise of heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they may make Aaron's vestments , in which he being consecrated , may minister to me.
text_la: Et loqueris cunctis sapientibus corde quos replevi spiritu prudentiæ, ut faciant vestes Aaron, in quibus sanctificatus ministret mihi.
text_pt: Falarás também a todos os que são sábios de coração, a quem eu tenho enchido do espírito da sabedoria, que façam vestes a Arão para santificá-lo; para que me administre o ofício sacerdotal.
text_el: καὶ σὺ λάλησον πᾶσι τοῖς σοφοῖς τῇ διανοίᾳ οὓς ἐνέπλησα πνεύματος αἰσθήσεως καὶ ποιήσουσιν τὴν στολὴν τὴν ἁγίαν Ααρων εἰς τὸ ἅγιον ἐν ᾗ ἱερατεύσει μοι

text_en: And these shall be the vestments that they shall make: A rational and an ephod , a tunic and a strait linen garment, a mitre and a girdle. They shall make the holy vestments for your brother Aaron and his sons, that they may do the office of priesthood unto me.
text_la: Hæc autem erunt vestimenta quæ faciet : rationale et superhumerale, tunicam et lineam strictam, cidarim et balteum. Facient vestimenta sancta fratri tuo Aaron et filiis ejus, ut sacerdotio fungantur mihi.
text_pt: Estas pois são as vestes que farão: um peitoral, e um éfode, e um manto, e uma túnica bordada, uma mitra, e um cinto; farão, pois, santas vestes para Arão, teu irmão, e para seus filhos, para me administrarem o ofício sacerdotal.
text_el: καὶ αὗται αἱ στολαί ἃς ποιήσουσιν τὸ περιστήθιον καὶ τὴν ἐπωμίδα καὶ τὸν ποδήρη καὶ χιτῶνα κοσυμβωτὸν καὶ κίδαριν καὶ ζώνην καὶ ποιήσουσιν στολὰς ἁγίας Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἱερατεύειν μοι

text_en: And they shall take gold, and violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine linen.
text_la: Accipientque aurum, et hyacinthum, et purpuram, coccumque bis tinctum, et byssum.
text_pt: E tomarão o ouro, e o azul, e a púrpura, e o carmesim, e o linho fino,
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ λήμψονται τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὴν ὑάκινθον καὶ τὴν πορφύραν καὶ τὸ κόκκινον καὶ τὴν βύσσον

text_en: And they shall make the ephod of gold, and violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine twisted linen, embroidered with divers colours.
text_la: Facient autem superhumerale de auro et hyacintho et purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso retorta, opere polymito.
text_pt: E farão o éfode de ouro, e de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido, de obra esmerada.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσουσιν τὴν ἐπωμίδα ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης ἔργον ὑφαντὸν ποικιλτοῦ

text_en: It shall have the two edges joined in the top on both sides, that they may be closed together.
text_la: Duas oras junctas habebit in utroque latere summitatum, ut in unum redeant.
text_pt: Terá duas ombreiras, que se unam às suas duas pontas, e assim se unirá.
text_el: δύο ἐπωμίδες συνέχουσαι ἔσονται αὐτῷ ἑτέρα τὴν ἑτέραν ἐπὶ τοῖς δυσὶ μέρεσιν ἐξηρτημέναι

text_en: The very workmanship also, and all the variety of the work, shall be of gold, and violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine twisted linen.
text_la: Ipsa quoque textura et cuncta operis varietas erit ex auro et hyacintho, et purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso retorta.
text_pt: E o cinto de obra esmerada do seu éfode, que estará sobre ele, será da sua mesma obra, igualmente, de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὕφασμα τῶν ἐπωμίδων ὅ ἐστιν ἐπ' αὐτῷ κατὰ τὴν ποίησιν ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔσται ἐκ χρυσίου καὶ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου διανενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης

text_en: And you shall take two onyx stones, and shall grave on them the names of the children of Israel :
text_la: Sumesque duos lapides onychinos, et sculpes in eis nomina filiorum Israël:
text_pt: E tomarás duas pedras de ônix, e gravarás nelas os nomes dos filhos de Israel,
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ τοὺς δύο λίθους λίθους σμαράγδου καὶ γλύψεις ἐν αὐτοῖς τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: Six names on one stone, and the other six on the other, according to the order of their birth.
text_la: sex nomina in lapide uno, et sex reliqua in altero, juxta ordinem nativitatis eorum.
text_pt: Seis dos seus nomes numa pedra, e os outros seis nomes na outra pedra, segundo as suas gerações;
text_el: ἓξ ὀνόματα ἐπὶ τὸν λίθον τὸν ἕνα καὶ τὰ ἓξ ὀνόματα τὰ λοιπὰ ἐπὶ τὸν λίθον τὸν δεύτερον κατὰ τὰς γενέσεις αὐτῶν

text_en: With the work of an engraver, and the graving of a jeweller, you shall engrave them with the names of the children of Israel , set in gold and compassed about:
text_la: Opere sculptoris et cælatura gemmarii, sculpes eos nominibus filiorum Israël, inclusos auro atque circumdatos:
text_pt: Conforme à obra do lapidário, como o lavor de selos lavrarás estas duas pedras, com os nomes dos filhos de Israel; engastadas ao redor em ouro as farás.
text_el: ἔργον λιθουργικῆς τέχνης γλύμμα σφραγῖδος διαγλύψεις τοὺς δύο λίθους ἐπὶ τοῖς ὀνόμασιν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And you shall put them in both sides of the ephod , a memorial for the children of Israel . And Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord upon both shoulders, for a remembrance.
text_la: et pones in utroque latere superhumeralis, memoriale filiis Israël. Portabitque Aaron nomina eorum coram Domino super utrumque humerum, ob recordationem.
text_pt: E porás as duas pedras nas ombreiras do éfode, por pedras de memória para os filhos de Israel; e Arão levará os seus nomes sobre ambos os seus ombros, para memória diante do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ θήσεις τοὺς δύο λίθους ἐπὶ τῶν ὤμων τῆς ἐπωμίδος λίθοι μνημοσύνου εἰσὶν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἀναλήμψεται Ααρων τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἔναντι κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν δύο ὤμων αὐτοῦ μνημόσυνον περὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: You shall make also hooks of gold.
text_la: Facies et uncinos ex auro,
text_pt: Farás também engastes de ouro,
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις ἀσπιδίσκας ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ

text_en: And two little chains of the purest gold, linked one to another, which you shall put into the hooks.
text_la: et duas catenulas ex auro purissimo sibi invicem cohærentes, quas inseres uncinis.
text_pt: E duas cadeiazinhas de ouro puro; de igual medida, de obra de fieira as farás; e as cadeiazinhas de fieira porás nos engastes.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις δύο κροσσωτὰ ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ καταμεμιγμένα ἐν ἄνθεσιν ἔργον πλοκῆς καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τὰ κροσσωτὰ τὰ πεπλεγμένα ἐπὶ τὰς ἀσπιδίσκας κατὰ τὰς παρωμίδας αὐτῶν ἐκ τῶν ἐμπροσθίων

text_en: And you shall make the rational of judgment with embroidered work of divers colours, according to the workmanship of the ephod , of gold, violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine twisted linen.
text_la: Rationale quoque judicii facies opere polymito juxta texturam superhumeralis, ex auro, hyacintho, et purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso retorta.
text_pt: Farás também o peitoral do juízo de obra esmerada, conforme à obra do éfode o farás; de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido o farás.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις λογεῖον τῶν κρίσεων ἔργον ποικιλτοῦ κατὰ τὸν ῥυθμὸν τῆς ἐπωμίδος ποιήσεις αὐτό ἐκ χρυσίου καὶ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου κεκλωσμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης ποιήσεις αὐτό

text_en: It shall be four square and doubled: it shall be the measure of a span both in length and in breadth.
text_la: Quadrangulum erit et duplex : mensuram palmi habebit tam in longitudine quam in latitudine.
text_pt: Quadrado e duplo, será de um palmo o seu comprimento, e de um palmo a sua largura.
text_el: τετράγωνον ἔσται διπλοῦν σπιθαμῆς τὸ μῆκος καὶ σπιθαμῆς τὸ εὖρος

text_en: And you shall set in it four rows of stones . In the first row shall be a sardius stone, and a topaz, and an emerald:
text_la: Ponesque in eo quatuor ordines lapidum : in primo versu erit lapis sardius, et topazius, et smaragdus:
text_pt: E o encherás de pedras de engaste, com quatro ordens de pedras; a ordem de um sárdio, de um topázio, e de um carbúnculo; esta será a primeira ordem;
text_el: καὶ καθυφανεῖς ἐν αὐτῷ ὕφασμα κατάλιθον τετράστιχον στίχος λίθων ἔσται σάρδιον τοπάζιον καὶ σμάραγδος ὁ στίχος ὁ εἷς

text_en: In the second a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a jasper:
text_la: in secundo carbunculus, sapphirus, et jaspis:
text_pt: E a segunda ordem será de uma esmeralda, de uma safira, e de um diamante;
text_el: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ δεύτερος ἄνθραξ καὶ σάπφειρος καὶ ἴασπις

text_en: In the third a ligurius, an agate, and an amethyst:
text_la: in tertio ligurius, achates, et amethystus:
text_pt: E a terceira ordem será de um jacinto, de uma ágata, e de uma ametista;
text_el: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ τρίτος λιγύριον ἀχάτης καὶ ἀμέθυστος

text_en: In the fourth a chrysolite, an onyx, and a beryl. They shall be set in gold by their rows.
text_la: in quarto chrysolithus, onychinus, et beryllus. Inclusi auro erunt per ordines suos.
text_pt: E a quarta ordem será de um berilo, e de um ônix, e de um jaspe; engastadas em ouro serão nos seus engastes.
text_el: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ τέταρτος χρυσόλιθος καὶ βηρύλλιον καὶ ὀνύχιον περικεκαλυμμένα χρυσίῳ συνδεδεμένα ἐν χρυσίῳ ἔστωσαν κατὰ στίχον αὐτῶν

text_en: And they shall have the names of the children of Israel : with twelve names shall they be engraved, each stone with the name of one according to the twelve tribes .
text_la: Habebuntque nomina filiorum Israël : duodecim nominibus cælabuntur, singuli lapides nominibus singulorum per duodecim tribus.
text_pt: E serão aquelas pedras segundo os nomes dos filhos de Israel, doze segundo os seus nomes; serão esculpidas como selos, cada uma com o seu nome, para as doze tribos.
text_el: καὶ οἱ λίθοι ἔστωσαν ἐκ τῶν ὀνομάτων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ δέκα δύο κατὰ τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν γλυφαὶ σφραγίδων ἕκαστος κατὰ τὸ ὄνομα ἔστωσαν εἰς δέκα δύο φυλάς

text_en: And you shall make on the rational chains, linked one to another, of the purest gold:
text_la: Facies in rationali catenas sibi invicem cohærentes ex auro purissimo,
text_pt: Também farás para o peitoral cadeiazinhas de igual medida, obra trançada de ouro puro.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις ἐπὶ τὸ λογεῖον κροσσοὺς συμπεπλεγμένους ἔργον ἁλυσιδωτὸν ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ

text_en: And two rings of gold, which you shall put in the two ends at the top of the rational .
text_la: et duos annulos aureos, quos pones in utraque rationalis summitate:
text_pt: Também farás para o peitoral dois anéis de ouro, e porás os dois anéis nas extremidades do peitoral.

text_en: And the golden chains you shall join to the rings, that are in the ends thereof.
text_la: catenasque aureas junges annulis, qui sunt in marginibus ejus,
text_pt: Então porás as duas cadeiazinhas de fieira de ouro nos dois anéis, nas extremidades do peitoral;

text_en: And the ends of the chains themselves, you shall join together with two hooks, on both sides of the ephod , which is towards the rational .
text_la: et ipsarum catenarum extrema duobus copulabis uncinis in utroque latere superhumeralis quod rationale respicit.
text_pt: E as duas pontas das duas cadeiazinhas de fieira colocarás nos dois engastes, e as porás nas ombreiras do éfode, na frente dele.

text_en: You shall make also two rings of gold, which you shall put in the top parts of the rational , in the borders that are over against the ephod , and look towards the back parts thereof.
text_la: Facies et duos annulos aureos, quos pones in summitatibus rationalis, in oris, quæ e regione sunt superhumeralis, et posteriora ejus aspiciunt.
text_pt: Farás também dois anéis de ouro, e os porás nas duas extremidades do peitoral, na sua borda que estiver junto ao éfode por dentro.

text_en: Moreover also other two rings of gold, which are to be set on each side of the ephod beneath, that looks towards the nether joining, that the rational may be fitted with the ephod ,
text_la: Necnon et alios duos annulos aureos, qui ponendi sunt in utroque latere superhumeralis deorsum, quod respicit contra faciem juncturæ inferioris, ut aptari possit cum superhumerali,
text_pt: Farás também dois anéis de ouro, que porás nas duas ombreiras do éfode, abaixo, na frente dele, perto da sua juntura, sobre o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode.

text_en: and may be fastened by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a violet fillet, that the joining artificially wrought may continue, and the rational and the ephod may not be loosed one from the other.
text_la: et stringatur rationale annulis suis cum annulis superhumeralis vitta hyacinthina, ut maneat junctura fabrefacta, et a se invicem rationale et superhumerale nequeant separari.
text_pt: E ligarão o peitoral, com os seus anéis, aos anéis do éfode por cima, com um cordão de azul, para que esteja sobre o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode; e nunca se separará o peitoral do éfode.

text_en: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the rational of judgment upon his breast, when he shall enter into the sanctuary, a memorial before the Lord for ever.
text_la: Portabitque Aaron nomina filiorum Israël in rationali judicii super pectus suum, quando ingredietur Sanctuarium, memoriale coram Domino in æternum.
text_pt: Assim Arão levará os nomes dos filhos de Israel no peitoral do juízo sobre o seu coração, quando entrar no santuário, para memória diante do Senhor continuamente.
text_el: καὶ λήμψεται Ααρων τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τοῦ λογείου τῆς κρίσεως ἐπὶ τοῦ στήθους εἰσιόντι εἰς τὸ ἅγιον μνημόσυνον ἔναντι τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And you shall put in the rational of judgment doctrine and truth , which shall be on Aaron's breast, when he shall go in before the Lord : and he shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his breast, in the sight of the Lord always.
text_la: Pones autem in rationali judicii Doctrinam et Veritatem, quæ erunt in pectore Aaron, quando ingredietur coram Domino : et gestabit judicium filiorum Israël in pectore suo, in conspectu Domini semper.
text_pt: Também porás no peitoral do juízo Urim e Tumim, para que estejam sobre o coração de Arão, quando entrar diante do Senhor: assim Arão levará o juízo dos filhos de Israel sobre o seu coração diante do Senhor continuamente.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἐπὶ τὸ λογεῖον τῆς κρίσεως τὴν δήλωσιν καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν καὶ ἔσται ἐπὶ τοῦ στήθους Ααρων ὅταν εἰσπορεύηται εἰς τὸ ἅγιον ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ οἴσει Ααρων τὰς κρίσεις τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τοῦ στήθους ἐναντίον κυρίου διὰ παντός

text_en: And you shall make the tunic of the ephod all of violet,
text_la: Facies et tunicam superhumeralis totam hyacinthinam,
text_pt: Também farás o manto do éfode, todo de azul.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις ὑποδύτην ποδήρη ὅλον ὑακίνθινον

text_en: in the midst whereof above shall be a hole for the head, and a border round about it woven, as is wont to be made in the outmost parts of garments, that it may not easily be broken.
text_la: in cujus medio supra erit capitium, et ora per gyrum ejus textilis, sicut fieri solet in extremis vestium partibus, ne facile rumpatur.
text_pt: E a abertura da cabeça estará no meio dele; esta abertura terá uma borda de obra tecida ao redor; como abertura de cota de malha será, para que não se rompa.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ περιστόμιον ἐξ αὐτοῦ μέσον ᾤαν ἔχον κύκλῳ τοῦ περιστομίου ἔργον ὑφάντου τὴν συμβολὴν συνυφασμένην ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἵνα μὴ ῥαγῇ

text_en: And beneath at the feet of the same tunic , round about, you shall make as it were pomegranates, of violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, with little bells set between:
text_la: Deorsum vero, ad pedes ejusdem tunicæ, per circuitum, quasi mala punica facies, ex hyacintho, et purpura, et cocco bis tincto, mistis in medio tintinnabulis,
text_pt: E nas suas bordas farás romãs de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, ao redor das suas bordas; e campainhas de ouro no meio delas ao redor.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις ἐπὶ τὸ λῶμα τοῦ ὑποδύτου κάτωθεν ὡσεὶ ἐξανθούσης ῥόας ῥοίσκους ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου διανενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης ἐπὶ τοῦ λώματος τοῦ ὑποδύτου κύκλῳ τὸ αὐτὸ δὲ εἶδος ῥοίσκους χρυσοῦς καὶ κώδωνας ἀνὰ μέσον τούτων περικύκλῳ

text_en: So that there shall be a golden bell and a pomegranate, and again another golden bell and a pomegranate.
text_la: ita ut tintinnabulum sit aureum et malum punicum : rursumque tintinnabulum aliud aureum et malum punicum.
text_pt: Uma campainha de ouro, e uma romã, outra campainha de ouro, e outra romã, haverá nas bordas do manto ao redor,
text_el: παρὰ ῥοίσκον χρυσοῦν κώδωνα καὶ ἄνθινον ἐπὶ τοῦ λώματος τοῦ ὑποδύτου κύκλῳ

text_en: And Aaron shall be vested with it in the office of his ministry, that the sound may be heard, when he goes in and comes out of the sanctuary, in the sight of the Lord , and that he may not die.
text_la: Et vestietur ea Aaron in officio ministerii, ut audiatur sonitus quando ingreditur et egreditur sanctuarium in conspectu Domini, et non moriatur.
text_pt: E estará sobre Arão quando ministrar, para que se ouça o seu sonido, quando entrar no santuário diante do Senhor, e quando sair, para que não morra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Ααρων ἐν τῷ λειτουργεῖν ἀκουστὴ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ εἰσιόντι εἰς τὸ ἅγιον ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ἐξιόντι ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνῃ

text_en: You shall make also a plate of the purest gold: wherein you shall grave with engraver's work, Holy to the Lord .
text_la: Facies et laminam de auro purissimo, in qua sculpes opere cælatoris, Sanctum Domino.
text_pt: Também farás uma lâmina de ouro puro, e nela gravarás como as gravuras de selos: SANTIDADE AO SENHOR.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις πέταλον χρυσοῦν καθαρὸν καὶ ἐκτυπώσεις ἐν αὐτῷ ἐκτύπωμα σφραγῖδος ἁγίασμα κυρίου

text_en: And you shall tie it with a violet fillet, and it shall be upon the mitre ,
text_la: Ligabisque eam vitta hyacinthina, et erit super tiaram,
text_pt: E atá-la-ás com um cordão de azul, de modo que esteja na mitra, na frente da mitra estará;
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσεις αὐτὸ ἐπὶ ὑακίνθου κεκλωσμένης καὶ ἔσται ἐπὶ τῆς μίτρας κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς μίτρας ἔσται

text_en: hanging over the forehead of the high priest . And Aaron shall bear the iniquities of those things, which the children of Israel have offered and sanctified , in all their gifts and offerings . And the plate shall be always on his forehead, that the Lord may be well pleased with them.
text_la: imminens fronti pontificis. Portabitque Aaron iniquitates eorum, quæ obtulerunt et sanctificaverunt filii Israël, in cunctis muneribus et donariis suis. Erit autem lamina semper in fronte ejus, ut placatus sit eis Dominus.
text_pt: E estará sobre a testa de Arão, para que Arão leve a iniqüidade das coisas santas, que os filhos de Israel santificarem em todas as ofertas de suas coisas santas; e estará continuamente na sua testa, para que tenham aceitação perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐπὶ τοῦ μετώπου Ααρων καὶ ἐξαρεῖ Ααρων τὰ ἁμαρτήματα τῶν ἁγίων ὅσα ἂν ἁγιάσωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ παντὸς δόματος τῶν ἁγίων αὐτῶν καὶ ἔσται ἐπὶ τοῦ μετώπου Ααρων διὰ παντός δεκτὸν αὐτοῖς ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And you shall gird the tunic with fine linen, and you shall make a fine linen mitre , and a girdle of embroidered work .
text_la: Stringesque tunicam bysso, et tiaram byssinam facies, et balteum opere plumarii.
text_pt: Também farás túnica de linho fino; também farás uma mitra de linho fino; mas o cinto farás de obra de bordador.
text_el: καὶ οἱ κόσυμβοι τῶν χιτώνων ἐκ βύσσου καὶ ποιήσεις κίδαριν βυσσίνην καὶ ζώνην ποιήσεις ἔργον ποικιλτοῦ

text_en: Moreover, for the sons of Aaron you shall prepare linen tunics , and girdles and mitres for glory and beauty:
text_la: Porro filiis Aaron tunicas lineas parabis et balteos ac tiaras in gloriam et decorem:
text_pt: Também farás túnicas aos filhos de Arão, e far-lhes-ás cintos; também lhes farás tiaras, para glória e ornamento.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων ποιήσεις χιτῶνας καὶ ζώνας καὶ κιδάρεις ποιήσεις αὐτοῖς εἰς τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν

text_en: And with all these things you shall vest Aaron your brother, and his sons with him. And you shall consecrate the hands of them all, and shall sanctify them, that they may do the office of priesthood unto me.
text_la: vestiesque his omnibus Aaron fratrem tuum et filios ejus cum eo. Et cunctorum consecrabis manus, sanctificabisque illos, ut sacerdotio fungantur mihi.
text_pt: E vestirás com eles a Arão, teu irmão, e também seus filhos; e os ungirás e consagrarás, e os santificarás, para que me administrem o sacerdócio.
text_el: καὶ ἐνδύσεις αὐτὰ Ααρων τὸν ἀδελφόν σου καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ χρίσεις αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐμπλήσεις αὐτῶν τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ἁγιάσεις αὐτούς ἵνα ἱερατεύωσίν μοι

text_en: You shall make also linen breeches, to cover the flesh of their nakedness, from the reins to the thighs:
text_la: Facies et feminalia linea, ut operiant carnem turpitudinis suæ, a renibus usque ad femora:
text_pt: Faze-lhes também calções de linho, para cobrirem a carne nua; irão dos lombos até as coxas.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτοῖς περισκελῆ λινᾶ καλύψαι ἀσχημοσύνην χρωτὸς αὐτῶν ἀπὸ ὀσφύος ἕως μηρῶν ἔσται

text_en: And Aaron and his sons shall use them when they shall go into the tabernacle of the testimony , or when they approach to the altar to minister in the sanctuary lest being guilty of iniquity they die. It shall be a law for ever to Aaron , and to his seed after him.
text_la: et utentur eis Aaron et filii ejus quando ingredientur tabernaculum testimonii, vel quando appropinquant ad altare ut ministrent in sanctuario, ne iniquitatis rei moriantur. Legitimum sempiternum erit Aaron, et semini ejus post eum.
text_pt: E estarão sobre Arão e sobre seus filhos, quando entrarem na tenda da congregação, ou quando chegarem ao altar para ministrar no santuário, para que não levem iniqüidade e morram; isto será estatuto perpétuo para ele e para a sua descendência depois dele.
text_el: καὶ ἕξει Ααρων αὐτὰ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς ἂν εἰσπορεύωνται εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἢ ὅταν προσπορεύωνται λειτουργεῖν πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ οὐκ ἐπάξονται πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς ἁμαρτίαν ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνωσιν νόμιμον αἰώνιον αὐτῷ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτόν

text_en: And you shall also do this, that they may be consecrated to me in priesthood . Take a calf from the herd, and two rams without blemish,
text_la: Sed et hoc facies, ut mihi in sacerdotio consecrentur. Tolle vitulum de armento, et arietes duos immaculatos,
text_pt: Isto é o que lhes hás de fazer, para os santificar, para que me administrem o sacerdócio: Toma um novilho e dois carneiros sem mácula,
text_el: καὶ ταῦτά ἐστιν ἃ ποιήσεις αὐτοῖς ἁγιάσαι αὐτοὺς ὥστε ἱερατεύειν μοι αὐτούς λήμψῃ μοσχάριον ἐκ βοῶν ἓν καὶ κριοὺς δύο ἀμώμους

text_en: and unleavened bread , and a cake without leaven , tempered with oil, wafers also unleavened , anointed with oil: you shall make them all of wheaten flour.
text_la: panesque azymos, et crustulam absque fermento, quæ conspersa sit oleo, lagana quoque azyma oleo lita : de simila triticea cuncta facies.
text_pt: E pão ázimo, e bolos ázimos, amassados com azeite, e coscorões ázimos, untados com azeite; com flor de farinha de trigo os farás,
text_el: καὶ ἄρτους ἀζύμους πεφυραμένους ἐν ἐλαίῳ καὶ λάγανα ἄζυμα κεχρισμένα ἐν ἐλαίῳ σεμίδαλιν ἐκ πυρῶν ποιήσεις αὐτά

text_en: And you shall put them in a basket, and offer them: and the calf and the two rams.
text_la: Et posita in canistro offeres: vitulum autem et duos arietes.
text_pt: E os porás num cesto, e os trarás no cesto, com o novilho e os dois carneiros.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσεις αὐτὰ ἐπὶ κανοῦν ἓν καὶ προσοίσεις αὐτὰ ἐπὶ τῷ κανῷ καὶ τὸ μοσχάριον καὶ τοὺς δύο κριούς

text_en: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony . And when you have washed the father and his sons with water,
text_la: Et Aaron ac filios ejus applicabis ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii. Cumque laveris patrem cum filiis suis aqua,
text_pt: Então farás chegar a Arão e a seus filhos à porta da tenda da congregação, e os lavarás com água;
text_el: καὶ Ααρων καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ προσάξεις ἐπὶ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ λούσεις αὐτοὺς ἐν ὕδατι

text_en: you shall clothe Aaron with his vestments , that is, with the linen garment and the tunic , and the ephod and the rational , which you shall gird with the girdle.
text_la: indues Aaron vestimentis suis, id est, linea et tunica, et superhumerali et rationali, quod constringes balteo.
text_pt: Depois tomarás as vestes, e vestirás a Arão da túnica e do manto do éfode, e do éfode, e do peitoral; e o cingirás com o cinto de obra de artífice do éfode.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν τὰς στολὰς ἐνδύσεις Ααρων τὸν ἀδελφόν σου καὶ τὸν χιτῶνα τὸν ποδήρη καὶ τὴν ἐπωμίδα καὶ τὸ λογεῖον καὶ συνάψεις αὐτῷ τὸ λογεῖον πρὸς τὴν ἐπωμίδα

text_en: And you shall put the mitre upon his head, and the holy plate upon the mitre ,
text_la: Et pones tiaram in capite ejus, et laminam sanctam super tiaram,
text_pt: E a mitra porás sobre a sua cabeça; a coroa da santidade porás sobre a mitra.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τὴν μίτραν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τὸ πέταλον τὸ ἁγίασμα ἐπὶ τὴν μίτραν

text_en: and you shall pour the oil of unction upon his head: and by this rite shall he be consecrated .
text_la: et oleum unctionis fundes super caput ejus : atque hoc ritu consecrabitur.
text_pt: E tomarás o azeite da unção, e o derramarás sobre a sua cabeça; assim o ungirás.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ τοῦ ἐλαίου τοῦ χρίσματος καὶ ἐπιχεεῖς αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ χρίσεις αὐτόν

text_en: You shall bring his sons also, and shall put on them the linen tunics , and gird them with a girdle:
text_la: Filios quoque illius applicabis, et indues tunicis lineis, cingesque balteo,
text_pt: Depois farás chegar seus filhos, e lhes farás vestir túnicas.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ προσάξεις καὶ ἐνδύσεις αὐτοὺς χιτῶνας

text_en: To wit, Aaron and his children, and you shall put mitres upon them; and they shall be priests to me by a perpetual ordinance. After you shall have consecrated their hands,
text_la: Aaron scilicet et liberos ejus, et impones eis mitras : eruntque sacerdotes mihi religione perpetua. Postquam initiaveris manus eorum,
text_pt: E os cingirás com o cinto, a Arão e a seus filhos, e lhes atarás as tiaras, para que tenham o sacerdócio por estatuto perpétuo, e consagrarás a Arão e a seus filhos;
text_el: καὶ ζώσεις αὐτοὺς ταῖς ζώναις καὶ περιθήσεις αὐτοῖς τὰς κιδάρεις καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῖς ἱερατεία ἐμοὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ τελειώσεις τὰς χεῖρας Ααρων καὶ τὰς χεῖρας τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: you shall present also the calf before the tabernacle of the testimony . And Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon his head,
text_la: applicabis et vitulum coram tabernaculo testimonii. Imponentque Aaron et filii ejus manus super caput illius,
text_pt: E farás chegar o novilho diante da tenda da congregação, e Arão e seus filhos porão as suas mãos sobre a cabeça do novilho;
text_el: καὶ προσάξεις τὸν μόσχον ἐπὶ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ μόσχου ἔναντι κυρίου παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: and you shall kill him in the sight of the Lord , beside the door of the tabernacle of the testimony .
text_la: et mactabis eum in conspectu Domini, juxta ostium tabernaculi testimonii.
text_pt: E imolarás o novilho perante o Senhor, à porta da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ σφάξεις τὸν μόσχον ἔναντι κυρίου παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And taking some of the blood of the calf, you shall put it upon the horns of the altar with your finger, and the rest of the blood you shall pour at the bottom thereof.
text_la: Sumptumque de sanguine vituli, pones super cornua altaris digito tuo, reliquum autem sanguinem fundes juxta basim ejus.
text_pt: Depois tomarás do sangue do novilho, e o porás com o teu dedo sobre as pontas do altar, e todo o sangue restante derramarás à base do altar.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ μόσχου καὶ θήσεις ἐπὶ τῶν κεράτων τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τῷ δακτύλῳ σου τὸ δὲ λοιπὸν πᾶν αἷμα ἐκχεεῖς παρὰ τὴν βάσιν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου

text_en: You shall take also all the fat that covers the entrails, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and shall offer a burnt offering upon the altar :
text_la: Sumes et adipem totum qui operit intestina, et reticulum jecoris, ac duos renes, et adipem qui super eos est, et offeres incensum super altare:
text_pt: Também tomarás toda a gordura que cobre as entranhas, e o redenho de sobre o fígado, e ambos os rins, e a gordura que houver neles, e queimá-los-ás sobre o altar;
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ πᾶν τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἐπὶ τῆς κοιλίας καὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ἥπατος καὶ τοὺς δύο νεφροὺς καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἐπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον

text_en: But the flesh of the calf, and the hide and the dung, you shall burn abroad, without the camp, because it is for sin .
text_la: carnes vero vituli et corium et fimum combures foris extra castra, eo quod pro peccato sit.
text_pt: Mas a carne do novilho, e a sua pele, e o seu esterco queimarás com fogo fora do arraial; é sacrifício pelo pecado.
text_el: τὰ δὲ κρέα τοῦ μόσχου καὶ τὸ δέρμα καὶ τὴν κόπρον κατακαύσεις πυρὶ ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἁμαρτίας γάρ ἐστιν

text_en: You shall take also one ram, upon the head whereof Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands .
text_la: Unum quoque arietem sumes, super cujus caput ponent Aaron et filii ejus manus.
text_pt: Depois tomarás um carneiro, e Arão e seus filhos porão as suas mãos sobre a cabeça do carneiro,
text_el: καὶ τὸν κριὸν λήμψῃ τὸν ἕνα καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ κριοῦ

text_en: And when you have killed him, you shall take of the blood thereof, and pour round about the altar .
text_la: Quem cum mactaveris, tolles de sanguine ejus, et fundes circa altare.
text_pt: E imolarás o carneiro, e tomarás o seu sangue, e o espalharás sobre o altar ao redor;
text_el: καὶ σφάξεις αὐτὸν καὶ λαβὼν τὸ αἷμα προσχεεῖς πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον κύκλῳ

text_en: And you shall cut the ram in pieces, and having washed his entrails and feet, you shall put them upon the flesh that is cut in pieces, and upon his head.
text_la: Ipsum autem arietem secabis in frustra : lotaque intestina ejus ac pedes, pones super concisas carnes, et super caput illius.
text_pt: E partirás o carneiro por suas partes, e lavarás as suas entranhas e as suas pernas, e as porás sobre as suas partes e sobre a sua cabeça.
text_el: καὶ τὸν κριὸν διχοτομήσεις κατὰ μέλη καὶ πλυνεῖς τὰ ἐνδόσθια καὶ τοὺς πόδας ὕδατι καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἐπὶ τὰ διχοτομήματα σὺν τῇ κεφαλῇ

text_en: And you shall offer the whole ram for a burnt offering upon the altar : it is an oblation to the Lord , a most sweet savour of the victim of the Lord .
text_la: Et offeres totum arietem in incensum super altare : oblatio est Domino, odor suavissimus victimæ Domini.
text_pt: Assim queimarás todo o carneiro sobre o altar; é um holocausto para o Senhor, cheiro suave; uma oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀνοίσεις ὅλον τὸν κριὸν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ὁλοκαύτωμα κυρίῳ εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας θυσίασμα κυρίῳ ἐστίν

text_en: You shall take also the other ram, upon whose head Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands .
text_la: Tolles quoque arietem alterum, super cujus caput Aaron et filii ejus ponent manus.
text_pt: Depois tomarás o outro carneiro, e Arão e seus filhos porão as suas mãos sobre a sua cabeça;
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ τὸν κριὸν τὸν δεύτερον καὶ ἐπιθήσει Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ κριοῦ

text_en: And when you have sacrificed him, you shall take of his blood, and put upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron and of his sons, and upon the thumbs and great toes of their right hand and foot, and you shall pour the blood upon the altar round about.
text_la: Quem cum immolaveris, sumes de sanguine ejus, et pones super extremum auriculæ dextræ Aaron et filiorum ejus, et super pollices manus eorum ac pedis dextri, fundesque sanguinem super altare per circuitum.
text_pt: E imolarás o carneiro e tomarás do seu sangue, e o porás sobre a ponta da orelha direita de Arão, e sobre as pontas das orelhas direitas de seus filhos, como também sobre os dedos polegares das suas mãos direitas, e sobre os dedos polegares dos seus pés direitos; e o restante do sangue espalharás sobre o altar ao redor;
text_el: καὶ σφάξεις αὐτὸν καὶ λήμψῃ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἐπὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ὠτὸς Ααρων τοῦ δεξιοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ποδὸς τοῦ δεξιοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς λοβοὺς τῶν ὤτων τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ τῶν δεξιῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἄκρα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν τῶν δεξιῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἄκρα τῶν ποδῶν αὐτῶν τῶν δεξιῶν

text_en: And when you have taken of the blood that is upon the altar , and of the oil of unction, you shall sprinkle Aaron and his vesture , his sons and their vestments . And after they and their vestments are consecrated ,
text_la: Cumque tuleris de sanguine qui est super altare, et de oleo unctionis, asperges Aaron et vestes ejus, filios et vestimenta eorum. Consecratisque ipsis et vestibus,
text_pt: Então tomarás do sangue, que estará sobre o altar, e do azeite da unção, e o espargirás sobre Arão e sobre as suas vestes, e sobre seus filhos, e sobre as vestes de seus filhos com ele; para que ele seja santificado, e as suas vestes, também seus filhos, e as vestes de seus filhos com ele.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐλαίου τῆς χρίσεως καὶ ῥανεῖς ἐπὶ Ααρων καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν στολὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς στολὰς τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἁγιασθήσεται αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ στολὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ στολαὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ τὸ δὲ αἷμα τοῦ κριοῦ προσχεεῖς πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον κύκλῳ

text_en: you shall take the fat of the ram, and the rump, and the fat that covers the lungs, and the caul of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder, because it is the ram of consecration :
text_la: tolles adipem de ariete, et caudam et arvinam, quæ operit vitalia, ac reticulum jecoris, et duos renes, atque adipem, qui super eos est, armumque dextrum, eo quod sit aries consecrationis:
text_pt: Depois tomarás do carneiro a gordura, e a cauda, e a gordura que cobre as entranhas, e o redenho do fígado, e ambos os rins com a gordura que houver neles, e o ombro direito, porque é carneiro das consagrações;
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ κριοῦ τὸ στέαρ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ κατακαλύπτον τὴν κοιλίαν καὶ τὸν λοβὸν τοῦ ἥπατος καὶ τοὺς δύο νεφροὺς καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ ἐπ' αὐτῶν καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τὸν δεξιόν ἔστιν γὰρ τελείωσις αὕτη

text_en: And one roll of bread, a cake tempered with oil, a wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread , which is set in the sight of the Lord :
text_la: tortamque panis unius, crustulam conspersam oleo, laganum de canistro azymorum, quod positum est in conspectu Domini:
text_pt: E um pão, e um bolo de pão azeitado, e um coscorão do cesto dos pães ázimos que estão diante do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἄρτον ἕνα ἐξ ἐλαίου καὶ λάγανον ἓν ἀπὸ τοῦ κανοῦ τῶν ἀζύμων τῶν προτεθειμένων ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And you shall put all upon the hands of Aaron and of his sons, and shall sanctify them elevating before the Lord .
text_la: ponesque omnia super manus Aaron et filiorum ejus, et sanctificabis eos elevans coram Domino.
text_pt: E tudo porás nas mãos de Arão, e nas mãos de seus filhos; e com movimento oferecerás perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τὰ πάντα ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας Ααρων καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀφοριεῖς αὐτοὺς ἀφόρισμα ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And you shall take all from their hands; and shall burn them upon the altar for a holocaust , a most sweet savour in the sight of the Lord , because it is his oblation .
text_la: Suscipiesque universa de manibus eorum : et incendes super altare in holocaustum, odorem suavissimum in conspectu Domini, quia oblatio ejus est.
text_pt: Depois o tomarás das suas mãos e o queimarás no altar sobre o holocausto por cheiro suave perante o Senhor; é oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ αὐτὰ ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνοίσεις ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας ἔναντι κυρίου κάρπωμά ἐστιν κυρίῳ

text_en: You shall take also the breast of the ram, wherewith Aaron was consecrated , and elevating it you shall sanctify it before the Lord , and it shall fall to your share.
text_la: Sumes quoque pectusculum de ariete, quo initiatus est Aaron, sanctificabisque illud elevatum coram Domino, et cedet in partem tuam.
text_pt: E tomarás o peito do carneiro das consagrações, que é de Arão, e com movimento oferecerás perante o Senhor; e isto será a tua porção.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ τὸ στηθύνιον ἀπὸ τοῦ κριοῦ τῆς τελειώσεως ὅ ἐστιν Ααρων καὶ ἀφοριεῖς αὐτὸ ἀφόρισμα ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἔσται σοι ἐν μερίδι

text_en: And you shall sanctify both the consecrated breast, and the shoulder that you separated of the ram,
text_la: Sanctificabisque et pectusculum consecratum, et armum quem de ariete separasti,
text_pt: E santificarás o peito da oferta de movimento e o ombro da oferta alçada, que foi movido e alçado do carneiro das consagrações, que for de Arão e de seus filhos.
text_el: καὶ ἁγιάσεις τὸ στηθύνιον ἀφόρισμα καὶ τὸν βραχίονα τοῦ ἀφαιρέματος ὃς ἀφώρισται καὶ ὃς ἀφῄρηται ἀπὸ τοῦ κριοῦ τῆς τελειώσεως ἀπὸ τοῦ Ααρων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: wherewith Aaron was consecrated and his sons, and they shall fall to Aaron's share, and his sons', by a perpetual right from the children of Israel : because they are the choicest and the beginnings of their peace victims which they offer to the Lord .
text_la: quo initiatus est Aaron et filii ejus, cedentque in partem Aaron et filiorum ejus jure perpetuo a filiis Israël : quia primitiva sunt et initia de victimis eorum pacificis quæ offerunt Domino.
text_pt: E será para Arão e para seus filhos por estatuto perpétuo dos filhos de Israel, porque é oferta alçada; e a oferta alçada será dos filhos de Israel, dos seus sacrifícios pacíficos; a sua oferta alçada será para o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ νόμιμον αἰώνιον παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἔστιν γὰρ ἀφαίρεμα τοῦτο καὶ ἀφαίρεμα ἔσται παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τῶν θυμάτων τῶν σωτηρίων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀφαίρεμα κυρίῳ

text_en: And the holy vesture , which Aaron shall use, his sons shall have after him, that they may be anointed, and their hands consecrated in it.
text_la: Vestem autem sanctam, qua utetur Aaron, habebunt filii ejus post eum, ut ungantur in ea, et consecrantur manus eorum.
text_pt: E as vestes sagradas, que são de Arão, serão de seus filhos depois dele, para serem ungidos com elas para serem consagrados com elas.
text_el: καὶ ἡ στολὴ τοῦ ἁγίου ἥ ἐστιν Ααρων ἔσται τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτόν χρισθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ τελειῶσαι τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν

text_en: He of his sons that shall be appointed high priest in his stead, and that shall enter into the tabernacle of the testimony to minister in the sanctuary, shall wear it seven days.
text_la: Septem diebus utetur illa qui pontifex pro eo fuerit constitutus de filiis ejus, et qui ingredietur tabernaculum testimonii ut ministret in sanctuario.
text_pt: Sete dias as vestirá aquele que de seus filhos for sacerdote em seu lugar, quando entrar na tenda da congregação para ministrar no santuário.
text_el: ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἐνδύσεται αὐτὰ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ ὃς εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου λειτουργεῖν ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις

text_en: And you shall take the ram of the consecration , and shall boil the flesh thereof in the holy place:
text_la: Arietem autem consecrationis tolles, et coques carnes ejus in loco sancto:
text_pt: E tomarás o carneiro das consagrações e cozerás a sua carne no lugar santo;
text_el: καὶ τὸν κριὸν τῆς τελειώσεως λήμψῃ καὶ ἑψήσεις τὰ κρέα ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ

text_en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat it. The loaves also, that are in the basket, they shall eat in the entry of the tabernacle of the testimony ,
text_la: quibus vescetur Aaron et filii ejus. Panes quoque, qui sunt in canistro, in vestibulo tabernaculi testimonii comedent,
text_pt: E Arão e seus filhos comerão a carne deste carneiro, e o pão que está no cesto, à porta da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ ἔδονται Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰ κρέα τοῦ κριοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τοὺς ἐν τῷ κανῷ παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: that it may be an atoning sacrifice , and the hands of the offerers may be sanctified . A stranger shall not eat of them, because they are holy .
text_la: ut sit placabile sacrificium, et sanctificentur offerentium manus. Alienigena non vescetur ex eis, quia sancti sunt.
text_pt: E comerão as coisas com que for feita expiação, para consagrá-los, e para santificá-los; mas o estranho delas não comerá, porque são santas.
text_el: ἔδονται αὐτά ἐν οἷς ἡγιάσθησαν ἐν αὐτοῖς τελειῶσαι τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἁγιάσαι αὐτούς καὶ ἀλλογενὴς οὐκ ἔδεται ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἔστιν γὰρ ἅγια

text_en: And if there remain of the consecrated flesh, or of the bread, till the morning, you shall burn the remainder with fire: they shall not be eaten, because they are sanctified .
text_la: Quod si remanserit de carnibus consecratis, sive de panibus usque mane, combures reliquias igni : non comedentur, quia sanctificata sunt.
text_pt: E se sobejar alguma coisa da carne das consagrações ou do pão até pela manhã, o que sobejar queimarás com fogo; não se comerá, porque é santo.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ καταλειφθῇ ἀπὸ τῶν κρεῶν τῆς θυσίας τῆς τελειώσεως καὶ τῶν ἄρτων ἕως πρωί κατακαύσεις τὰ λοιπὰ πυρί οὐ βρωθήσεται ἁγίασμα γάρ ἐστιν

text_en: All that I have commanded you, you shall do unto Aaron and his sons. Seven days shall you consecrate their hands:
text_la: Omnia, quæ præcepi tibi, facies super Aaron et filiis ejus. Septem diebus consecrabis manus eorum:
text_pt: Assim, pois, farás a Arão e a seus filhos conforme a tudo o que eu te tenho ordenado; por sete dias os consagrarás.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ οὕτως κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην σοι ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας τελειώσεις αὐτῶν τὰς χεῖρας

text_en: And you shall offer a calf for sin every day for expiation. And you shall cleanse the altar when you have offered the victim of expiation, and shall anoint it to sanctify it.
text_la: et vitulum pro peccato offeres per singulos dies ad expiandum. Mundabisque altare cum immolaveris expiationis hostiam, et unges illud in sanctificationem.
text_pt: Também cada dia prepararás um novilho por sacrifício pelo pecado para as expiações, e purificarás o altar, fazendo expiação sobre ele; e o ungirás para santificá-lo.
text_el: καὶ τὸ μοσχάριον τῆς ἁμαρτίας ποιήσεις τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ καὶ καθαριεῖς τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐν τῷ ἁγιάζειν σε ἐπ' αὐτῷ καὶ χρίσεις αὐτὸ ὥστε ἁγιάσαι αὐτό

text_en: Seven days shall you expiate the altar and sanctify it, and it shall be most holy . Every one, that shall touch it, shall be holy .
text_la: Septem diebus expiabis altare, et sanctificabis, et erit Sanctum sanctorum : omnis, qui tetigerit illud, sanctificabitur.
text_pt: Sete dias farás expiação pelo altar, e o santificarás; e o altar será santíssimo; tudo o que tocar o altar será santo.
text_el: ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας καθαριεῖς τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ ἁγιάσεις αὐτό καὶ ἔσται τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἅγιον τοῦ ἁγίου πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ἁγιασθήσεται

text_en: This is what you shall sacrifice upon the altar : Two lambs of a year old every day continually,
text_la: Hoc est quod facies in altari : agnos anniculos duos per singulos dies jugiter,
text_pt: Isto, pois, é o que oferecereis sobre o altar: dois cordeiros de um ano, cada dia, continuamente.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτά ἐστιν ἃ ποιήσεις ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ἀμνοὺς ἐνιαυσίους ἀμώμους δύο τὴν ἡμέραν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐνδελεχῶς κάρπωμα ἐνδελεχισμοῦ

text_en: one lamb in the morning, and another in the evening.
text_la: unum agnum mane, et alterum vespere,
text_pt: Um cordeiro oferecerás pela manhã, e o outro cordeiro oferecerás à tarde.
text_el: τὸν ἀμνὸν τὸν ἕνα ποιήσεις τὸ πρωὶ καὶ τὸν ἀμνὸν τὸν δεύτερον ποιήσεις τὸ δειλινόν

text_en: With one lamb a tenth part of flour tempered with beaten oil, of the fourth part of a hin, and wine for libation of the same measure.
text_la: decimam partem similæ conspersæ oleo tuso, quod habeat mensuram quartam partem hin, et vinum ad libandum ejusdem mensuræ in agno uno.
text_pt: Com um cordeiro a décima parte de flor de farinha, misturada com a quarta parte de um him de azeite batido, e para libação a quarta parte de um him de vinho,
text_el: καὶ δέκατον σεμιδάλεως πεφυραμένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ κεκομμένῳ τῷ τετάρτῳ τοῦ ιν καὶ σπονδὴν τὸ τέταρτον τοῦ ιν οἴνου τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνί

text_en: And the other lamb you shall offer in the evening, according to the rite of the morning oblation , and according to what we have said, for a savour of sweetness:
text_la: Alterum vero agnum offeres ad vesperam juxta ritum matutinæ oblationis, et juxta ea quæ diximus, in odorem suavitatis:
text_pt: E o outro cordeiro oferecerás à tarde, e com ele farás como com a oferta da manhã, e conforme à sua libação, por cheiro suave; oferta queimada é ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τὸν ἀμνὸν τὸν δεύτερον ποιήσεις τὸ δειλινόν κατὰ τὴν θυσίαν τὴν πρωινὴν καὶ κατὰ τὴν σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ ποιήσεις εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κάρπωμα κυρίῳ

text_en: It is a sacrifice to the Lord , by perpetual oblation unto your generations , at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony before the Lord , where I will appoint to speak unto you.
text_la: sacrificium est Domino, oblatione perpetua in generationes vestras, ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii coram Domino, ubi constituam ut loquar ad te.
text_pt: Este será o holocausto contínuo por vossas gerações, à porta da tenda da congregação, perante o Senhor, onde vos encontrarei, para falar contigo ali.
text_el: θυσίαν ἐνδελεχισμοῦ εἰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἐπὶ θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἔναντι κυρίου ἐν οἷς γνωσθήσομαί σοι ἐκεῖθεν ὥστε λαλῆσαί σοι

text_en: And there will I command the children of Israel , and the altar shall be sanctified by my glory .
text_la: Ibique præcipiam filiis Israël, et sanctificabitur altare in gloria mea.
text_pt: E ali virei aos filhos de Israel, para que por minha glória sejam santificados.
text_el: καὶ τάξομαι ἐκεῖ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι ἐν δόξῃ μου

text_en: I will sanctify also the tabernacle of the testimony with the altar , and Aaron with his sons, to do the office of priesthood unto me.
text_la: Sanctificabo et tabernaculum testimonii cum altari, et Aaron cum filiis suis, ut sacerdotio fungantur mihi.
text_pt: E santificarei a tenda da congregação e o altar; também santificarei a Arão e seus filhos, para que me administrem o sacerdócio.
text_el: καὶ ἁγιάσω τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ Ααρων καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ἁγιάσω ἱερατεύειν μοι

text_en: And I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel , and will be their God :
text_la: Et habitabo in medio filiorum Israël, eroque eis Deus,
text_pt: E habitarei no meio dos filhos de Israel, e lhes serei o seu Deus,
text_el: καὶ ἐπικληθήσομαι ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτῶν θεός

text_en: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God , who have brought them out of the land of Egypt , that I might abide among them, I the Lord their God .
text_la: et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum, qui eduxi eos de terra Ægypti, ut manerem inter illos, ego Dominus Deus ipsorum.
text_pt: E saberão que eu sou o Senhor seu Deus, que os tenho tirado da terra do Egito, para habitar no meio deles. Eu sou o Senhor seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν ὁ ἐξαγαγὼν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐπικληθῆναι αὐτοῖς καὶ θεὸς εἶναι αὐτῶν

text_en: You shall make also an altar to burn incense , of setim wood .
text_la: Facies quoque altare ad adolendum thymiama, de lignis setim,
text_pt: E farás um altar para queimar o incenso; de madeira de acácia o farás.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις θυσιαστήριον θυμιάματος ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτὸ

text_en: It shall be a cubit in length, and another in breadth, that is, four square, and two in height. Horns shall go out of the same.
text_la: habens cubitum longitudinis, et alterum latitudinis, id est, quadrangulum, et duos cubitos in altitudine. Cornua ex ipso procedent.
text_pt: O seu comprimento será de um côvado, e a sua largura de um côvado; será quadrado, e dois côvados a sua altura; dele mesmo serão as suas pontas.
text_el: πήχεος τὸ μῆκος καὶ πήχεος τὸ εὖρος τετράγωνον ἔσται καὶ δύο πήχεων τὸ ὕψος ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔσται τὰ κέρατα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And you shall overlay it with the purest gold, as well the grate thereof, as the walls round about, and the horns . And you shall make to it a crown of gold round about,
text_la: Vestiesque illud auro purissimo, tam craticulam ejus, quam parietes per circuitum, et cornua. Faciesque ei coronam aureolam per gyrum,
text_pt: E com ouro puro o forrarás, o seu teto, e as suas paredes ao redor, e as suas pontas; e lhe farás uma coroa de ouro ao redor.
text_el: καὶ καταχρυσώσεις αὐτὰ χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ τὴν ἐσχάραν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς τοίχους αὐτοῦ κύκλῳ καὶ τὰ κέρατα αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῷ στρεπτὴν στεφάνην χρυσῆν κύκλῳ

text_en: and two golden rings under the crown on either side, that the bars may be put into them, and the altar be carried.
text_la: et duos annulos aureos sub corona per singula latera, ut mittantur in eos vectes, et altare portetur.
text_pt: Também lhe farás duas argolas de ouro debaixo da sua coroa; nos dois cantos as farás, de ambos os lados; e serão para lugares dos varais, com que será levado.
text_el: καὶ δύο δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς καθαροὺς ποιήσεις ὑπὸ τὴν στρεπτὴν στεφάνην αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰ δύο κλίτη ποιήσεις ἐν τοῖς δυσὶ πλευροῖς καὶ ἔσονται ψαλίδες ταῖς σκυτάλαις ὥστε αἴρειν αὐτὸ ἐν αὐταῖς

text_en: And you shall make the bars also of setim wood , and shall overlay them with gold.
text_la: Ipsos quoque vectes facies de lignis setim, et inaurabis.
text_pt: E os varais farás de madeira de acácia, e os forrarás com ouro.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις σκυτάλας ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων καὶ καταχρυσώσεις αὐτὰς χρυσίῳ

text_en: And you shall set the altar over against the veil, that hangs before the ark of the testimony before the propitiatory wherewith the testimony is covered, where I will speak to you.
text_la: Ponesque altare contra velum, quod ante arcum pendet testimonii coram propitiatorio quo tegitur testimonium, ubi loquar tibi.
text_pt: E o porás diante do véu que está diante da arca do testemunho, diante do propiciatório, que está sobre o testemunho, onde me ajuntarei contigo.
text_el: καὶ θήσεις αὐτὸ ἀπέναντι τοῦ καταπετάσματος τοῦ ὄντος ἐπὶ τῆς κιβωτοῦ τῶν μαρτυρίων ἐν οἷς γνωσθήσομαί σοι ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: And Aaron shall burn sweet smelling incense upon it in the morning. When he shall dress the lamps, he shall burn it:
text_la: Et adolebit incensum super eo Aaron, suave fragrans, mane. Quando componet lucernas, incendet illud:
text_pt: E Arão sobre ele queimará o incenso das especiarias; cada manhã, quando puser em ordem as lâmpadas, o queimará.
text_el: καὶ θυμιάσει ἐπ' αὐτοῦ Ααρων θυμίαμα σύνθετον λεπτόν τὸ πρωὶ πρωί ὅταν ἐπισκευάζῃ τοὺς λύχνους θυμιάσει ἐπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when he shall place them in the evening, he shall burn an everlasting incense before the Lord throughout your generations .
text_la: et quando collocabit eas ad vesperum, uret thymiama sempiternum coram Domino in generationes vestras.
text_pt: E, acendendo Arão as lâmpadas à tarde, o queimará; este será incenso contínuo perante o Senhor pelas vossas gerações.
text_el: καὶ ὅταν ἐξάπτῃ Ααρων τοὺς λύχνους ὀψέ θυμιάσει ἐπ' αὐτοῦ θυμίαμα ἐνδελεχισμοῦ διὰ παντὸς ἔναντι κυρίου εἰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: You shall not offer upon it incense of another composition, nor oblation , and victim, neither shall you offer libations.
text_la: Non offeretis super eo thymiama compositionis alterius, nec oblationem, et victimam, nec libabitis libamina.
text_pt: Não oferecereis sobre ele incenso estranho, nem holocausto, nem oferta; nem tampouco derramareis sobre ele libações.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀνοίσεις ἐπ' αὐτοῦ θυμίαμα ἕτερον κάρπωμα θυσίαν καὶ σπονδὴν οὐ σπείσεις ἐπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Aaron shall pray upon the horns thereof once a year, with the blood of that which was offered for sin ; and shall make atonement upon it in your generations . It shall be most holy to the Lord .
text_la: Et deprecabitur Aaron super cornua ejus semel per annum, in sanguine quod oblatum est pro peccato, et placabit super eo in generationibus vestris. Sanctum sanctorum erit Domino.
text_pt: E uma vez no ano Arão fará expiação sobre as suas pontas com o sangue do sacrifício das expiações; uma vez no ano fará expiação sobre ele pelas vossas gerações; santíssimo é ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐξιλάσεται ἐπ' αὐτὸ Ααρων ἐπὶ τῶν κεράτων αὐτοῦ ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν τοῦ ἐξιλασμοῦ ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ καθαριεῖ αὐτὸ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν ἅγιον τῶν ἁγίων ἐστὶν κυρίῳ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: When you shall take the sum of the children of Israel , according to their number, every one of them shall give a price for their souls to the Lord , and there shall be no scourge among them, when they shall be reckoned.
text_la: Quando tuleris summam filiorum Israël juxta numerum, dabunt singuli pretium pro animabus suis Domino, et non erit plaga in eis, cum fuerint recensiti.
text_pt: Quando fizeres a contagem dos filhos de Israel, conforme a sua soma, cada um deles dará ao Senhor o resgate da sua alma, quando os contares; para que não haja entre eles praga alguma, quando os contares.
text_el: ἐὰν λάβῃς τὸν συλλογισμὸν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐπισκοπῇ αὐτῶν καὶ δώσουσιν ἕκαστος λύτρα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἐν αὐτοῖς πτῶσις ἐν τῇ ἐπισκοπῇ αὐτῶν

text_en: And this shall every one give that passes at the naming, half a sicle according to the standard of the temple . A sicle has twenty obols. Half a sicle shall be offered to the Lord .
text_la: Hoc autem dabit omnis qui transit ad nomen, dimidium sicli juxta mensuram templi (siclus viginti obolos habet); media pars sicli offeretur Domino.
text_pt: Todo aquele que passar pelo arrolamento dará isto: a metade de um siclo, segundo o siclo do santuário (este siclo é de vinte geras); a metade de um siclo é a oferta ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτό ἐστιν ὃ δώσουσιν ὅσοι ἂν παραπορεύωνται τὴν ἐπίσκεψιν τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ διδράχμου ὅ ἐστιν κατὰ τὸ δίδραχμον τὸ ἅγιον εἴκοσι ὀβολοὶ τὸ δίδραχμον τὸ δὲ ἥμισυ τοῦ διδράχμου εἰσφορὰ κυρίῳ

text_en: He that is counted in the number from twenty years and upwards, shall give the price.
text_la: Qui habetur in numero, a viginti annis et supra, dabit pretium.
text_pt: Qualquer que passar pelo arrolamento, de vinte anos para cima, dará a oferta alçada ao Senhor.
text_el: πᾶς ὁ παραπορευόμενος εἰς τὴν ἐπίσκεψιν ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω δώσουσιν τὴν εἰσφορὰν κυρίῳ

text_en: The rich man shall not add to half a sicle, and the poor man shall diminish nothing.
text_la: Dives non addet ad medium sicli, et pauper nihil minuet.
text_pt: O rico não dará mais, e o pobre não dará menos da metade do siclo, quando derem a oferta alçada ao Senhor, para fazer expiação por vossas almas.
text_el: ὁ πλουτῶν οὐ προσθήσει καὶ ὁ πενόμενος οὐκ ἐλαττονήσει ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους τοῦ διδράχμου ἐν τῷ διδόναι τὴν εἰσφορὰν κυρίῳ ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: And the money received, which was contributed by the children of Israel , you shall deliver unto the uses of the tabernacle of the testimony , that it may be a memorial of them before the Lord , and he may be merciful to their souls .
text_la: Susceptamque pecuniam, quæ collata est a filiis Israël, trades in usus tabernaculi testimonii, ut sit monimentum eorum coram Domino, et propitietur animabus eorum.
text_pt: E tomarás o dinheiro das expiações dos filhos de Israel, e o darás ao serviço da tenda da congregação; e será para memória aos filhos de Israel diante do Senhor, para fazer expiação por vossas almas.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ τὸ ἀργύριον τῆς εἰσφορᾶς παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ δώσεις αὐτὸ εἰς κάτεργον τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἔσται τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ μνημόσυνον ἔναντι κυρίου ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: E falou o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: You shall make also a brazen laver with its foot to wash in: and you shall set it between the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar . And water being put into it:
text_la: Facies et labrum æneum cum basi sua ad lavandum : ponesque illud inter tabernaculum testimonii et altare. Et missa aqua,
text_pt: Farás também uma pia de cobre com a sua base de cobre, para lavar; e a porás entre a tenda da congregação e o altar; e nela deitarás água.
text_el: ποίησον λουτῆρα χαλκοῦν καὶ βάσιν αὐτῷ χαλκῆν ὥστε νίπτεσθαι καὶ θήσεις αὐτὸν ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ἐκχεεῖς εἰς αὐτὸν ὕδωρ

text_en: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and feet in it:
text_la: lavabunt in ea Aaron et filii ejus manus suas ac pedes,
text_pt: E Arão e seus filhos nela lavarão as suas mãos e os seus pés.
text_el: καὶ νίψεται Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐξ αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τοὺς πόδας ὕδατι

text_en: When they are going into the tabernacle of the testimony , and when they are to come to the altar , to offer on it incense to the Lord ,
text_la: quando ingressuri sunt tabernaculum testimonii, et quando accessuri sunt ad altare, ut offerant in eo thymiama Domino,
text_pt: Quando entrarem na tenda da congregação, lavar-se-ão com água, para que não morram, ou quando se chegarem ao altar para ministrar, para acender a oferta queimada ao Senhor.
text_el: ὅταν εἰσπορεύωνται εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου νίψονται ὕδατι καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνωσιν ἢ ὅταν προσπορεύωνται πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον λειτουργεῖν καὶ ἀναφέρειν τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα κυρίῳ

text_en: lest perhaps they die. It shall be an everlasting law to him, and to his seed by successions.
text_la: ne forte moriantur; legitimum sempiternum erit ipsi, et semini ejus per successiones.
text_pt: Lavarão, pois, as suas mãos e os seus pés, para que não morram; e isto lhes será por estatuto perpétuo a ele e à sua descendência nas suas gerações.
text_el: νίψονται τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τοὺς πόδας ὕδατι ὅταν εἰσπορεύωνται εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου νίψονται ὕδατι ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνωσιν καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῖς νόμιμον αἰώνιον αὐτῷ καὶ ταῖς γενεαῖς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτόν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses ,
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: saying: Take spices, of principal and chosen myrrh five hundred sicles, and of cinnamon half so much; that is, two hundred and fifty sicles, of calamus in like manner two hundred and fifty,
text_la: dicens : Sume tibi aromata, primæ myrrhæ et electæ quingentos siclos, et cinnamomi medium, id est, ducentos quinquaginta siclos, calami similiter ducentos quinquaginta,
text_pt: Tu, pois, toma para ti das principais especiarias, da mais pura mirra quinhentos siclos, e de canela aromática a metade, a saber, duzentos e cinqüenta siclos, e de cálamo aromático duzentos e cinqüenta siclos,
text_el: καὶ σὺ λαβὲ ἡδύσματα τὸ ἄνθος σμύρνης ἐκλεκτῆς πεντακοσίους σίκλους καὶ κινναμώμου εὐώδους τὸ ἥμισυ τούτου διακοσίους πεντήκοντα καὶ καλάμου εὐώδους διακοσίους πεντήκοντα

text_en: and of cassia five hundred sicles by the weight of the sanctuary, of oil of olives the measure hin:
text_la: casiæ autem quingentos siclos, in pondere sanctuarii, olei de olivetis mensuram hin:
text_pt: E de cássia quinhentos siclos, segundo o siclo do santuário, e de azeite de oliveiras um him.
text_el: καὶ ἴρεως πεντακοσίους σίκλους τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἔλαιον ἐξ ἐλαίων ιν

text_en: And you shall make the holy oil of unction, an ointment compounded after the art of the perfumer,
text_la: faciesque unctionis oleum sanctum, unguentum compositum opere unguentarii,
text_pt: E disto farás o azeite da santa unção, o perfume composto segundo a obra do perfumista: este será o azeite da santa unção.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτὸ ἔλαιον χρῖσμα ἅγιον μύρον μυρεψικὸν τέχνῃ μυρεψοῦ ἔλαιον χρῖσμα ἅγιον ἔσται

text_en: and therewith you shall anoint the tabernacle of the testimony , and the ark of the testament ,
text_la: et unges ex eo tabernaculum testimonii, et arcam testamenti,
text_pt: E com ele ungirás a tenda da congregação, e a arca do testemunho,
text_el: καὶ χρίσεις ἐξ αὐτοῦ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: and the table with the vessels thereof, the candlestick and furniture thereof, the altars of incense ,
text_la: mensamque cum vasis suis, et candelabrum, et utensilia ejus, altaria thymiamatis,
text_pt: E a mesa com todos os seus utensílios, e o candelabro com os seus utensílios, e o altar do incenso.
text_el: καὶ τὴν λυχνίαν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θυμιάματος

text_en: and of holocaust , and all the furniture that belongs to the service of them.
text_la: et holocausti, et universam supellectilem quæ ad cultum eorum pertinet.
text_pt: E o altar do holocausto com todos os seus utensílios, e a pia com a sua base.
text_el: καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων καὶ πάντα αὐτοῦ τὰ σκεύη καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ τὸν λουτῆρα καὶ τὴν βάσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And you shall sanctify all, and they shall be most holy : he that shall touch them shall be sanctified .
text_la: Sanctificabisque omnia, et erunt Sancta sanctorum; qui tetigerit ea, sanctificabitur.
text_pt: Assim santificarás estas coisas, para que sejam santíssimas; tudo o que tocar nelas será santo.
text_el: καὶ ἁγιάσεις αὐτά καὶ ἔσται ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος αὐτῶν ἁγιασθήσεται

text_en: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and shall sanctify them, that they may do the office of priesthood unto me.
text_la: Aaron et filios ejus unges, sanctificabisque eos, ut sacerdotio fungantur mihi.
text_pt: Também ungirás a Arão e seus filhos, e os santificarás para me administrarem o sacerdócio.
text_el: καὶ Ααρων καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ χρίσεις καὶ ἁγιάσεις αὐτοὺς ἱερατεύειν μοι

text_en: And you shall say to the children of Israel : This oil of unction shall be holy unto me throughout your generations .
text_la: Filiis quoque Israël dices : Hoc oleum unctionis sanctum erit mihi in generationes vestras.
text_pt: E falarás aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Este me será o azeite da santa unção nas vossas gerações.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λαλήσεις λέγων ἔλαιον ἄλειμμα χρίσεως ἅγιον ἔσται τοῦτο ὑμῖν εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν

text_en: The flesh of man shall not be anointed therewith, and you shall make none other of the same composition, because it is sanctified , and shall be holy unto you.
text_la: Caro hominis non ungetur ex eo, et juxta compositionem ejus non facietis aliud, quia sanctificatum est, et sanctum erit vobis.
text_pt: Não se ungirá com ele a carne do homem, nem fareis outro de semelhante composição; santo é, e será santo para vós.
text_el: ἐπὶ σάρκα ἀνθρώπου οὐ χρισθήσεται καὶ κατὰ τὴν σύνθεσιν ταύτην οὐ ποιήσετε ὑμῖν ἑαυτοῖς ὡσαύτως ἅγιόν ἐστιν καὶ ἁγίασμα ἔσται ὑμῖν

text_en: What man soever shall compound such, and shall give thereof to a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.
text_la: Homo quicumque tale composuerit, et dederit ex eo alieno, exterminabitur de populo suo.
text_pt: O homem que compuser um perfume como este, ou dele puser sobre um estranho, será extirpado do seu povo.
text_el: ὃς ἂν ποιήσῃ ὡσαύτως καὶ ὃς ἂν δῷ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἀλλογενεῖ ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Take unto you spices, stacte, and onycha, galbanum of sweet savour, and the clearest frankincense, all shall be of equal weight.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Sume tibi aromata, stacten et onycha, galbanum boni odoris, et thus lucidissimum; æqualis ponderis erunt omnia:
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Toma especiarias aromáticas, estoraque, e onicha, e gálbano; estas especiarias aromáticas e o incenso puro, em igual proporção;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λαβὲ σεαυτῷ ἡδύσματα στακτήν ὄνυχα χαλβάνην ἡδυσμοῦ καὶ λίβανον διαφανῆ ἴσον ἴσῳ ἔσται

text_en: And you shall make incense compounded by the work of the perfumer, well tempered together, and pure, and most worthy of sanctification .
text_la: faciesque thymiama compositum opere unguentarii, mistum diligenter, et purum, et sanctificatione dignissimum.
text_pt: E disto farás incenso, um perfume segundo a arte do perfumista, temperado, puro e santo;
text_el: καὶ ποιήσουσιν ἐν αὐτῷ θυμίαμα μυρεψικὸν ἔργον μυρεψοῦ μεμιγμένον καθαρόν ἔργον ἅγιον

text_en: And when you have beaten all into very small powder, you shall set of it before the tabernacle of the testimony , in the place where I will appear to you. Most holy shall this incense be unto you.
text_la: Cumque in tenuissimum pulverem universa contuderis, pones ex eo coram tabernaculo testimonii, in quo loco apparebo tibi. Sanctum sanctorum erit vobis thymiama.
text_pt: E uma parte dele moerás, e porás diante do testemunho, na tenda da congregação, onde eu virei a ti; coisa santíssima vos será.
text_el: καὶ συγκόψεις ἐκ τούτων λεπτὸν καὶ θήσεις ἀπέναντι τῶν μαρτυρίων ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ὅθεν γνωσθήσομαί σοι ἐκεῖθεν ἅγιον τῶν ἁγίων ἔσται ὑμῖν

text_en: You shall not make such a composition for your own uses, because it is holy to the Lord .
text_la: Talem compositionem non facietis in usus vestros, quia sanctum est Domino.
text_pt: Porém o incenso que fareis conforme essa composição, não o fareis para vós mesmos; santo será para o Senhor.
text_el: θυμίαμα κατὰ τὴν σύνθεσιν ταύτην οὐ ποιήσετε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς ἁγίασμα ἔσται ὑμῖν κυρίῳ

text_en: What man soever shall make the like, to enjoy the smell thereof, he shall perish out of his people.
text_la: Homo quicumque fecerit simile, ut odore illius perfruatur, peribit de populis suis.
text_pt: O homem que fizer tal como este para cheirar, será extirpado do seu povo.
text_el: ὃς ἂν ποιήσῃ ὡσαύτως ὥστε ὀσφραίνεσθαι ἐν αὐτῷ ἀπολεῖται ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Depois falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Behold, I have called by name Beseleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Juda ,
text_la: Ecce, vocavi ex nomine Beseleel filium Uri filii Hur de tribu Juda,
text_pt: Eis que eu tenho chamado por nome a Bezalel, o filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá,
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἀνακέκλημαι ἐξ ὀνόματος τὸν Βεσελεηλ τὸν τοῦ Ουριου τὸν Ωρ τῆς φυλῆς Ιουδα

text_en: and I have filled him with the spirit of God , with wisdom and understanding, and knowledge in all manner of work,
text_la: et implevi spiritu Dei, sapientia, et intelligentia et scientia in omni opere,
text_pt: E o enchi do Espírito de Deus, de sabedoria, e de entendimento, e de ciência, em todo o lavor,
text_el: καὶ ἐνέπλησα αὐτὸν πνεῦμα θεῖον σοφίας καὶ συνέσεως καὶ ἐπιστήμης ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ

text_en: to devise whatsoever may be artificially made of gold, and silver, and brass,
text_la: ad excogitandum quidquid fabrefieri potest ex auro, et argento, et ære,
text_pt: Para elaborar projetos, e trabalhar em ouro, em prata, e em cobre,
text_el: διανοεῖσθαι καὶ ἀρχιτεκτονῆσαι ἐργάζεσθαι τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸν χαλκὸν καὶ τὴν ὑάκινθον καὶ τὴν πορφύραν καὶ τὸ κόκκινον τὸ νηστὸν καὶ τὴν βύσσον τὴν κεκλωσμένην

text_en: of marble, and precious stones , and variety of wood.
text_la: marmore, et gemmis, et diversitate lignorum.
text_pt: E em lapidar pedras para engastar, e em entalhes de madeira, para trabalhar em todo o lavor.
