text_el: καὶ τὰ λιθουργικὰ καὶ εἰς τὰ ἔργα τὰ τεκτονικὰ τῶν ξύλων ἐργάζεσθαι κατὰ πάντα τὰ ἔργα

text_en: And I have given him for his companion Ooliab, the son of Achisamech, of the tribe of Dan . And I have put wisdom in the heart of every skilful man , that they may make all things which I have commanded you,
text_la: Dedique ei socium Ooliab filium Achisamech de tribu Dan. Et in corde omnis eruditi posui sapientiam : ut faciant cuncta quæ præcepi tibi,
text_pt: E eis que eu tenho posto com ele a Aoliabe, o filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã, e tenho dado sabedoria ao coração de todos aqueles que são hábeis, para que façam tudo o que te tenho ordenado.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἔδωκα αὐτὸν καὶ τὸν Ελιαβ τὸν τοῦ Αχισαμαχ ἐκ φυλῆς Δαν καὶ παντὶ συνετῷ καρδίᾳ δέδωκα σύνεσιν καὶ ποιήσουσιν πάντα ὅσα σοι συνέταξα

text_en: the tabernacle of the covenant , and the ark of the testimony , and the propitiatory, that is over it, and all the vessels of the tabernacle ,
text_la: tabernaculum fœderis, et arcam testimonii, et propitiatorium, quod super eam est, et cuncta vasa tabernaculi,
text_pt: A saber: a tenda da congregação, e a arca do testemunho, e o propiciatório que estará sobre ela, e todos os pertences da tenda;
text_el: τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης καὶ τὸ ἱλαστήριον τὸ ἐπ' αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν διασκευὴν τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: and the table and the vessels thereof, the most pure candlestick with the vessels thereof, and the altars of incense ,
text_la: mensamque et vasa ejus, candelabrum purissimum cum vasis suis, et altaris thymiamatis,
text_pt: E a mesa com os seus utensílios, e o candelabro de ouro puro com todos os seus pertences, e o altar do incenso;
text_el: καὶ τὰ θυσιαστήρια καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν λυχνίαν τὴν καθαρὰν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς

text_en: and of holocaust , and all their vessels, the laver with its foot,
text_la: et holocausti, et omnia vasa eorum, labrum cum basi sua,
text_pt: E o altar do holocausto com todos os seus utensílios, e a pia com a sua base;
text_el: καὶ τὸν λουτῆρα καὶ τὴν βάσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: the holy vestments in the ministry for Aaron the priest , and for his sons, that they may execute their office, about the sacred things:
text_la: vestes sanctas in ministerio Aaron sacerdoti, et filiis ejus, ut fungantur officio suo in sacris:
text_pt: E as vestes do ministério, e as vestes sagradas de Arão o sacerdote, e as vestes de seus filhos, para administrarem o sacerdócio;
text_el: καὶ τὰς στολὰς τὰς λειτουργικὰς Ααρων καὶ τὰς στολὰς τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ ἱερατεύειν μοι

text_en: The oil of unction, and the incense of spices in the sanctuary, all things which I have commanded you, shall they make.
text_la: oleum unctionis, et thymiama aromatum in sanctuario, omnia quæ præcepi tibi, facient.
text_pt: E o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático para o santuário; farão conforme a tudo que te tenho mandado.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως καὶ τὸ θυμίαμα τῆς συνθέσεως τοῦ ἁγίου κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐνετειλάμην σοι ποιήσουσιν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: Speak to the children of Israel , and you shall say to them: See that you keep my sabbath ; because it is a sign between me and you in your generations that you may know that I am the Lord , who sanctify you.
text_la: Loquere filiis Israël, et dices ad eos : Videte ut sabbatum meum custodiatis : quia signum est inter me et vos in generationibus vestris : ut sciatis quia ego Dominus, qui sanctifico vos.
text_pt: Tu, pois, fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Certamente guardareis meus sábados; porquanto isso é um sinal entre mim e vós nas vossas gerações; para que saibais que eu sou o Senhor, que vos santifica.
text_el: καὶ σὺ σύνταξον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγων ὁρᾶτε καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου φυλάξεσθε σημεῖόν ἐστιν παρ' ἐμοὶ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ἵνα γνῶτε ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ ἁγιάζων ὑμᾶς

text_en: Keep you my sabbath : for it is holy unto you: he that shall profane it, shall be put to death : he that shall do any work in it, his soul shall perish out of the midst of his people.
text_la: Custodite sabbatum meum, sanctum est enim vobis : qui polluerit illud, morte morietur; qui fecerit in eo opus, peribit anima illius de medio populi sui.
text_pt: Portanto guardareis o sábado, porque santo é para vós; aquele que o profanar certamente morrerá; porque qualquer que nele fizer alguma obra, aquela alma será eliminada do meio do seu povo.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεσθε τὰ σάββατα ὅτι ἅγιον τοῦτό ἐστιν κυρίου ὑμῖν ὁ βεβηλῶν αὐτὸ θανάτῳ θανατωθήσεται πᾶς ὃς ποιήσει ἐν αὐτῷ ἔργον ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐκ μέσου τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Six days shall you do work: in the seventh day is the sabbath , the rest holy to the Lord . Every one that shall do any work on this day, shall die .
text_la: Sex diebus facietis opus : in die septimo sabbatum est, requies sancta Domino; omnis qui fecerit opus in hac die, morietur.
text_pt: Seis dias se trabalhará, porém o sétimo dia é o sábado do descanso, santo ao Senhor; qualquer que no dia do sábado fizer algum trabalho, certamente morrerá.
text_el: ἓξ ἡμέρας ποιήσεις ἔργα τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ σάββατα ἀνάπαυσις ἁγία τῷ κυρίῳ πᾶς ὃς ποιήσει ἔργον τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ θανάτῳ θανατωθήσεται

text_en: Let the children of Israel keep the sabbath , and celebrate it in their generations . It is an everlasting covenant.
text_la: Custodiant filii Israël sabbatum, et celebrent illud in generationibus suis. Pactum est sempiternum
text_pt: Guardarão, pois, o sábado os filhos de Israel, celebrando-o nas suas gerações por aliança perpétua.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὰ σάββατα ποιεῖν αὐτὰ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν διαθήκη αἰώνιος

text_en: Between me and the children of Israel , and a perpetual sign. For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and in the seventh he ceased from work.
text_la: inter me et filios Israël, signumque perpetuum; sex enim diebus fecit Dominus cælum et terram, et in septimo ab opere cessavit.
text_pt: Entre mim e os filhos de Israel será um sinal para sempre; porque em seis dias fez o Senhor os céus e a terra, e ao sétimo dia descansou, e restaurou-se.
text_el: ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ σημεῖόν ἐστιν αἰώνιον ὅτι ἐν ἓξ ἡμέραις ἐποίησεν κύριος τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἐπαύσατο καὶ κατέπαυσεν

text_en: And the Lord , when he had ended these words in Mount Sinai , gave to Moses two stone tables of testimony, written with the finger of God .
text_la: Deditque Dominus Moysi, completis hujuscemodi sermonibus in monte Sinai, duas tabulas testimonii lapideas, scriptas digito Dei.
text_pt: E deu a Moisés (quando acabou de falar com ele no monte Sinai) as duas tábuas do testemunho, tábuas de pedra, escritas pelo dedo de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Μωυσεῖ ἡνίκα κατέπαυσεν λαλῶν αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Σινα τὰς δύο πλάκας τοῦ μαρτυρίου πλάκας λιθίνας γεγραμμένας τῷ δακτύλῳ τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And the people seeing that Moses delayed to come down from the mount , gathering together against Aaron , said: Arise, make us gods , that may go before us: For as to this Moses , the man that brought us out of the land of Egypt , we know not what has befallen him.
text_la: Videns autem populus quod moram faceret descendendi de monte Moyses, congregatus adversus Aaron, dixit : Surge, fac nobis deos, qui nos præcedant : Moysi enim huic viro, qui nos eduxit de terra Ægypti, ignoramus quid acciderit.
text_pt: Mas vendo o povo que Moisés tardava em descer do monte, acercou-se de Arão, e disse-lhe: Levanta-te, faze-nos deuses, que vão adiante de nós; porque quanto a este Moisés, o homem que nos tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe sucedeu.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν ὁ λαὸς ὅτι κεχρόνικεν Μωυσῆς καταβῆναι ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους συνέστη ὁ λαὸς ἐπὶ Ααρων καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ἀνάστηθι καὶ ποίησον ἡμῖν θεούς οἳ προπορεύσονται ἡμῶν ὁ γὰρ Μωυσῆς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί γέγονεν αὐτῷ

text_en: And Aaron said to them: Take the golden earrings from the ears of your wives, and your sons and daughters, and bring them to me.
text_la: Dixitque ad eos Aaron : Tollite inaures aureas de uxorum, filiorumque et filiarum vestrarum auribus, et afferte ad me.
text_pt: E Arão lhes disse: Arrancai os pendentes de ouro, que estão nas orelhas de vossas mulheres, e de vossos filhos, e de vossas filhas, e trazei-mos.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ααρων περιέλεσθε τὰ ἐνώτια τὰ χρυσᾶ τὰ ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν τῶν γυναικῶν ὑμῶν καὶ θυγατέρων καὶ ἐνέγκατε πρός με

text_en: And the people did what he had commanded, bringing the earrings to Aaron .
text_la: Fecitque populus quæ jusserat, deferens inaures ad Aaron.
text_pt: Então todo o povo arrancou os pendentes de ouro, que estavam nas suas orelhas, e os trouxeram a Arão.
text_el: καὶ περιείλαντο πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τὰ ἐνώτια τὰ χρυσᾶ τὰ ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἤνεγκαν πρὸς Ααρων

text_en: And when he had received them, he fashioned them by founders' work, and made of them a molten calf . And they said: These are your gods, O Israel , that have brought you out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Quas cum ille accepisset, formavit opere fusorio, et fecit ex eis vitulum conflatilem : dixeruntque : Hi sunt dii tui Israël, qui te eduxerunt de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E ele os tomou das suas mãos, e trabalhou o ouro com um buril, e fez dele um bezerro de fundição. Então disseram: Este é teu deus, ó Israel, que te tirou da terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐδέξατο ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔπλασεν αὐτὰ ἐν τῇ γραφίδι καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτὰ μόσχον χωνευτὸν καὶ εἶπεν οὗτοι οἱ θεοί σου Ισραηλ οἵτινες ἀνεβίβασάν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And when Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it, and made proclamation by a crier's voice, saying Tomorrow is the solemnity of the Lord .
text_la: Quod cum vidisset Aaron, ædificavit altare coram eo, et præconis voce clamavit dicens : Cras solemnitas Domini est.
text_pt: E Arão, vendo isto, edificou um altar diante dele; e apregoou Arão, e disse: Amanhã será festa ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν Ααρων ᾠκοδόμησεν θυσιαστήριον κατέναντι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκήρυξεν Ααρων λέγων ἑορτὴ τοῦ κυρίου αὔριον

text_en: And rising in the morning, they offered holocausts , and peace victims, and the people sat down to eat and drink, and they rose up to play.
text_la: Surgentesque mane, obtulerunt holocausta, et hostias pacificas, et sedit populus manducare, et bibere, et surrexerunt ludere.
text_pt: E no dia seguinte madrugaram, e ofereceram holocaustos, e trouxeram ofertas pacíficas; e o povo assentou-se a comer e a beber; depois levantou-se a folgar.
text_el: καὶ ὀρθρίσας τῇ ἐπαύριον ἀνεβίβασεν ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ προσήνεγκεν θυσίαν σωτηρίου καὶ ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying: Go, get you down: your people, which you have brought out of the land of Egypt , has sinned .
text_la: Locutus est autem Dominus ad Moysen, dicens : Vade, descende : peccavit populus tuus, quem eduxisti de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Vai, desce; porque o teu povo, que fizeste subir do Egito, se tem corrompido,
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων βάδιζε τὸ τάχος ἐντεῦθεν κατάβηθι ἠνόμησεν γὰρ ὁ λαός σου οὓς ἐξήγαγες ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: They have quickly strayed from the way which you showed them: and they have made to themselves a molten calf , and have adored it, and sacrificing victims to it, have said: These are your gods , O Israel , that have brought you out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Recesserunt cito de via, quam ostendisti eis : feceruntque sibi vitulum conflatilem, et adoraverunt, atque immolantes ei hostias, dixerunt : Isti sunt dii tui Israël, qui te eduxerunt de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E depressa se tem desviado do caminho que eu lhe tinha ordenado; eles fizeram para si um bezerro de fundição, e perante ele se inclinaram, e ofereceram-lhe sacrifícios, e disseram: Este é o teu deus, ó Israel, que te tirou da terra do Egito.
text_el: παρέβησαν ταχὺ ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἧς ἐνετείλω αὐτοῖς ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς μόσχον καὶ προσκεκυνήκασιν αὐτῷ καὶ τεθύκασιν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπαν οὗτοι οἱ θεοί σου Ισραηλ οἵτινες ἀνεβίβασάν σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And again the Lord said to Moses : I see that this people is stiffnecked:
text_la: Rursumque ait Dominus ad Moysen : Cerno quod populus iste duræ cervicis sit:
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Tenho visto a este povo, e eis que é povo de dura cerviz.

text_en: Let me alone, that my wrath may be kindled against them, and that I may destroy them, and I will make of you a great nation.
text_la: dimitte me, ut irascatur furor meus contra eos, et deleam eos, faciamque te in gentem magnam.
text_pt: Agora, pois, deixa-me, para que o meu furor se acenda contra ele, e o consuma; e eu farei de ti uma grande nação.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἔασόν με καὶ θυμωθεὶς ὀργῇ εἰς αὐτοὺς ἐκτρίψω αὐτοὺς καὶ ποιήσω σὲ εἰς ἔθνος μέγα

text_en: But Moses besought the Lord his God , saying: Why, O Lord , is your indignation enkindled against your people, whom you have brought out of the land of Egypt , with great power, and with a mighty hand?
text_la: Moyses autem orabat Dominum Deum suum, dicens : Cur, Domine, irascitur furor tuus contra populum tuum, quem eduxisti de terra Ægypti, in fortitudine magna, et in manu robusta?
text_pt: Moisés, porém, suplicou ao Senhor seu Deus e disse: Ó Senhor, por que se acende o teu furor contra o teu povo, que tiraste da terra do Egito com grande força e com forte mão?
text_el: καὶ ἐδεήθη Μωυσῆς ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἵνα τί κύριε θυμοῖ ὀργῇ εἰς τὸν λαόν σου οὓς ἐξήγαγες ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ἐν ἰσχύι μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν τῷ βραχίονί σου τῷ ὑψηλῷ

text_en: Let not the Egyptians say, I beseech you: He craftily brought them out, that he might kill them in the mountains, and destroy them from the earth: let your anger cease, and be appeased upon the wickedness of your people.
text_la: Ne quæso dicant Ægyptii : Callide eduxit eos, ut interficeret in montibus, et deleret e terra : quiescat ira tua, et esto placabilis super nequitia populi tui.
text_pt: Por que hão de falar os egípcios, dizendo: Para mal os tirou, para matá-los nos montes, e para destruí-los da face da terra? Torna-te do furor da tua ira, e arrepende-te deste mal contra o teu povo.
text_el: μήποτε εἴπωσιν οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι λέγοντες μετὰ πονηρίας ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἀποκτεῖναι ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ ἐξαναλῶσαι αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς παῦσαι τῆς ὀργῆς τοῦ θυμοῦ σου καὶ ἵλεως γενοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ κακίᾳ τοῦ λαοῦ σου

text_en: Remember Abraham , Isaac , and Israel , your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, saying: I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven : and this whole land that I have spoken of, I will give to your seed, and you shall possess it for ever:
text_la: Recordare Abraham, Isaac, et Israël servorum tuorum, quibus jurasti per temetipsum, dicens : Multiplicabo semen vestrum sicut stellas cæli; et universam terram hanc, de qua locutus sum, dabo semini vestro, et possidebitis eam semper.
text_pt: Lembra-te de Abraão, de Isaque, e de Israel, os teus servos, aos quais por ti mesmo tens jurado, e lhes disseste: Multiplicarei a vossa descendência como as estrelas dos céus, e darei à vossa descendência toda esta terra, de que tenho falado, para que a possuam por herança eternamente.
text_el: μνησθεὶς Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ τῶν σῶν οἰκετῶν οἷς ὤμοσας κατὰ σεαυτοῦ καὶ ἐλάλησας πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων πολυπληθυνῶ τὸ σπέρμα ὑμῶν ὡσεὶ τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἣν εἶπας δοῦναι τῷ σπέρματι αὐτῶν καὶ καθέξουσιν αὐτὴν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And the Lord was appeased from doing the evil which he had spoken against his people .
text_la: Placatusque est Dominus ne faceret malum quod locutus fuerat adversus populum suum.
text_pt: Então o Senhor arrependeu-se do mal que dissera que havia de fazer ao seu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἱλάσθη κύριος περὶ τῆς κακίας ἧς εἶπεν ποιῆσαι τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Moses returned from the mount , carrying the two tables of the testimony in his hand, written on both sides,
text_la: Et reversus est Moyses de monte, portans duas tabulas testimonii in manu sua, scriptas ex utraque parte,
text_pt: E virou-se Moisés e desceu do monte com as duas tábuas do testemunho na mão, tábuas escritas de ambos os lados; de um e de outro lado estavam escritas.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψας Μωυσῆς κατέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους καὶ αἱ δύο πλάκες τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ πλάκες λίθιναι καταγεγραμμέναι ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν μερῶν αὐτῶν ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν ἦσαν γεγραμμέναι

text_en: and made by the work of God ; the writing also of God was graven in the tables.
text_la: et factas opere Dei : scriptura quoque Dei erat sculpta in tabulis.
text_pt: E aquelas tábuas eram obra de Deus; também a escritura era a mesma escritura de Deus, esculpida nas tábuas.
text_el: καὶ αἱ πλάκες ἔργον θεοῦ ἦσαν καὶ ἡ γραφὴ γραφὴ θεοῦ ἐστιν κεκολαμμένη ἐν ταῖς πλαξίν

text_en: And Joshua hearing the noise of the people shouting, said to Moses : The noise of battle is heard in the camp.
text_la: Audiens autem Josue tumultum populi vociferantis, dixit ad Moysen : Ululatus pugnæ auditur in castris.
text_pt: E, ouvindo Josué a voz do povo que jubilava, disse a Moisés: Alarido de guerra há no arraial.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσας Ἰησοῦς τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ λαοῦ κραζόντων λέγει πρὸς Μωυσῆν φωνὴ πολέμου ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ

text_en: But he answered: It is not the cry of men encouraging to fight, nor the shout of men compelling to flee: but I hear the voice of singers.
text_la: Qui respondit : Non est clamor adhortantium ad pugnam, neque vociferatio compellentium ad fugam : sed vocem cantantium ego audio.
text_pt: Porém ele respondeu: Não é alarido dos vitoriosos, nem alarido dos vencidos, mas o alarido dos que cantam, eu ouço.
text_el: καὶ λέγει οὐκ ἔστιν φωνὴ ἐξαρχόντων κατ' ἰσχὺν οὐδὲ φωνὴ ἐξαρχόντων τροπῆς ἀλλὰ φωνὴν ἐξαρχόντων οἴνου ἐγὼ ἀκούω

text_en: And when he came near to the camp, he saw the calf , and the dances : and being very angry , he threw the tables out of his hand, and broke them at the foot of the mount :
text_la: Cumque appropinquasset ad castra, vidit vitulum, et choros : iratusque valde, projecit de manu tabulas, et confregit eas ad radicem montis:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, chegando Moisés ao arraial, e vendo o bezerro e as danças, acendeu-se-lhe o furor, e arremessou as tábuas das suas mãos, e quebrou-as ao pé do monte;
text_el: καὶ ἡνίκα ἤγγιζεν τῇ παρεμβολῇ ὁρᾷ τὸν μόσχον καὶ τοὺς χορούς καὶ ὀργισθεὶς θυμῷ Μωυσῆς ἔρριψεν ἀπὸ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ τὰς δύο πλάκας καὶ συνέτριψεν αὐτὰς ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος

text_en: And laying hold of the calf which they had made, he burnt it, and beat it to powder, which he strewed into water, and gave thereof to the children of Israel to drink.
text_la: arripiensque vitulum quem fecerant, combussit, et contrivit usque ad pulverem, quem sparsit in aquam, et dedit ex eo potum filiis Israël.
text_pt: E tomou o bezerro que tinham feito, e queimou-o no fogo, moendo-o até que se tornou em pó; e o espargiu sobre as águas, e deu-o a beber aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν τὸν μόσχον ὃν ἐποίησαν κατέκαυσεν αὐτὸν ἐν πυρὶ καὶ κατήλεσεν αὐτὸν λεπτὸν καὶ ἔσπειρεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ ἐπότισεν αὐτὸ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: And he said to Aaron : What has this people done to you, that you should bring upon them a most heinous sin ?
text_la: Dixitque ad Aaron : Quid tibi fecit hic populus, ut induceres super eum peccatum maximum?
text_pt: E Moisés perguntou a Arão: Que te tem feito este povo, que sobre ele trouxeste tamanho pecado?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς τῷ Ααρων τί ἐποίησέν σοι ὁ λαὸς οὗτος ὅτι ἐπήγαγες ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἁμαρτίαν μεγάλην

text_en: And he answered him: Let not my lord be offended; for you know this people, that they are prone to evil .
text_la: Cui ille respondit : Ne indignetur dominus meus : tu enim nosti populum istum, quod pronus sit ad malum:
text_pt: Então respondeu Arão: Não se acenda a ira do meu senhor; tu sabes que este povo é inclinado ao mal;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ααρων πρὸς Μωυσῆν μὴ ὀργίζου κύριε σὺ γὰρ οἶδας τὸ ὅρμημα τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου

text_en: They said to me: make us gods , that may go before us; for as to this Moses , who brought us forth out of the land of Egypt , we know not what is befallen him.
text_la: dixerunt mihi : Fac nobis deos, qui nos præcedant : huic enim Moysi, qui nos eduxit de terra Ægypti, nescimus quid acciderit.
text_pt: E eles me disseram: Faze-nos um deus que vá adiante de nós; porque não sabemos o que sucedeu a este Moisés, a este homem que nos tirou da terra do Egito.
text_el: λέγουσιν γάρ μοι ποίησον ἡμῖν θεούς οἳ προπορεύσονται ἡμῶν ὁ γὰρ Μωυσῆς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί γέγονεν αὐτῷ

text_en: And I said to them: Which of you has any gold? And they took and brought it to me; and I cast it into the fire, and this calf came out.
text_la: Quibus ego dixi : Quis vestrum habet aurum? Tulerunt, et dederunt mihi : et projeci illud in ignem, egressusque est hic vitulus.
text_pt: Então eu lhes disse: Quem tem ouro, arranque-o; e deram-mo, e lancei-o no fogo, e saiu este bezerro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα αὐτοῖς εἴ τινι ὑπάρχει χρυσία περιέλεσθε καὶ ἔδωκάν μοι καὶ ἔρριψα εἰς τὸ πῦρ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ μόσχος οὗτος

text_en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked, (for Aaron had stripped them by occasion of the shame of the filth, and had set them naked among their enemies)
text_la: Videns ergo Moyses populum quod esset nudatus (spoliaverat enim eum Aaron propter ignominiam sordis, et inter hostes nudum constituerat),
text_pt: E, vendo Moisés que o povo estava despido, porque Arão o havia deixado despir-se para vergonha entre os seus inimigos,
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν Μωυσῆς τὸν λαὸν ὅτι διεσκέδασται διεσκέδασεν γὰρ αὐτοὺς Ααρων ἐπίχαρμα τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις αὐτῶν

text_en: then standing in the gate of the camp, he said: If any man be on the Lord's side, let him join with me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him:
text_la: et stans in porta castrorum, ait : Si quis est Domini, jungatur mihi. Congregatique sunt ad eum omnes filii Levi:
text_pt: Pôs-se em pé Moisés na porta do arraial e disse: Quem é do Senhor, venha a mim. Então se ajuntaram a ele todos os filhos de Levi.
text_el: ἔστη δὲ Μωυσῆς ἐπὶ τῆς πύλης τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ εἶπεν τίς πρὸς κύριον ἴτω πρός με συνῆλθον οὖν πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Λευι

text_en: And he said to them: Thus says the Lord God of Israel : Put every man his sword upon his thigh: go, and return from gate to gate through the midst of the camp, and let every man kill his brother, and friend, and neighbour.
text_la: quibus ait : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Ponat vir gladium super femur suum : ite, et redite de porta usque ad portam per medium castrorum, et occidat unusquisque fratrem, et amicum, et proximum suum.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Cada um ponha a sua espada sobre a sua coxa; e passai e tornai pelo arraial de porta em porta, e mate cada um a seu irmão, e cada um a seu amigo, e cada um a seu vizinho.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ θέσθε ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ῥομφαίαν ἐπὶ τὸν μηρὸν καὶ διέλθατε καὶ ἀνακάμψατε ἀπὸ πύλης ἐπὶ πύλην διὰ τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἀποκτείνατε ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος τὸν ἔγγιστα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the sons of Levi did according to the words of Moses , and there were slain that day about three and twenty thousand men .
text_la: Feceruntque filii Levi juxta sermonem Moysi, cecideruntque in die illa quasi viginti tria millia hominum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Levi fizeram conforme à palavra de Moisés; e caíram do povo aquele dia uns três mil homens.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Λευι καθὰ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ εἰς τρισχιλίους ἄνδρας

text_en: And Moses said: You have consecrated your hands this day to the Lord , every man in his son and in his brother, that a blessing may be given to you.
text_la: Et ait Moyses : Consecrastis manus vestras hodie Domino, unusquisque in filio, et in fratre suo, ut detur vobis benedictio.
text_pt: Porquanto Moisés tinha dito: Consagrai hoje as vossas mãos ao Senhor; porquanto cada um será contra o seu filho e contra o seu irmão; e isto, para que ele vos conceda hoje uma bênção.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς ἐπληρώσατε τὰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν σήμερον κυρίῳ ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ υἱῷ ἢ τῷ ἀδελφῷ δοθῆναι ἐφ' ὑμᾶς εὐλογίαν

text_en: And when the next day had come, Moses spoke to the people: You have sinned a very great sin : I will go up to the Lord , if by any means I may be able to entreat him for your crime.
text_la: Facto autem altero die, locutus est Moyses ad populum : Peccastis peccatum maximum : ascendam ad Dominum, si quomodo quivero eum deprecari pro scelere vestro.
text_pt: E aconteceu que no dia seguinte Moisés disse ao povo: Vós cometestes grande pecado. Agora, porém, subirei ao Senhor; porventura farei propiciação por vosso pecado.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὴν αὔριον εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς τὸν λαόν ὑμεῖς ἡμαρτήκατε ἁμαρτίαν μεγάλην καὶ νῦν ἀναβήσομαι πρὸς τὸν θεόν ἵνα ἐξιλάσωμαι περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν

text_en: And returning to the Lord , he said: I beseech you: this people has sinned a heinous sin , and they have made to themselves gods of gold: either forgive them this trespass,
text_la: Reversusque ad Dominum, ait : Obsecro, peccavit populus iste peccatum maximum, feceruntque sibi deos aureos : aut dimitte eis hanc noxam,
text_pt: Assim tornou-se Moisés ao Senhor, e disse: Ora, este povo cometeu grande pecado fazendo para si deuses de ouro.
text_el: ὑπέστρεψεν δὲ Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον καὶ εἶπεν δέομαι κύριε ἡμάρτηκεν ὁ λαὸς οὗτος ἁμαρτίαν μεγάλην καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς θεοὺς χρυσοῦς

text_en: or if you do not, strike me out of the book that you have written.
text_la: aut si non facis, dele me de libro tuo quem scripsisti.
text_pt: Agora, pois, perdoa o seu pecado; se não, risca-me, peço-te, do teu livro, que tens escrito.
text_el: καὶ νῦν εἰ μὲν ἀφεῖς αὐτοῖς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἄφες εἰ δὲ μή ἐξάλειψόν με ἐκ τῆς βίβλου σου ἧς ἔγραψας

text_en: And the Lord answered him: He that has sinned against me, him will I strike out of my book:
text_la: Cui respondit Dominus : Qui peccaverit mihi, delebo eum de libro meo:
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Aquele que pecar contra mim, a este riscarei do meu livro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν εἴ τις ἡμάρτηκεν ἐνώπιόν μου ἐξαλείψω αὐτὸν ἐκ τῆς βίβλου μου

text_en: But go and lead this people whither I have told you: my angel shall go before you. And I in the day of revenge will visit this sin also of theirs.
text_la: tu autem vade, et duc populum istum quo locutus sum tibi : angelus meus præcedet te. Ego autem in die ultionis visitabo et hoc peccatum eorum.
text_pt: Vai, pois, agora, conduze este povo para onde te tenho dito; eis que o meu anjo irá adiante de ti; porém no dia da minha visitação visitarei neles o seu pecado.
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ βάδιζε κατάβηθι καὶ ὁδήγησον τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν εἶπά σοι ἰδοὺ ὁ ἄγγελός μου προπορεύεται πρὸ προσώπου σου ᾗ δ' ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπισκέπτωμαι ἐπάξω ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord therefore struck the people for the guilt, on occasion of the calf which Aaron had made.
text_la: Percussit ergo Dominus populum pro reatu vituli, quem fecerat Aaron.
text_pt: Assim feriu o Senhor o povo, por ter sido feito o bezerro que Arão tinha formado.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν κύριος τὸν λαὸν περὶ τῆς ποιήσεως τοῦ μόσχου οὗ ἐποίησεν Ααρων

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying: Go, get up from this place, you and your people which you have brought out of the land of Egypt , into the land concerning which I swore to Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , saying: To your seed I will give it:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens : Vade, ascende de loco isto tu, et populus tuus quem eduxisti de terra Ægypti, in terram quam juravi Abraham, Isaac et Jacob, dicens : Semini tuo dabo eam:
text_pt: Disse mais o SENHOR a Moisés: Vai, sobe daqui, tu e o povo que fizeste subir da terra do Egito, à terra que jurei a Abraão, a Isaque, e a Jacó, dizendo: À tua descendência a darei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν πορεύου ἀνάβηθι ἐντεῦθεν σὺ καὶ ὁ λαός σου οὓς ἐξήγαγες ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ λέγων τῷ σπέρματι ὑμῶν δώσω αὐτήν

text_en: And I will send an angel before you, that I may cast out the Chanaanite , and the Amorrhite , and the Hethite , and the Pherezite, and the Hevite, and the Jebusite,
text_la: et mittam præcursorem tui angelum, ut ejiciam Chananæum, et Amorrhæum, et Hethæum, et Pherezæum, et Hevæum, et Jebusæum,
text_pt: E enviarei um anjo adiante de ti, e lançarei fora os cananeus, e os amorreus, e os heteus, e os perizeus, e os heveus, e os jebuseus,
text_el: καὶ συναποστελῶ τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἐκβαλεῖ τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ Χετταῖον καὶ Φερεζαῖον καὶ Γεργεσαῖον καὶ Ευαῖον καὶ Ιεβουσαῖον

text_en: that you may enter into the land that flows with milk and honey. For I will not go up with you, because you are a stiffnecked people; lest I destroy you on the way.
text_la: et intres in terram fluentem lacte et melle. Non enim ascendam tecum, quia populus duræ cervicis es : ne forte disperdam te in via.
text_pt: A uma terra que mana leite e mel; porque eu não subirei no meio de ti, porquanto és povo de dura cerviz, para que te não consuma eu no caminho.
text_el: καὶ εἰσάξω σε εἰς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι οὐ γὰρ μὴ συναναβῶ μετὰ σοῦ διὰ τὸ λαὸν σκληροτράχηλόν σε εἶναι ἵνα μὴ ἐξαναλώσω σε ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ

text_en: And the people hearing these very bad tidings, mourned: and no man put on his ornaments according to custom.
text_la: Audiensque populus sermonem hunc pessimum, luxit : et nullus ex more indutus est cultu suo.
text_pt: E, ouvindo o povo esta má notícia, pranteou-se e ninguém pôs sobre si os seus atavios.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσας ὁ λαὸς τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ πονηρὸν τοῦτο κατεπένθησαν ἐν πενθικοῖς

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Say to the children of Israel : You are a stiffnecked people, once I shall come up in the midst of you, and shall destroy you. Now presently lay aside your ornaments, that I may know what to do to you.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Loquere filiis Israël : Populus duræ cervicis es : semel ascendam in medio tui, et delebo te. Jam nunc depone ornatum tuum, ut sciam quid faciam tibi.
text_pt: Porquanto o Senhor tinha dito a Moisés: Dize aos filhos de Israel: És povo de dura cerviz; se por um momento subir no meio de ti, te consumirei; porém agora tira os teus atavios, para que eu saiba o que te hei de fazer.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ὑμεῖς λαὸς σκληροτράχηλος ὁρᾶτε μὴ πληγὴν ἄλλην ἐπάξω ἐγὼ ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐξαναλώσω ὑμᾶς νῦν οὖν ἀφέλεσθε τὰς στολὰς τῶν δοξῶν ὑμῶν καὶ τὸν κόσμον καὶ δείξω σοι ἃ ποιήσω σοι

text_en: So the children of Israel laid aside their ornaments by Mount Horeb .
text_la: Deposuerunt ergo filii Israël ornatum suum a monte Horeb.
text_pt: Então os filhos de Israel se despojaram dos seus atavios, ao pé do monte Horebe.
text_el: καὶ περιείλαντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸν κόσμον αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν περιστολὴν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους τοῦ Χωρηβ

text_en: Moses also taking the tabernacle , pitched it without the camp afar off, and called the name thereof, The tabernacle of the covenant . And all the people, that had any question, went forth to the tabernacle of the covenant , without the camp.
text_la: Moyses quoque tollens tabernaculum, tetendit extra castra procul, vocavitque nomen ejus, Tabernaculum fœderis. Et omnis populus, qui habebat aliquam quæstionem, egrediebatur ad tabernaculum fœderis, extra castra.
text_pt: E tomou Moisés a tenda, e a estendeu para si fora do arraial, desviada longe do arraial, e chamou-lhe a tenda da congregação. E aconteceu que todo aquele que buscava o Senhor saía à tenda da congregação, que estava fora do arraial.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν Μωυσῆς τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ ἔπηξεν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἐκλήθη σκηνὴ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἐγένετο πᾶς ὁ ζητῶν κύριον ἐξεπορεύετο εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: And when Moses went forth to the tabernacle , all the people rose up, and every one stood in the door of his pavilion, and they beheld the back of Moses , till he went into the tabernacle .
text_la: Cumque egrederetur Moyses ad tabernaculum, surgebat universa plebs, et stabat unusquisque in ostio papilionis sui, aspiciebantque tergum Moysi, donec ingrederetur tentorium.
text_pt: E acontecia que, saindo Moisés à tenda, todo o povo se levantava, e cada um ficava em pé à porta da sua tenda; e olhava para Moisés pelas costas, até ele entrar na tenda.
text_el: ἡνίκα δ' ἂν εἰσεπορεύετο Μωυσῆς εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς εἱστήκει πᾶς ὁ λαὸς σκοπεύοντες ἕκαστος παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ κατενοοῦσαν ἀπιόντος Μωυσῆ ἕως τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν σκηνήν

text_en: And when he had gone into the tabernacle of the covenant , the pillar of the cloud came down, and stood at the door, and he spoke with Moses .
text_la: Ingresso autem illo tabernaculum fœderis, descendebat columna nubis, et stabat ad ostium, loquebaturque cum Moyse,
text_pt: E sucedia que, entrando Moisés na tenda, descia a coluna de nuvem, e punha-se à porta da tenda; e o Senhor falava com Moisés.
text_el: ὡς δ' ἂν εἰσῆλθεν Μωυσῆς εἰς τὴν σκηνήν κατέβαινεν ὁ στῦλος τῆς νεφέλης καὶ ἵστατο ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ ἐλάλει Μωυσῇ

text_en: And all saw that the pillar of the cloud stood at the door of the tabernacle . And they stood and worshipped at the doors of their tent.
text_la: cernentibus universis quod columna nubis staret ad ostium tabernaculi. Stabantque ipsi, et adorabant per fores tabernaculorum suorum.
text_pt: E, vendo todo o povo a coluna de nuvem que estava à porta da tenda, todo o povo se levantava e cada um, à porta da sua tenda, adorava.
text_el: καὶ ἑώρα πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τὸν στῦλον τῆς νεφέλης ἑστῶτα ἐπὶ τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ στάντες πᾶς ὁ λαὸς προσεκύνησαν ἕκαστος ἀπὸ τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as a man is wont to speak to his friend. And when he returned into the camp, his servant Joshua, the son of Nun , a young man, departed not from the tabernacle .
text_la: Loquebatur autem Dominus ad Moysen facie ad faciem, sicut solet loqui homo ad amicum suum. Cumque ille reverteretur in castra, minister ejus Josue filius Nun, puer, non recedebat de tabernaculo.
text_pt: E falava o Senhor a Moisés face a face, como qualquer fala com o seu amigo; depois tornava-se ao arraial; mas o seu servidor, o jovem Josué, filho de Num, nunca se apartava do meio da tenda.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐνώπιος ἐνωπίῳ ὡς εἴ τις λαλήσει πρὸς τὸν ἑαυτοῦ φίλον καὶ ἀπελύετο εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν ὁ δὲ θεράπων Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυη νέος οὐκ ἐξεπορεύετο ἐκ τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: And Moses said to the Lord : You command me to lead forth this people; and you do not let me know whom you will send with me, especially whereas you have said: I know you by name , and you have found favour in my sight.
text_la: Dixit autem Moyses ad Dominum : Præcipis ut educam populum istum : et non indicas mihi quem missurus es mecum, præsertim cum dixeris : Novi te ex nomine, et invenisti gratiam coram me.
text_pt: E Moisés disse ao Senhor: Eis que tu me dizes: Faze subir a este povo, porém não me fazes saber a quem hás de enviar comigo; e tu disseste: Conheço-te por teu nome, também achaste graça aos meus olhos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον ἰδοὺ σύ μοι λέγεις ἀνάγαγε τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον σὺ δὲ οὐκ ἐδήλωσάς μοι ὃν συναποστελεῖς μετ' ἐμοῦ σὺ δέ μοι εἶπας οἶδά σε παρὰ πάντας καὶ χάριν ἔχεις παρ' ἐμοί

text_en: If therefore I have found favour in your sight, show me your face, that I may know you, and may find grace before your eyes: look upon your people this nation .
text_la: Si ergo inveni gratiam in conspectu tuo, ostende mihi faciem tuam, ut sciam te, et inveniam gratiam ante oculos tuos : respice populum tuum gentem hanc.
text_pt: Agora, pois, se tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, rogo-te que me faças saber o teu caminho, e conhecer-te-ei, para que ache graça aos teus olhos; e considera que esta nação é o teu povo.
text_el: εἰ οὖν εὕρηκα χάριν ἐναντίον σου ἐμφάνισόν μοι σεαυτόν γνωστῶς ἴδω σε ὅπως ἂν ὦ εὑρηκὼς χάριν ἐναντίον σου καὶ ἵνα γνῶ ὅτι λαός σου τὸ ἔθνος τὸ μέγα τοῦτο

text_en: And the Lord said: My face shall go before you, and I will give you rest.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus : Facies mea præcedet te, et requiem dabo tibi.
text_pt: Disse pois: Irá a minha presença contigo para te fazer descansar.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτὸς προπορεύσομαί σου καὶ καταπαύσω σε

text_en: And Moses said: If you yourself do not go before, bring us not out of this place.
text_la: Et ait Moyses : Si non tu ipse præcedas, ne educas nos de loco isto.
text_pt: Então lhe disse: Se tu mesmo não fores conosco, não nos faças subir daqui.
text_el: καὶ λέγει πρὸς αὐτόν εἰ μὴ αὐτὸς σὺ πορεύῃ μή με ἀναγάγῃς ἐντεῦθεν

text_en: For how shall we be able to know, I and your people, that we have found grace in your sight, unless you walk with us, that we may be glorified by all people that dwell upon the earth?
text_la: In quo enim scire poterimus ego et populus tuus invenisse nos gratiam in conspectu tuo, nisi ambulaveris nobiscum, ut glorificemur ab omnibus populis qui habitant super terram?
text_pt: Como, pois, se saberá agora que tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, eu e o teu povo? Acaso não é por andares tu conosco, de modo a sermos separados, eu e o teu povo, de todos os povos que há sobre a face da terra?
text_el: καὶ πῶς γνωστὸν ἔσται ἀληθῶς ὅτι εὕρηκα χάριν παρὰ σοί ἐγώ τε καὶ ὁ λαός σου ἀλλ' ἢ συμπορευομένου σου μεθ' ἡμῶν καὶ ἐνδοξασθήσομαι ἐγώ τε καὶ ὁ λαός σου παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὅσα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐστιν

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : This word also, which you have spoken, will I do; for you have found grace before me, and you I have known by name .
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Moysen : Et verbum istud, quod locutus es, faciam : invenisti enim gratiam coram me, et teipsum novi ex nomine.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Farei também isto, que tens dito; porquanto achaste graça aos meus olhos, e te conheço por nome.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ τοῦτόν σοι τὸν λόγον ὃν εἴρηκας ποιήσω εὕρηκας γὰρ χάριν ἐνώπιόν μου καὶ οἶδά σε παρὰ πάντας

text_en: And he said: Show me your glory .
text_la: Qui ait : Ostende mihi gloriam tuam.
text_pt: Então ele disse: Rogo-te que me mostres a tua glória.
text_el: καὶ λέγει δεῖξόν μοι τὴν σεαυτοῦ δόξαν

text_en: He answered: I will show you all good , and I will proclaim in the name of the Lord before you: and I will have mercy on whom I will, and I will be merciful to whom it shall please me.
text_la: Respondit : Ego ostendam omne bonum tibi, et vocabo in nomine Domini coram te : et miserebor cui voluero, et clemens ero in quem mihi placuerit.
text_pt: Porém ele disse: Eu farei passar toda a minha bondade por diante de ti, e proclamarei o nome do Senhor diante de ti; e terei misericórdia de quem eu tiver misericórdia, e me compadecerei de quem eu me compadecer.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐγὼ παρελεύσομαι πρότερός σου τῇ δόξῃ μου καὶ καλέσω ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου κύριος ἐναντίον σου καὶ ἐλεήσω ὃν ἂν ἐλεῶ καὶ οἰκτιρήσω ὃν ἂν οἰκτίρω

text_en: And again he said: You can not see my face : for man shall not see me , and live.
text_la: Rursumque ait : Non poteris videre faciem meam : non enim videbit me homo et vivet.
text_pt: E disse mais: Não poderás ver a minha face, porquanto homem nenhum verá a minha face, e viverá.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν οὐ δυνήσῃ ἰδεῖν μου τὸ πρόσωπον οὐ γὰρ μὴ ἴδῃ ἄνθρωπος τὸ πρόσωπόν μου καὶ ζήσεται

text_en: And again he said: Behold there is a place with me, and you shall stand upon the rock.
text_la: Et iterum : Ecce, inquit, est locus apud me, et stabis supra petram.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor: Eis aqui um lugar junto a mim; aqui te porás sobre a penha.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἰδοὺ τόπος παρ' ἐμοί στήσῃ ἐπὶ τῆς πέτρας

text_en: And when my glory shall pass, I will set you in a hole of the rock, and protect you with my righthand till I pass:
text_la: Cumque transibit gloria mea, ponam te in foramine petræ, et protegam dextera mea, donec transeam:
text_pt: E acontecerá que, quando a minha glória passar, pôr-te-ei numa fenda da penha, e te cobrirei com a minha mão, até que eu haja passado.
text_el: ἡνίκα δ' ἂν παρέλθῃ μου ἡ δόξα καὶ θήσω σε εἰς ὀπὴν τῆς πέτρας καὶ σκεπάσω τῇ χειρί μου ἐπὶ σέ ἕως ἂν παρέλθω

text_en: And I will take away my hand, and you shall see my back parts: but my face you can not see.
text_la: tollamque manum meam, et videbis posteriora mea : faciem autem meam videre non poteris.
text_pt: E, havendo eu tirado a minha mão, me verás pelas costas; mas a minha face não se verá.
text_el: καὶ ἀφελῶ τὴν χεῖρα καὶ τότε ὄψῃ τὰ ὀπίσω μου τὸ δὲ πρόσωπόν μου οὐκ ὀφθήσεταί σοι

text_en: And after this he said: Hew you two tables of stone like unto the former, and I will write upon them the words, which were in the tables, which you broke.
text_la: Ac deinceps : Præcide, ait, tibi duas tabulas lapideas instar priorum, et scribam super eas verba, quæ habuerunt tabulæ quas fregisti.
text_pt: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Lavra duas tábuas de pedra, como as primeiras; e eu escreverei nas tábuas as mesmas palavras que estavam nas primeiras tábuas, que tu quebraste.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λάξευσον σεαυτῷ δύο πλάκας λιθίνας καθὼς καὶ αἱ πρῶται καὶ ἀνάβηθι πρός με εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ γράψω ἐπὶ τῶν πλακῶν τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἦν ἐν ταῖς πλαξὶν ταῖς πρώταις αἷς συνέτριψας

text_en: Be ready in the morning, that you may forthwith go up into Mount Sinai , and you shall stand with me upon the top of the mount .
text_la: Esto paratus mane, ut ascendas statim in montem Sinai, stabisque mecum super verticem montis.
text_pt: E prepara-te para amanhã, para que subas pela manhã ao monte Sinai, e ali põe-te diante de mim no cume do monte.
text_el: καὶ γίνου ἕτοιμος εἰς τὸ πρωὶ καὶ ἀναβήσῃ ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινα καὶ στήσῃ μοι ἐκεῖ ἐπ' ἄκρου τοῦ ὄρους

text_en: Let no man go up with you, and let not any man be seen throughout all the mount ; neither let the oxen nor the sheep feed over against it.
text_la: Nullus ascendat tecum, nec videatur quispiam per totum montem : boves quoque et oves non pascantur e contra.
text_pt: E ninguém suba contigo, e também ninguém apareça em todo o monte; nem ovelhas nem bois se apascentem defronte do monte.
text_el: καὶ μηδεὶς ἀναβήτω μετὰ σοῦ μηδὲ ὀφθήτω ἐν παντὶ τῷ ὄρει καὶ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ αἱ βόες μὴ νεμέσθωσαν πλησίον τοῦ ὄρους ἐκείνου

text_en: Then he cut out two tables of stone, such as had been before; and rising very early he went up into the Mount Sinai , as the Lord had commanded him, carrying with him the tables.
text_la: Excidit ergo duas tabulas lapideas, quales antea fuerant : et de nocte consurgens ascendit in montem Sinai, sicut præceperat ei Dominus, portans secum tabulas.
text_pt: Então Moisés lavrou duas tábuas de pedra, como as primeiras; e levantando-se pela manhã de madrugada, subiu ao monte Sinai, como o Senhor lhe tinha ordenado; e levou as duas tábuas de pedra nas suas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάξευσεν δύο πλάκας λιθίνας καθάπερ καὶ αἱ πρῶται καὶ ὀρθρίσας Μωυσῆς ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σινα καθότι συνέταξεν αὐτῷ κύριος καὶ ἔλαβεν Μωυσῆς τὰς δύο πλάκας τὰς λιθίνας

text_en: And when the Lord had come down in a cloud, Moses stood with him, calling upon the name of the Lord .
text_la: Cumque descendisset Dominus per nubem, stetit Moyses cum eo, invocans nomen Domini.
text_pt: E o Senhor desceu numa nuvem e se pôs ali junto a ele; e ele proclamou o nome do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη κύριος ἐν νεφέλῃ καὶ παρέστη αὐτῷ ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: And when he passed before him, he said: O the Lord , the Lord God , merciful and gracious, patient and of much compassion, and true ,
text_la: Quo transeunte coram eo, ait : Dominator Domine Deus, misericors et clemens, patiens et multæ miserationis, ac verax,
text_pt: Passando, pois, o Senhor perante ele, clamou: O Senhor, o Senhor Deus, misericordioso e piedoso, tardio em irar-se e grande em beneficência e verdade;
text_el: καὶ παρῆλθεν κύριος πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἐλεήμων μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος καὶ ἀληθινὸς

text_en: who keeps mercy unto thousands: who takes away iniquity , and wickedness , and sin , and no man of himself is innocent before you. Who renders the iniquity of the fathers to the children, and to the grandchildren unto the third and fourth generation .
text_la: qui custodis misericordiam in millia; qui aufers iniquitatem, et scelera, atque peccata, nullusque apud te per se innocens est; qui reddis iniquitatem patrum filiis, ac nepotibus in tertiam et quartam progeniem.
text_pt: Que guarda a beneficência em milhares; que perdoa a iniqüidade, e a transgressão e o pecado; que ao culpado não tem por inocente; que visita a iniqüidade dos pais sobre os filhos e sobre os filhos dos filhos até a terceira e quarta geração.
text_el: καὶ δικαιοσύνην διατηρῶν καὶ ποιῶν ἔλεος εἰς χιλιάδας ἀφαιρῶν ἀνομίας καὶ ἀδικίας καὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ οὐ καθαριεῖ τὸν ἔνοχον ἐπάγων ἀνομίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα καὶ ἐπὶ τέκνα τέκνων ἐπὶ τρίτην καὶ τετάρτην γενεάν

text_en: And Moses making haste, bowed down prostrate unto the earth, and adoring ,
text_la: Festinusque Moyses, curvatus est pronus in terram, et adorans
text_pt: E Moisés apressou-se, e inclinou a cabeça à terra, adorou,
text_el: καὶ σπεύσας Μωυσῆς κύψας ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν προσεκύνησεν

text_en: said: If I have found grace in your sight, O Lord , I beseech you that you will go with us, (for it is a stiffnecked people) and take away our iniquities and sin , and possess us.
text_la: ait : Si inveni gratiam in conspectu tuo, Domine, obsecro ut gradiaris nobiscum (populus enim duræ cervicis est) et auferas iniquitates nostras atque peccata, nosque possideas.
text_pt: E disse: Senhor, se agora tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, vá agora o Senhor no meio de nós; porque este é povo de dura cerviz; porém perdoa a nossa iniqüidade e o nosso pecado, e toma-nos por tua herança.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν εἰ εὕρηκα χάριν ἐνώπιόν σου συμπορευθήτω ὁ κύριός μου μεθ' ἡμῶν ὁ λαὸς γὰρ σκληροτράχηλός ἐστιν καὶ ἀφελεῖς σὺ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν καὶ τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν καὶ ἐσόμεθα σοί

text_en: The Lord answered: I will make a covenant in the sight of all, I will do signs such as were never seen upon the earth, nor in any nations; that this people, in the midst of whom you are, may see the terrible work of the Lord which I will do.
text_la: Respondit Dominus : Ego inibo pactum videntibus cunctis : signa faciam quæ numquam visa sunt super terram, nec in ullis gentibus, ut cernat populus iste, in cujus es medio, opus Domini terribile quod facturus sum.
text_pt: Então disse: Eis que eu faço uma aliança; farei diante de todo o teu povo maravilhas que nunca foram feitas em toda a terra, nem em nação alguma; de maneira que todo este povo, em cujo meio tu estás, veja a obra do Senhor; porque coisa terrível é o que faço contigo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ τίθημί σοι διαθήκην ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ σου ποιήσω ἔνδοξα ἃ οὐ γέγονεν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ καὶ ἐν παντὶ ἔθνει καὶ ὄψεται πᾶς ὁ λαός ἐν οἷς εἶ σύ τὰ ἔργα κυρίου ὅτι θαυμαστά ἐστιν ἃ ἐγὼ ποιήσω σοι

text_en: Observe all things which this day I command you: I myself will drive out before your face the Amorrhite , and the Chanaanite , and the Hethite , and the Pherezite, and the Hevite, and the Jebusite.
text_la: Observa cuncta quæ hodie mando tibi : ego ipse ejiciam ante faciem tuam Amorrhæum, et Chananæum, et Hethæum, Pherezæum quoque, et Hevæum, et Jebusæum.
text_pt: Guarda o que eu te ordeno hoje; eis que eu lançarei fora diante de ti os amorreus, e os cananeus, e os heteus, e os perizeus, e os heveus e os jebuseus.
text_el: πρόσεχε σὺ πάντα ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐκβάλλω πρὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ Χαναναῖον καὶ Χετταῖον καὶ Φερεζαῖον καὶ Ευαῖον καὶ Γεργεσαῖον καὶ Ιεβουσαῖον

text_en: Beware that you never join in friendship with the inhabitants of that land, which may be your ruin:
text_la: Cave ne umquam cum habitatoribus terræ illius jungas amicitias, quæ sint tibi in ruinam:
text_pt: Guarda-te de fazeres aliança com os moradores da terra aonde hás de entrar; para que não seja por laço no meio de ti.
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μήποτε θῇς διαθήκην τοῖς ἐγκαθημένοις ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ εἰς αὐτήν μή σοι γένηται πρόσκομμα ἐν ὑμῖν

text_en: But destroy their altars , break their statues and cut down their groves:
text_la: sed aras eorum destrue, confringe statuas, lucosque succide:
text_pt: Mas os seus altares derrubareis, e as suas estátuas quebrareis, e os seus bosques cortareis.
text_el: τοὺς βωμοὺς αὐτῶν καθελεῖτε καὶ τὰς στήλας αὐτῶν συντρίψετε καὶ τὰ ἄλση αὐτῶν ἐκκόψετε καὶ τὰ γλυπτὰ τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν κατακαύσετε ἐν πυρί

text_en: Adore not any strange god . The Lord his name is jealous , he is a jealous God .
text_la: noli adorare deum alienum. Dominus zelotes nomen ejus; Deus est æmulator.
text_pt: Porque não te inclinarás diante de outro deus; pois o nome do Senhor é Zeloso; é um Deus zeloso.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ μὴ προσκυνήσητε θεῷ ἑτέρῳ ὁ γὰρ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ζηλωτὸν ὄνομα θεὸς ζηλωτής ἐστιν

text_en: Make no covenant with the men of those countries; lest, when they have committed fornication with their gods, and have adored their idols , some one call you to eat of the things sacrificed .
text_la: Ne ineas pactum cum hominibus illarum regionum : ne, cum fornicati fuerint cum diis suis, et adoraverint simulacra eorum, vocet te quispiam ut comedas de immolatis.
text_pt: Para que não faças aliança com os moradores da terra, e quando eles se prostituírem após os seus deuses, ou sacrificarem aos seus deuses, tu, como convidado deles, comas também dos seus sacrifícios,
text_el: μήποτε θῇς διαθήκην τοῖς ἐγκαθημένοις πρὸς ἀλλοφύλους ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκπορνεύσωσιν ὀπίσω τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν καὶ θύσωσι τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ καλέσωσίν σε καὶ φάγῃς τῶν θυμάτων αὐτῶν

text_en: Neither shall you take of their daughters a wife for your son, lest after they themselves have committed fornication, they make your sons also to commit fornication with their gods.
text_la: Nec uxorem de filiabus eorum accipies filiis tuis : ne, postquam ipsæ fuerint fornicatæ, fornicari faciant et filios tuos in deos suos.
text_pt: E tomes mulheres das suas filhas para os teus filhos, e suas filhas, prostituindo-se com os seus deuses, façam que também teus filhos se prostituam com os seus deuses.
text_el: καὶ λάβῃς τῶν θυγατέρων αὐτῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς σου καὶ τῶν θυγατέρων σου δῷς τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκπορνεύσωσιν αἱ θυγατέρες σου ὀπίσω τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκπορνεύσωσιν τοὺς υἱούς σου ὀπίσω τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: You shall not make to yourself any molten gods .
text_la: Deos conflatiles non facies tibi.
text_pt: Não te farás deuses de fundição.
text_el: καὶ θεοὺς χωνευτοὺς οὐ ποιήσεις σεαυτῷ

text_en: You shall keep the feast of the unleavened bread . Seven days shall you eat unleavened bread , as I commanded you in the time of the month of the new corn: for in the month of the spring time you came out from Egypt .
text_la: Solemnitatem azymorum custodies. Septem diebus vesceris azymis, sicut præcepi tibi, in tempore mensis novorum : mense enim verni temporis egressus es de Ægypto.
text_pt: A festa dos pães ázimos guardarás; sete dias comerás pães ázimos, como te tenho ordenado, ao tempo apontado do mês de Abibe; porque no mês de Abibe saíste do Egito.
text_el: καὶ τὴν ἑορτὴν τῶν ἀζύμων φυλάξῃ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας φάγῃ ἄζυμα καθάπερ ἐντέταλμαί σοι εἰς τὸν καιρὸν ἐν μηνὶ τῶν νέων ἐν γὰρ μηνὶ τῶν νέων ἐξῆλθες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: All of the male kind that opens the womb , shall be mine. Of all beasts; both of oxen and of sheep, it shall be mine.
text_la: Omne quod aperit vulvam generis masculini, meum erit. De cunctis animantibus, tam de bobus, quam de ovibus, meum erit.
text_pt: Tudo o que abre a madre meu é, até todo o teu gado, que seja macho, e que abre a madre de vacas e de ovelhas;
text_el: πᾶν διανοῖγον μήτραν ἐμοί τὰ ἀρσενικά πρωτότοκον μόσχου καὶ πρωτότοκον προβάτου

text_en: The firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a sheep: but if you will not give a price for it, it shall be slain. The firstborn of your sons you shall redeem : neither shall you appear before me empty.
text_la: Primogenitum asini redimes ove : sin autem nec pretium pro eo dederis, occidetur. Primogenitum filiorum tuorum redimes : nec apparebis in conspectu meo vacuus.
text_pt: O burro, porém, que abrir a madre, resgatarás com um cordeiro; mas, se o não resgatares, cortar-lhe-ás a cabeça; todo o primogênito de teus filhos resgatarás. E ninguém aparecerá vazio diante de mim.
text_el: καὶ πρωτότοκον ὑποζυγίου λυτρώσῃ προβάτῳ ἐὰν δὲ μὴ λυτρώσῃ αὐτό τιμὴν δώσεις πᾶν πρωτότοκον τῶν υἱῶν σου λυτρώσῃ οὐκ ὀφθήσῃ ἐνώπιόν μου κενός

text_en: Six days shall you work, the seventh day you shall cease to plough and to reap.
text_la: Sex diebus operaberis; die septimo cessabis arare et metere.
text_pt: Seis dias trabalharás, mas ao sétimo dia descansarás: na aradura e na sega descansarás.
text_el: ἓξ ἡμέρας ἐργᾷ τῇ δὲ ἑβδόμῃ καταπαύσεις τῷ σπόρῳ καὶ τῷ ἀμήτῳ καταπαύσεις

text_en: You shall keep the feast of weeks with the firstfruits of the corn of your wheat harvest, and the feast when the time of the year returns that all things are laid in.
text_la: Solemnitatem hebdomadarum facies tibi in primitiis frugum messis tuæ triticeæ, et solemnitatem, quando redeunte anni tempore cuncta conduntur.
text_pt: Também guardarás a festa das semanas, que é a festa das primícias da sega do trigo, e a festa da colheita no fim do ano.
text_el: καὶ ἑορτὴν ἑβδομάδων ποιήσεις μοι ἀρχὴν θερισμοῦ πυρῶν καὶ ἑορτὴν συναγωγῆς μεσοῦντος τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ

text_en: Three times in the year all your males shall appear in the sight of the almighty Lord the God of Israel .
text_la: Tribus temporibus anni apparebit omne masculinum tuum in conspectu omnipotentis Domini Dei Israël.
text_pt: Três vezes ao ano todos os homens aparecerão perante o Senhor DEUS, o Deus de Israel;
text_el: τρεῖς καιροὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ὀφθήσεται πᾶν ἀρσενικόν σου ἐνώπιον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: For when I shall have taken away the nations from your face, and shall have enlarged your borders, no man shall lie in wait against your land when you shall go up, and appear in the sight of the Lord your God thrice in a year.
text_la: Cum enim tulero gentes a facie tua, et dilatavero terminos tuos, nullus insidiabitur terræ tuæ, ascendente te, et apparente in conspectu Domini Dei tui ter in anno.
text_pt: Porque eu lançarei fora as nações de diante de ti, e alargarei o teu território; ninguém cobiçará a tua terra, quando subires para aparecer três vezes no ano diante do Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: ὅταν γὰρ ἐκβάλω τὰ ἔθνη πρὸ προσώπου σου καὶ πλατύνω τὰ ὅριά σου οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσει οὐδεὶς τῆς γῆς σου ἡνίκα ἂν ἀναβαίνῃς ὀφθῆναι ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τρεῖς καιροὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ

text_en: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice upon leaven; neither shall there remain in the morning anything of the victim of the solemnity of the Phase .
text_la: Non immolabis super fermento sanguinem hostiæ meæ : neque residebit mane de victima solemnitatis Phase.
text_pt: Não sacrificarás o sangue do meu sacrifício com pão levedado, nem o sacrifício da festa da páscoa ficará da noite para a manhã.
text_el: οὐ σφάξεις ἐπὶ ζύμῃ αἷμα θυμιαμάτων μου καὶ οὐ κοιμηθήσεται εἰς τὸ πρωὶ θύματα τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ πασχα

text_en: The first of the fruits of your ground you shall offer in the house of the Lord your God . You shall not boil a kid in the milk of his dam.
text_la: Primitias frugum terræ tuæ offeres in domo Domini Dei tui. Non coques hædum in lacte matris suæ.
text_pt: As primícias dos primeiros frutos da tua terra trarás à casa do Senhor teu Deus; não cozerás o cabrito no leite de sua mãe.
text_el: τὰ πρωτογενήματα τῆς γῆς σου θήσεις εἰς τὸν οἶκον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου οὐ προσοίσεις ἄρνα ἐν γάλακτι μητρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses : Write you these words, by which I have made a covenant both with you and with Israel .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Scribe tibi verba hæc, quibus et tecum et cum Israël pepigi fœdus.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Escreve estas palavras; porque conforme ao teor destas palavras tenho feito aliança contigo e com Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν γράψον σεαυτῷ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐπὶ γὰρ τῶν λόγων τούτων τέθειμαί σοι διαθήκην καὶ τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights: he neither ate bread nor drank water, and he wrote upon the tables the ten words of the covenant.
text_la: Fuit ergo ibi cum Domino quadraginta dies et quadraginta noctes : panem non comedit, et aquam non bibit, et scripsit in tabulis verba fœderis decem.
text_pt: E esteve ali com o Senhor quarenta dias e quarenta noites; não comeu pão, nem bebeu água, e escreveu nas tábuas as palavras da aliança, os dez mandamentos.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ Μωυσῆς ἐναντίον κυρίου τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας ἄρτον οὖκ ἔφαγεν καὶ ὕδωρ οὐκ ἔπιεν καὶ ἔγραψεν τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐπὶ τῶν πλακῶν τῆς διαθήκης τοὺς δέκα λόγους

text_en: And when Moses came down from the Mount Sinai , he held the two tables of the testimony, and he knew not that his face was horned from the conversation of the Lord .
text_la: Cumque descenderet Moyses de monte Sinai, tenebat duas tabulas testimonii, et ignorabat quod cornuta esset facies sua ex consortio sermonis Domini.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, descendo Moisés do monte Sinai trazia as duas tábuas do testemunho em suas mãos, sim, quando desceu do monte, Moisés não sabia que a pele do seu rosto resplandecia, depois que falara com ele.
text_el: ὡς δὲ κατέβαινεν Μωυσῆς ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους καὶ αἱ δύο πλάκες ἐπὶ τῶν χειρῶν Μωυσῆ καταβαίνοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους Μωυσῆς οὐκ ᾔδει ὅτι δεδόξασται ἡ ὄψις τοῦ χρώματος τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ λαλεῖν αὐτὸν αὐτῷ

text_en: And Aaron and the children of Israel seeing the face of Moses horned, were afraid to come near.
text_la: Videntes autem Aaron et filii Israël cornutam Moysi faciem, timuerunt prope accedere.
text_pt: Olhando, pois, Arão e todos os filhos de Israel para Moisés, eis que a pele do seu rosto resplandecia; por isso temeram chegar-se a ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ααρων καὶ πάντες οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ισραηλ τὸν Μωυσῆν καὶ ἦν δεδοξασμένη ἡ ὄψις τοῦ χρώματος τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν ἐγγίσαι αὐτοῦ

text_en: And being called by him, they returned, both Aaron and the rulers of the congregation. And after that he spoke to them,
text_la: Vocatique ab eo, reversi sunt tam Aaron, quam principes synagogæ. Et postquam locutus est ad eos,
text_pt: Então Moisés os chamou, e Arão e todos os príncipes da congregação tornaram-se a ele; e Moisés lhes falou.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐπεστράφησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ααρων καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς συναγωγῆς καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς

text_en: and all the children of Israel came to him: and he gave them in commandment all that he had heard of the Lord on Mount Sinai .
text_la: venerunt ad eum etiam omnes filii Israël : quibus præcepit cuncta quæ audierat a Domino in monte Sinai.
text_pt: Depois chegaram também todos os filhos de Israel; e ele lhes ordenou tudo o que o Senhor falara com ele no monte Sinai.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα προσῆλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς πάντα ὅσα ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινα

text_en: And having done speaking, he put a veil upon his face.
text_la: Impletisque sermonibus, posuit velamen super faciem suam.
text_pt: Assim que Moisés acabou de falar com eles, pôs um véu sobre o seu rosto.
text_el: καὶ ἐπειδὴ κατέπαυσεν λαλῶν πρὸς αὐτούς ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ κάλυμμα

text_en: But when he went in to the Lord , and spoke with him, he took it away until he came forth, and then he spoke to the children of Israel all things that had been commanded him.
text_la: Quod ingressus ad Dominum, et loquens cum eo, auferebat donec exiret, et tunc loquebatur ad filios Israël omnia quæ sibi fuerant imperata.
text_pt: Porém, entrando Moisés perante o Senhor, para falar com ele, tirava o véu até sair; e, saindo, falava com os filhos de Israel o que lhe era ordenado.
text_el: ἡνίκα δ' ἂν εἰσεπορεύετο Μωυσῆς ἔναντι κυρίου λαλεῖν αὐτῷ περιῃρεῖτο τὸ κάλυμμα ἕως τοῦ ἐκπορεύεσθαι καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐλάλει πᾶσιν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ὅσα ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ κύριος

text_en: And they saw that the face of Moses when he came out was horned, but he covered his face again, if at any time he spoke to them.
text_la: Qui videbant faciem egredientis Moysi esse cornutam, sed operiebat ille rursus faciem suam, siquando loquebatur ad eos.
text_pt: Assim, pois, viam os filhos de Israel o rosto de Moisés, e que resplandecia a pele do seu rosto; e tornava Moisés a pôr o véu sobre o seu rosto, até entrar para falar com ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸ πρόσωπον Μωυσῆ ὅτι δεδόξασται καὶ περιέθηκεν Μωυσῆς κάλυμμα ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσωπον ἑαυτοῦ ἕως ἂν εἰσέλθῃ συλλαλεῖν αὐτῷ

text_en: And all the multitude of the children of Israel being gathered together, he said to them: These are the things which the Lord has commanded to be done:
text_la: Igitur congregata omni turba filiorum Israël, dixit ad eos : Hæc sunt quæ jussit Dominus fieri.
text_pt: Então Moisés convocou toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e disse-lhes: Estas são as palavras que o SENHOR ordenou que se cumprissem.
text_el: καὶ συνήθροισεν Μωυσῆς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι οὓς εἶπεν κύριος ποιῆσαι αὐτούς

text_en: Six days you shall do work; the seventh day shall be holy unto you, the sabbath and the rest of the Lord : he that shall do any work on it, shall be put to death .
text_la: Sex diebus facietis opus : septimus dies erit vobis sanctus, sabbatum, et requies Domini : qui fecerit opus in eo, occidetur.
text_pt: Seis dias se trabalhará, mas o sétimo dia vos será santo, o sábado do repouso ao Senhor; todo aquele que nele fizer qualquer trabalho morrerá.
text_el: ἓξ ἡμέρας ποιήσεις ἔργα τῇ δὲ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ κατάπαυσις ἅγιον σάββατα ἀνάπαυσις κυρίῳ πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν ἔργον ἐν αὐτῇ τελευτάτω

text_en: You shall kindle no fire in any of your habitations on the sabbath day .
text_la: Non succendetis ignem in omnibus habitaculis vestris per diem sabbati.
text_pt: Não acendereis fogo em nenhuma das vossas moradas no dia do sábado.
text_el: οὐ καύσετε πῦρ ἐν πάσῃ κατοικίᾳ ὑμῶν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And Moses said to all the assembly of the children of Israel : This is the word the Lord has commanded , saying:
text_la: Et ait Moyses ad omnem catervam filiorum Israël : Iste est sermo quem præcepit Dominus, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais Moisés a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Esta é a palavra que o Senhor ordenou, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ισραηλ λέγων τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ συνέταξεν κύριος λέγων

text_en: Set aside with you firstfruits to the Lord . Let every one that is willing and has a ready heart, offer them to the Lord : gold, and silver, and brass,
text_la: Separate apud vos primitias Domino. Omnis voluntarius et prono animo offerat eas Domino : aurum et argentum, et æs,
text_pt: Tomai do que tendes, uma oferta para o Senhor; cada um, cujo coração é voluntariamente disposto, a trará por oferta alçada ao Senhor: ouro, prata e cobre,
text_el: λάβετε παρ' ὑμῶν αὐτῶν ἀφαίρεμα κυρίῳ πᾶς ὁ καταδεχόμενος τῇ καρδίᾳ οἴσουσιν τὰς ἀπαρχὰς κυρίῳ χρυσίον ἀργύριον χαλκόν

text_en: violet and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine linen, goats' hair,
text_la: hyacinthum et purpuram, coccumque bis tinctum, et byssum, pilos caprarum,
text_pt: Como também azul, púrpura, carmesim, linho fino, pêlos de cabras,
text_el: ὑάκινθον πορφύραν κόκκινον διπλοῦν διανενησμένον καὶ βύσσον κεκλωσμένην καὶ τρίχας αἰγείας

text_en: and rams' skins dyed red, and violet coloured skins, setim wood ,
text_la: pellesque arietum rubricatas, et janthinas, ligna setim,
text_pt: E peles de carneiros, tintas de vermelho, e peles de texugos, madeira de acácia,
text_el: καὶ δέρματα κριῶν ἠρυθροδανωμένα καὶ δέρματα ὑακίνθινα καὶ ξύλα ἄσηπτα

text_en: and oil to maintain lights, and to make ointment , and most sweet incense ,
text_la: et oleum ad luminaria concinnanda, et ut conficiatur unguentum, et thymiama suavissimum,
text_pt: E azeite para a luminária, e especiarias para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático.

text_en: onyx stones, and precious stones , for the adorning of the ephod and the rational .
text_la: lapides onychinos, et gemmas ad ornatum superhumeralis et rationalis.
text_pt: E pedras de ônix, e pedras de engaste, para o éfode e para o peitoral.
text_el: καὶ λίθους σαρδίου καὶ λίθους εἰς τὴν γλυφὴν εἰς τὴν ἐπωμίδα καὶ τὸν ποδήρη

text_en: Whosoever of you is wise, let him come, and make that which the Lord has commanded:
text_la: Quisque vestrum sapiens est, veniat, et faciat quod Dominus imperavit:
text_pt: E venham todos os sábios de coração entre vós, e façam tudo o que o Senhor tem mandado;
text_el: καὶ πᾶς σοφὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ ἐν ὑμῖν ἐλθὼν ἐργαζέσθω πάντα ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος

text_en: To wit, the tabernacle , and the roof thereof, and the cover, the rings, and the board-work with the bars, the pillars and the sockets:
text_la: tabernaculum scilicet, et tectum ejus, atque operimentum, annulos, et tabulata cum vectibus, paxillos, et bases:
text_pt: O tabernáculo, a sua tenda e a sua coberta, os seus colchetes e as suas tábuas, as suas barras, as suas colunas, e as suas bases;
text_el: τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ τὰ παραρρύματα καὶ τὰ καλύμματα καὶ τὰ διατόνια καὶ τοὺς μοχλοὺς καὶ τοὺς στύλους

text_en: The ark and the staves, the propitiatory, and the veil that is drawn before it:
text_la: arcam et vectes, propitiatorium, et velum, quod ante illud oppanditur:
text_pt: A arca e os seus varais, o propiciatório e o véu de cobertura,
text_el: καὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ ἱλαστήριον αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα

text_en: The table with the bars and the vessels, and the loaves of proposition :
text_la: mensam cum vectibus et vasis, et propositionis panibus:
text_pt: A mesa e os seus varais, e todos os seus pertences; e os pães da proposição,
text_el: καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς

text_en: The candlestick to bear up the lights , the vessels thereof and the lamps, and the oil for the nourishing of fires:
text_la: candelabrum ad luminaria sustentanda, vasa illius et lucernas, et oleum ad nutrimenta ignium:
text_pt: E o candelabro da luminária, e os seus utensílios, e as suas lâmpadas, e o azeite para a luminária,
text_el: καὶ τὴν λυχνίαν τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς

text_en: The altar of incense , and the bars, and the oil of unction, and the incense of spices: the hanging at the door of the tabernacle :
text_la: altare thymiamatis, et vectes, et oleum unctionis et thymiama ex aromatibus : tentorium ad ostium tabernaculi:
text_pt: E o altar do incenso e os seus varais, e o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático, e a cortina da porta para a entrada do tabernáculo,

text_en: The altar of holocaust , and its grate of brass, with the bars and vessels thereof: the laver and its foot:
text_la: altare holocausti, et craticulam ejus æneam cum vectibus et vasis suis : labrum et basim ejus:
text_pt: O altar do holocausto, e o crivo de cobre, os seus varais, e todos os seus pertences, a pia e a sua base,
text_el: καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ

text_en: The curtains of the court , with the pillars and the sockets, the hanging in the doors of the entry.
text_la: cortinas atrii cum columnis et basibus, tentorium in foribus vestibuli,
text_pt: As cortinas do pátio, as suas colunas e as suas bases, e o reposteiro da porta do pátio,

text_en: The pins of the tabernacle , and of the court , with their little cords:
text_la: paxillos tabernaculi et atrii cum funiculis suis:
text_pt: As estacas do tabernáculo, e as estacas do pátio, e as suas cordas,

text_en: The vestments that are to be used in the ministry of the sanctuary, the vesture of Aaron the high priest , and of his sons, to do the office of priesthood to me.
text_la: vestimenta, quorum usus est in ministerio sanctuarii, vestes Aaron pontificis ac filiorum ejus, ut sacerdotio fungantur mihi.
text_pt: As vestes do ministério para ministrar no santuário, as vestes santas de Arão o sacerdote, e as vestes de seus filhos, para administrarem o sacerdócio.
text_el: καὶ τὰς στολὰς τὰς ἁγίας Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ τὰς στολάς ἐν αἷς λειτουργήσουσιν ἐν αὐταῖς καὶ τοὺς χιτῶνας τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων τῆς ἱερατείας καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τοῦ χρίσματος καὶ τὸ θυμίαμα τῆς συνθέσεως

text_en: And all the multitude of the children of Israel going out from the presence of Moses ,
text_la: Egressaque omnis multitudo filiorum Israël de conspectu Moysi,
text_pt: Então toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel saiu da presença de Moisés,
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πᾶσα συναγωγὴ υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀπὸ Μωυσῆ

text_en: offered firstfruits to the Lord with a most ready and devout mind, to make the work of the tabernacle of the testimony . Whatever was necessary to the service and to the holy vestments ,
text_la: obtulerunt mente promptissima atque devota primitias Domino, ad faciendum opus tabernaculi testimonii. Quidquid ad cultum et ad vestes sanctas necessarium erat,
text_pt: E veio todo o homem, a quem o seu coração moveu, e todo aquele cujo espírito voluntariamente o excitou, e trouxeram a oferta alçada ao Senhor para a obra da tenda da congregação, e para todo o seu serviço, e para as vestes santas.
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκαν ἕκαστος ὧν ἔφερεν αὐτῶν ἡ καρδία καὶ ὅσοις ἔδοξεν τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτῶν ἤνεγκαν ἀφαίρεμα κυρίῳ εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔργα τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ εἰς πάντα τὰ κάτεργα αὐτῆς καὶ εἰς πάσας τὰς στολὰς τοῦ ἁγίου

text_en: both men and women gave bracelets and earrings, rings and tablets: every vessel of gold was set aside to be offered to the Lord .
text_la: viri cum mulieribus præbuerunt, armillas et inaures, annulos et dextralia : omne vas aureum in donaria Domini separatum est.
text_pt: Assim vieram homens e mulheres, todos dispostos de coração; trouxeram fivelas, e pendentes, e anéis, e braceletes, todos os objetos de ouro; e todo o homem fazia oferta de ouro ao Senhor;
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκαν οἱ ἄνδρες παρὰ τῶν γυναικῶν πᾶς ᾧ ἔδοξεν τῇ διανοίᾳ ἤνεγκαν σφραγῖδας καὶ ἐνώτια καὶ δακτυλίους καὶ ἐμπλόκια καὶ περιδέξια πᾶν σκεῦος χρυσοῦν καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἤνεγκαν ἀφαιρέματα χρυσίου κυρίῳ

text_en: If any man had violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, fine linen and goats' hair, ramskins dyed red, and violet coloured skins,
text_la: Si quis habebat hyacinthum, et purpuram, coccumque bis tinctum, byssum et pilos caprarum, pelles arietum rubricatas, et janthinas,
text_pt: E todo o homem que se achou com azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho fino, e pêlos de cabras, e peles de carneiro tintas de vermelho, e peles de texugos, os trazia;
text_el: καὶ παρ' ᾧ εὑρέθη βύσσος καὶ δέρματα ὑακίνθινα καὶ δέρματα κριῶν ἠρυθροδανωμένα ἤνεγκαν

text_en: metal of silver and brass, they offered it to the Lord , and setim wood for divers uses.
text_la: argenti, ærisque metalla, obtulerunt Domino, lignaque setim in varios usus.
text_pt: Todo aquele que fazia oferta alçada de prata ou de metal, a trazia por oferta alçada ao Senhor; e todo aquele que possuía madeira de acácia, a trazia para toda a obra do serviço.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀφαιρῶν ἀφαίρεμα ἀργύριον καὶ χαλκὸν ἤνεγκαν τὰ ἀφαιρέματα κυρίῳ καὶ παρ' οἷς εὑρέθη ξύλα ἄσηπτα εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔργα τῆς κατασκευῆς ἤνεγκαν

text_en: The skilful women also gave such things as they had spun, violet, purple, and scarlet, and fine linen,
text_la: Sed et mulieres doctæ, quæ neverant, dederunt hyacinthum, purpuram, et vermiculum, ac byssum,
text_pt: E todas as mulheres sábias de coração fiavam com as suas mãos, e traziam o que tinham fiado, o azul e a púrpura, o carmesim e o linho fino.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα γυνὴ σοφὴ τῇ διανοίᾳ ταῖς χερσὶν νήθειν ἤνεγκαν νενησμένα τὴν ὑάκινθον καὶ τὴν πορφύραν καὶ τὸ κόκκινον καὶ τὴν βύσσον

text_en: and goats' hair, giving all of their own accord.
text_la: et pilos caprarum, sponte propria cuncta tribuentes.
text_pt: E todas as mulheres, cujo coração as moveu em habilidade fiavam os pêlos das cabras.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ γυναῖκες αἷς ἔδοξεν τῇ διανοίᾳ αὐτῶν ἐν σοφίᾳ ἔνησαν τὰς τρίχας τὰς αἰγείας

text_en: But the princes offered onyx stones, and precious stones , for the ephod and the rational ,
text_la: Principes vero obtulerunt lapides onychinos, et gemmas ad superhumerale et rationale,
text_pt: E os príncipes traziam pedras de ônix e pedras de engastes para o éfode e para o peitoral,
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ἤνεγκαν τοὺς λίθους τῆς σμαράγδου καὶ τοὺς λίθους τῆς πληρώσεως εἰς τὴν ἐπωμίδα καὶ εἰς τὸ λογεῖον

text_en: and spices and oil for the lights, and for the preparing of ointment , and to make the incense of most sweet savour.
text_la: aromataque et oleum ad luminaria concinnanda, et ad præparandum unguentum, ac thymiama odoris suavissimi componendum.
text_pt: E especiarias, e azeite para a luminária, e para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático.
text_el: καὶ τὰς συνθέσεις καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως καὶ τὴν σύνθεσιν τοῦ θυμιάματος

text_en: All, both men and women , with devout mind offered gifts, that the works might be done which the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses . All the children of Israel dedicated voluntary offerings to the Lord .
text_la: Omnes viri et mulieres mente devota obtulerunt donaria, ut fierent opera, quæ jusserat Dominus per manum Moysi. Cuncti filii Israël voluntaria Domino dedicaverunt.
text_pt: Todo homem e mulher, cujo coração voluntariamente se moveu a trazer alguma coisa para toda a obra que o Senhor ordenara se fizesse pela mão de Moisés; assim os filhos de Israel trouxeram por oferta voluntária ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ἀνὴρ καὶ γυνή ὧν ἔφερεν ἡ διάνοια αὐτῶν εἰσελθόντας ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ ἔργα ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος ποιῆσαι αὐτὰ διὰ Μωυσῆ ἤνεγκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀφαίρεμα κυρίῳ

text_en: And Moses said to the children of Israel : Behold, the Lord has called by name Beseleel , the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Juda ,
text_la: Dixitque Moyses ad filios Israël : Ecce, vocavit Dominus ex nomine Beseleel filium Uri, filii Hur de tribu Juda,
text_pt: Depois disse Moisés aos filhos de Israel: Eis que o Senhor tem chamado por nome a Bezalel, filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ ἀνακέκληκεν ὁ θεὸς ἐξ ὀνόματος τὸν Βεσελεηλ τὸν τοῦ Ουριου τὸν Ωρ ἐκ φυλῆς Ιουδα

text_en: and has filled him with the spirit of God , with wisdom and understanding, and knowledge , and all learning,
text_la: implevitque eum spiritu Dei, sapientia et intelligentia, et scientia et omni doctrina,
text_pt: E o Espírito de Deus o encheu de sabedoria, entendimento, ciência e em todo o lavor,
text_el: καὶ ἐνέπλησεν αὐτὸν πνεῦμα θεῖον σοφίας καὶ συνέσεως καὶ ἐπιστήμης πάντων

text_en: to devise and to work in gold and silver and brass,
text_la: ad excogitandum, et faciendum opus in auro, et argento, et ære,
text_pt: E para criar invenções, para trabalhar em ouro, e em prata, e em cobre,
text_el: ἀρχιτεκτονεῖν κατὰ πάντα τὰ ἔργα τῆς ἀρχιτεκτονίας ποιεῖν τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸν χαλκὸν

text_en: and in engraving stones , and in carpenters' work. Whatsoever can be devised artificially,
text_la: sculpendisque lapidibus, et opere carpentario, quidquid fabre adinveniri potest,
text_pt: E em lapidar de pedras para engastar, e em entalhar madeira, e para trabalhar em toda a obra esmerada.
text_el: καὶ λιθουργῆσαι τὸν λίθον καὶ κατεργάζεσθαι τὰ ξύλα καὶ ποιεῖν ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ σοφίας

text_en: he has given in his heart: Ooliab also, the son of Achisamech, of the tribe of Dan :
text_la: dedit in corde ejus: Ooliab quoque filium Achisamech de tribu Dan:
text_pt: Também lhe dispôs o coração para ensinar a outros; a ele e a Aoliabe, o filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã.
text_el: καὶ προβιβάσαι γε ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ αὐτῷ τε καὶ Ελιαβ τῷ τοῦ Αχισαμακ ἐκ φυλῆς Δαν

text_en: Both of them has he instructed with wisdom, to do carpenters' work, and tapestry , and embroidery in blue and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine linen, and to weave all things, and to invent all new things.
text_la: ambos erudivit sapientia, ut faciant opera abietarii, polymitarii, ac plumarii, de hyacintho ac purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso, et texant omnia, ac nova quæque reperiant.
text_pt: Encheu-os de sabedoria do coração, para fazer toda a obra de mestre, até a mais engenhosa, e a do gravador, em azul, e em púrpura, em carmesim, e em linho fino, e do tecelão; fazendo toda a obra, e criando invenções.
text_el: ἐνέπλησεν αὐτοὺς σοφίας καὶ συνέσεως διανοίας πάντα συνιέναι ποιῆσαι τὰ ἔργα τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ τὰ ὑφαντὰ καὶ ποικιλτὰ ὑφᾶναι τῷ κοκκίνῳ καὶ τῇ βύσσῳ ποιεῖν πᾶν ἔργον ἀρχιτεκτονίας ποικιλίας

text_en: Beseleel therefore, and Ooliab, and every wise man , to whom the Lord gave wisdom and understanding, to know how to work artificially, made the things that are necessary for the uses of the sanctuary, and which the Lord commanded.
text_la: Fecit ergo Beseleel, et Ooliab, et omnis vir sapiens, quibus dedit Dominus sapientiam et intellectum, ut scirent fabre operari quæ in usus sanctuarii necessaria sunt, et quæ præcepit Dominus.
text_pt: Assim trabalharam Bezalel e Aoliabe, e todo o homem sábio de coração, a quem o SENHOR dera sabedoria e inteligência, para saber como haviam de fazer toda a obra para o serviço do santuário, conforme a tudo o que o SENHOR tinha ordenado.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Βεσελεηλ καὶ Ελιαβ καὶ πᾶς σοφὸς τῇ διανοίᾳ ᾧ ἐδόθη σοφία καὶ ἐπιστήμη ἐν αὐτοῖς συνιέναι ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ ἔργα κατὰ τὰ ἅγια καθήκοντα κατὰ πάντα ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος

text_en: And when Moses had called them, and every skilful man , to whom the Lord had given wisdom, and such as of their own accord had offered themselves to the making of the work,
text_la: Cumque vocasset eos Moyses et omnem eruditum virum, cui dederat Dominus sapientiam, et qui sponte sua obtulerant se ad faciendum opus,
text_pt: Então Moisés chamou a Bezalel e a Aoliabe, e a todo o homem sábio de coração, em cujo coração o Senhor tinha dado sabedoria; a todo aquele a quem o seu coração moveu a se chegar à obra para fazê-la.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Μωυσῆς Βεσελεηλ καὶ Ελιαβ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἔχοντας τὴν σοφίαν ᾧ ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς ἐπιστήμην ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἑκουσίως βουλομένους προσπορεύεσθαι πρὸς τὰ ἔργα ὥστε συντελεῖν αὐτά

text_en: he delivered all the offerings of the children of Israel unto them. And while they were earnest about the work, the people daily in the morning offered their vows .
text_la: tradidit eis universa donaria filiorum Israël. Qui cum instarent operi, quotidie mane vota populus offerebat.
text_pt: Estes receberam de Moisés toda a oferta alçada, que trouxeram os filhos de Israel para a obra do serviço do santuário, para fazê-la, e ainda eles lhe traziam cada manhã ofertas voluntárias.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον παρὰ Μωυσῆ πάντα τὰ ἀφαιρέματα ἃ ἤνεγκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ ἁγίου ποιεῖν αὐτά καὶ αὐτοὶ προσεδέχοντο ἔτι τὰ προσφερόμενα παρὰ τῶν φερόντων τὸ πρωὶ πρωί

text_en: Whereupon the workmen being constrained to come,
text_la: Unde artifices venire compulsi,
text_pt: E vieram todos os sábios, que faziam toda a obra do santuário, cada um da obra que fazia,
text_el: καὶ παρεγίνοντο πάντες οἱ σοφοὶ οἱ ποιοῦντες τὰ ἔργα τοῦ ἁγίου ἕκαστος κατὰ τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔργον ὃ αὐτοὶ ἠργάζοντο

text_en: said to Moses : The people offers more than is necessary.
text_la: dixerunt Moysi : Plus offert populus quam necessarium est.
text_pt: E falaram a Moisés, dizendo: O povo traz muito mais do que basta para o serviço da obra que o Senhor ordenou se fizesse.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Μωυσῆν ὅτι πλῆθος φέρει ὁ λαὸς παρὰ τὰ ἔργα ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος ποιῆσαι
