text_en: Moses therefore commanded proclamation to be made by the crier's voice: Let neither man nor woman offer any more for the work of the sanctuary. And so they ceased from offering gifts,
text_la: Jussit ergo Moyses præconis voce cantari : Nec vir, nec mulier quidquam offerat ultra in opere sanctuarii. Sicque cessatum est a muneribus offerendis,
text_pt: Então mandou Moisés que proclamassem por todo o arraial, dizendo: Nenhum homem, nem mulher, faça mais obra alguma para a oferta alçada do santuário. Assim o povo foi proibido de trazer mais,
text_el: καὶ προσέταξεν Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐκήρυξεν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ λέγων ἀνὴρ καὶ γυνὴ μηκέτι ἐργαζέσθωσαν εἰς τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἐκωλύθη ὁ λαὸς ἔτι προσφέρειν

text_en: because the things that were offered did suffice, and were too much.
text_la: eo quod oblata sufficerent et superabundarent.
text_pt: Porque tinham material bastante para toda a obra que havia de fazer-se, e ainda sobejava.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἔργα ἦν αὐτοῖς ἱκανὰ εἰς τὴν κατασκευὴν ποιῆσαι καὶ προσκατέλιπον

text_en: And all the men that were wise of heart, to accomplish the work of the tabernacle , made ten curtains of twisted fine linen, and violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, with varied work, and the art of embroidering :
text_la: Feceruntque omnes corde sapientes ad explendum opus tabernaculi, cortinas decem de bysso retorta, et hyacintho, et purpura, coccoque bis tincto, opere vario, et arte polymita:
text_pt: Assim todo o sábio de coração, entre os que faziam a obra, fez o tabernáculo de dez cortinas de linho fino torcido, e de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, com querubins; da obra mais esmerada as fez.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν πᾶς σοφὸς ἐν τοῖς ἐργαζομένοις τὰς στολὰς τῶν ἁγίων αἵ εἰσιν Ααρων τῷ ἱερεῖ καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: The length of one curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth four: all the curtains were of the same size.
text_la: quarum una habebat in longitudine viginti octo cubitos, et in latitudine quatuor; una mensura erat omnium cortinarum.
text_pt: O comprimento de cada cortina era de vinte e oito côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados; todas as cortinas tinham uma mesma medida.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὴν ἐπωμίδα ἐκ χρυσίου καὶ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης

text_en: And he joined five curtains, one to another, and the other five he coupled one to another.
text_la: Conjunxitque cortinas quinque, alteram alteri, et alias quinque sibi invicem copulavit.
text_pt: E ligou cinco cortinas uma com a outra; e outras cinco cortinas também ligou uma com outra.
text_el: καὶ ἐτμήθη τὰ πέταλα τοῦ χρυσίου τρίχες ὥστε συνυφᾶναι σὺν τῇ ὑακίνθῳ καὶ τῇ πορφύρᾳ καὶ σὺν τῷ κοκκίνῳ τῷ διανενησμένῳ καὶ σὺν τῇ βύσσῳ τῇ κεκλωσμένῃ ἔργον ὑφαντόν

text_en: He made also loops of violet in the edge of one curtain on both sides, and in the edge of the other curtain in like manner,
text_la: Fecit et ansas hyacinthinas in ora cortinæ unius ex utroque latere, et in ora cortinæ alterius similiter,
text_pt: Depois fez laçadas de azul na borda de uma cortina, à extremidade, na juntura; assim também fez na borda, à extremidade da juntura da segunda cortina.
text_el: ἐποίησαν αὐτὸ ἐπωμίδας συνεχούσας ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν μερῶν

text_en: that the loops might meet one against another, and might be joined each with the other.
text_la: ut contra se invicem venirent ansæ, et mutuo jungerentur.
text_pt: Cinqüenta laçadas fez numa cortina, e cinqüenta laçadas fez numa extremidade da cortina, que se ligava com a segunda; estas laçadas eram contrapostas uma a outra.
text_el: ἔργον ὑφαντὸν εἰς ἄλληλα συμπεπλεγμένον καθ' ἑαυτὸ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἐποίησαν κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ ποίησιν ἐκ χρυσίου καὶ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου διανενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: Whereupon also he cast fifty rings of gold, that might catch the loops of the curtains, and they might be made one tabernacle .
text_la: Unde et quinquaginta fudit circulos aureos, qui morderent cortinarum ansas, et fieret unum tabernaculum.
text_pt: Também fez cinqüenta colchetes de ouro, e com estes colchetes uniu as cortinas uma com a outra; e assim foi feito um tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν ἀμφοτέρους τοὺς λίθους τῆς σμαράγδου συμπεπορπημένους καὶ περισεσιαλωμένους χρυσίῳ γεγλυμμένους καὶ ἐκκεκολαμμένους ἐκκόλαμμα σφραγῖδος ἐκ τῶν ὀνομάτων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: He made also eleven curtains of goats' hair, to cover the roof of the tabernacle :
text_la: Fecit et saga undecim de pilis caprarum ad operiendum tectum tabernaculi:
text_pt: Fez também cortinas de pêlos de cabras para a tenda sobre o tabernáculo; fez onze cortinas.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τοὺς ὤμους τῆς ἐπωμίδος λίθους μνημοσύνου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: One curtain was thirty cubits long, and four cubits broad: all the curtains were of one measure.
text_la: unum sagum in longitudine habebat cubitos triginta, et in latitudine cubitos quatuor : unius mensuræ erant omnia saga:
text_pt: O comprimento de uma cortina era de trinta côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados; estas onze cortinas tinham uma mesma medida.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν λογεῖον ἔργον ὑφαντὸν ποικιλίᾳ κατὰ τὸ ἔργον τῆς ἐπωμίδος ἐκ χρυσίου καὶ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου διανενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης

text_en: Five of which he joined apart, and the other six apart.
text_la: quorum quinque junxit seorsum, et sex alia separatim.
text_pt: E uniu cinco cortinas à parte, e outras seis à parte,
text_el: τετράγωνον διπλοῦν ἐποίησαν τὸ λογεῖον σπιθαμῆς τὸ μῆκος καὶ σπιθαμῆς τὸ εὖρος διπλοῦν

text_en: And he made fifty loops in the edge of one curtain, and fifty in the edge of another curtain, that they might be joined one to another.
text_la: Fecitque ansas quinquaginta in ora sagi unius, et quinquaginta in ora sagi alterius, ut sibi invicem jungerentur.
text_pt: E fez cinqüenta laçadas na borda da última cortina, na juntura; também fez cinqüenta laçadas na borda da cortina, na outra juntura.
text_el: καὶ συνυφάνθη ἐν αὐτῷ ὕφασμα κατάλιθον τετράστιχον στίχος λίθων σάρδιον καὶ τοπάζιον καὶ σμάραγδος ὁ στίχος ὁ εἷς

text_en: And fifty buckles of brass wherewith the roof might be knit together, that of all the curtains there might be made one covering.
text_la: Et fibulas æneas quinquaginta, quibus necteretur tectum, ut unum pallium ex omnibus sagis fieret.
text_pt: Fez também cinqüenta colchetes de metal, para ajuntar a tenda, para que fosse um todo.
text_el: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ δεύτερος ἄνθραξ καὶ σάπφειρος καὶ ἴασπις

text_en: He made also a cover for the tabernacle of rams' skins dyed red; and another cover over that of violet skins.
text_la: Fecit et opertorium tabernaculi de pellibus arietum rubricatis : aliudque desuper velamentum de pellibus janthinis.
text_pt: Fez também, para a tenda, uma coberta de peles de carneiros, tintas de vermelho; e por cima uma coberta de peles de texugos.
text_el: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ τρίτος λιγύριον καὶ ἀχάτης καὶ ἀμέθυστος

text_en: He made also the boards of the tabernacle of setim wood standing.
text_la: Fecit et tabulas tabernaculi de lignis setim stantes.
text_pt: Também fez, de madeira de acácia, tábuas levantadas para o tabernáculo, que foram colocadas verticalmente.
text_el: καὶ ὁ στίχος ὁ τέταρτος χρυσόλιθος καὶ βηρύλλιον καὶ ὀνύχιον περικεκυκλωμένα χρυσίῳ καὶ συνδεδεμένα χρυσίῳ

text_en: The length of one board was ten cubits; and the breadth was one cubit and a half.
text_la: Decem cubitorum erat longitudo tabulæ unius : et unum ac semis cubitum latitudo retinebat.
text_pt: O comprimento de cada tábua era de dez côvados, e a largura de um côvado e meio.
text_el: καὶ οἱ λίθοι ἦσαν ἐκ τῶν ὀνομάτων τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ δώδεκα ἐκ τῶν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν ἐγγεγραμμένα εἰς σφραγῖδας ἕκαστος ἐκ τοῦ ἑαυτοῦ ὀνόματος εἰς τὰς δώδεκα φυλάς

text_en: There were two mortises throughout every board, that one might be joined to the other. And in this manner he made for all the boards of the tabernacle .
text_la: Binæ incastraturæ erant per singulas tabulas, ut altera alteri jungeretur. Sic fecit in omnibus tabernaculi tabulis.
text_pt: Cada tábua tinha duas cavilhas pregadas uma a outra; assim fez com todas as tábuas do tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν ἐπὶ τὸ λογεῖον κροσσοὺς συμπεπλεγμένους ἔργον ἐμπλοκίου ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ

text_en: Of which twenty were at the south side southward,
text_la: E quibus viginti ad plagam meridianam erant contra austrum,
text_pt: Assim, pois, fez as tábuas para o tabernáculo; vinte tábuas para o lado que dá para o sul;
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν δύο ἀσπιδίσκας χρυσᾶς καὶ δύο δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τοὺς δύο δακτυλίους τοὺς χρυσοῦς ἐπ' ἀμφοτέρας τὰς ἀρχὰς τοῦ λογείου

text_en: with forty sockets of silver, two sockets were put under one board on the two sides of the corners, where the mortises of the sides end in the corners.
text_la: cum quadraginta basibus argenteis. Duæ bases sub una tabula ponebantur ex utraque parte angulorum, ubi incastraturæ laterum in angulis terminantur.
text_pt: E fez quarenta bases de prata debaixo das vinte tábuas; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, para as suas duas cavilhas, e duas debaixo de outra, para as suas duas cavilhas.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τὰ ἐμπλόκια ἐκ χρυσίου ἐπὶ τοὺς δακτυλίους ἐπ' ἀμφοτέρων τῶν μερῶν τοῦ λογείου

text_en: At that side also of the tabernacle , that looks towards the north, he made twenty boards,
text_la: Ad plagam quoque tabernaculi, quæ respicit ad aquilonem, fecit viginti tabulas,
text_pt: Também fez vinte tábuas ao outro lado do tabernáculo, do lado norte,
text_el: καὶ εἰς τὰς δύο συμβολὰς τὰ δύο ἐμπλόκια καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τὰς δύο ἀσπιδίσκας καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὤμους τῆς ἐπωμίδος ἐξ ἐναντίας κατὰ πρόσωπον

text_en: with forty sockets of silver, two sockets for every board.
text_la: cum quadraginta basibus argenteis, duas bases per singulas tabulas.
text_pt: Com as suas quarenta bases de prata; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, e duas bases debaixo de outra tábua.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν δύο δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπὶ τὰ δύο πτερύγια ἐπ' ἄκρου τοῦ λογείου ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ὀπισθίου τῆς ἐπωμίδος ἔσωθεν

text_en: But against the west, to wit, at that side of the tabernacle , which looks to the sea, he made six boards,
text_la: Contra occidentem vero, id est, ad eam partem tabernaculi quæ mare respicit, fecit sex tabulas,
text_pt: E ao lado do tabernáculo para o ocidente fez seis tábuas.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν δύο δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπ' ἀμφοτέρους τοὺς ὤμους τῆς ἐπωμίδος κάτωθεν αὐτοῦ κατὰ πρόσωπον κατὰ τὴν συμβολὴν ἄνωθεν τῆς συνυφῆς τῆς ἐπωμίδος

text_en: and two others at each corner of the tabernacle behind:
text_la: et duas alias per singulos angulos tabernaculi retro:
text_pt: Fez também duas tábuas para os cantos do tabernáculo nos dois lados,
text_el: καὶ συνέσφιγξεν τὸ λογεῖον ἀπὸ τῶν δακτυλίων τῶν ἐπ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς δακτυλίους τῆς ἐπωμίδος συνεχομένους ἐκ τῆς ὑακίνθου συμπεπλεγμένους εἰς τὸ ὕφασμα τῆς ἐπωμίδος ἵνα μὴ χαλᾶται τὸ λογεῖον ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπωμίδος καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: Which were also joined from beneath unto the top, and went together into one joint. Thus he did on both sides at the corners:
text_la: quæ junctæ erant a deorsum usque sursum, et in unam compaginem pariter ferebantur. Ita fecit ex utraque parte per angulos:
text_pt: As quais por baixo estavam juntas, e também se ajuntavam por cima com uma argola; assim fez com ambas nos dois cantos.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὸν ὑποδύτην ὑπὸ τὴν ἐπωμίδα ἔργον ὑφαντὸν ὅλον ὑακίνθινον

text_en: So there were in all eight boards, and they had sixteen sockets of silver, to wit, two sockets under every board.
text_la: ut octo essent simul tabulæ, et haberent bases argenteas sedecim, binas scilicet bases sub singulis tabulis.
text_pt: Assim eram oito tábuas com as suas bases de prata, a saber, dezesseis bases; duas bases debaixo de cada tábua.
text_el: τὸ δὲ περιστόμιον τοῦ ὑποδύτου ἐν τῷ μέσῳ διυφασμένον συμπλεκτόν ᾤαν ἔχον κύκλῳ τὸ περιστόμιον ἀδιάλυτον

text_en: He made also bars of setim wood , five to hold together the boards of one side of the tabernacle ,
text_la: Fecit et vectes de lignis setim, quinque ad continendas tabulas unius lateris tabernaculi,
text_pt: Fez também travessas de madeira de acácia; cinco para as tábuas de um lado do tabernáculo,
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν ἐπὶ τοῦ λώματος τοῦ ὑποδύτου κάτωθεν ὡς ἐξανθούσης ῥόας ῥοίσκους ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης

text_en: and five others to join together the boards of the other side; and besides these, five other bars at the west side of the tabernacle towards the sea.
text_la: et quinque alios ad alterius lateris coaptandas tabulas : et extra hos, quinque alios vectes ad occidentalem plagam tabernaculi contra mare.
text_pt: E cinco travessas para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo; e outras cinco travessas para as tábuas do tabernáculo do lado ocidental.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν κώδωνας χρυσοῦς καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τοὺς κώδωνας ἐπὶ τὸ λῶμα τοῦ ὑποδύτου κύκλῳ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ῥοίσκων

text_en: He made also another bar, that might come by the midst of the boards from corner to corner.
text_la: Fecit quoque vectem alium, qui per medias tabulas ab angulo usque ad angulum perveniret.
text_pt: E fez que a travessa do meio passasse pelo meio das tábuas de uma extremidade até a outra.
text_el: κώδων χρυσοῦς καὶ ῥοίσκος ἐπὶ τοῦ λώματος τοῦ ὑποδύτου κύκλῳ εἰς τὸ λειτουργεῖν καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And the boards themselves he overlaid with gold casting for them sockets of silver. And their rings he made of gold, through which the bars might be drawn: and he covered the bars themselves with plates of gold.
text_la: Ipsa autem tabulata deauravit, fusis basibus earum argenteis. Et circulos eorum fecit aureos, per quos vectes induci possent : quos et ipsos laminis aureis operuit.
text_pt: E cobriu as tábuas de ouro, e as suas argolas (os lugares das travessas) fez de ouro; as travessas também cobriu de ouro.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν χιτῶνας βυσσίνους ἔργον ὑφαντὸν Ααρων καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: He made also a veil of violet, and purple, scarlet and fine twisted linen, varied and distinguished with embroidery :
text_la: Fecit et velum de hyacintho, et purpura, vermiculo, ac bysso retorta, opere polymitario, varium atque distinctum:
text_pt: Depois fez o véu de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido; de obra esmerada o fez com querubins.
text_el: καὶ τὰς κιδάρεις ἐκ βύσσου καὶ τὴν μίτραν ἐκ βύσσου καὶ τὰ περισκελῆ ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης

text_en: And four pillars of setim wood , which with their heads he overlaid with gold, casting for them sockets of silver.
text_la: et quatuor columnas de lignis setim, quas cum capitibus deauravit, fusis basibus earum argenteis.
text_pt: E fez-lhe quatro colunas de madeira de acácia, e as cobriu de ouro; e seus colchetes fez de ouro, e fundiu-lhe quatro bases de prata.
text_el: καὶ τὰς ζώνας αὐτῶν ἐκ βύσσου καὶ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου ἔργον ποικιλτοῦ ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: He made also a hanging in the entry of the tabernacle of violet, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, with the work of an embroiderer .
text_la: Fecit et tentorium in introitu tabernaculi ex hyacintho, purpura, vermiculo, byssoque retorta, opere plumarii:
text_pt: Fez também para a porta da tenda o véu de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido, da obra do bordador,
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὸ πέταλον τὸ χρυσοῦν ἀφόρισμα τοῦ ἁγίου χρυσίου καθαροῦ καὶ ἔγραψεν ἐπ' αὐτοῦ γράμματα ἐκτετυπωμένα σφραγῖδος ἁγίασμα κυρίῳ

text_en: And five pillars with their heads, which he covered with gold, and their sockets he cast of brass.
text_la: et columnas quinque cum capitibus suis, quas operuit auro, basesque earum fudit æneas.
text_pt: Com as suas cinco colunas e os seus colchetes; e as suas cabeças e as suas molduras cobriu de ouro; e as suas cinco bases eram de cobre.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπ' αὐτὸ λῶμα ὑακίνθινον ὥστε ἐπικεῖσθαι ἐπὶ τὴν μίτραν ἄνωθεν ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And Beseleel made also, the ark of setim wood : it was two cubits and a half in length, and a cubit and a half in breadth, and the height was of one cubit and a half: and he overlaid it with the purest gold within and without.
text_la: Fecit autem Beseleel et arcam de lignis setim, habentem duos semis cubitos in longitudine, et cubitum ac semissem in latitudine, altitudo quoque unius cubiti fuit et dimidii : vestivitque eam auro purissimo intus ac foris.
text_pt: Fez também Bezalel a arca de madeira de acácia; o seu comprimento era de dois côvados e meio; e a sua largura de um côvado e meio; e a sua altura de um côvado e meio.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τῇ σκηνῇ δέκα αὐλαίας

text_en: And he made to it a crown of gold round about,
text_la: Et fecit illi coronam auream per gyrum,
text_pt: E cobriu-a de ouro puro por dentro e por fora; e fez-lhe uma coroa de ouro ao redor;
text_el: ὀκτὼ καὶ εἴκοσι πήχεων μῆκος τῆς αὐλαίας τῆς μιᾶς τὸ αὐτὸ ἦσαν πᾶσαι καὶ τεσσάρων πηχῶν τὸ εὖρος τῆς αὐλαίας τῆς μιᾶς

text_en: casting four rings of gold at the four corners thereof: two rings in one side, and two in the other.
text_la: conflans quatuor annulos aureos per quatuor angulos ejus : duos annulos in latere uno, et duos in altero.
text_pt: E fundiu-lhe quatro argolas de ouro nos seus quatro cantos; num lado duas, e no outro lado duas argolas;
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὸ καταπέτασμα ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης ἔργον ὑφάντου χερουβιμ

text_en: And he made bars of setim wood , which he overlaid with gold,
text_la: Vectes quoque fecit de lignis setim, quos vestivit auro,
text_pt: E fez varais de madeira de acácia, e os cobriu de ouro;
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκαν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τέσσαρας στύλους ἀσήπτους κατακεχρυσωμένους ἐν χρυσίῳ καὶ αἱ κεφαλίδες αὐτῶν χρυσαῖ καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τέσσαρες ἀργυραῖ

text_en: and he put them into the rings that were at the sides of the ark to carry it.
text_la: et quos misit in annulos, qui erant in lateribus arcæ ad portandum eam.
text_pt: E pôs os varais pelas argolas aos lados da arca, para se levar a arca.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὸ καταπέτασμα τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης ἔργον ὑφάντου χερουβιμ

text_en: He made also the propitiatory, that is, the oracle, of the purest gold, two cubits and a half in length, and a cubit and a half in breadth.
text_la: Fecit et propitiatorium, id est, oraculum, de auro mundissimo, duorum cubitorum et dimidii in longitudine, et cubiti ac semis in latitudine.
text_pt: Fez também o propiciatório de ouro puro; o seu comprimento era de dois côvados e meio, e a sua largura de um côvado e meio.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς στύλους αὐτοῦ πέντε καὶ τοὺς κρίκους καὶ τὰς κεφαλίδας αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς ψαλίδας αὐτῶν κατεχρύσωσαν χρυσίῳ καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν πέντε χαλκαῖ

text_en: Two cherubims also of beaten gold, which he set on the two sides of the propitiatory:
text_la: Duos etiam cherubim ex auro ductili, quos posuit ex utraque parte propitiatorii:
text_pt: Fez também dois querubins de ouro; de obra batida os fez, nas duas extremidades do propiciatório.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὴν αὐλήν τὰ πρὸς λίβα ἱστία τῆς αὐλῆς ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης ἑκατὸν ἐφ' ἑκατόν

text_en: One cherub in the top of one side, and the other cherub in the top of the other side: two cherubims at the two ends of the propitiatory,
text_la: cherub unum in summitate unius partis, et cherub alterum in summitate partis alterius : duos cherubim in singulis summitatibus propitiatorii,
text_pt: Um querubim na extremidade de um lado, e o outro na outra extremidade do outro lado; de uma só peça com o propiciatório fez os querubins nas duas extremidades dele.
text_el: καὶ οἱ στῦλοι αὐτῶν εἴκοσι καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν εἴκοσι

text_en: spreading their wings, and covering the propitiatory, and looking one towards the other, and towards it.
text_la: extendentes alas, et tegentes propitiatorium, seque mutuo et illud respicientes.
text_pt: E os querubins estendiam as asas por cima, cobrindo com elas o propiciatório; e os seus rostos estavam defronte um do outro; os rostos dos querubins estavam virados para o propiciatório.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς βορρᾶν ἑκατὸν ἐφ' ἑκατόν καὶ οἱ στῦλοι αὐτῶν εἴκοσι καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν εἴκοσι

text_en: He made also the table of setim wood , in length two cubits, and in breadth one cubit, and in height it was a cubit and a half.
text_la: Fecit et mensam de lignis setim in longitudine duorum cubitorum, et in latitudine unius cubiti, quæ habebat in altitudine cubitum ac semissem.
text_pt: Fez também a mesa de madeira de acácia; o seu comprimento era de dois côvados, e a sua largura de um côvado, e a sua altura de um côvado e meio.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς θάλασσαν αὐλαῖαι πεντήκοντα πήχεων στῦλοι αὐτῶν δέκα καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν δέκα

text_en: And he overlaid it with the finest gold, and he made to it a golden ledge round about,
text_la: Circumdeditque eam auro mundissimo, et fecit illi labium aureum per gyrum,
text_pt: E cobriu-a de ouro puro, e fez-lhe uma coroa de ouro ao redor.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς πεντήκοντα πήχεων

text_en: and to the ledge itself he made a polished crown of gold, of four fingers breadth, and upon the same another golden crown.
text_la: ipsique labio coronam auream interrasilem quatuor digitorum, et super eamdem, alteram coronam auream.
text_pt: Fez-lhe também, ao redor, uma moldura da largura da mão; e fez uma coroa de ouro ao redor da moldura.
text_el: ἱστία πεντεκαίδεκα πήχεων τὸ κατὰ νώτου καὶ οἱ στῦλοι αὐτῶν τρεῖς καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τρεῖς

text_en: And he cast four rings of gold, which he put in the four corners at each foot of the table,
text_la: Fudit et quatuor circulos aureos, quos posuit in quatuor angulis per singulos pedes mensæ
text_pt: Fundiu-lhe também quatro argolas de ouro; e pôs as argolas nos quatro cantos que estavam em seus quatro pés.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ νώτου τοῦ δευτέρου ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν κατὰ τὴν πύλην τῆς αὐλῆς αὐλαῖαι πεντεκαίδεκα πήχεων καὶ οἱ στῦλοι αὐτῶν τρεῖς καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τρεῖς

text_en: over against the crown: and he put the bars into them, that the table might be carried.
text_la: contra coronam : misitque in eos vectes, ut possit mensa portari.
text_pt: Defronte da moldura estavam as argolas para os lugares dos varais, para se levar a mesa.
text_el: πᾶσαι αἱ αὐλαῖαι τῆς αὐλῆς ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης

text_en: The bars also themselves he made of setim wood , and overlaid them with gold.
text_la: Ipsos quoque vectes fecit de lignis setim, et circumdedit eos auro.
text_pt: Fez também os varais de madeira de acácia, e os cobriu de ouro, para se levar a mesa.
text_el: καὶ αἱ βάσεις τῶν στύλων χαλκαῖ καὶ αἱ ἀγκύλαι αὐτῶν ἀργυραῖ καὶ αἱ κεφαλίδες αὐτῶν περιηργυρωμέναι ἀργυρίῳ καὶ οἱ στῦλοι περιηργυρωμένοι ἀργυρίῳ πάντες οἱ στῦλοι τῆς αὐλῆς

text_en: And the vessels for the divers uses of the table, dishes, bowls, and cups, and censers of pure gold, wherein the libations are to be offered.
text_la: Et vasa ad diversos usus mensæ, acetabula, phialas, et cyathos, et thuribula, ex auro puro, in quibus offerenda sunt libamina.
text_pt: E fez de ouro puro os utensílios que haviam de estar sobre a mesa, os seus pratos e as suas colheres, e as suas tigelas e as suas taças em que se haviam de oferecer libações.
text_el: καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα τῆς πύλης τῆς αὐλῆς ἔργον ποικιλτοῦ ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου νενησμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης εἴκοσι πήχεων τὸ μῆκος καὶ τὸ ὕψος καὶ τὸ εὖρος πέντε πήχεων ἐξισούμενον τοῖς ἱστίοις τῆς αὐλῆς

text_en: He made also the candlestick of beaten work of the finest gold, from the shaft whereof its branches, its cups, and bowls, and lilies came out:
text_la: Fecit et candelabrum ductile de auro mundissimo, de cujus vecte calami, scyphi, sphærulæque, ac lilia procedebant:
text_pt: Fez também o candelabro de ouro puro; de obra batida fez este candelabro; o seu pedestal, e as suas hastes, os seus copos, as suas maçãs, e as suas flores, formavam com ele uma só peça.
text_el: καὶ οἱ στῦλοι αὐτῶν τέσσαρες καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τέσσαρες χαλκαῖ καὶ αἱ ἀγκύλαι αὐτῶν ἀργυραῖ καὶ αἱ κεφαλίδες αὐτῶν περιηργυρωμέναι ἀργυρίῳ

text_en: Six on the two sides: three branches on one side, and three on the other.
text_la: sex in utroque latere, tres calami ex parte una, et tres ex altera:
text_pt: Seis hastes saíam dos seus lados; três hastes do candelabro, de um lado dele, e três do outro lado.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ περιηργυρωμένοι ἀργυρίῳ καὶ πάντες οἱ πάσσαλοι τῆς αὐλῆς κύκλῳ χαλκοῖ

text_en: Three cups in manner of a nut on each branch, and bowls withal and lilies: and three cups of the fashion of a nut in another branch, and bowls withal and lilies. The work of the six branches, that went out from the shaft of the candlestick was equal.
text_la: tres scyphi in nucis modum per calamos singulos, sphærulæque simul et lilia : et tres scyphi instar nucis in calamo altero, sphærulæque simul et lilia. Æquum erat opus sex calamorum, qui procedebant de stipite candelabri.
text_pt: Numa haste estavam três copos do feitio de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor; e na outra haste três copos do feitio de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor; assim eram as seis hastes que saíam do candelabro.
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἡ σύνταξις τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καθὰ συνετάγη Μωυσῇ τὴν λειτουργίαν εἶναι τῶν Λευιτῶν διὰ Ιθαμαρ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως

text_en: And in the shaft itself were four cups after the manner of a nut, and bowls withal at every one, and lilies:
text_la: In ipso autem vecte erant quatuor scyphi in nucis modum, sphærulæque per singulos simul et lilia:
text_pt: Mas no mesmo candelabro havia quatro copos do feitio de amêndoas com os seus botões e com as suas flores.
text_el: καὶ Βεσελεηλ ὁ τοῦ Ουριου ἐκ φυλῆς Ιουδα ἐποίησεν καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And bowls under two branches in three places, which together made six branches going out from one shaft.
text_la: et sphærulæ sub duobus calamis per loca tria, qui simul sex fiunt calami procedentes de vecte uno.
text_pt: E havia um botão debaixo de duas hastes da mesma peça; e outro botão debaixo de duas hastes da mesma peça; e mais um botão debaixo de duas hastes da mesma peça; assim se fez para as seis hastes, que saíam dele.
text_el: καὶ Ελιαβ ὁ τοῦ Αχισαμακ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δαν ὃς ἠρχιτεκτόνησεν τὰ ὑφαντὰ καὶ τὰ ῥαφιδευτὰ καὶ ποικιλτικὰ ὑφᾶναι τῷ κοκκίνῳ καὶ τῇ βύσσῳ

text_en: So both the bowls, and the branches were of the same, all beaten work of the purest gold.
text_la: Et sphærulæ igitur, et calami ex ipso erant, universa ductilia ex auro purissimo.
text_pt: Os seus botões e as suas hastes eram da mesma peça; tudo era uma obra batida de ouro puro.

text_en: He made also the seven lamps with their snuffers, and the vessels where the snuffings were to be put out, of the purest gold.
text_la: Fecit et lucernas septem cum emunctoriis suis, et vasa ubi ea, quæ emuncta sunt, extinguantur, de auro mundissimo.
text_pt: E fez-lhe, de ouro puro, sete lâmpadas com os seus espevitadores e os seus apagadores;

text_en: The candlestick with all the vessels thereof weighed a talent of gold.
text_la: Talentum auri appendebat candelabrum cum omnibus vasis suis.
text_pt: De um talento de ouro puro fez o candelabro e todos os seus utensílios.

text_en: He made also the altar of incense of setim wood , being a cubit on every side foursquare, and in height two cubits: from the corners of which went out horns .
text_la: Fecit et altare thymiamatis de lignis setim, per quadrum singulos habens cubitos, et in altitudine duos : e cujus angulis procedebant cornua.
text_pt: E fez o altar do incenso de madeira de acácia; de um côvado era o seu comprimento, e de um côvado a sua largura, era quadrado; e de dois côvados a sua altura; dele mesmo eram feitas as suas pontas.

text_en: And he overlaid it with the purest gold, with its grate, and the sides, and the horns .
text_la: Vestivitque illud auro purissimo cum craticula ac parietibus et cornibus.
text_pt: E cobriu-o de ouro puro, a parte superior e as suas paredes ao redor, e as suas pontas; e fez-lhe uma coroa de ouro ao redor.

text_en: And he made to it a crown of gold round about, and two golden rings under the crown at each side, that the bars might be put into them, and the altar be carried.
text_la: Fecitque ei coronam aureolam per gyrum, et duos annulos aureos sub corona per singula latera, ut mittantur in eos vectes, et possit altare portari.
text_pt: Fez-lhe também duas argolas de ouro debaixo da sua coroa, e os seus dois cantos, de ambos os seus lados, para neles se colocar os varais, e com eles levá-lo.

text_en: And the bars themselves he made also of setim wood , and overlaid them with plates of gold.
text_la: Ipsos autem vectes fecit de lignis setim, et operuit laminis aureis.
text_pt: E os varais fez de madeira de acácia, e os cobriu de ouro.

text_en: He compounded also the oil for the ointment of sanctification , and incense of the purest spices, according to the work of a perfumer.
text_la: Composuit et oleum ad sanctificationis unguentum, et thymiama de aromatibus mundissimis opere pigmentarii.
text_pt: Também fez o azeite santo da unção, e o incenso aromático, puro, qual obra do perfumista.

text_en: He made also the altar of holocaust of setim wood , five cubits square, and three in height:
text_la: Fecit et altare holocausti de lignis setim, quinque cubitorum per quadrum, et trium in altitudine:
text_pt: Fez também o altar do holocausto de madeira de acácia; de cinco côvados era o seu comprimento, e de cinco côvados a sua largura, era quadrado; e de três côvados a sua altura.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Βεσελεηλ τὴν κιβωτὸν

text_en: The horns whereof went out from the corners, and he overlaid it with plates of brass.
text_la: cujus cornua de angulis procedebant, operuitque illum laminis æneis.
text_pt: E fez-lhe as suas pontas nos seus quatro cantos; da mesma peça eram as suas pontas; e cobriu-o de cobre.
text_el: καὶ κατεχρύσωσεν αὐτὴν χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ ἔσωθεν καὶ ἔξωθεν

text_en: And for the uses thereof, he prepared divers vessels of brass, cauldrons, tongs, fleshhooks, pothooks and firepans.
text_la: Et in usus ejus paravit ex ære vasa diversa, lebetes, forcipes, fuscinulas, uncinos, et ignium receptacula.
text_pt: Fez também todos os utensílios do altar; os cinzeiros, e as pás, e as bacias, e os garfos, e os braseiros; todos esses pertences fez de cobre.
text_el: καὶ ἐχώνευσεν αὐτῇ τέσσαρας δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς δύο ἐπὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ ἓν καὶ δύο ἐπὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ δεύτερον

text_en: And he made the grate thereof of brass, in manner of a net, and under it in the midst of the altar a hearth,
text_la: Craticulamque ejus in modum retis fecit æneam, et subter eam in altaris medio arulam,
text_pt: Fez também, para o altar, um crivo de cobre, em forma de rede, na sua cercadura em baixo, até ao meio do altar.
text_el: εὐρεῖς τοῖς διωστῆρσιν ὥστε αἴρειν αὐτὴν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: casting four rings at the four ends of the net at the top, to put in bars to carry it:
text_la: fusis quatuor annulis per totidem retiaculi summitates, ad immittendos vectes ad portandum:
text_pt: E fundiu quatro argolas para as quatro extremidades do crivo de cobre, para os lugares dos varais.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ ἱλαστήριον ἐπάνωθεν τῆς κιβωτοῦ ἐκ χρυσίου

text_en: And he made the bars of setim wood , and overlaid them with plates of brass:
text_la: quos et ipsos fecit de lignis setim, et operuit laminis æneis:
text_pt: E fez os varais de madeira de acácia, e os cobriu de cobre.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς δύο χερουβιμ χρυσοῦς

text_en: And he drew them through the rings that stood out in the sides of the altar . And the altar itself was not solid, but hollow, of boards, and empty within.
text_la: induxitque in circulos, qui in lateribus altaris eminebant. Ipsum autem altare non erat solidum, sed cavum ex tabulis, et intus vacuum.
text_pt: E pôs os varais pelas argolas aos lados do altar, para com eles levar o altar; fê-lo oco e de tábuas.
text_el: χερουβ ἕνα ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου τὸ ἓν καὶ χερουβ ἕνα ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τὸ δεύτερον τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου

text_en: He made also the laver of brass, with the foot thereof, of the mirrors of the women that watched at the door of the tabernacle .
text_la: Fecit et labrum æneum cum basi sua de speculis mulierum, quæ excubabant in ostio tabernaculi.
text_pt: Fez também a pia de cobre com a sua base de cobre, dos espelhos das mulheres que se reuniam, para servir à porta da tenda da congregação.
text_el: σκιάζοντα ταῖς πτέρυξιν αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ ἱλαστήριον

text_en: He made also the court , in the south side whereof were hangings of fine twisted linen of a hundred cubits.
text_la: Fecit et atrium, in cujus australi plaga erant tentoria de bysso retorta, cubitorum centum,
text_pt: Fez também o pátio do lado meridional; as cortinas do pátio eram de linho fino torcido, de cem côvados.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὴν τράπεζαν τὴν προκειμένην ἐκ χρυσίου καθαροῦ

text_en: Twenty pillars of brass with their sockets, the beads of the pillars, and the whole graving of the work, of silver.
text_la: columnæ æneæ viginti cum basibus suis, capita columnarum, et tota operis cælatura, argentea.
text_pt: As suas vinte colunas e as suas vinte bases eram de cobre; os colchetes destas colunas e as suas molduras eram de prata;
text_el: καὶ ἐχώνευσεν αὐτῇ τέσσαρας δακτυλίους δύο ἐπὶ τοῦ κλίτους τοῦ ἑνὸς καὶ δύο ἐπὶ τοῦ κλίτους τοῦ δευτέρου εὐρεῖς ὥστε αἴρειν τοῖς διωστῆρσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: In like manner at the north side the hangings, the pillars, and the sockets and heads of the pillars were of the same measure, and work and metal .
text_la: Æque ad septentrionalem plagam tentoria columnæ, basesque et capita columnarum ejusdem mensuræ, et operis ac metalli, erant.
text_pt: E do lado norte cortinas de cem côvados; as suas vinte colunas e as suas vinte bases eram de cobre, os colchetes das colunas e as suas molduras eram de prata.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς διωστῆρας τῆς κιβωτοῦ καὶ τῆς τραπέζης ἐποίησεν καὶ κατεχρύσωσεν αὐτοὺς χρυσίῳ

text_en: But on that side that looks to the west, there were hangings of fifty cubits, ten pillars of brass with their sockets, and the heads of the pillars, and all the graving of the work, of silver.
text_la: In ea vero plaga, quæ ad occidentem respicit, fuerunt tentoria cubitorum quinquaginta, columnæ decem cum basibus suis æneæ, et capita columnarum, et tota operis cælatura, argentea.
text_pt: E do lado do ocidente cortinas de cinqüenta côvados, as suas colunas dez, e as suas bases dez; os colchetes das colunas e as suas molduras eram de prata.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὰ σκεύη τῆς τραπέζης τά τε τρυβλία καὶ τὰς θυίσκας καὶ τοὺς κυάθους καὶ τὰ σπονδεῖα ἐν οἷς σπείσει ἐν αὐτοῖς χρυσᾶ

text_en: Moreover, towards the east he prepared hangings of fifty cubits:
text_la: Porro contra orientem quinquaginta cubitorum paravit tentoria:
text_pt: E do lado leste, ao oriente, cortinas de cinqüenta côvados.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὴν λυχνίαν ἣ φωτίζει χρυσῆν στερεὰν τὸν καυλόν

text_en: Fifteen cubits of which, were on one side with three pillars, and their sockets:
text_la: e quibus, quindecim cubitos columnarum trium, cum basibus suis, unum tenebat latus:
text_pt: As cortinas de um lado da porta eram de quinze côvados; as suas colunas três e as suas bases três.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς καλαμίσκους ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν μερῶν αὐτῆς

text_en: And on the other side (for between the two he made the entry of the tabernacle ) there were hangings equally of fifteen cubits, and three pillars, and as many sockets.
text_la: et in parte altera (quia inter utraque introitum tabernaculi fecit) quindecim æque cubitorum erant tentoria, columnæque tres, et bases totidem.
text_pt: E do outro lado da porta do pátio, de ambos os lados, eram cortinas de quinze côvados; as suas colunas três e as suas bases três.
text_el: ἐκ τῶν καλαμίσκων αὐτῆς οἱ βλαστοὶ ἐξέχοντες τρεῖς ἐκ τούτου καὶ τρεῖς ἐκ τούτου ἐξισούμενοι ἀλλήλοις

text_en: All the hangings of the court were woven with twisted linen.
text_la: Cuncta atrii tentoria byssus retorta texuerat.
text_pt: Todas as cortinas do pátio ao redor eram de linho fino torcido.
text_el: καὶ τὰ λαμπάδια αὐτῶν ἅ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τῶν ἄκρων καρυωτὰ ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἐνθέμια ἐξ αὐτῶν ἵνα ὦσιν ἐπ' αὐτῶν οἱ λύχνοι καὶ τὸ ἐνθέμιον τὸ ἕβδομον ἀπ' ἄκρου τοῦ λαμπαδίου ἐπὶ τῆς κορυφῆς ἄνωθεν στερεὸν ὅλον χρυσοῦν

text_en: The sockets of the pillars were of brass, and their heads with all their gravings of silver: and he overlaid the pillars of the court also with silver.
text_la: Bases columnarum fuere æneæ, capita autem earum cum cunctis cælaturis suis argentea : sed et ipsas columnas atrii vestivit argento.
text_pt: E as bases das colunas eram de cobre; os colchetes das colunas e as suas molduras eram de prata; e o revestimento dos seus capitéis era de prata; e todas as colunas do pátio eram cingidas de prata.
text_el: καὶ ἑπτὰ λύχνους ἐπ' αὐτῆς χρυσοῦς καὶ τὰς λαβίδας αὐτῆς χρυσᾶς καὶ τὰς ἐπαρυστρίδας αὐτῶν χρυσᾶς

text_en: And he made in the entry thereof an embroidered hanging of violet, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, that was twenty cubits long, and five cubits high, according to the measure of all the hangings of the court .
text_la: Et in introitu ejus opere plumario fecit tentorium ex hyacintho, purpura, vermiculo, ac bysso retorta, quod habebat viginti cubitos in longitudine, altitudo vero quinque cubitorum erat juxta mensuram, quam cuncta atrii tentoria habebant.
text_pt: E a cobertura da porta do pátio era de obra de bordador, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido; e o comprimento era de vinte côvados, e a altura, na largura, de cinco côvados, conforme as cortinas do pátio.
text_el: οὗτος περιηργύρωσεν τοὺς στύλους καὶ ἐχώνευσεν τῷ στύλῳ δακτυλίους χρυσοῦς καὶ ἐχρύσωσεν τοὺς μοχλοὺς χρυσίῳ καὶ κατεχρύσωσεν τοὺς στύλους τοῦ καταπετάσματος χρυσίῳ καὶ ἐποίησεν τὰς ἀγκύλας χρυσᾶς

text_en: And the pillars in the entry were four, with sockets of brass, and their heads and gravings of silver.
text_la: Columnæ autem in ingressu fuere quatuor cum basibus æneis, capitaque earum et cælaturæ argenteæ.
text_pt: E as suas quatro colunas e as suas quatro bases eram de cobre, os seus colchetes de prata, e o revestimento dos seus capitéis, e as suas molduras, também de prata.
text_el: οὗτος ἐποίησεν καὶ τοὺς κρίκους τῆς σκηνῆς χρυσοῦς καὶ τοὺς κρίκους τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ κρίκους εἰς τὸ ἐκτείνειν τὸ κατακάλυμμα ἄνωθεν χαλκοῦς

text_en: The pins also of the tabernacle and of the court round about he made of brass.
text_la: Paxillos quoque tabernaculi et atrii per gyrum fecit æneos.
text_pt: E todas as estacas do tabernáculo e do pátio ao redor eram de cobre.
text_el: οὗτος ἐχώνευσεν τὰς κεφαλίδας τὰς ἀργυρᾶς τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τὰς κεφαλίδας τὰς χαλκᾶς τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τὴν πύλην τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ ἀγκύλας ἐποίησεν τοῖς στύλοις ἀργυρᾶς ἐπὶ τῶν στύλων οὗτος περιηργύρωσεν αὐτάς

text_en: These are the instruments of the tabernacle of the testimony , which were counted according to the commandment of Moses , in the ceremonies of the Levites , by the hand of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest :
text_la: Hæc sunt instrumenta tabernaculi testimonii, quæ enumerata sunt juxta præceptum Moysi in cæremoniis Levitarum per manum Ithamar filii Aaron sacerdotis:
text_pt: Esta é a enumeração das coisas usadas no tabernáculo do testemunho, que por ordem de Moisés foram contadas para o ministério dos levitas, por intermédio de Itamar, filho de Arão, o sacerdote.
text_el: οὗτος ἐποίησεν καὶ τοὺς πασσάλους τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τοὺς πασσάλους τῆς αὐλῆς χαλκοῦς

text_en: Which Beseleel , the son of Uri, the son of Hur of the tribe of Juda , had made, as the Lord commanded by Moses .
text_la: quæ Beseleel filius Uri filii Hur de tribu Juda, Domino per Moysen jubente, compleverat,
text_pt: Fez, pois, Bezalel, o filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá, tudo quanto o Senhor tinha ordenado a Moisés.
text_el: οὗτος ἐποίησεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χαλκοῦν ἐκ τῶν πυρείων τῶν χαλκῶν ἃ ἦσαν τοῖς ἀνδράσιν τοῖς καταστασιάσασι μετὰ τῆς Κορε συναγωγῆς

text_en: Having for his companion Ooliab, the son of Achisamech, of the tribe of Dan : who also was an excellent artificer in wood, and worker in tapestry and embroidery in violet, purple, scarlet, and fine linen.
text_la: juncto sibi socio Ooliab filio Achisamech de tribu Dan : qui et ipse artifex lignorum egregius fuit, et polymitarius atque plumarius ex hyacintho, purpura, vermiculo et bysso.
text_pt: E com ele Aoliabe, filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã, um mestre de obra, e engenhoso artífice, e bordador em azul, e em púrpura e em carmesim e em linho fino.
text_el: οὗτος ἐποίησεν πάντα τὰ σκεύη τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ τὸ πυρεῖον αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν βάσιν καὶ τὰς φιάλας καὶ τὰς κρεάγρας χαλκᾶς

text_en: All the gold that was spent in the work of the sanctuary, and that was offered in gifts, was nine and twenty talents, and seven hundred and thirty sicles according to the standard of the sanctuary.
text_la: Omne aurum quod expensum est in opere sanctuarii, et quod oblatum est in donariis, viginti novem talentorum fuit, et septingentorum triginta siclorum ad mensuram sanctuarii.
text_pt: Todo o ouro gasto na obra, em toda a obra do santuário, a saber, o ouro da oferta, foi vinte e nove talentos e setecentos e trinta siclos, conforme ao siclo do santuário;
text_el: οὗτος ἐποίησεν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ παράθεμα ἔργον δικτυωτόν κάτωθεν τοῦ πυρείου ὑπὸ αὐτὸ ἕως τοῦ ἡμίσους αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτῷ τέσσαρας δακτυλίους ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων μερῶν τοῦ παραθέματος τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου χαλκοῦς τοῖς μοχλοῖς εὐρεῖς ὥστε αἴρειν τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And it was offered by them that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upwards, of six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty men able to bear arms.
text_la: Oblatum est autem ab his qui transierunt ad numerum a viginti annis et supra, de sexcentis tribus millibus et quingentis quinquaginta armatorum.
text_pt: E a prata dos arrolados da congregação foi cem talentos e mil e setecentos e setenta e cinco siclos, conforme o siclo do santuário;
text_el: οὗτος ἐποίησεν τὸ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως τὸ ἅγιον καὶ τὴν σύνθεσιν τοῦ θυμιάματος καθαρὸν ἔργον μυρεψοῦ

text_en: There were moreover a hundred talents of silver, whereof were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and of the entry where the veil hangs.
text_la: Fuerunt præterea centum talenta argenti e quibus conflatæ sunt bases sanctuarii, et introitus, ubi velum pendet.
text_pt: Um beca por cabeça, isto é, meio siclo, conforme o siclo do santuário; de todo aquele que passava aos arrolados, da idade de vinte anos para cima, que foram seiscentos e três mil e quinhentos e cinqüenta.
text_el: οὗτος ἐποίησεν τὸν λουτῆρα χαλκοῦν καὶ τὴν βάσιν αὐτοῦ χαλκῆν ἐκ τῶν κατόπτρων τῶν νηστευσασῶν αἳ ἐνήστευσαν παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἔπηξεν αὐτήν

text_en: A hundred sockets were made of a hundred talents, one talent being reckoned for every socket.
text_la: Centum bases factæ sunt de talentis centum, singulis talentis per bases singulas supputatis.
text_pt: E houve cem talentos de prata para fundir as bases do santuário e as bases do véu; para as cem bases cem talentos; um talento para cada base.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸν λουτῆρα ἵνα νίπτωνται ἐξ αὐτοῦ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς πόδας εἰσπορευομένων αὐτῶν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἢ ὅταν προσπορεύωνται πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον λειτουργεῖν ἐνίπτοντο ἐξ αὐτοῦ καθάπερ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And of the thousand seven hundred and seventy-five he made the heads of the pillars, which also he overlaid with silver.
text_la: De mille autem septingentis et septuaginta quinque, fecit capita columnarum, quas et ipsas vestivit argento.
text_pt: E dos mil e setecentos e setenta e cinco siclos fez os colchetes das colunas, e cobriu os seus capitéis, e os cingiu de molduras.

text_en: And there were offered of brass also seventy-two thousand talents, and four hundred sicles besides,
text_la: Æris quoque oblata sunt talenta septuaginta duo millia, et quadringenti supra sicli,
text_pt: E o cobre da oferta foi setenta talentos e dois mil e quatrocentos siclos.

text_en: of which were cast the sockets in the entry of the tabernacle of the testimony , and the altar of brass with the grate thereof, and also the vessels that belong to the use thereof.
text_la: ex quibus fusæ sunt bases in introitu tabernaculi testimonii, et altare æneum cum craticula sua, omniaque vasa quæ ad usum ejus pertinent,
text_pt: E dele fez as bases da porta da tenda da congregação e o altar de cobre, e o crivo de cobre e todos os utensílios do altar.

text_en: And the sockets of the court as well round about as in the entry thereof, and the pins of the tabernacle , and of the court round about.
text_la: et bases atrii tam in circuitu quam in ingressu ejus, et paxilli tabernaculi atque atrii per gyrum.
text_pt: E as bases do pátio ao redor, e as bases da porta do pátio, e todas as estacas do tabernáculo e todas as estacas do pátio ao redor.

text_en: And he made, of violet and purple, scarlet and fine linen, the vestments for Aaron to wear when he ministered in the holy places, as the Lord commanded Moses .
text_la: De hyacintho vero et purpura, vermiculo ac bysso, fecit vestes, quibus indueretur Aaron quando ministrabat in sanctis, sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Fizeram também as vestes do ministério, para ministrar no santuário, de azul, e de púrpura e de carmesim; também fizeram as vestes santas, para Arão, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: πᾶν τὸ χρυσίον ὃ κατειργάσθη εἰς τὰ ἔργα κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν ἐργασίαν τῶν ἁγίων ἐγένετο χρυσίου τοῦ τῆς ἀπαρχῆς ἐννέα καὶ εἴκοσι τάλαντα καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι εἴκοσι σίκλοι κατὰ τὸν σίκλον τὸν ἅγιον

text_en: So he made an ephod of gold, violet, and purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine twisted linen,
text_la: Fecit igitur superhumerale de auro, hyacintho, et purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso retorta,
text_pt: Assim se fez o éfode de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim e de linho fino torcido.
text_el: καὶ ἀργυρίου ἀφαίρεμα παρὰ τῶν ἐπεσκεμμένων ἀνδρῶν τῆς συναγωγῆς ἑκατὸν τάλαντα καὶ χίλιοι ἑπτακόσιοι ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε σίκλοι

text_en: with embroidered work , and he cut thin plates of gold, and drew them small into threads, that they might be twisted with the woof of the foresaid colours,
text_la: opere polymitario : inciditque bracteas aureas, et extenuavit in fila, ut possent torqueri cum priorum colorum subtegmine,
text_pt: E estenderam as lâminas de ouro, e as cortaram em fios, para tecê-los entre o azul, e entre a púrpura, e entre o carmesim, e entre o linho fino com trabalho esmerado.
text_el: δραχμὴ μία τῇ κεφαλῇ τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ σίκλου κατὰ τὸν σίκλον τὸν ἅγιον πᾶς ὁ παραπορευόμενος τὴν ἐπίσκεψιν ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω εἰς τὰς ἑξήκοντα μυριάδας καὶ τρισχίλιοι πεντακόσιοι καὶ πεντήκοντα

text_en: and two borders coupled one to the other in the top on either side,
text_la: duasque oras sibi invicem copulatas in utroque latere summitatum,
text_pt: Fizeram-lhe ombreiras que se ajuntavam; e uniam-se em suas duas pontas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ἑκατὸν τάλαντα τοῦ ἀργυρίου εἰς τὴν χώνευσιν τῶν ἑκατὸν κεφαλίδων τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ εἰς τὰς κεφαλίδας τοῦ καταπετάσματος ἑκατὸν κεφαλίδες εἰς τὰ ἑκατὸν τάλαντα τάλαντον τῇ κεφαλίδι

text_en: and a girdle of the same colours, as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: et balteum ex eisdem coloribus, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode, que estava sobre ele, formava com ele uma só peça e era de obra semelhante, de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς χιλίους ἑπτακοσίους ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε σίκλους ἐποίησαν εἰς τὰς ἀγκύλας τοῖς στύλοις καὶ κατεχρύσωσεν τὰς κεφαλίδας αὐτῶν καὶ κατεκόσμησεν αὐτούς

text_en: He prepared also two onyx stones, fast set and closed in gold, and graven, by the art of a lapidary, with the names of the children of Israel :
text_la: Paravit et duos lapides onychinos, astrictos et inclusos auro, et sculptos arte gemmaria nominibus filiorum Israël:
text_pt: Também prepararam as pedras de ônix, engastadas em ouro, lavradas com gravuras de um selo, com os nomes dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ὁ χαλκὸς τοῦ ἀφαιρέματος ἑβδομήκοντα τάλαντα καὶ χίλιοι πεντακόσιοι σίκλοι

text_en: And he set them in the sides of the ephod , for a memorial of the children of Israel , as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: posuitque eos in lateribus superhumeralis in monimentum filiorum Israël, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E as pôs sobre as ombreiras do éfode por pedras de memória para os filhos de Israel, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ τὰς βάσεις τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: He made also a rational with embroidered work , according to the work of the ephod , of gold, violet, purple, and scarlet twice dyed, and fine twisted linen:
text_la: Fecit et rationale opere polymito juxta opus superhumeralis, ex auro, hyacintho, purpura, coccoque bis tincto, et bysso retorta:
text_pt: Fez-se também o peitoral de obra de artífice, como a obra do éfode, de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido.
text_el: καὶ τὰς βάσεις τῆς αὐλῆς κύκλῳ καὶ τὰς βάσεις τῆς πύλης τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ τοὺς πασσάλους τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τοὺς πασσάλους τῆς αὐλῆς κύκλῳ

text_en: Foursquare, double, of the measure of a span.
text_la: quadrangulum, duplex, mensuræ palmi.
text_pt: Quadrado era; duplo fizeram o peitoral; o seu comprimento era de um palmo, e a sua largura de um palmo dobrado.
text_el: καὶ τὸ παράθεμα τὸ χαλκοῦν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐργαλεῖα τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And he set four rows of precious stones in it. In the first row was a sardius, a topaz, an emerald.
text_la: Et posuit in eo gemmarum ordines quatuor. In primo versu erat sardius, topazius, smaragdus.
text_pt: E engastaram nele quatro ordens de pedras; uma ordem de um sárdio, de um topázio, e de um carbúnculo; esta era a primeira ordem;
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ οὕτως ἐποίησαν

text_en: In the second, a carbuncle, a sapphire, and a jasper.
text_la: In secundo, carbunculus, sapphirus, et jaspis.
text_pt: E a segunda ordem de uma esmeralda, de uma safira e de um diamante;
text_el: τὸ δὲ λοιπὸν χρυσίον τοῦ ἀφαιρέματος ἐποίησαν σκεύη εἰς τὸ λειτουργεῖν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: In the third, a ligurius, an agate, and an amethyst.
text_la: In tertio, ligurius, achates, et amethystus.
text_pt: E a terceira ordem de um jacinto, de uma ágata, e de uma ametista;
text_el: καὶ τὴν καταλειφθεῖσαν ὑάκινθον καὶ πορφύραν καὶ τὸ κόκκινον ἐποίησαν στολὰς λειτουργικὰς Ααρων ὥστε λειτουργεῖν ἐν αὐταῖς ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ

text_en: In the fourth, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a beryl, set and enclosed in gold by their rows.
text_la: In quarto, chrysolithus, onychinus, et beryllus, circumdati et inclusi auro per ordines suos.
text_pt: E a quarta ordem de um berilo, e de um ônix, e de um jaspe, engastadas em engastes de ouro.
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκαν τὰς στολὰς πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς βάσεις καὶ τοὺς μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς στύλους

text_en: And the twelve stones, were engraved with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel , each one with its several name .
text_la: Ipsique lapides duodecim sculpti erant nominibus duodecim tribuum Israël, singuli per nomina singulorum.
text_pt: Estas pedras, pois, eram segundo os nomes dos filhos de Israel, doze segundo os seus nomes; como gravuras de selo, cada uma com o seu nome, segundo as doze tribos.
text_el: καὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης καὶ τοὺς διωστῆρας αὐτῆς

text_en: They made also in the rational little chains, linked one to another, of the purest gold,
text_la: Fecerunt in rationali et catenulas sibi invicem cohærentes, de auro purissimo:
text_pt: Também fizeram para o peitoral cadeiazinhas de igual medida, obra de ouro puro trançado.
text_el: καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τῆς χρίσεως καὶ τὸ θυμίαμα τῆς συνθέσεως

text_en: and two hooks, and as many rings of gold. And they set the rings on either side of the rational ,
text_la: et duos uncinos, totidemque annulos aureos. Porro annulos posuerunt in utroque latere rationalis,
text_pt: E fizeram dois engastes de ouro e duas argolas de ouro; e puseram as duas argolas nas duas extremidades do peitoral.
text_el: καὶ τὴν λυχνίαν τὴν καθαρὰν καὶ τοὺς λύχνους αὐτῆς λύχνους τῆς καύσεως καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον τοῦ φωτὸς

text_en: on which rings the two golden chains should hang, which they put into the hooks that stood out in the corners of the ephod .
text_la: e quibus penderent duæ catenæ aureæ, quas inseruerunt uncinis, qui in superhumeralis angulis eminebant.
text_pt: E puseram as duas cadeiazinhas de trança de ouro nas duas argolas, nas duas extremidades do peitoral.
text_el: καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν τῆς προθέσεως καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτῆς σκεύη καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τοὺς προκειμένους

text_en: These both before and behind so answered one another, that the ephod and the rational were bound together,
text_la: Hæc et ante et retro ita conveniebant sibi, ut superhumerale et rationale mutuo necterentur,
text_pt: E as outras duas pontas das duas cadeiazinhas de trança puseram nos dois engastes; e as puseram sobre as ombreiras do éfode na frente dele.
text_el: καὶ τὰς στολὰς τοῦ ἁγίου αἵ εἰσιν Ααρων καὶ τὰς στολὰς τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἱερατείαν

text_en: being fastened to the girdle, and strongly coupled with rings, which a violet fillet joined, lest they should flag loose, and be moved one from the other, as the Lord commanded Moses .
text_la: stricta ad balteum et annulis fortius copulata, quos jungebat vitta hyacinthina, ne laxa fluerent, et a se invicem moverentur, sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Fizeram também duas argolas de ouro, que puseram nas duas extremidades do peitoral, na sua borda que estava junto ao éfode por dentro.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἱστία τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ τοὺς στύλους καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τῆς πύλης τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐργαλεῖα αὐτῆς

text_en: They made also the tunic of the ephod all of violet,
text_la: Feceruntque quoque tunicam superhumeralis totam hyacinthinam,
text_pt: Fizeram mais duas argolas de ouro, que puseram nas duas ombreiras do éfode, abaixo, na frente dele, perto da sua juntura, sobre o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode.
text_el: καὶ τὰς διφθέρας δέρματα κριῶν ἠρυθροδανωμένα καὶ τὰ καλύμματα δέρματα ὑακίνθινα καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν τὰ ἐπικαλύμματα

text_en: and a hole for the head in the upper part at the middle, and a woven border round about the hole:
text_la: et capitium in superiori parte contra medium, oramque per gyrum capitii textilem:
text_pt: E ligaram o peitoral com as suas argolas às argolas do éfode com um cordão de azul, para que estivesse sobre o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode, e o peitoral não se separasse do éfode, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς πασσάλους καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐργαλεῖα τὰ εἰς τὰ ἔργα τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And beneath at the feet pomegranates of violet, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen:
text_la: deorsum autem ad pedes mala punica ex hyacintho, purpura, vermiculo, ac bysso retorta:
text_pt: E fez-se o manto do éfode de obra tecida, todo de azul.
text_el: ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ οὕτως ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀποσκευήν

text_en: And little bells of the purest gold, which they put between the pomegranates at the bottom of the tunic round about:
text_la: et tintinnabula de auro purissimo, quæ posuerunt inter malogranata, in extrema parte tunicæ per gyrum:
text_pt: E a abertura do manto estava no meio dele, como abertura de cota de malha; esta abertura tinha uma borda em volta, para que se não rompesse.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Μωυσῆς πάντα τὰ ἔργα καὶ ἦσαν πεποιηκότες αὐτὰ ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ οὕτως ἐποίησαν αὐτά καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς

text_en: To wit, a bell of gold, and a pomegranate, wherewith the high priest went adorned, when he discharged his ministry, as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: tintinnabulum autem aureum, et malum punicum, quibus ornatus incedebat pontifex quando ministerio fungebatur, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E nas bordas do manto fizeram romãs de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, de fio torcido.

text_en: They made also fine linen tunics with woven work for Aaron and his sons:
text_la: Fecerunt et tunicas byssinas opere textili Aaron et filiis ejus:
text_pt: Fizeram também as campainhas de ouro puro, pondo as campainhas no meio das romãs nas bordas do manto, ao redor, entre as romãs;

text_en: And mitres with their little crowns of fine linen:
text_la: et mitras cum coronulis suis ex bysso:
text_pt: Uma campainha e uma romã, outra campainha e outra romã, nas bordas do manto ao redor; para ministrar, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.

text_en: And linen breeches of fine linen:
text_la: feminalia quoque linea, byssina:
text_pt: Fizeram também as túnicas de linho fino, de obra tecida, para Arão e para seus filhos.

text_en: And a girdle of fine twisted linen, violet, purple, and scarlet twice dyed, of embroidery work , as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: cingulum vero de bysso retorta, hyacintho, purpura, ac vermiculo bis tincto, arte plumaria, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E a mitra de linho fino, e o ornato das tiaras de linho fino, e os calções de linho fino torcido,

text_en: They made also the plate of sacred veneration of the purest gold, and they wrote on it with the engraving of a lapidary: The Holy of the Lord :
text_la: Fecerunt et laminam sacræ venerationis de auro purissimo, scripseruntque in ea opere gemmario, Sanctum Domini:
text_pt: E o cinto de linho fino torcido, e de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, obra de bordador, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.

text_en: And they fastened it to the mitre with a violet fillet, as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: et strinxerunt eam cum mitra vitta hyacinthina, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Fizeram também, de ouro puro, a lâmina da coroa de santidade, e nela escreveram o escrito como de gravura de selo: SANTIDADE AO SENHOR.

text_en: So all the work of the tabernacle and of the roof of the testimony was finished: and the children of Israel did all things which the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: Perfectum est igitur omne opus tabernaculi et tecti testimonii : feceruntque filii Israël cuncta quæ præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E ataram-na com um cordão de azul, para prendê-la à parte superior da mitra, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.

text_en: And they offered the tabernacle , and the roof, and the whole furniture, the rings, the boards, the bars, the pillars and their sockets,
text_la: Et obtulerunt tabernaculum et tectum et universam supellectilem, annulos, tabulas, vectes, columnas ac bases,
text_pt: Assim se acabou toda a obra do tabernáculo da tenda da congregação; e os filhos de Israel fizeram conforme a tudo o que o Senhor ordenara a Moisés; assim o fizeram.

text_en: the cover of rams' skins dyed red, and the other cover of violet skins,
text_la: opertorium de pellibus arietum rubricatis, et aliud operimentum de janthinis pellibus,
text_pt: Depois trouxeram a Moisés o tabernáculo, a tenda e todos os seus pertences; os seus colchetes, as suas tábuas, os seus varais, e as suas colunas, e as suas bases;

text_en: the veil, the ark , the bars, the propitiatory,
text_la: velum; arcam, vectes, propitiatorium,
text_pt: E a cobertura de peles de carneiro tintas de vermelho, e a cobertura de peles de texugos, e o véu de cobertura;

text_en: the table, with the vessels thereof, and the loaves of proposition :
text_la: mensam cum vasis suis et propositionis panibus;
text_pt: A arca do testemunho, e os seus varais, e o propiciatório;

text_en: The candlestick , the lamps, and the furniture of them, with the oil:
text_la: candelabrum, lucernas, et utensilia earum cum oleo;
text_pt: A mesa com todos os seus pertences, e os pães da proposição;

text_en: The altar of gold, and the ointment , and the incense of spices:
text_la: altare aureum, et unguentum, et thymiama ex aromatibus,
text_pt: O candelabro puro com suas lâmpadas, as lâmpadas em ordem, e todos os seus pertences, e o azeite para a luminária;

text_en: And the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle :
text_la: et tentorium in introitu tabernaculi;
text_pt: Também o altar de ouro, e o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático, e a cortina da porta da tenda;

text_en: The altar of brass, the grate, the bars, and all the vessels thereof: the laver, with the foot thereof: the hangings of the court , and the pillars, with their sockets:
text_la: altare æneum, retiaculum, vectes, et vasa ejus omnia; labrum cum basi sua; tentoria atrii, et columnas cum basibus suis;
text_pt: O altar de cobre, e o seu crivo de cobre, os seus varais, e todos os seus pertences, a pia, e a sua base;

text_en: The hanging in the entry of the court , and the little cords, and the pins thereof. Nothing was wanting of the vessels, that were commanded to be made for the ministry of the tabernacle , and for the roof of the covenant.
text_la: tentorium in introitu atrii, funiculosque illius et paxillos. Nihil ex vasis defuit, quæ in ministerium tabernaculi, et in tectum fœderis jussa sunt fieri.
text_pt: As cortinas do pátio, as suas colunas, e as suas bases, e a cortina da porta do pátio, as suas cordas, e os seus pregos, e todos os utensílios do serviço do tabernáculo, para a tenda da congregação;

text_en: The vestments also, which the priests , to wit, Aaron and his sons, use in the sanctuary,
text_la: Vestes quoque, quibus sacerdotes utuntur in sanctuario, Aaron scilicet et filii ejus,
text_pt: As vestes do ministério para ministrar no santuário; as santas vestes de Arão o sacerdote, e as vestes dos seus filhos, para administrarem o sacerdócio.

text_en: the children of Israel offered, as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: obtulerunt filii Israël, sicut præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: Conforme a tudo o que o Senhor ordenara a Moisés, assim fizeram os filhos de Israel toda a obra.

text_en: And when Moses saw all things finished, he blessed them.
text_la: Quæ postquam Moyses cuncta vidit completa, benedixit eis.
text_pt: Viu, pois, Moisés toda a obra, e eis que a tinham feito; como o Senhor ordenara, assim a fizeram; então Moisés os abençoou.

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses , saying:
text_la: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων

text_en: The first month, the first day of the month, you shall set up the tabernacle of the testimony ,
text_la: Mense primo, prima die mensis, eriges tabernaculum testimonii,
text_pt: No primeiro mês, no primeiro dia do mês, levantarás o tabernáculo da tenda da congregação,
text_el: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου νουμηνίᾳ στήσεις τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: and shall put the ark in it, and shall let down the veil before it:
text_la: et pones in eo arcam, dimittesque ante illam velum:
text_pt: E porás nele a arca do testemunho, e cobrirás a arca com o véu.
text_el: καὶ θήσεις τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ σκεπάσεις τὴν κιβωτὸν τῷ καταπετάσματι

text_en: And you shall bring in the table, and set upon it the things that are commanded according to the rite . The candlestick shall stand with its lamps,
text_la: et illata mensa, pones super eam quæ rite præcepta sunt. Candelabrum stabit cum lucernis suis,
text_pt: Depois colocarás nele a mesa, e porás em ordem o que se deve pôr em ordem nela; também colocarás nele o candelabro, e acenderás as suas lâmpadas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσοίσεις τὴν τράπεζαν καὶ προθήσεις τὴν πρόθεσιν αὐτῆς καὶ εἰσοίσεις τὴν λυχνίαν καὶ ἐπιθήσεις τοὺς λύχνους αὐτῆς

text_en: and the altar of gold, whereon the incense is burnt before the ark of the testimony . You shall put the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle ,
text_la: et altare aureum, in quo adoletur incensum, coram arca testimonii. Tentorium in introitu tabernaculi pones,
text_pt: E porás o altar de ouro para o incenso diante da arca do testemunho; então pendurarás a cortina da porta do tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ θήσεις τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν εἰς τὸ θυμιᾶν ἐναντίον τῆς κιβωτοῦ καὶ ἐπιθήσεις κάλυμμα καταπετάσματος ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: and before it the altar of holocaust .
text_la: et ante illud altare holocausti:
text_pt: Porás também o altar do holocausto diante da porta do tabernáculo da tenda da congregação.
text_el: καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν καρπωμάτων θήσεις παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: The laver between the altar and the tabernacle , and you shall fill it with water.
text_la: labrum inter altare et tabernaculum, quod implebis aqua.
text_pt: E porás a pia entre a tenda da congregação e o altar, e nela porás água.

text_en: And you shall encompass the court with hangings, and the entry thereof.
text_la: Circumdabisque atrium tentoriis, et ingressum ejus.
text_pt: Depois porás o pátio ao redor, e pendurarás a cortina à porta do pátio.
text_el: καὶ περιθήσεις τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτῆς ἁγιάσεις κύκλῳ

text_en: And you shall take the oil of unction and anoint the tabernacle with its vessels, that they may be sanctified :
text_la: Et assumpto unctionis oleo unges tabernaculum cum vasis suis, ut sanctificentur:
text_pt: Então tomarás o azeite da unção, e ungirás o tabernáculo, e tudo o que há nele; e o santificarás com todos os seus pertences, e será santo.
text_el: καὶ λήμψῃ τὸ ἔλαιον τοῦ χρίσματος καὶ χρίσεις τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἁγιάσεις αὐτὴν καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ ἔσται ἁγία

text_en: The altar of holocaust and all its vessels:
text_la: altare holocausti et omnia vasa ejus,
text_pt: Ungirás também o altar do holocausto, e todos os seus utensílios; e santificarás o altar; e o altar será santíssimo.
text_el: καὶ χρίσεις τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν καρπωμάτων καὶ πάντα αὐτοῦ τὰ σκεύη καὶ ἁγιάσεις τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ ἔσται τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἅγιον τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: The laver with its foot: you shall consecrate all with the oil of unction, that they may be most holy .
text_la: labrum cum basi sua : omnia unctionis oleo consecrabis, ut sint Sancta sanctorum.
text_pt: Então ungirás a pia e a sua base, e a santificarás.

text_en: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony , and having washed them with water,
text_la: Applicabisque Aaron et filios ejus ad fores tabernaculi testimonii, et lotos aqua
text_pt: Farás também chegar a Arão e a seus filhos à porta da tenda da congregação; e os lavarás com água.
text_el: καὶ προσάξεις Ααρων καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ λούσεις αὐτοὺς ὕδατι

text_en: you shall put on them the holy vestments , that they may minister to me, and that the unction of them may prosper to an everlasting priesthood .
text_la: indues sanctis vestibus, ut ministrent mihi, et unctio eorum in sacerdotium sempiternum proficiat.
text_pt: E vestirás a Arão as vestes santas, e o ungirás, e o santificarás, para que me administre o sacerdócio.
text_el: καὶ ἐνδύσεις Ααρων τὰς στολὰς τὰς ἁγίας καὶ χρίσεις αὐτὸν καὶ ἁγιάσεις αὐτόν καὶ ἱερατεύσει μοι

text_en: And Moses did all that the Lord had commanded.
text_la: Fecitque Moyses omnia quæ præceperat Dominus.
text_pt: Também farás chegar a seus filhos, e lhes vestirás as túnicas,
text_el: καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ προσάξεις καὶ ἐνδύσεις αὐτοὺς χιτῶνας

text_en: So in the first month of the second year, the first day of the month, the tabernacle was set up.
text_la: Igitur mense primo anni secundi, prima die mensis, collocatum est tabernaculum.
text_pt: E os ungirás como ungiste a seu pai, para que me administrem o sacerdócio, e a sua unção lhes será por sacerdócio perpétuo nas suas gerações.
text_el: καὶ ἀλείψεις αὐτούς ὃν τρόπον ἤλειψας τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν καὶ ἱερατεύσουσίν μοι καὶ ἔσται ὥστε εἶναι αὐτοῖς χρῖσμα ἱερατείας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: And Moses reared it up, and placed the boards and the sockets and the bars, and set up the pillars,
text_la: Erexitque Moyses illud, et posuit tabulas ac bases et vectes, statuitque columnas,
text_pt: E Moisés fez conforme a tudo o que o Senhor lhe ordenou, assim o fez.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ κύριος οὕτως ἐποίησεν

text_en: and spread the roof over the tabernacle , putting over it a cover, as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: et expandit tectum super tabernaculum, imposito desuper operimento, sicut Dominus imperaverat.
text_pt: Assim, no primeiro mês, no ano segundo, ao primeiro dia do mês foi levantado o tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πρώτῳ τῷ δευτέρῳ ἔτει ἐκπορευομένων αὐτῶν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου νουμηνίᾳ ἐστάθη ἡ σκηνή

text_en: And he put the testimony in the ark , thrusting bars underneath, and the oracle above.
text_la: Posuit et testimonium in arca, subditis infra vectibus, et oraculum desuper.
text_pt: Moisés levantou o tabernáculo, e pôs as suas bases, e armou as suas tábuas, e colocou nele os seus varais, e levantou as suas colunas;
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν Μωυσῆς τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τὰς κεφαλίδας καὶ διενέβαλεν τοὺς μοχλοὺς καὶ ἔστησεν τοὺς στύλους

text_en: And when he had brought the ark into the tabernacle , he drew the veil before it to fulfil the commandment of the Lord .
text_la: Cumque intulisset arcam in tabernaculum, appendit ante eam velum ut expleret Domini jussionem.
text_pt: E estendeu a tenda sobre o tabernáculo, e pôs a cobertura da tenda sobre ela, em cima, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν τὰς αὐλαίας ἐπὶ τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τὸ κατακάλυμμα τῆς σκηνῆς ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἄνωθεν καθὰ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And he set the table in the tabernacle of the testimony , at the north side, without the veil,
text_la: Posuit et mensam in tabernaculo testimonii ad plagam septentrionalem extra velum,
text_pt: Tomou o testemunho, e pô-lo na arca, e colocou os varais na arca; e pôs o propiciatório em cima da arca.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν τὰ μαρτύρια ἐνέβαλεν εἰς τὴν κιβωτὸν καὶ ὑπέθηκεν τοὺς διωστῆρας ὑπὸ τὴν κιβωτὸν

text_en: setting there in order the loaves of proposition , as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: ordinatis coram propositionis panibus, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E introduziu a arca no tabernáculo, e pendurou o véu da cobertura, e cobriu a arca do testemunho, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν τὴν κιβωτὸν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τὸ κατακάλυμμα τοῦ καταπετάσματος καὶ ἐσκέπασεν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: He set the candlestick also in the tabernacle of the testimony , over against the table on the south side,
text_la: Posuit et candelabrum in tabernaculo testimonii e regione mensæ in parte australi,
text_pt: pôs também a mesa na tenda da congregação, ao lado do tabernáculo, para o norte, fora do véu,
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν τράπεζαν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐπὶ τὸ κλίτος τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου τὸ πρὸς βορρᾶν ἔξωθεν τοῦ καταπετάσματος τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: placing the lamps in order, according to the precept of the Lord .
text_la: locatis per ordinem lucernis, juxta præceptum Domini.
text_pt: E sobre ela pôs em ordem o pão perante o Senhor, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ προέθηκεν ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως ἔναντι κυρίου ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: He set also the altar of gold under the roof of the testimony , over against the veil,
text_la: Posuit et altare aureum sub tecto testimonii contra velum,
text_pt: pôs também na tenda da congregação o candelabro na frente da mesa, ao lado do tabernáculo, para o sul,
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν λυχνίαν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου εἰς τὸ κλίτος τῆς σκηνῆς τὸ πρὸς νότον

text_en: and burnt upon it the incense of spices, as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: et adolevit super eo incensum aromatum, sicut jusserat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: E acendeu as lâmpadas perante o Senhor, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τοὺς λύχνους αὐτῆς ἔναντι κυρίου ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And he put also the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle of the testimony ,
text_la: Posuit et tentorium in introitu tabernaculi testimonii,
text_pt: E pôs o altar de ouro na tenda da congregação, diante do véu,
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἀπέναντι τοῦ καταπετάσματος

text_en: and the altar of holocaust in the entry of the testimony , offering the holocaust , and the sacrifices upon it, as the Lord had commanded.
text_la: et altare holocausti in vestibulo testimonii, offerens in eo holocaustum, et sacrificia, ut Dominus imperaverat.
text_pt: E acendeu sobre ele o incenso de especiarias aromáticas, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυμίασεν ἐπ' αὐτοῦ τὸ θυμίαμα τῆς συνθέσεως καθάπερ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: And he set the laver between the tabernacle of the testimony and the altar , filling it with water.
text_la: Labrum quoque statuit inter tabernaculum testimonii et altare, implens illud aqua.
text_pt: Pendurou também a cortina da porta do tabernáculo,

text_en: And Moses and Aaron , and his sons, washed their hands and feet ,
text_la: Laveruntque Moyses et Aaron ac filii ejus manus suas et pedes,
text_pt: E pôs o altar do holocausto à porta do tabernáculo da tenda da congregação, e sobre ele ofereceu holocausto e oferta de alimentos, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν καρπωμάτων ἔθηκεν παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς

text_en: when they went into the tabernacle of the covenant , and went to the altar , as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: cum ingrederentur tectum fœderis, et accederent ad altare, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Pôs também a pia entre a tenda da congregação e o altar, e nela pôs água para lavar.

text_en: He set up also the court round about the tabernacle and the altar , drawing the hanging in the entry thereof. After all things were perfected,
text_la: Erexit et atrium per gyrum tabernaculi et altaris, ducto in introitu ejus tentorio. Postquam omnia perfecta sunt,
text_pt: E Moisés, e Arão e seus filhos nela lavaram as suas mãos e os seus pés.

text_en: the cloud covered the tabernacle of the testimony , and the glory of the Lord filled it.
text_la: operuit nubes tabernaculum testimonii, et gloria Domini implevit illud.
text_pt: Quando entravam na tenda da congregação, e quando chegavam ao altar, lavavam-se, como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.

text_en: Neither could Moses go into the tabernacle of the covenant , the cloud covering all things, and the majesty of the Lord shining, for the cloud had covered all.
text_la: Nec poterat Moyses ingredi tectum fœderis, nube operiente omnia, et majestate Domini coruscante, quia cuncta nubes operuerat.
text_pt: Levantou também o pátio ao redor do tabernáculo e do altar, e pendurou a cortina da porta do pátio. Assim Moisés acabou a obra.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν τὴν αὐλὴν κύκλῳ τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ συνετέλεσεν Μωυσῆς πάντα τὰ ἔργα

text_en: If at any time the cloud removed from the tabernacle , the children of Israel went forward by their troops:
text_la: Siquando nubes tabernaculum deserebat, proficiscebantur filii Israël per turmas suas:
text_pt: Então a nuvem cobriu a tenda da congregação, e a glória do Senhor encheu o tabernáculo;
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλυψεν ἡ νεφέλη τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ δόξης κυρίου ἐπλήσθη ἡ σκηνή

text_en: If it hung over, they remained in the same place.
text_la: si pendebat desuper, manebant in eodem loco.
text_pt: De maneira que Moisés não podia entrar na tenda da congregação, porquanto a nuvem permanecia sobre ela, e a glória do Senhor enchia o tabernáculo.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθη Μωυσῆς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ὅτι ἐπεσκίαζεν ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἡ νεφέλη καὶ δόξης κυρίου ἐπλήσθη ἡ σκηνή

text_en: For the cloud of the Lord hung over the tabernacle by day, and a fire by night, in the sight of all the children of Israel throughout all their mansions.
text_la: Nubes quippe Domini incubabat per diem tabernaculo, et ignis in nocte, videntibus cunctis populis Israël per cunctas mansiones suas.
text_pt: Quando, pois, a nuvem se levantava de sobre o tabernáculo, então os filhos de Israel caminhavam em todas as suas jornadas.
text_el: ἡνίκα δ' ἂν ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς ἀνεζεύγνυσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ σὺν τῇ ἀπαρτίᾳ αὐτῶν

text_en: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
text_pt: Se a nuvem, porém, não se levantava, não caminhavam, até ao dia em que ela se levantasse;
text_el: εἰ δὲ μὴ ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη οὐκ ἀνεζεύγνυσαν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἀνέβη ἡ νεφέλη

text_en: For the cloud of the LORD {was} upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
text_pt: Porquanto a nuvem do Senhor estava de dia sobre o tabernáculo, e o fogo estava de noite sobre ele, perante os olhos de toda a casa de Israel, em todas as suas jornadas.
text_el: νεφέλη γὰρ ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς ἡμέρας καὶ πῦρ ἦν ἐπ' αὐτῆς νυκτὸς ἐναντίον παντὸς Ισραηλ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἀναζυγαῖς αὐτῶν
